title: When Does Adaptive Guidance Help? Belief-Aware Privileged Distillation for Autonomous Driving Under Partial Observability
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Accepted at CVPR 2026 Workshop on Autonomous Driving (WAD)
summary: Guided Soft Actor-Critic (GSAC) distills knowledge from a privileged full-state teacher to a partial-observation student for autonomous driving, but uses a fixed distillation coefficient lambda regardless of the agent's uncertainty. We present Belief-Aware GSAC (BA-GSAC), which modulates lambda via ensemble disagreement, and use it as a testbed for a systematic empirical study asking: when does adaptive guidance actually help? Evaluating five strategies (fixed lambda in {0.01, 0.1}, adaptive, linear decay, and vanilla SAC) across three POMDP difficulty levels on Highway-Env, we find that preliminary single-seed runs suggest benefits under mild and moderate partial observability, but under severe occlusion (evaluated with 3 seeds for all methods) the adaptive coefficient collapses to lambda_min within about 3K steps. We trace this to an observability blindness phenomenon: because the ensemble predicts partial observations, it achieves low disagreement even under heavy occlusion, modeling what is visible but unable to detect what is missing. We diagnose the root cause and propose an architectural fix (training the ensemble on full-state predictions using the guiding actor's privileged access); while not validated here, we show that even with current limitations, the warmup phase provides measurable stabilization (CV=13.3% vs. 29.8% for constant lambda=0.01). In fact, a simple deterministic linear decay schedule achieves the best severe-POMDP performance across all metrics (mean 116.5, CV=8.9%), suggesting that the scheduling effect, not the ensemble, drives the stability benefit. These findings provide practical guidance for designing uncertainty-aware teacher-student frameworks and highlight ensemble prediction targets as an important design choice.

AI.tldr: BA-GSAC通过集成不确定性自适应调节蒸馏系数，但实验发现自适应机制在严重遮挡下失效，简单的线性衰减调度反而表现更好，揭示了集成预测目标选择的重要性。
AI.motivation: GSAC中蒸馏系数λ固定，未考虑智能体的不确定性。BA-GSAC旨在通过集成分歧自适应调节λ，并系统研究自适应指导何时有效。
AI.method: 提出Belief-Aware GSAC (BA-GSAC)，使用集成分歧（ensemble disagreement）动态调制蒸馏系数λ。在Highway-Env上设置三种POMDP难度，对比五种策略：固定λ∈{0.01, 0.1}、自适应、线性衰减和vanilla SAC。
AI.result: 单种子初步实验显示在轻度和中度部分可观测性下自适应有益；但在严重遮挡下（3种子验证），自适应系数在约3K步内坍缩至λ_min。线性衰减调度在严重POMDP下表现最佳（均值116.5, CV=8.9%），而自适应λ的CV=13.3% vs 固定λ=0.01的CV=29.8%。
AI.conclusion: 自适应机制在严重遮挡下失效的原因是"可观测性盲区"：集成基于部分观测预测，低分歧无法反映观测缺失。建议将集成训练于全状态预测。实际工程中，简单调度策略（线性衰减）比复杂自适应更稳健。

title: PhyPush: One Push is All You Need for Sensorless Physical Property Estimation with Physics-Guided Transformers
comment: Submitted to 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems
summary: Accurately estimating object mass and friction is fundamental to achieving reliable and adaptive robotic manipulation. Although interactive perception provides a powerful mechanism for inferring such properties, most existing approaches depend on specialized hardware such as force/torque sensors, tactile arrays, or multi-camera motion-capture systems, limiting scalability and deployment. This paper presents PhyPush, a physics-guided Transformer framework that estimates an object's mass and friction coefficient using only kinematically derived end-effector velocity from a single push. This typically requires data available on standard robotic arms. The model incorporates constraints from Newton's second law and the Coulomb friction model through a physics-guided loss, improving physical consistency and generalization to unseen objects and surfaces. Across diverse simulation and real-world setups, PhyPush consistently achieves more accurate mass and friction estimation in challenging out-of-domain conditions. In simulation, it reduces error by over 10% compared with a baseline that has privileged access to full force information, while in real-world experiments, it outperforms a data-driven loss approach. Overall, the results demonstrate that physics-guided learning can enable low-cost, sensor-efficient estimation of physical properties, relying solely on a single push and readily available kinematic data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PhyPush，一种物理引导的Transformer框架，仅利用单次推搡的末端执行器速度即可估计物体质量和摩擦系数，无需力/力矩传感器、触觉阵列等多摄像头运动捕捉系统等专用硬件。
AI.motivation: 现有物体质量和摩擦估计方法依赖力/力矩传感器、触觉阵列或多摄像头运动捕捉等专用硬件，限制了可扩展性和实际部署。为解决这一问题，本文探索仅利用标准机械臂可获取的末端执行器运动学数据进行物理属性估计。
AI.method: 基于Transformer架构，输入为单次推搡动作中机械臂末端执行器的运动学速度数据；引入物理引导损失函数，将牛顿第二定律和库仑摩擦模型作为约束条件融入训练过程；在仿真和真实世界场景中进行跨域泛化测试。
AI.result: 仿真实验中，相比可获得完整力信息的基线方法，PhyPush误差降低超过10%；真实实验中，优于纯数据驱动损失方法。在面向未知物体和表面的挑战性跨域条件下仍保持较高精度。
AI.conclusion: 物理引导学习能够在仅依赖单次推搡和现成运动学数据的条件下，实现低成本、传感器高效的物理属性估计，为机器人操作中无需专用传感器的质量与摩擦感知提供了可行方案。

title: Collaborative Navigation and Exploration with $β$-Sparse Gaussian Processes
summary: Collaborative navigation of heterogeneous robots in unknown environments poses significant challenges due to sensing, communication, and computational limitations. In this work, a lead robot navigates toward a target while a mobile sensor robot (e.g., a drone) assists by transmitting information about its locally observed environment under bandwidth constraints. We propose a framework that enables the sensor to jointly select its transmitted map points and navigation actions online, while also predicting unexplored regions of the environment. To this end, we present $β$-Sparse Gaussian Processes, a novel and robust variational sparse Gaussian Process model for task-aware inducing point selection. Furthermore, we develop an action-selection strategy that balances task relevance with exploration. Simulations on Mars and Earth maps show that the framework can reduce path cost by 18% relative to no communication and decrease transmitted information by 76% compared to raw-data transmission baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向异构机器人协作导航的框架，通过β-稀疏高斯过程实现任务感知的诱导点选择，在未知环境中联合优化通信、动作选择与环境预测，在降低路径成本18%的同时减少76%的信息传输量。
AI.motivation: 异构机器人在未知环境中的协作导航面临感知、通信和计算资源的严重限制，如何在带宽约束下高效共享环境信息以辅助领航机器人导航是核心挑战。
AI.method: 提出β-稀疏高斯过程（β-Sparse Gaussian Processes）用于任务感知的诱导点选择，同时开发了平衡任务相关性与探索的动作选择策略，实现传感器在线联合选择传输地图点和导航动作。
AI.result: 在火星和地球地图上的仿真显示，该框架相比无通信基线降低了18%的路径成本，相比原始数据传输基线减少了76%的传输信息量。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效缓解了带宽约束下异构机器人协作导航的通信瓶颈，通过智能选择传输内容与导航动作，在保障导航性能的同时显著降低通信负载。

title: NightSight: Passive Computation for Navigation in Dark Using Events
summary: Small aerial robots are particularly well-suited for search and rescue in confined and hazardous environments due to their agility, low cost, and ability to traverse through cluttered spaces that are inaccessible to larger platforms. However, enabling autonomous navigation in complete darkness remains a significant challenge, because small aerial robots cannot easily accommodate perception systems that demand substantial payload, power, or computation. In this work, we present a lightweight perception approach that combines a monocular event camera, a coded aperture lens, and an infrared dot projector to enable navigation in such conditions. The projected pattern, when imaged through the coded aperture, produces depth dependent blur signatures that implicitly encode scene geometry. We train a convolutional neural network to decode these signatures into dense depth maps using only synthetic data generated from a simple planar wall setup. Despite this minimal training regime, the model generalizes zero-shot to complex real-world scenes. Our system operates in real time at 20 Hz on a NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano, demonstrating suitability for resource-constrained platforms. We further analyze the impact of different coded aperture designs on depth estimation performance. Our approach gives high accuracy (l1 error 7.0cm) upto 2.5m range (2.80% error). These results highlight the potential of combining structured illumination, coded optics, and event-based sensing for enabling robust perception and navigation in complete darkness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种轻量级感知方法，结合单目事件相机、编码孔径镜头和红外点阵投影器，使小型空中机器人在完全黑暗环境中实现自主导航。系统通过投影图案经编码孔径成像产生深度相关的模糊特征，利用CNN从合成数据中学习解码为密集深度图，在NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano上以20Hz实时运行，2.5m范围内误差仅7.0cm（2.80%）。
AI.motivation: 小型空中机器人在封闭危险环境中执行搜救任务具有优势，但完全黑暗条件下的自主导航极具挑战，因为小型平台无法承载需要大载荷、高功耗或高计算资源的传统感知系统。
AI.method: 采用单目事件相机、编码孔径镜头和红外点阵投影器的轻量级组合；投影图案经编码孔径成像产生与深度相关的模糊特征；训练CNN从简单平面墙合成数据中学习解码这些特征为密集深度图。
AI.result: 系统在NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano上以20Hz实时运行；仅用合成数据训练的模型零样本泛化到真实复杂场景；2.5m范围内L1误差7.0cm（2.80%）；分析了不同编码孔径设计对深度估计性能的影响。
AI.conclusion: 结合结构光照明、编码光学和事件相机感知的方法在完全黑暗环境下实现鲁棒感知和导航方面具有潜力，为资源受限的小型空中机器人提供了可行的黑暗环境导航方案。

title: Geometry-Aware Representation Denoising for Robust Multi-view 3D Reconstruction
summary: Multi-view 3D reconstruction has achieved remarkable progress with the advent of feed-forward 3D reconstruction models. However, these models are typically trained and evaluated under ideal, degradation-free imaging conditions, whereas real-world observations often contain degradations that differ significantly from such settings. Improving robustness for multi-view 3D reconstruction under degraded conditions therefore remains an important challenge. We present Geometry-Aware Representation Denoising (GARD), a novel framework that performs diffusion-based multi-view restoration directly in the feature space of a feed-forward 3D reconstruction model. This design exploits the geometry-aware feature representations of the 3D reconstructor to effectively recover accurate scene geometry. Furthermore, by employing an additional RGB image decoder, the refined representations can also be used to restore high-quality RGB images, thereby enabling the simultaneous recovery of 3D scene geometry and high-quality imagery. Comprehensive experiments on the Depth Anything 3 (DA3) benchmark demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed GARD framework.

AI.tldr: GARD是一个在feed-forward 3D重建模型的特征空间中进行扩散式多视图恢复的框架，能够同时恢复3D场景几何和高质量RGB图像，在DA3基准上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有feed-forward 3D重建模型通常在理想无退化条件下训练和评估，而实际观测中存在各种退化，亟需提升多视图3D重建在退化条件下的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出GARD框架，在feed-forward 3D重建模型的特征空间内执行基于扩散的多视图恢复，利用3D重建器的几何感知特征表示来恢复准确的场景几何，并额外使用RGB图像解码器同步恢复高质量图像。
AI.result: 在Depth Anything 3 (DA3)基准上的综合实验证明了GARD框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: GARD通过特征空间中的扩散式去噪实现了退化条件下多视图3D几何与RGB图像的联合恢复，为解决实际场景中的鲁棒3D重建问题提供了有效途径。

title: GEM: Geometric Entropy Mixing for Optimal LLM Data Curation
summary: LLM pre-training efficacy increasingly depends on data composition rather than sheer volume. Yet, optimal mixing is hindered by categorization flaws: human taxonomies suffer from ontological misalignment, and Euclidean clustering fails to address embedding anisotropy. We introduce GEM (Geometric Entropy Mixing), a framework reformulating data curation as a variational problem on the hypersphere augmented with a mixing-balance regularizer. By decoupling the generative prior and optimizing the objective via a provable MM (Minorize-Maximize) algorithm, GEM effectively counteracts the cluster collapse to discover balanced semantic structures invisible to Euclidean heuristics. We employ teacher-student distillation to scale this geometric fidelity to web-scale corpora and introduce the Geometric Influence Score (GIS) for interpretable taxonomy generation. Experiments with 1.1B-parameter models demonstrate that GEM establishes a new state-of-the-art when integrated into mixing strategies like DoReMi and RegMix, improving average downstream accuracy by up to 1.2% and offering a robust coordinate system for predictable data mixing.

AI.tldr: GEM（几何熵混合）是一个将数据配比重构为超球面上的变分问题，通过MM算法优化混合平衡正则化器，结合师生蒸馏实现大规模语料库的几何保真度，显著提升下游任务准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有数据混合策略受限于分类缺陷：人工分类存在本体论错位，欧几里得聚类无法处理嵌入各向异性，导致最优混合难以实现。
AI.method: 将数据配比形式化为超球面上的变分问题，引入混合平衡正则化器；通过MM（Minorize-Maximize）算法解耦生成先验并优化目标；利用师生蒸馏实现网络规模语料库的几何保真度；提出几何影响分数（GIS）用于可解释的类别生成。
AI.result: 在1.1B参数模型上，GEM集成到DoReMi和RegMix等混合策略中，将平均下游准确率提升高达1.2%，实现了新的最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: GEM提供了一个鲁棒的坐标系统用于可预测的数据混合，有效对抗聚类坍缩，发现欧几里得启发式方法无法察觉的平衡语义结构。

title: RCSP: Risk-Sensitive Conjectural Scenario Planning for Safe Dynamic Robot Navigation
summary: Mobile robots can fail before they collide: a velocity that is safe now may commit the robot to a passage that moving obstacles will soon close. We study this predictive near-miss commitment problem and propose Risk-Sensitive Conjectural Scenario Planning (RCSP), a planning layer that evaluates candidate commands against plausible short-horizon obstacle futures. RCSP maintains a lightweight belief over local motion conjectures, samples future interactions, penalizes high-risk tails, and executes through a local safety check. In controlled MuJoCo bottleneck tasks, the RCSP planner reaches the goal without collisions and yields higher secondary safety and path-quality point estimates than a non-adaptive predictor, with additional latency. In ROS2/Gazebo, adding the local safety layer to a standard Nav2 stack reduces dynamic near-miss failures. On official DynaBARN/Jackal transfer, tuned DWA and TEB remain stronger on strict benchmark success, revealing the boundary of the approach. These simulation results position RCSP as a predictive-risk module that complements existing navigation stacks in dynamic bottleneck regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出风险敏感猜想情景规划（RCSP），一种针对移动机器人在动态障碍物环境中预测性近失问题（即使当前安全的速度也可能因未来障碍物运动而失效）的规划层。RCSP通过维护轻量级局部运动猜想信念、采样未来交互、惩罚高风险尾部分布，并辅以局部安全检查执行。在MuJoCo瓶颈任务中，RCSP相比非自适应预测器实现零碰撞、更高的次生安全性和路径质量。在ROS2/Gazebo中为Nav2堆栈添加局部安全层可减少动态近失故障，而在官方DynaBARN/Jackal迁移测试中，DWA和TEB在严格基准成功率上仍更优，揭示了该方法的应用边界。整体而言，RCSP定位为一种在动态瓶颈场景中补充现有导航堆栈的预测性风险模块。
AI.motivation: 移动机器人面临的"预测性近失承诺问题"：当前看似安全的速度可能将机器人约束到一条即将被移动障碍物封闭的通路，现有方法缺乏对这种未来风险的预测能力。
AI.method: RCSP包含三个关键环节：(1) 维护对局部运动猜想的轻量级信念分布；(2) 采样未来交互情景并评估候选指令；(3) 惩罚高风险的尾部分布（风险敏感），并通过局部安全检查执行。
AI.result: 在MuJoCo中：零碰撞、更高的次生安全性和路径质量指标，但增加了延迟。在ROS2/Gazebo中：为Nav2堆栈添加该层可减少动态近失故障。在DynaBARN/Jackal迁移测试中：DWA和TEB在严格基准成功率上仍更强。
AI.conclusion: RCSP可作为一种预测性风险模块，在动态瓶颈场景中补充现有导航堆栈，但存在应用边界，不能在所有场景下取代传统规划器。

title: Not All Modalities Are Equal: Instruction-Aware Gating for Multimodal Videos
summary: Pre-trained video large language models excel at visual reasoning. However, they struggle when videos arrive with auxiliary streams, such as audio, depth map, or dense temporal evidence. In such a scenario, uniform fusion induces modality interference, allowing irrelevant channels to distract the model. To address this issue, we present a unified multimodal video understanding framework, named UniMVU, that performs instruction-aware fusion across video, audio, depth map, or any other modality inputs via two levels of dynamic gating: inner-modality gates emphasize salient regions within each modality, whereas modality-level gates re-weight whole streams; both are conditioned on the text instruction to adaptively balance modality importance. Our UniMVU combines cross-modal self-attention with instruction-driven inner-modality gating module and a modality-level gating module with control token; for time-aligned streams we further adopt a fast-to-slow fusion scheme that reduces redundancy. Across six benchmarks (AVQA, AVSD, Music-AVQA, ScanQA, SQA3D and MVBench), our UniMVU achieves consistent gains over static-fusion baselines achieving gains as high as 13.5 in terms of CIDEr metric. Further, our analysis shows that the gating mechanism aligns with the human-interpretable modality relevance, and ablations show the contributions of inner-modality and modality-level gating. Our UniMVU provides a simple, unified recipe for instruction-aware multimodal video understanding that scales to diverse modalities without hand-crafted fusion rules.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UniMVU，一种统一的指令感知多模态视频理解框架，通过两层动态门控（模态内门控和模态级门控）实现视频、音频、深度图等多模态输入的自适应融合，在六个基准上显著优于静态融合基线。
AI.motivation: 现有预训练视频大语言模型在视觉推理上表现出色，但当视频附带音频、深度图或密集时间证据等辅助流时，统一融合会导致模态干扰，无关通道会分散模型注意力。因此需要一种能根据指令自适应平衡各模态重要性的融合方法。
AI.method: 提出UniMVU框架，包含两层动态门控机制：(1) 内模态门控（Inner-modality gates）：强调每个模态内的显著区域；(2) 模态级门控（Modality-level gates）：重新加权整个流。两者均以文本指令为条件，自适应平衡模态重要性。结合跨模态自注意力、指令驱动的内模态门控模块、带控制令牌的模态级门控模块，并对时间对齐流采用快慢融合方案以减少冗余。
AI.result: 在AVQA、AVSD、Music-AVQA、ScanQA、SQA3D和MVBench六个基准上，UniMVU相比静态融合基线取得一致提升，CIDEr指标最高提升13.5。门控机制与人类可解释的模态相关性一致，消融实验验证了两层门控各自的贡献。
AI.conclusion: UniMVU提供了一种简单、统一、无需手工设计融合规则的多模态视频理解方案，可扩展至多种模态输入。

title: The Constraint Tax: Measuring Validity-Correctness Tradeoffs in Structured Outputs for Small Language Models
summary: Production LLM systems increasingly require machine-readable outputs: JSON objects, typed traces, regex-constrained fields, and tool-call schemas. This paper targets on-device and low-cost small language model (SLM) deployments, where sub-3B models are attractive for privacy, latency, and commodity hardware but have limited capacity to satisfy schemas while solving tasks. The usual engineering assumption is that hard output constraints improve reliability without changing the underlying answer. We show that this assumption is unsafe for small models. We introduce \emph{constraint tax}, a measurement protocol for isolating the answer and executable-accuracy loss caused by structured-output constraints at fixed model, fixed task distribution, and fixed problem instances. Across 15,000 commodity-GPU generations with Qwen2.5-0.5B, Qwen2.5-1.5B, and SmolLM2-1.7B, hard answer-only schema decoding raises schema validity from 61.5\% to 100.0\%, but lowers answer accuracy from 19.7\% to 11.0\% and increases wrong-valid-schema outputs from 49.5\% to 88.9\%. The strongest industry analogue is a deterministic calendar tool-call task: Qwen2.5-1.5B achieves 91.5\% executable accuracy with prompt-only JSON but only 48.0\% under the same hard tool-call schema, while both modes are 100.0\% schema-valid. The error is semantic, not structural. We also show that the 3B boundary still pays a direct-schema tax and that delayed packaging supports a constructive design pattern: reason free, constrain late. The practical conclusion is direct: production systems should report schema validity, answer accuracy, executable accuracy, and wrong-valid-schema rate separately.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示了结构化输出约束对小型语言模型（<3B参数）会产生"约束税"现象：强制输出约束虽然能将模式有效性从61.5%提升到100%，但会导致答案准确率从19.7%降至11.0%，错误有效模式输出从49.5%增至88.9%。作者提出"延迟封装"策略（先自由推理，后约束封装）作为建设性设计模式，并建议生产系统应分开报告四项指标。
AI.motivation: 生产级LLM系统日益需要机器可读的结构化输出（JSON、工具调用模式等），但在设备端和小型语言模型（<3B参数）部署中，模型容量有限，难以同时满足模式约束和任务求解。通常的工程假设认为硬性输出约束能提升可靠性而不改变答案质量，但该假设对小型模型不安全，需要系统性验证。
AI.method: 提出"约束税"测量协议，在固定模型、固定任务分布和固定问题实例下，分离结构化输出约束对答案准确率和可执行准确率的影响。在15,000次commodity-GPU生成实验中，使用Qwen2.5-0.5B、Qwen2.5-1.5B和SmolLM2-1.7B模型，对比纯提示JSON与硬性工具调用模式约束的性能差异。
AI.result: 硬性答案模式解码将模式有效性从61.5%提升至100.0%，但答案准确率从19.7%降至11.0%，错误有效模式输出从49.5%增至88.9%。在日历工具调用任务中，Qwen2.5-1.5B在纯提示JSON下可执行准确率为91.5%，但在硬性工具调用模式下仅为48.0%，两种模式模式有效性均为100.0%。3B边界仍存在直接模式税。
AI.conclusion: 结构化输出约束对小型语言模型会产生语义层面的"约束税"，而非结构错误。建议采用"先自由推理，后约束封装"的延迟封装设计模式。生产系统应分别报告模式有效性、答案准确率、可执行准确率和错误有效模式率四项指标，以全面评估约束对模型性能的影响。

title: Closing the Loop in Teleoperation: Episode-Level Data Quality Assessment and Feedback for High-Quality Demonstration Collection
summary: Industrial automation is at a pivotal moment, as Physical AI is driving a transition from rigid, hand-engineered automation systems toward more flexible and adaptive systems. This shift has created a growing demand for large-scale, real-world robot demonstration data, making teleoperation an increasingly important mechanism for data collection. However, high-quality teleoperated demonstrations remain difficult to obtain in practice, as novice operators often produce episodes that are task-successful but suboptimal for downstream use due to inefficient motion, repeated corrections, or operation near robot joint limits. We present a Data Quality Assessment and Feedback (DQAF) framework that closes the loop in teleoperation by providing immediate post-episode feedback grounded in semantic task progress and robot telemetry. The framework extracts quality relevant signals such as sub-task progress, motion smoothness, stalls, kinematic limits and converts them into structured quality assessments and actionable natural-language feedback. Unlike binary success or failure feedback, the proposed system explains why an episode is suboptimal and highlights specific behaviors to correct in the next trial. We evaluate the framework through a diagnostic validation study and a pilot user study. In the validation study, the system is compared with a human reviewer during dataset curation, producing rejection reasons and actionable feedback for improvement. In the pilot study with three novice operators across two manipulation tasks, the operator who received the systems immediate, automated post-episode feedback improved faster than those who did not, producing higher-quality demonstrations sooner.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种数据质量评估与反馈（DQAF）框架，通过在遥操作后提供基于语义任务进度和机器人遥测数据的即时反馈，帮助操作者提升演示数据质量。实验表明，接收该框架反馈的操作者比未接收者更快地产生高质量演示。
AI.motivation: 工业自动化正从刚性系统向灵活自适应系统转型，物理AI的发展使得大规模真实世界机器人演示数据的需求激增，遥操作成为关键的数据采集手段。然而，新手操作者常产生任务成功但运动轨迹次优（如低效运动、重复修正、接近关节极限）的演示数据，现有二元成功/失败反馈无法有效指导操作者改进。
AI.method: 提出DQAF框架，在每次遥操作结束后立即提供反馈。该框架提取子任务进度、运动平滑度、停顿、运动学极限等质量相关信号，将其转化为结构化的质量评估和可操作的自然语言反馈，而非简单的成功/失败判断。
AI.result: 诊断验证研究中，系统在数据集筛选时与人类评审员对比，能产生合理的拒绝原因和改进建议。三项用户研究中，三名新手操作者执行两类操作任务，接收系统即时自动化反馈的操作者比未接收者提升更快，更早产生高质量演示。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够有效提升遥操作演示数据的质量，为大规模机器人数据收集提供反馈闭环，是推动物理AI数据采集自动化的重要工具。

title: DuoGesture: Neuro-Inspired and Biomechanically Informed Dual-Stream Co-Speech Gesture Generation
summary: Co-speech gesture generation requires both semantic expressivity and biomechanically plausible rhythmic motion. Existing holistic gesture models mix lexically grounded semantic gestures with frequent prosody-aligned beat gestures. This limits semantic grounding, speech-motion alignment, and kinematic smoothness. We propose \emph{DuoGesture}, a neuro-inspired and biomechanically informed dual-stream approach that decomposes co-speech gesture synthesis into coupled semantic and beat streams. The two streams are coordinated by a \emph{Semantic Variational Information Bottleneck}, a stochastic frame-level gate that learns when semantic gestures should override rhythmic beat motion. The semantic stream is controlled by \emph{Motion-Grounded Semantic Conditioning}, which replaces purely linguistic word embeddings with motion-language representations to provide motion-aligned semantic priors for long-tailed lexical triggers of gestures. The beat stream is further regularised by an \emph{Inertial Beat Prior}, an anthropometry-weighted arm-chain module that reduces jitter and improves rhythmic consistency without constraining semantic frames. Objective evaluations and subjective experiments show that DuoGesture outperforms strong holistic baselines, while component ablations confirm the complementary roles of semantic grounding, stochastic stream selection, and biomechanical regularisation.

AI.tldr: DuoGesture提出了一种神经启发且生物力学信息的双流方法，将共语手势生成分解为耦合的语义流和节拍流，通过语义变分信息瓶颈、运动接地语义条件和惯性节拍先验实现更优的语义表达和节奏一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有整体手势模型混合了基于词汇的语义手势和韵律对齐的节拍手势，限制了语义接地性、语音-运动对齐精度和运动学平滑度。
AI.method: 提出双流架构，包括：(1) 语义变分信息瓶颈作为随机帧级门控，学习何时语义手势应覆盖节拍运动；(2) 运动接地语义条件，用运动-语言表示替换纯语言词嵌入；(3) 惯性节拍先验，基于人体测量的加权臂链模块减少抖动并提升节奏一致性。
AI.result: 客观评估和主观实验表明DuoGesture优于强整体基线方法，组件消融实验证实了语义接地、随机流选择和生物力学正则化的互补作用。
AI.conclusion: 分解语义和节拍双流并引入生物力学先验能有效提升共语手势生成的语义表达和运动质量。

title: AirCast-SR: A Foundation Model for Kilometer-Scale Atmospheric Super-Resolution via Latent Consistency Diffusion
comment: Somnath Luitel and Manmeet Singh are equal-contribution co-first authors, with Manmeet Singh (manmeet.singh@wku.edu) as corresponding author
summary: Operational weather prediction at kilometer scales remains computationally prohibitive for traditional numerical weather prediction (NWP) models, limiting forecast access for applications in energy, agriculture, and disaster management that require fine-grained spatiotemporal detail. Here we introduce AirCast-SR, a foundation model for atmospheric super-resolution that downscales global AI weather forecasts from 0.25 degree (~28 km) to 1 km horizontal resolution at hourly temporal resolution, producing 67-hour forecasts of eight coupled surface variables simultaneously. EarthMind-SR employs a three-dimensional U-Net conditioned within a Latent Consistency Model (LCM) diffusion framework, trained on patch-based samples over the contiguous United States (CONUS) using GraphCast forecasts as input and NOAA's Analysis of Record for Calibration (AORC) as the target. The model achieves near-zero bias across all variables and lead times, and its radial power spectral density analysis demonstrates preservation of fine-scale atmospheric structure at wavelengths of 10 km to 100 km where coarser models lose spectral power. We validate EarthMind-SR across three CONUS case studies spanning winter, summer, and spring seasons, and demonstrate zero-shot global transferability over India and Germany using independent surface station observations without any retraining or fine-tuning. As an open-weights foundation model, EarthMind-SR establishes a new paradigm for kilometer-scale AI weather prediction and provides a platform for regional fine-tuning, distillation, and downstream applications in climate services and hazard forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EarthMind-SR，一种基于潜在一致性模型（LCM）扩散框架的大气超分辨率基础模型，可将全球AI天气预报从0.25度（~28公里）降尺度至1公里/小时的精细分辨率，在67小时预报时长内保持近零偏差和精细大气结构，并展示出零样本全球迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 公里级精细化天气预报对传统数值天气预测（NWP）模型计算开销巨大，限制了能源、农业和灾害管理等应用对高时空分辨率预报的获取。现有模型难以在计算可行性与精细度之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 采用三维U-Net作为骨干网络，在潜在一致性模型（LCM）扩散框架下进行条件建模。训练时使用GraphCast预报作为输入，NOAA的AORC再分析数据作为目标，在美国本土（CONUS）进行基于图块（patch-based）的样本训练。模型同时输出8个地表变量的67小时预报，时间分辨率为1小时，空间降尺度因子为28倍。
AI.result: 模型在所有变量和预报时效上实现近零偏差；径向功率谱密度分析表明在10~100公里波长范围内保持精细大气结构，而粗分辨率模型在此区间失去谱功率；通过CONUS地区冬、夏、春三个案例验证，并在印度和德国实现零样本全球迁移，无需任何微调。
AI.conclusion: EarthMind-SR作为开放权重的公里级AI天气预测基础模型，为区域微调、知识蒸馏及气候服务和灾害预报等下游应用建立了新范式，证明了大规模扩散模型在大气超分辨率任务中的可行性与泛化能力。

title: Multi-Robot Box Transport over Different Surfaces with Decentralized Role-based Proportional Control
summary: Collaborative transport of objects via pushing by multiple robots has many applications, ranging from construction and warehouse environments to post disaster debris clean-up. Achieving collaborative transport over surfaces with different inclination and friction properties however poses unique challenges. To address these challenges, this paper presents an asynchronous decentralized task and motion planning approach for transporting rectangular boxes of varying mass over flat, uphill and downhill terrain. Such a decentralized approach alleviates communication, synchronization and consensus needs and mitigates single point of failure issues. Our approach, called R2P2 or Roles with Rules and Proportional-control Primitive, assigns roles (e.g., push, support and prevent) to robots based on rules cognizant of the mode of manipulation needed (box rotation vs translation); this is followed by either rule-based control or proportional control of robot velocity based on the roles. Each robot is assumed to observe the location and heading of self and the box in executing the role and controls. R2P2 is evaluated with a six-robot team deployed in a simulator built using NVIDIA IsaacSim -- demonstrating generalizability across different surface friction/inclination and box mass scenarios, and better success rate compared to a standard virtual-leader-follower method. R2P2 is also successfully validated with a physical experiment, where it is executed onboard four turtlebots tasked with moving a 1.2 kg box.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为R2P2（Roles with Rules and Proportional-control Primitive）的异步分散式任务与运动规划方法，用于多机器人协作推运箱子，能适应不同摩擦系数和坡度的地形，并在仿真和实物实验中表现出优于虚拟领导者-跟随者方法的成功率和泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 多机器人协作推运物体在建筑、仓储及灾后清理等场景有广泛应用，但不同倾斜角度和摩擦特性的表面对协同运输带来了独特的挑战，现有方法在通信、同步和共识方面需求较高且存在单点故障问题。
AI.method: 提出R2P2方法，采用异步分散式架构：首先基于规则（感知箱体旋转与平移模式）为每个机器人分配角色（推动、支撑、阻止），随后根据角色执行基于规则的控制或比例速度控制；每个机器人仅需观测自身与箱体的位置及朝向。
AI.result: 在基于NVIDIA IsaacSim搭建的仿真环境中使用六机器人团队进行验证，展示了在不同地表摩擦/倾斜度和箱体质量场景下的泛化能力，成功率优于标准的虚拟领导者-跟随者方法；并在四台Turtlebot实物平台上成功完成1.2kg箱体的推运实验。
AI.conclusion: R2P2通过异步分散式角色分配与规则/比例混合控制，有效降低了对通信、同步和共识的需求，消除了单点故障问题，且在不同地形和负载条件下具备良好的泛化性和鲁棒性。

title: Sentinel: Embodied Cooperative Spatial Reasoning and Planning
comment: The first two authors contributed equally
summary: In this work, we study Cooperative Spatial Intelligence, the ability of decentralized embodied agents to coordinate effectively under dynamic environmental constraints across city-scale outdoor domains. We introduce Sentinel Challenge, a benchmark where multiple decentralized embodied agents must communicate in natural language to agree on a mutually safe and convenient meeting point within large, city-scale outdoor environments. Each agent must then navigate safely while avoiding dynamic sentinels patrolling the area, using a tool that provides coarse spatial information. To address this, we propose CoSaR (Cooperative Spatial Reasoning and Planning), a framework that bridges the high-level communication and planning abilities of foundation models with the precision of classical spatial navigation algorithms. CoSaR enables agents to exchange situational updates, reason over evolving spatial constraints, and collaboratively replan trajectories. Evaluated across 14 city-level scenes with 3-5 agents, CoSaR consistently leads to faster gathering, shorter path lengths, and improved safety. Our results demonstrate that integrating dynamic communication with spatial reasoning is essential for robust multi-agent cooperation. By formalizing this new setting and providing a scalable benchmark, we aim to build a foundation for advancing cooperative spatial intelligence in embodied multi-agent systems. Code and challenge are available at https://github.com/UMass-Embodied-AGI/Sentinel.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个名为 Sentinel Challenge 的城市级多智能体协作基准测试，并设计了 CoSaR 框架，该框架结合大模型的通信规划能力与经典空间导航算法，使分散的具身智能体能通过自然语言协商安全会合点并规避动态巡逻哨兵，实验证明该方法在14个城市场景中显著提升了聚集速度、路径效率与安全性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏面向城市级室外环境的多智能体协作空间智能基准，分散式具身智能体在动态环境约束下协调沟通的能力尚未被系统评估。
AI.method: 提出 Sentinel Challenge 基准测试与 CoSaR 框架。CoSaR 融合基础模型的自然语言通信与高层规划能力，以及经典空间导航算法的精确路径规划能力，使智能体通过自然语言交换情境信息、推理动态空间约束并协同重规划轨迹。
AI.result: 在14个城市级场景、3-5个智能体的实验中，CoSaR 一致实现了更快的聚集速度、更短的路径长度和更高的安全性。
AI.conclusion: 将动态通信与空间推理相结合对于鲁棒的多智能体协作至关重要，本文通过形式化设定和可扩展基准为具身多智能体系统的协作空间智能奠定了基础。

title: SilIF: Silhouette-Augmented Isolation Forest for Unsupervised Transaction Fraud Detection
summary: Unsupervised anomaly detection is widely used in transaction fraud detection where labels are scarce. Isolation Forest (IF) is among the most popular classical methods due to its scalability and ease of deployment. We propose SilIF, an augmentation of Isolation Forest that adds a silhouette-based scoring layer computed in a representation space induced by the trees of the forest. For each point, we extract a vector of per-tree path lengths, cluster these "fingerprints" into structural groups, and compute a silhouette score that measures how well the point fits its assigned group versus the nearest alternative. The silhouette signal is combined with the base IF score via a single hyperparameter alpha. On the IEEE-CIS Fraud Detection benchmark (~590K transactions, 3.5% fraud), SilIF with alpha=1.0 improves over plain Isolation Forest by +0.0080 AUC-PR on average across five seeds, with SilIF winning on all five seeds (paired t-test p=0.046). We also report results on a synthetic credit-card dataset (Sparkov) where the silhouette augmentation does not improve over plain IF, and we characterize the conditions that distinguish the two outcomes. The paper presents SilIF as a tunable, easy-to-deploy enhancement to Isolation Forest with honest reporting of when it helps and when it does not. Code at https://github.com/venkat15vk/silif-anomaly-detection.

AI.tldr: SilIF 是一种对 Isolation Forest 的增强方法，通过在森林树结构诱导的表示空间中添加基于轮廓系数（silhouette）的评分层来提升无监督异常检测性能。在 IEEE-CIS 欺诈检测数据集上（59万笔交易，3.5%欺诈率），SilIF（alpha=1.0）相比原始 IF 在 AUC-PR 上平均提升 0.0080，且在所有五个随机种子下均表现更好（p=0.046）。但在合成数据集 Sparkov 上未见提升。论文诚实地报告了该方法有效和无效的条件。
AI.motivation: 无监督异常检测在标签稀缺的交易欺诈检测中广泛应用。Isolation Forest 因其可扩展性和易部署性成为最流行的经典方法之一，但其评分机制仅依赖路径长度，忽略了数据点在树结构中的聚类信息。作者希望引入结构分组信息来增强 IF 的判别能力。
AI.method: SilIF 在 Isolation Forest 基础上增加了一层基于轮廓系数的评分层。具体而言：1) 对每个样本提取其在每棵树上的路径长度向量（"指纹"）；2) 对这些"指纹"进行聚类，形成结构分组；3) 计算每个样本的轮廓系数，衡量其与归属组和最近邻组的匹配程度；4) 通过超参数 alpha 将轮廓信号与原始 IF 分数组合。
AI.result: 在 IEEE-CIS 欺诈检测基准（~59万笔交易，3.5% 欺诈率）上，SilIF（alpha=1.0）相比原始 Isolation Forest 在 AUC-PR 上平均提升 0.0080，五个随机种子均胜出（配对 t 检验 p=0.046）。在合成信用卡数据集 Sparkov 上，轮廓增强未见提升。
AI.conclusion: SilIF 提供了一种可调、易部署的 Isolation Forest 增强方案，并在真实欺诈检测场景中验证了有效性。论文同时诚实地报告了其在某些合成数据集上无效的情况，并刻画了两种结果差异的条件特征。

title: Robust Koopman Control Barrier Filters for Safe Actor-Critic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Safe reinforcement learning (RL) for robotic systems requires policies that improve task performance while satisfying state and input constraints during both training and deployment. Control barrier functions (CBFs) provide a principled mechanism for enforcing forward invariance through minimally invasive safety filters, but their use in model-free RL is limited by the need for accurate dynamics and hand-designed barrier certificates. We propose Robust Koopman-CBF SAC, a safety-filtered actor--critic framework that learns a finite-dimensional Koopman predictor from data, constructs affine CBF constraints in the lifted space, and enforces them through a quadratic-program safety layer. To account for finite-dimensional Koopman approximation error, the CBF condition is tightened using a projected residual margin estimated from held-out rollout data. The critic is trained on the executed safe action, while the actor is regularized toward the Koopman-CBF feasible set, reducing dependence on the filter over training. Across safe-control benchmarks, the method achieves zero constraint violations on CartPole stabilization and tracking while matching or exceeding unconstrained SAC returns. On high-dimensional Safety Gymnasium locomotion tasks, the method reduces violations in some settings but also exposes important limitations of first-order velocity barriers and linear EDMD models, motivating high-order and multi-step Koopman-CBF extensions. These results suggest that robust Koopman-CBF filters are a promising bridge between model-free RL and certifiable safety, while clarifying the structural conditions under which such filters remain effective. All code is available at \href{https://github.com/DhruvKushwaha/Koopman-CBF-Soft-Actor-Critic}{Github Repository}.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种鲁棒Koopman-CBF SAC框架，结合数据驱动的Koopman预测器与CBF安全滤波器，在无模型强化学习中实现零违规安全控制，并通过投影残差边际处理有限维逼近误差。在CartPole任务上实现零约束违反，在Safety Gymnasium任务中部分降低违规，同时揭示了线性EDMD模型与一阶速度屏障的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有CBF方法在无模型RL中受限于需要精确动力学模型和手工设计的障碍证书，难以在模型不可知场景中部署。
AI.method: 1) 从数据中学习有限维Koopman预测器；2) 在提升空间中构建仿射CBF约束；3) 通过二次规划安全层施加约束；4) 用投影残差边际收紧CBF条件以补偿逼近误差；5) 评论家在安全动作上训练，演员向Koopman-CBF可行集正则化。
AI.result: CartPole稳定与跟踪任务零约束违反，回报匹敌或超过无约束SAC；Safety Gymnasium任务中部分场景降低违规，但在高维任务中暴露一阶速度屏障和线性EDMD模型的局限性。
AI.conclusion: 鲁棒Koopman-CBF滤波器是连接无模型RL与可认证安全性的有前途桥梁，其有效性依赖于结构条件，未来需要高阶和多步Koopman-CBF扩展。

title: RoMo: A Large-Scale, Richly Organized Dataset and Semantic Taxonomy for Human Motion Generation
summary: Success in generative modeling across language, image, and video demonstrates that large, well-curated datasets are the key driver for building capable models. 3D Human motion, however, has lagged behind, constrained by an unsatisfying choice between small, high-fidelity motion capture datasets and large-scale in-the-wild collections dominated by static or low-quality sequences. We introduce RoMo, a rich, large-scale, carefully curated dataset of in-the-wild human motions that resolves these tradeoffs. To ensure quality, we introduce a taxonomy-aware filtering pipeline that aggressively removes static and artifact-prone sequences. Every sequence is annotated with detailed captions and organized by a novel three-level semantic taxonomy. This hierarchical structure enables fine-grained, per-category evaluation, that reveals model strengths and weaknesses obscured by global metrics. We demonstrate that models trained on RoMo achieve state-of-the-art fidelity and diversity while gaining a superior understanding of complex, subtle text prompts. Finally, we release the Motion Toolbox to standardize metrics, data conversion, and visualization, establishing a foundation for reproducible and interpretable motion generation research.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍 RoMo，一个大规模、高质量、经过精心筛选的野外人体运动数据集，通过语义分类法过滤和细粒度标注，解决了现有运动数据集规模与质量不可兼得的矛盾，训练出的模型在保真度、多样性和复杂文本理解上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有3D人体运动数据集存在两难选择：小规模高精度的动捕数据集 vs 大规模但充满静态/低质量序列的野外数据集，缺乏能兼顾规模与质量的高质量数据集。
AI.method: 提出RoMo数据集，采用基于分类法的过滤流程去除静态和伪影序列；为每个序列提供详细描述并构建三级语义分类体系；发布Motion Toolbox统一评估标准。
AI.result: 基于RoMo训练的模型在保真度和多样性上达到SOTA；对复杂文本提示的理解能力显著提升；三级分类体系实现了细粒度的类别级评估，揭示了全局指标掩盖的模型优劣势。
AI.conclusion: RoMo通过大规模高质量数据和结构化标注，为3D人体运动生成研究提供了可复现、可解释的基准，推动了该领域的发展。

title: Neural Bayesian Sequential Routing
summary: Human decision-making is sequential and uncertainty-aware, yet standard neural networks often rely on static, dense forward computation with limited visibility into evidence acquisition, uncertainty evolution, or when computation should stop. We introduce \textbf{Neural Bayesian Sequential Routing (NBSR)}, a framework that models neural inference as active evidence accumulation over a hierarchical Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG). Within a Dirichlet--Categorical conjugate framework, neural experts query a persistent global knowledge oracle to extract positive evidence vectors, which act as pseudo-counts and update a Dirichlet belief state by exact conjugate addition. Coupled with a Gumbel-Softmax Straight-Through estimator, this update enables hard, path-dependent routing while preserving surrogate gradients for end-to-end training. The resulting Dirichlet precision and entropy provide mechanisms for uncertainty quantification, entropy-based early exiting, OOD abstention, and cost-aware evidence acquisition. We prove that, under strictly positive evidence extraction, total Dirichlet precision increases monotonically along any valid trajectory and marginal predictive variance is bounded, formalizing sequential ``hypothesis sharpening''; under idealized capacity and optimization assumptions, the terminal Dirichlet expectation recovers the Bayes-optimal conditional distribution. Empirical evaluations across visual categorization, structured medical diagnosis, language modeling, partially observable control, and cost-aware Bayesian experimental design show that NBSR achieves competitive predictive performance while providing transparent routing traces, path-dependent evidence attribution, uncertainty-aware decision control, and resource-rational inference. Overall, NBSR offers a mathematically grounded framework for interpretable, modular, and resource-rational agentic AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出神经贝叶斯顺序路由（NBSR）框架，将神经网络推理建模为有向无环图上的主动证据累积过程，通过Dirichlet-Categorical共轭框架和Gumbel-Softmax估计器实现硬路径路由，提供不确定性量化、早期退出、OOD拒绝和成本感知推理，并在多个任务上取得竞争性性能。
AI.motivation: 标准神经网络依赖静态、密集的前向计算，缺乏对证据获取过程、不确定性演化以及何时停止计算的显式建模，无法支持人类决策中的顺序性和不确定性感知特性。
AI.method: 在层次化DAG上，神经专家从全局知识oracle提取正证据向量作为伪计数，通过Dirichlet-Categorical共轭更新信念状态；结合Gumbel-Softmax Straight-Through估计器实现硬路径路由和端到端训练；利用Dirichlet精度和熵进行不确定性量化、早期退出、OOD拒绝和成本感知证据获取。
AI.result: 在视觉分类、结构化医学诊断、语言建模、部分可观测控制和成本感知贝叶斯实验设计等任务上，NBSR在保持竞争性预测性能的同时，提供了透明的路由轨迹、路径依赖的证据归因、不确定性感知的决策控制和资源理性推理。
AI.conclusion: NBSR为可解释、模块化和资源理性的智能体AI提供了数学上有理论基础的框架，严格证明了正证据提取下Dirichlet精度单调递增和边际预测方差有界，理想条件下终端Dirichlet期望可恢复贝叶斯最优条件分布。

title: Heterogeneous AAV Logistics Task Allocation: A Reinforcement Learning Enhanced Overlapping Coalition Formation Game Approach
summary: In dynamic urban logistics, the stochastic emergence of time-sensitive tasks poses a significant optimality challenge for heterogeneous AAVs logistics task allocation. To address this problem, a reinforcement learning enhanced overlapping coalition formation game approach is proposed. A dynamic task allocation model is established, where global optimality is mathematically quantified by a generalized logistics cost coupling service quality and resource consumption. To deal with the time-varying task sets induced by stochastic order arrivals, a transformer-based soft actor-critic network is designed. By leveraging multi-head self-attention to encode variable-length logistics states and capture task-wise spatiotemporal dependencies, the learned policy adaptively guides coalition updates, replacing heuristic rules in the overlapping coalition formation game. On this basis, heterogeneous AAVs can form more efficient overlapping coalitions for dynamic logistics tasks. The resulting coalition formation process is proven to constitute an exact potential game, which guarantees convergence to a Nash-stable equilibrium within a finite number of iterations. Numerical simulations demonstrate that the proposed algorithm effectively improves the optimality of task allocation under the generalized logistics cost criterion. In a scenario with 32 AAVs and 80 tasks, our algorithm achieves a 39.76% cost reduction compared with the heuristic OCF baseline. Indoor flight experiments further validate its practicality.

AI.tldr: 针对异构AAV物流任务分配中随机到达的时敏任务优化难题，提出一种强化学习增强的重叠联盟形成博弈方法。该方法通过Transformer软演员-评论家网络动态学习任务分配策略，替代传统启发式规则，在广义物流成本准则下实现39.76%的成本降低，并证明了博弈收敛到纳什稳定均衡。
AI.motivation: 动态城市物流中随机出现的时敏任务对异构AAV（自主飞行器）物流任务分配的最优性构成显著挑战，现有方法难以同时应对任务集的时变性和任务间的时空依赖关系。
AI.method: 建立了动态任务分配模型，用广义物流成本（耦合服务质量和资源消耗）量化全局最优性；设计了基于Transformer的软演员-评论家网络，利用多头自注意力编码变长物流状态并捕获任务间时空依赖关系，学习到的策略自适应指导重叠联盟形成博弈中的联盟更新；证明了该联盟形成过程构成精确势能博弈，保证有限迭代内收敛到纳什稳定均衡。
AI.result: 在32架AAV和80个任务的场景中，所提算法相比启发式重叠联盟形成（OCF）基线实现了39.76%的成本降低；通过室内飞行实验验证了其实用性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的强化学习增强重叠联盟形成博弈方法有效提高了动态任务分配在广义物流成本准则下的最优性，兼具理论收敛保证和实际可行性。

title: LongAV-Compass: Towards Unified Evaluation of Minute-Scale Audio-Visual Generation Across T2AV, I2AV, and V2AV
summary: Audio-visual generation is rapidly advancing from short clips to minute-long content, while existing evaluation protocols remain largely confined to short-form settings. Existing benchmarks primarily focus on 5--10 second text-conditioned generation and rarely support unified evaluation across text, image, and video conditioning modalities. Moreover, they provide limited insight into how identity consistency, narrative coherence, and audio-visual alignment degrade over extended temporal horizons. To bridge this gap, we introduce LongAV-Compass, a systematic benchmark for minute-long audio-visual generation. LongAV-Compass contains 284 curated test cases spanning text-to-audio-video (T2AV), image-to-audio-video (I2AV), and video-to-audio-video (V2AV), organized by application scenario and generation complexity. The benchmark combines taxonomy-guided benchmark construction with a unified evaluation framework that integrates MLLM-assisted assessment with complementary perceptual and multimodal metrics, including DINO-v2, ArcFace, CLIP, and ImageBind. The framework evaluates more than 20 fine-grained dimensions covering within-segment quality, cross-segment consistency, global narrative coherence, semantic alignment, and audio-visual synchronization. Through experiments on 11 representative models together with human-alignment validation, LongAV-Compass provides a diagnostic testbed for analyzing the limitations of current systems in sustaining coherent, semantically aligned, and temporally consistent minute-scale audio-visual generation across diverse input modalities.

AI.tldr: LongAV-Compass 是一个面向分钟级长时音视频生成系统的系统性评测基准，涵盖文本/图像/视频三种条件输入、284个测试用例、超过20个细粒度评测维度，并通过11个代表性模型和人工对齐验证揭示了现有系统在身份一致性、叙事连贯性和音视频同步方面的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有音视频生成评测主要局限于5-10秒的短片段，缺乏对分钟级长时内容在身份一致性、叙事连贯性和音视频对齐随长时间退化情况的系统性评估，且不支持文本/图像/视频多种条件输入的统一评测。
AI.method: 构建包含284个测试用例的基准，按应用场景和生成复杂度组织T2AV、I2AV、V2AV三类任务；采用分类学指导的基准构建方法与统一评测框架，结合MLLM辅助评估与DINO-v2、ArcFace、CLIP、ImageBind等感知/多模态指标，覆盖超过20个细粒度维度（段内质量、跨段一致性、全局叙事连贯性、语义对齐、音视频同步）。
AI.result: 通过对11个代表性模型的实验和人工对齐验证，LongAV-Compass提供了诊断性测试平台，揭示了当前系统在分钟级跨模态音视频生成中维持连贯性、语义对齐和时间一致性的局限性。
AI.conclusion: 提出了首个面向分钟级长时音视频生成的系统性评测基准，填补了现有评测在长时、多条件、细粒度评估方面的空白，为未来长时音视频生成模型的改进提供了诊断工具和标准化评估框架。

title: TSFMAudit: Data Contamination Auditing in Forecasting Time Series Foundation Models
summary: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) are increasingly pretrained on large corpora, raising concerns that evaluation datasets may have been exposed during pretraining and thus yield overly optimistic performance estimates. Auditing such contamination is challenging in time series because signals are continuous and heterogeneous, and often lack corpus documentation. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to study pretraining contamination auditing for TSFMs. We formalize the problem of pretraining contamination auditing for TSFMs and propose TSFMAudit, a method based on probe adaptation dynamics. Our key intuition is that contamination manifests as unusually efficient adaptation: after a fine tuning probe, contaminated datasets tend to exhibit faster loss reduction with smaller backbone movement. We evaluate TSFMAudit on 6 TSFMs and 187 datasets using documented training source evidence as supervision, and compare against 10 competitive baselines adapted from the LLM literature.

AI.tldr: 本文首次研究时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）的预训练污染审计问题，提出基于探针适应动态（probe adaptation dynamics）的TSFMAudit方法，通过检测微调过程中异常的快速损失下降和较小骨干网络参数移动来识别污染数据集。在6个TSFMs和187个数据集上的实验表明，该方法优于10种从LLM领域适配的基线方法。
AI.motivation: TSFMs在大规模语料上预训练，评估数据集可能在预训练阶段暴露，导致性能估计过于乐观。时间序列信号的连续性和异质性使得污染审计极具挑战性，且缺乏语料文档记录。目前尚无针对TSFMs的预训练污染审计研究。
AI.method: 提出TSFMAudit方法，核心直觉是污染会导致异常高效的适应：经过微调探针后，受污染数据集往往表现出更快的损失下降和更小的骨干网络参数移动。利用文档化的训练来源证据作为监督，在6个TSFMs和187个数据集上评估，并与10种从LLM领域适配的基线方法对比。
AI.result: TSFMAudit在6个TSFMs和187个数据集上的评估表现优于10种从LLM领域适配的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个针对TSFMs预训练污染审计的工作，TSFMAudit能够有效检测时间序列模型中的预训练数据污染问题。

title: Efficient On-policy Visual-RL via Stochastic Decoupled Policy Gradient
summary: We present the stochastic decoupled policy gradient (SDPG), a lightweight visual reinforcement learning (RL) method that trains diverse visuomotor control policies end-to-end within a few hours on a single NVIDIA RTX 4080 GPU. SDPG estimates policy gradients via random perturbations of trajectory rollouts, requiring orders of magnitude fewer batch-rendered environments and substantially reducing compute and memory overhead. On visual MuJoCo benchmarks, SDPG consistently outperforms baseline methods in training time, memory usage, and rewards. Finally, to support future research, we introduce a suite of realistic visual robotics benchmarks spanning dexterous manipulation, challenging locomotion, and demonstrate effective sim-to-real transfer on physical hardware.

AI.tldr: 提出随机解耦策略梯度（SDPG），一种轻量级视觉强化学习方法，能在单个RTX 4080 GPU上数小时内训练多样化视觉运动控制策略，通过轨迹rollout的随机扰动估计策略梯度，大幅减少计算和内存开销，在视觉MuJoCo基准上优于基线方法，并引入真实视觉机器人基准套件及有效的sim-to-real迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉强化学习方法训练成本高昂，需要大量批量渲染环境和计算资源，难以在单GPU上高效完成端到端训练，亟需一种轻量级方法降低计算和内存开销。
AI.method: 通过轨迹rollout的随机扰动估计策略梯度（随机解耦策略梯度，SDPG），大幅减少所需的批量渲染环境数量，降低计算和内存开销。
AI.result: 在视觉MuJoCo基准上，SDPG在训练时间、内存使用和奖励方面一致优于基线方法；并展示了有效的sim-to-real迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: SDPG是一种高效轻量的视觉RL方法，能在单GPU上数小时内完成端到端训练，并支持真实机器人部署，为未来研究提供了新的基准套件。

title: Dimensional Distribution Emotion State: Leveraging Valence and Arousal as a Common Embedding Space for Visual Emotion Analysis
summary: Museums are important sites for the dissemination of culture and art. They are institutions rooted in history and tradition; their exhibitions are often designed to highlight these aspects. Recently, a new approach is being explored in the field: emotion-based exhibitions. These exhibitions are designed specifically to elicit emotions in the visitors, in order to maximize engagement, and as a way to democratize access to art and attract a wider, more diverse audience. To do so, the emotional content of the artworks must first be extracted, however, manually annotating the artworks by experts is a prohibitively labor-intensive process, and risks introducing the personal bias of curators. To assist the museum curators in their design of these exhibitions, we wish to develop a tool that can predict the emotional response evoked by a work of art. In this article, we leverage a continuous bi-dimensional emotion space to enhance emotion representations and the training process of deep learning models. Drawing inspiration from existing categorical and dimensional emotion representations, we introduce a new representation, Dimensional Distribution Emotion State (DDES), along with a pipeline for multi-dataset training. We show that DDES provides multiple advantages compared to widely used representations while exhibiting similar baseline performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的情感表征方法DDES（维度分布情感状态），用于预测艺术品引发的情感反应，以辅助博物馆策展人设计情感化展览。该方法结合了分类和维度情感表征的优点，支持多数据集训练，在保持相似基准性能的同时提供了多种优势。
AI.motivation: 传统上，博物馆展览侧重历史和传统。新兴的情感化展览旨在最大化观众参与度并民主化艺术访问，但人工标注艺术品情感内容成本高昂且存在策展人偏见，因此需要自动化工具来预测艺术品引发的情感反应。
AI.method: 利用连续的二维情感空间增强情感表征和深度学习模型训练过程；融合现有分类和维度情感表征，提出新的Dimensional Distribution Emotion State (DDES)表征方法，并构建多数据集训练流程。
AI.result: DDES在保持与广泛使用的表征方法相当的基准性能的同时，提供了多种优势。
AI.conclusion: DDES作为一种新的情感表征方法，能够有效辅助策展人设计情感化展览，在性能和适用性上优于现有方法。

title: On the Push-Based Asynchronous Federated Learning: A Bias-Correction Aggregation Approach
comment: Accepted at the 32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining (KDD 2026). This is the extended version with full appendix
summary: Asynchronous decentralized federated learning (ADFL) eliminates central coordination and global synchronization, making it attractive for large-scale and heterogeneous systems. However, frequent peer-to-peer communication, asynchronous updates on directed topologies, and non-IID data jointly lead to excessive communication overhead, biased aggregation and severe model drift. We propose PushCen-ADFL, a communication-efficient ADFL framework that enables stable training under asymmetric communication and delayed client participation. PushCen-ADFL couples communication, aggregation, and local stabilization in a shared centroid representation space, forming a closed loop between compression and optimization. Clients exchange centroid-form messages, apply average-preserving push-sum mixing to correct aggregation bias, and use a lightweight centroid regularization anchored in the same centroid space to mitigate drift under heterogeneity and staleness. A bounded, sender-deduplicated buffer further improves robustness under irregular asynchronous arrivals. Experiments on vision datasets demonstrate that PushCen-ADFL improves accuracy under data heterogeneity by up to 6\% while reducing per-push communication cost by more than 80\%, achieving a favorable accuracy-communication trade-off.

AI.tldr: PushCen-ADFL 是一个通信高效的异步去中心化联邦学习框架，通过质心表示空间中的闭环设计（包含压缩通信、Push-Sum 聚合和质心正则化），在非对称通信和延迟客户端参与下实现稳定训练，在视觉数据集上相比基线方法准确率提升最高 6%，通信开销降低超 80%。
AI.motivation: 现有异步去中心化联邦学习面临三大挑战：频繁的点对点通信导致通信开销过大；有向拓扑上的异步更新引发聚合偏差；非独立同分布数据造成严重的模型漂移。这些问题共同限制了 ADFL 在大规模异构系统中的应用。
AI.method: PushCen-ADFL 设计了通信、聚合与局部稳定化的闭环结构：客户端交换质心形式的消息实现通信压缩；使用平均保持的 Push-Sum 混合机制纠正有向拓扑上的聚合偏差；在相同质心空间中引入轻量级质心正则化，缓解异构性和陈旧性导致的漂移；采用有界、发送端去重的缓冲区增强对不规则异步到达的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在视觉数据集上的实验表明，PushCen-ADFL 在数据异质性条件下准确率提升最高 6%，每次推送的通信成本降低超过 80%，实现了良好的准确率-通信权衡。
AI.conclusion: PushCen-ADFL 通过质心空间的闭环设计有效解决了异步去中心化联邦学习中的通信效率、聚合偏差和模型漂移问题，为大规模异构系统中的 ADFL 提供了一种实用且高效的解决方案。

title: Provably Safe Motion Planning Under Unknown Disturbances
summary: We present a provably safe sampling-based motion planning algorithm for robotic systems affected by random disturbances of unknown distribution. We consider systems with linear or linearizable dynamics evolving in workspace with arbitrary-shaped obstacles subject to state and control constraints. Safety requirements are formulated as chance-constraints. Our approach leverages data from trajectories of the system to learn a Wasserstein ambiguity tube, i.e., a sequence of ambiguity sets, which contains the trajectory of the system's state distribution with high confidence. This ambiguity tube is then used in a probabilistically complete algorithm to grow a sampling-based motion planning tree that respects the constraints of the problem. We show that learning several lower-dimensional ambiguity tubes instead of a single high-dimensional one effectively reduces the conservatism and boosts scalability. Additionally, we design an efficient bandit-based validity checker that remarkably increases the empirical performance of our approach without sacrificing probabilistic completeness. Case studies show our algorithm finds valid plans in cluttered environments under strict safety thresholds, outperforming state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种受随机干扰（分布未知）的机器人系统的可证明安全的基于采样的运动规划算法，通过学习Wasserstein模糊管来满足机会约束，并利用降维和基于bandit的有效性检查提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有运动规划方法在处理未知分布的随机干扰时缺乏安全性保证，需要在不确定环境下设计可证明安全且高效的规划算法。
AI.method: 1) 利用系统轨迹数据学习Wasserstein模糊管，以高置信度包含状态分布轨迹；2) 提出概率完备的采样树生长算法；3) 通过学习多个低维模糊管替代单个高维模糊管降低保守性；4) 设计基于bandit的高效有效性检查器。
AI.result: 在杂乱环境中，算法能在严格安全阈值下找到有效规划，性能优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 所提算法在未知分布随机干扰下实现了可证明安全的运动规划，降维策略有效减少了保守性，bandit检查器在保证概率完备性的同时提升了实际效率。

title: Frequency-Guided Fusion For RGB-Thermal Semantic Segmentation
comment: 9 pages, 7 figures, To be Presented at Perception Beyond the Visible Spectrum workshop series (IEEE PBVS) at CVPR, 2026
summary: Semantic segmentation in complex environments such as urban driving scenes remains challenging under adverse lighting conditions, where RGB images alone provide insufficient information. RGB-Thermal fusion leverages the complementary strengths of visible and infrared imagery to improve scene understanding; however, effectively integrating these heterogeneous modalities at varying levels of feature abstraction remains an open problem. In this paper, we propose a multi-modal fusion architecture built upon dual ConvNeXt V2 backbones that employs stage-wise, modality-adaptive fusion strategies. For early-stage features, we introduce a Frequency-Based Fusion Module that decomposes infrared features into low- and high-frequency components via Gaussian filtering, applies dual-branch spatial attention to selectively emphasize thermal patterns and fine-grained boundaries, and integrates them with RGB features through a confidence-gated residual mechanism. For late-stage features, we design a semantic fusion module with cross-modal attention and multi-scale depthwise convolutions to capture semantic correspondences across modalities. The fused features are decoded via a PANet-style bidirectional decoder with deep supervision. Experiments on MFNet and PST900 demonstrate that our lightest variant achieves 61.73\% and 86.24\% mIoU, respectively, with only 35.43M parameters, outperforming recent methods while using substantially fewer parameters and lower computational cost. Code is available at https://github.com/ismailemrecntz/VISIBLE-INFRARED-SENSOR-FUSION

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于双ConvNeXt V2骨干网络的多模态融合架构，通过频率分解和语义融合模块实现RGB和红外特征的分阶段自适应融合，在MFNet和PST900数据集上以较少参数取得优异分割性能。
AI.motivation: 城市驾驶场景等复杂环境在不良光照条件下，仅依赖RGB图像难以提供足够信息进行语义分割。RGB-热红外融合虽能互补可见光与红外图像的优点，但如何在不同的特征抽象层次上有效整合这两种异质模态仍然是一个开放问题。
AI.method: 提出基于双ConvNeXt V2骨干网络的多模态融合架构，采用分阶段、模态自适应的融合策略：1) 早期特征引入基于频率的融合模块，通过高斯滤波将红外特征分解为低高频分量，利用双分支空间注意力突出热纹理和细粒度边界，并通过置信门控残差机制与RGB特征融合；2) 晚期特征设计语义融合模块，使用跨模态注意力和多尺度深度可分离卷积捕获模态间的语义对应关系；3) 融合特征通过PANet风格的双向解码器进行解码，并采用深度监督训练。
AI.result: 在MFNet和PST900数据集上，最轻量变体分别达到61.73%和86.24% mIoU，仅需35.43M参数，在显著减少参数量和计算成本的同时优于近期方法。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的分阶段模态自适应融合策略能够有效整合RGB和热红外特征，在参数量和计算效率方面具有明显优势，为多模态语义分割提供了轻量化且高性能的解决方案。

title: Planning Neural Dynamics with Lie Group Embedding through Supervised Projective Manifold Learning
summary: We propose Lie group embedded dynamical neural networks (LieEDNN) and the corresponding learning algorithms based on gradient descent and metric projection on smooth manifold, where we treat Lie group as an intrinsic representation for continuous symmetry of manifold geometry. Thereby we achieve learnable and stable dynamics on the underlying manifold for general Lie group, and we are able to utilize the powerful representation capability of Lie group such as SO(3) and SE(3) to solve real world engineering problems in areas such as robotics, graphics, and control. Two core challenges are: (i) General Lie groups are incompatible with addition arithmetic, which is necessary for neural network interactions. (ii) The dynamics evolve in the nonlinear representation space of special algebra rather than the normal Euclidean space, which violates the paradigm of common neural ODEs. To address these two challenges, we firstly introduce adjoint Lie group action on the Lie algebra, which induces a linear mapping and transfer to the block-wise structure of weight matrices, such that addition could operate on the Lie algebra as a vector space. Then we parameterize the Lie algebra and the adjoint action as linear transformation so that the architecture is aligned with neural network perceptrons. Explicitly, this embedding appears as block-wise manifold constraints on weights, and we develop algorithms to learn the equilibrium with stability guarantees of the temporal neural network dynamics. Experiments are implemented on a specific Lie group SE(3), with the application scenario of telescopic manipulators.

AI.tldr: 提出Lie群嵌入动态神经网络(LieEDNN)，通过将Lie代数与伴随作用参数化为线性变换，并施加流形约束，实现了一般Lie群上的可学习、稳定动力学，在SE(3)伸缩机械臂上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有神经ODE无法处理Lie群上的动力学，因为Lie群与加法算术不兼容（群运算非加法），且动力学演化在非线性表示空间而非欧氏空间，亟需一种能将Lie群嵌入神经网络并实现稳定学习的方法。
AI.method: (1) 引入伴随Lie群作用将Lie代数映射为线性映射，转化为权重矩阵的分块结构，使加法可在Lie代数向量空间操作；(2) 将Lie代数与伴随作用参数化为线性变换，对齐神经网络感知机架构；(3) 施加权重分块流形约束，基于梯度下降与度量投影在光滑流形上学习，保证平衡点的稳定性。
AI.result: 在SE(3)群上实现了LieEDNN，应用于伸缩机械臂动力学建模与学习，验证了模型在流形上稳定演化的能力。
AI.conclusion: LieEDNN有效解决了Lie群与神经网络结合的核心困难，为机器人、图形学、控制等领域中涉及连续对称性的流形动力学问题提供了通用框架。

title: Enabling Extensible Embodied Capabilities with Tools
summary: Most existing embodied intelligence methods formulate perception, reasoning, planning, and control within a unified parameterized policy. Yet these capabilities are inherently hierarchical and heterogeneous, making them difficult to reliably learn and modularize within a single model. We propose a capability externalization approach that decouples heterogeneous capabilities into independently optimized tools, dynamically invoked at inference time. To this end, we introduce Embodied Tool Protocol (ETP), a standardized protocol for embodied tool registration, discovery, invocation, and execution, and curate 100+ validated tools spanning perception, cognition, reasoning, and execution as the tool base. Building on this, we construct EmbodiedToolBench to evaluate both whether tool augmentation improves embodied performance and how well current models use tools across tool-necessity recognition, tool selection, tool execution, and tool-chain composition. Experiments across simulation and real-world platforms confirm that capability externalization consistently improves embodied performance (avg. gain 31% on EB-ALFRED and 36% on EB-Navigation), yet reveal a clear boundary: gains are substantial for cognition and perception but are limited for execution-type capabilities. Moreover, our analysis reveals that knowing when, which, and how to invoke tools remains a persistent challenge across all models, thereby highlighting embodied tool competence as a critical direction for future research.

AI.tldr: 提出Embodied Tool Protocol (ETP)标准协议和EmbodiedToolBench基准，通过能力外化将异构能力解耦为独立工具，实验表明该方法在具身任务上平均提升31%-36%，但认知与感知类能力提升显著，执行类能力提升有限，且模型在何时、选择何工具及如何调用方面仍存在持续挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有具身智能方法将感知、推理、规划与控制统一参数化，但这些能力本质上是层次化且异构的，单一模型难以可靠学习和模块化。
AI.method: 提出能力外化方法，将异构能力解耦为独立优化的工具，通过ETP协议（涵盖工具注册、发现、调用和执行）实现推理时动态调用；构建100+验证工具及EmbodiedToolBench基准进行评估。
AI.result: 模拟和真实平台实验表明能力外化一致提升具身性能（EB-ALFRED平均提升31%，EB-Navigation平均提升36%），但认知和感知类能力提升显著，执行类能力提升有限；所有模型在工具调用时机、选择和方式上仍存在挑战。
AI.conclusion: 能力外化能有效提升具身智能性能，但存在明显边界；具身工具能力（何时、选择何工具、如何调用）是未来研究的关键方向。

title: VesselSim: learning 3D blood vessel segmentation without expert annotations
comment: This preprint has not undergone peer review or any post-submission improvements or corrections. The Version of Record of this contribution will be published as part of the MICCAI 2026 proceedings in October
summary: Blood vessel segmentation is a core task in medical image analysis for the care of vascular diseases and surgical planning, yet the challenges of providing expert vascular annotations pose a major obstacle for the progress of related deep learning techniques. To address this, we propose VesselSim, a two-stage framework for universal 3D blood vessel segmentation that eliminates the need for real annotated data during training. First, we introduce a stochastic, geometry-driven vascular simulation framework that models recursive branching, curvature-controlled growth, and collision-aware topology, followed by domain-randomized intensity synthesis to generate 16,500 anatomically plausible 3D angiographic volumes. Second, a 3D U-Net is trained solely on this synthetic data. To bridge the domain gap from synthetic to real images at inference time, we introduce a test-time adaptation strategy via a self-supervised mask reconstruction decoder, enabling adaptation to unseen clinical scans without prior domain knowledge. We evaluate VesselSim in a zero-shot setting on multiple real-world datasets spanning MR and CT across several anatomical regions, including the brain and kidneys. Despite being trained exclusively on synthetic data, VesselSim achieves performance competitive with state-of-the-art vascular segmentation foundation models. These findings suggest that learning vessel geometry from synthetic tubular structures is effective for robust cross-domain generalization, substantially reducing the reliance on acquired medical imaging data and more importantly, expert annotations.

AI.tldr: 提出VesselSim框架，通过几何驱动的随机血管模拟生成16500个合成3D血管造影数据，结合测试时自监督适应策略，在零样本设置下实现与有监督SOTA相当的跨模态（MR/CT）、跨部位（脑/肾）血管分割性能，完全消除了对真实标注数据的需求。
AI.motivation: 消除血管分割深度学习中对真实专家标注数据的依赖，解决标注稀缺这一核心障碍。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：1) 随机几何驱动血管模拟（递归分支、曲率控制生长、碰撞感知拓扑+域随机化强度合成）生成16500个3D血管造影体数据；2) 3D U-Net在纯合成数据上训练，推理时通过自监督掩码重建解码器进行测试时适应，弥合合成-真实域差距。
AI.result: 在多个真实MR/CT数据集（脑、肾等解剖区域）的零样本评估中，VesselSim性能与有监督血管分割SOTA基础模型相当。
AI.conclusion: 从合成管状结构中学习血管几何形状可有效实现跨域泛化，显著降低对真实医学影像数据尤其是专家标注的依赖。

title: When Rule Violations Are Rare: Chimera Training for Logical Anomaly Detection
summary: Many practical anomalies are not merely rare inputs, but violations of semantic constraints: objects co-occur in structured ways, actions imply preconditions, and events satisfy temporal or relational regularities. We study anomaly detection in this setting, where constraints are given as logical rules over learned visual concepts, but real rule violations are rare or absent during training. We propose a neural rule evaluator that compiles each constraint into a directed acyclic graph and learns feature-aware subtree MLP gates for its internal logical operators. Each gate maps child features and edge-level negations to a parent representation and a rule-satisfaction probability, with intermediate supervision obtained from exact Boolean propagation over ground-truth concept labels. The key difficulty is that same-image training data often provide insufficient coverage of informative truth configurations and also allow shortcut solutions. To address this, we introduce chimera training: an operand-level counterfactual construction at the feature level. Instead of mixing input images, we concatenate subtree features from different samples; each operand keeps the hard truth label of the sample it came from, and the chimera target is obtained by applying the node's logical operator to those inherited labels. This supplies supervised logical counterexamples without requiring real anomalous images. Across CLEVRER, OpenImages, and VidOR, the resulting evaluator improves rule-level anomaly AUROC over independent-events and same-image semantic-training baselines, especially for compositional and relational rules. The method yields both scalar anomaly scores and rule-level attributions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种神经规则评估器，用于检测违反语义约束的异常。该方法将逻辑规则编译为有向无环图，通过学习特征感知的子树MLP门实现逻辑运算，并引入"嵌合体训练"策略——在不同样本间拼接子树特征并继承其真值标签，以生成逻辑反事实样本。在CLEVRER、OpenImages和VidOR数据集上，该方法在规则级异常检测AUROC上优于基线，尤其适用于组合性和关系性规则。
AI.motivation: 实际异常不仅是罕见的输入，更重要的是对语义约束的违反（如对象共现、动作前提条件、事件时序关系等）。现有方法难以处理训练时规则违反样本稀少或缺失的情况，且同图像训练数据对真值配置的覆盖率不足，容易产生捷径解。
AI.method: 1) 将逻辑规则编译为有向无环图；2) 为每个内部逻辑运算符学习特征感知的子树MLP门，将子特征和边级否定映射到父表示和规则满足概率；3) 通过真实概念标签的精确布尔传播获得中间监督；4) 提出嵌合体训练：在不同样本间拼接子树特征，每个操作数保留其来源样本的硬标签，通过逻辑运算符组合得到嵌合体目标，生成监督逻辑反例。
AI.result: 在CLEVRER、OpenImages和VidOR数据集上，该方法在规则级异常检测AUROC上优于独立事件基线和同图像语义训练基线，尤其对组合性和关系性规则提升显著。方法同时输出标量异常分数和规则级归因。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的神经规则评估器结合嵌合体训练策略，有效解决了缺乏真实异常样本情况下的语义约束违反检测问题，在多个数据集上取得了优异的异常检测性能。

title: HyperSim: A Holistic Sim-To-Real Framework For Robust Robotic Manipulation
summary: Scaling data volume and diversity is critical for generalizing embodied intelligence. While synthetic data generation offers a scalable alternative to expensive physical data acquisition, transferring robotic manipulation policies from simulation to the real world (sim-to-real) remains a formidable challenge due to the domain gap. This paper presents HyperSim, a holistic framework spanning from synthetic data generation to policy training and seamless real-world deployment. To systematically bridge the sim-to-real gap, HyperSim is realized through three core pillars: high-fidelity environment synthesis, adversarial trajectory generation, and sim-and-real co-training. Collectively, these modules address domain discrepancies by enhancing visual fidelity, expanding data coverage, and enforcing domain-invariant representations. We rigorously validate HyperSim through a large-scale empirical study involving 400 real-world task executions across two representative manipulation models. Assessed across three fine-grained metrics, our complete pipeline achieves remarkable sim-to-real success rates of 80% and 95% with ACT and π_{0}, respectively. Furthermore, policies trained on our adversarial trajectories exhibit significantly enhanced robustness against dynamic uncertainties, achieving a 35% higher completion rate under physical perturbations.

AI.tldr: HyperSim 是一个从合成数据生成到策略训练再到真实世界部署的全流程框架，通过高保真环境合成、对抗轨迹生成和仿真-真实联合训练三大支柱系统性地缩小 sim-to-real 域差距。在包含 400 次真实世界任务执行的大规模实证中，完整 pipeline 在 ACT 和 π₀ 模型上分别达到 80% 和 95% 的 sim-to-real 成功率，且在物理扰动下完成率提升 35%。
AI.motivation: 扩展数据规模与多样性对于泛化具身智能至关重要，但真实物理数据采集成本高昂。合成数据生成虽可扩展，但机器人操作策略从仿真迁移到真实世界（sim-to-real）仍因域差距面临巨大挑战。
AI.method: HyperSim 提出三个核心模块：(1) 高保真环境合成——增强视觉真实性；(2) 对抗轨迹生成——扩展数据覆盖范围；(3) 仿真-真实联合训练——强制学习域不变表征。三者协同缩小域差异。
AI.result: 在 400 次真实世界任务执行中，完整 pipeline 在 ACT 上达 80% 成功率，在 π₀ 上达 95% 成功率。采用对抗轨迹训练的策略在物理扰动下完成率提升 35%。
AI.conclusion: HyperSim 通过系统性地结合高保真合成、对抗生成与联合训练，有效弥合了 sim-to-real 域差距，显著提升了机器人操作策略的迁移鲁棒性与真实世界部署成功率。

title: Benchmarking Convolutional, Transformer, Hybrid, and Vision Language Models for Multi Disease Retinal Screening
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, accepted at ICMHI 2026, 10th International Conference on Medical and Health Informatics, Kyoto, Japan. To appear in ACM Conference Proceedings
summary: Modern deep learning offers powerful tools for automated retinal screening, but it remains unclear how different visual model families compare in realistic multi-disease settings and under domain shift. In this work, we benchmark twelve architectures across four model families: convolutional neural networks, vision transformers, hybrid CNN-transformer backbones, and vision-language models, using the Retinal Fundus Multi-disease Image Dataset (RFMiD). We evaluate two tasks: binary screening for any retinal disease and multi-label classification across 28 disease classes. Using standardized training, calibration, and evaluation protocols, we report AUC, F1, precision, recall, and sensitivity at a clinically relevant operating point with specificity near 80%. On RFMiD, all architectures perform well on binary screening, with AUC above 84%, but attention-based models perform best. SwinTiny and the hybrid CoAtNet0 and MaxViTTiny models achieve the strongest binary screening results and improve macro and micro F1 in the multi-label setting. Vision-language models, including CLIP ViT-B/16 and SigLIP-Base384, are competitive with CNN baselines but do not surpass the best transformer and hybrid backbones. In external validation on Messidor-2 for referable diabetic retinopathy, AUC ranges from 66.8% to 84.7%, with hybrid and transformer models again showing strong performance. These results provide a reproducible reference for model selection in multi-disease retinal screening and guide future automated screening tools for clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了四大类（CNN、ViT、混合CNN-Transformer、视觉语言模型）共12种架构在视网膜多疾病筛查任务上的表现，涵盖二分类筛查和28类多标签分类，并在外部数据集上进行域迁移验证，发现基于注意力机制的模型（SwinTiny、CoAtNet0、MaxViTTiny）综合表现最优。
AI.motivation: 现代深度学习在自动化视网膜筛查中潜力巨大，但不同视觉模型家族在多疾病设定及域迁移条件下的表现差异尚不明确，缺乏系统、可复现的基准参考。
AI.method: 使用RFMiD数据集，采用标准化训练、校准和评估流程，对12种架构（涵盖CNN、ViT、混合CNN-Transformer及视觉语言模型）进行二分类筛查和多标签（28类）分类评估，并以特异性≈80%的临床相关操作点报告AUC、F1、精确率、召回率和灵敏度；同时在Messidor-2上进行外部域迁移验证。
AI.result: 二分类筛查中所有架构AUC均＞84%，注意力模型最优；SwinTiny、CoAtNet0和MaxViTTiny在二分类和多标签上均表现最强；视觉语言模型（CLIP ViT-B/16、SigLIP-Base384）与CNN基线相当但未超越最优Transformer及混合骨干网络；外部验证AUC在66.8%~84.7%之间，混合和Transformer模型表现强劲。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为多疾病视网膜筛查中的模型选择提供了可复现的参考，为未来自动化筛查工具的临床部署提供了指导。

title: ARBITER: Reasoning Trajectory Basins and Majority Vote Failures in Test-Time Sampling
summary: When language models use test-time sampling, they generate multiple reasoning trajectories and select an answer by majority vote. We show that these trajectories are not independent: for a given question, they concentrate into a small number of clusters, or reasoning basins, each defined by a normalized final answer and the solutions that reach it. A majority vote therefore selects the most stable basin rather than the most accurate one, which creates wrong-majority failures where the correct answer is present but outvoted. We introduce ARBITER, a model-agnostic approach that models interactions between basins using only the base model's own sampled outputs, hidden states, and derived evidence. Most direct correction strategies fail; ARBITER instead uses conservative additive evidence on top of consensus. In its simplest parameter-free form, ARBITER-Δ adds same-model evidence to the majority prior, while ARBITER-Enc augments this with bounded residual signals from hidden states over complete solutions. On GSM8K with Qwen3-4B, consensus over K=24 samples achieves around the mid-94% range, while a same-pool top-2 oracle reaches around the mid-96% range. ARBITER recovers a subset of these cases using zero external information. Across three model families and three math benchmarks, it yields consistent gains with no net-negative cases; for example, on Llama-3.1-8B MMLU-HS-Math, it improves accuracy from the mid-78% range to the mid-82% range, recovering about 22% of the available oracle headroom, indicating that this headroom can be partially recovered from the sample pool itself.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ARBITER方法，通过建模语言模型测试时采样中推理轨迹的聚类（推理盆地）现象，利用保守加性证据和隐藏状态信号来纠正多数投票中的错误多数失败，在多个基准上取得了一致性提升。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在测试时采样生成的多个推理轨迹并非独立，而是集中到少数几个簇（推理盆地）中，多数投票会选择最稳定的盆地而非最准确的盆地，导致正确答案被多数错误答案压倒的"错误多数失败"。现有方法无法有效纠正这一现象。
AI.method: 提出ARBITER方法，是模型无关的框架，利用基础模型自身的采样输出、隐藏状态和派生证据来建模推理盆地间的交互。包含两种形式：ARBITER-Δ（在多数先验上添加同模型证据）和ARBITER-Enc（进一步利用隐藏状态上的有界残差信号）。不使用任何外部信息。
AI.result: 在GSM8K上用Qwen3-4B：多数投票（K=24）约94%多，top-2 oracle约96%多，ARBITER恢复了部分差距。在Llama-3.1-8B MMLU-HS-Math上：准确率从约78%多提升到约82%多，恢复了约22%的oracle余量。跨三个模型家族和三个数学基准，一致增益，无净负案例。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型测试时采样的推理轨迹存在聚类现象，多数投票存在系统性缺陷。ARBITER方法能从样本池自身部分恢复oracle余量，且无需外部信息，具有广泛的适用性和稳健性。

title: L-Learning : A Lyapunov-Based Approach Leveraging Lagrangian Mechanics for Efficient and Stable Robot Tracking
summary: This paper presents L-Learning, a novel data-driven control framework for robotics that integrates Lyapunov stability theory with Lagrangian mechanics to enhance trajectory tracking performance. While traditional control methods often suffer from performance degradation in dynamic and uncertain environments, data-driven approaches, while more adaptable, are frequently limited by high sample complexity and a lack of rigorous stability guarantees. L-Learning mitigates these challenges by explicitly learning the system's energy function from data, thereby optimizing performance while ensuring closed-loop stability intrinsically. Characterized by superior control accuracy, theoretical stability guarantees, and high sample efficiency, L-Learning represents a promising solution for practical robotic applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出L-Learning，一种结合李雅普诺夫稳定性理论与拉格朗日力学的数据驱动机器人控制框架，通过学习系统能量函数同时优化轨迹跟踪性能并保证闭环稳定性，具有高控制精度、理论稳定保证和样本效率优势。
AI.motivation: 传统控制方法在动态不确定环境中性能退化，而数据驱动方法虽更具适应性但样本复杂度高且缺乏严格的稳定性保证。L-Learning旨在弥合这两类方法的差距。
AI.method: 将李雅普诺夫稳定性理论与拉格朗日力学整合到数据驱动控制框架中，从数据中显式学习系统的能量函数，在优化控制性能的同时内在地保证闭环稳定性。
AI.result: L-Learning具有优越的控制精度、理论稳定性保证和高样本效率。
AI.conclusion: L-Learning是解决实际机器人应用中稳定性与性能兼顾问题的有前景的方案。

title: A multifractal-based masked auto-encoder: an application to medical images
summary: Masked autoencoders (MAE) have shown great promise in medical image classification. However, the random masking strategy employed by traditional MAEs may overlook critical areas in medical images, where even subtle changes can indicate disease. To address this limitation, we propose a novel approach that utilizes a multifractal measure (Renyi entropy) to optimize the masking strategy. Our method, termed Multifractal-Optimized Masked Autoencoder (MO-MAE), employs a multifractal analysis to identify regions of high complexity and information content. By focusing the masking process on these areas, MO-MAE ensures that the model learns to reconstruct the most diagnostically relevant features. This approach is particularly beneficial for medical imaging, where fine-grained inspection of tissue structures is crucial for accurate diagnosis. We evaluate MO-MAE on several medical datasets covering various diseases, including MedMNIST and COVID-CT. Our results demonstrate that MO-MAE achieves promising performance, surpassing other basiline and state-of-the-art models. The proposed method also adds minimum computational overhead as the computation of the proposed measure is straightforward. Our findings suggest that the multifractal-optimized masking strategy enhances the model's ability to capture and reconstruct complex tissue structures, leading to more accurate and efficient medical image representation. The proposed MO-MAE framework offers a promising direction for improving the accuracy and efficiency of deep learning models in medical image analysis, potentially advancing the field of computer-aided diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于多重分形测度（Renyi熵）优化掩码策略的掩码自编码器（MO-MAE），用于医学图像分类，在MedMNIST和COVID-CT等数据集上超越基线模型和SOTA方法，且计算开销极小。
AI.motivation: 传统MAE采用随机掩码策略，可能忽略医学图像中指示疾病的细微关键区域，导致模型无法充分学习诊断相关的特征。
AI.method: 利用多重分形分析（Renyi熵）识别医学图像中高复杂度和高信息量的区域，并将掩码过程聚焦于这些区域，迫使模型重建最具诊断意义的特征。
AI.result: 在MedMNIST和COVID-CT等多个医学数据集上，MO-MAE超越了基线模型和现有SOTA方法，且仅增加极小的计算开销。
AI.conclusion: 多重分形优化的掩码策略增强了模型捕获和重建复杂组织结构的能力，提升了医学图像表示的准确性和效率，为计算机辅助诊断提供了有前景的方向。

title: InfoQuant: Shaping Activation Distributions for Low-Bit LLM Quantization
summary: Low-bit activation quantization remains a major bottleneck in efficient large language model (LLM) deployment. The difficulty is not only that activations contain outliers, but that their distributions are often poorly matched to a low-bit uniform quantizer. Existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods suppress peaks, balance channels, or minimize reconstruction error, yet they rarely specify what activation distribution is actually easy to discretize. As a result, activations may appear numerically smoother while still incurring large quantization error because the quantization range remains wide or most values collapse into a few levels near the mean. We recast activation transformation as quantizer-facing distribution design and analyze quantization error from an information-theoretic perspective. Our analysis shows that quantization-friendly activations should jointly have a smaller numerical range and sufficient dispersion within that range. Guided by this analysis, we propose InfoQuant, a train-free method that employs Peak Suppression Orthogonal Transformation (PSOT) to shape activations into more quantization-friendly distributions. We further introduce adaptive outlier-token selection to improve the robustness of PSOT during optimization. Across multiple LLM families, InfoQuant consistently outperforms prior PTQ and end-to-end training baselines. Under W4A4KV4, it preserves 97% of floating-point accuracy on average and reduces the LLaMA-2 13B performance gap by 42% over the previous state of the art. Code is available at [https://github.com/LLIKKE/InfoQuant](https://github.com/LLIKKE/InfoQuant)

AI.tldr: 本文提出InfoQuant，一种无需训练的后训练量化方法，通过峰值抑制正交变换将激活分布塑造为更易量化的形式，在W4A4KV4设置下平均保留97%的浮点精度，在LLaMA-2 13B上相比之前最先进方法将性能差距缩小42%。
AI.motivation: 低比特激活量化是大语言模型高效部署的主要瓶颈，现有后训练量化方法虽然抑制异常值、平衡通道或最小化重构误差，但未明确说明什么样的激活分布易于离散化，导致激活值看似平滑却仍存在大量量化误差。
AI.method: 从信息论角度分析量化误差，提出量化友好的激活应同时具有较小的数值范围和充分的离散程度。基于此分析，提出InfoQuant：采用峰值抑制正交变换（PSOT）塑造激活分布，并引入自适应异常令牌选择以提高PSOT优化的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在多种LLM系列上，InfoQuant持续优于先前的后训练量化和端到端训练方法。在W4A4KV4设置下平均保留97%的浮点精度，将LLaMA-2 13B的性能差距相比之前最先进方法缩小42%。
AI.conclusion: 从信息论视角将激活变换重新定义为面向量化器的分布设计问题，明确了量化友好分布的关键特征（小数值范围+充分离散），提出的InfoQuant方法无需训练即可显著提升低比特激活量化效果。

title: On the Generalization Capabilities, Design Choices and Limitations of Keypoint Imitation Learning
comment: This version was submitted to IROS 2026
summary: RGB-based imitation learning requires many demonstrations to generalize to unseen objects or scenes, motivating research into intermediate representations to improve generalization for robotic manipulation. Visual foundation models enable one-shot extraction of keypoints to provide such representation. However, it remains unclear how to integrate them into imitation learning optimally and when they outperform alternative representations. We combine approaches from previous works on keypoint imitation learning (KIL) and investigate several design choices to provide practical guidelines. Using over 2000 real-world rollouts, we also assess the generalization capabilities of KIL to unseen objects and scene variations. KIL achieves a 75% overall success rate across five tasks, significantly outperforming the RGB baseline (47%) and performing on par with S2-diffusion (73%). Finally, we explore the limitations of the foundation models used for keypoint extraction and extend KIL to tasks with multiple object instances. Our results confirm KIL as a data-efficient approach for robot learning, though it does not outperform alternative representations and inherits limitations of the foundation models used for keypoint extraction. All rollout videos, demonstrations, and results are available at https://kil-manipulation.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于关键点的模仿学习（KIL）在机器人操作中的泛化能力，通过2000多次真实世界 rollout 评估发现，KIL 在五类任务中达到75%成功率，显著优于RGB基线（47%），与S2-diffusion（73%）持平，但未超越其他表示方法，且受限于基础模型的关键点提取能力。
AI.motivation: 基于RGB的模仿学习需要大量演示才能泛化到未见过的物体或场景，因此需要研究中间表示来提升机器人操作的泛化能力。视觉基础模型能够通过一次性提取关键点来提供这种表示，但如何将它们最优地整合到模仿学习中，以及何时它们优于其他表示，仍不清楚。
AI.method: 结合前人关于关键点模仿学习（KIL）的方法，研究多种设计选择以提供实用指南。通过2000多次真实世界 rollout，评估KIL对未见物体和场景变化的泛化能力，并与RGB基线和S2-diffusion进行对比。
AI.result: KIL在五类任务中取得75%总体成功率，显著优于RGB基线（47%），与S2-diffusion（73%）表现相当。
AI.conclusion: KIL是一种数据高效的机器人学习方法，但并未超越其他表示方法，且继承了用于关键点提取的基础模型的局限性。研究还探索了基础模型在关键点提取中的局限性，并将KIL扩展到多物体实例任务。

title: Evi-Steer: Learning to Steer Biomedical Vision-Language Models through Efficient and Generalizable Evidential Tuning
comment: MICCAI 2026 Early Accept; Project Page: https://tahakoleilat.github.io/Evi-Steer
summary: Parameter-efficient adaptation of vision-language foundation models is crucial for precise multimodal understanding of biomedical images, yet existing methods remain deterministic and often struggle under domain shift or ambiguous image-text alignment. This limitation is particularly critical in the clinic, where models should remain robust in low-data regimes and domain shifts. We present Evi-Steer, an evidential cross-modal low-dimensional steering framework for BiomedCLIP that enables uncertainty-aware parameter-efficient fine-tuning while updating only 0.11% of total model parameters.
