Our approach performs lightweight low-dimensional token updates in both vision and text encoders while simultaneously estimating epistemic uncertainty. These uncertainty estimates update gate residuals, allowing the model to adapt conservatively when evidence is weak. Furthermore, we introduce cross-modal confidence fusion based on Dempster-Shafer theory, enabling visual adaptation to be conditioned on textual confidence and suppressing conflicting or uncertain cross-modal updates. We conduct a comprehensive evaluation on 15 biomedical imaging datasets spanning 8 organs and 8 imaging modalities under few-shot learning and domain generalization settings. Evi-Steer consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods under few-shot learning and domain shift settings, demonstrating a practical and robust pathway for deploying vision-language models in real-world clinical settings. Code is available at https://github.com/HealthX-Lab/Evi-Steer.

AI.tldr: Evi-Steer提出了一种基于证据理论的跨模态低维引导框架，仅更新0.11%的BiomedCLIP参数，通过不确定性感知的轻量级微调在15个生物医学数据集上实现了少样本学习和域泛化场景下的最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言基础模型的参数高效微调方法在生物医学图像理解中是确定性的，在域偏移或图像-文本对齐模糊时表现不佳，临床场景下亟需在低数据 regime 和域偏移中保持鲁棒性的方法。
AI.method: 1) 在视觉和文本编码器中执行轻量级低维token更新，同时估计认知不确定性；2) 不确定性估计更新门控残差，使模型在证据薄弱时保守适应；3) 基于Dempster-Shafer理论的跨模态置信度融合，使视觉适应条件依赖于文本置信度，抑制冲突或不确定的跨模态更新。
AI.result: 在涵盖8个器官、8种成像模态的15个生物医学数据集上，Evi-Steer在少样本学习和域泛化设置下持续优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: Evi-Steer为视觉-语言模型在真实临床环境中的部署提供了一种实用且鲁棒的途径。

title: GAC: Noise-Aware Adaptive Mixing for Hybrid SFT-RL Post-Training
summary: Hybrid post-training usually combines supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, but fixed mixing schedules cannot adapt when the relative noise of the two signals changes over time. We propose GAC, a noise-aware controller that derives an adaptive mixing weight from online estimates of gradient variance and disagreement between the two training signals. The method adds smoothing, prior guidance, and bounded updates while reusing existing training tensors. Experiments on math, code, science, and logic benchmarks show that GAC consistently improves hybrid post-training over strong fixed and rule-based baselines, with larger gains at larger model scales and less than 1% training overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出GAC，一种基于噪声感知的自适应混合权重控制器，通过在线估计梯度方差和两个训练信号之间的分歧来动态调整监督微调与强化学习的混合比例，在数学、代码、科学和逻辑基准上持续优于固定和基于规则的基线方法，且训练开销小于1%。
AI.motivation: 混合后训练通常结合监督微调和强化学习，但固定的混合调度无法适应两种信号相对噪声随时间变化的问题。
AI.method: 提出GAC（Gradient-Aware Controller），一种噪声感知控制器，通过在线估计梯度方差和两个训练信号之间的分歧来推导自适应混合权重；同时引入平滑处理、先验指导和有界更新机制，并重用现有训练张量以减少计算开销。
AI.result: 在数学、代码、科学和逻辑基准上，GAC持续优于强固定基线和基于规则的基线方法，在更大模型规模上增益更显著，且训练开销低于1%。
AI.conclusion: GAC通过噪声感知的自适应混合策略有效提升了混合后训练的性能，尤其在大规模模型上优势明显，且计算开销极小，是一种实用的替代固定混合调度的方法。

title: SteelDS: A High-Resolution Video Dataset of E40 Steel Scrap for Object Detection and Instance Segmentation
summary: This dataset provides high-resolution, annotated video sequences of shredded E40-grade steel and copper scrap on a conveyor belt. Captured in a controlled laboratory environment, the data reflects the industrial post-magnetic sorting stage, where manual intervention is typically required to remove copper contaminants. The dataset comprises 24,297 labeled frames across five subsets, featuring 396 steel and 101 copper objects categorized by size. It supports the development of machine learning models for material classification, object detection, and instance segmentation. Variations in object spacing and density are included to simulate realistic industrial sorting conditions. Ground truth annotations include pixel-wise segmentation masks and material classes. This dataset serves as a benchmark for evaluating automated sorting algorithms aiming to identify copper impurities within complex, heterogeneous steel scrap streams.

AI.tldr: 该数据集包含24,297帧高分辨率标注视频，记录了传送带上E40级钢和铜废料的工业级后磁选分拣场景，包含396个钢铁和101个铜物体，提供像素级分割掩码和材料类别标注，用于支持材料分类、目标检测和实例分割的机器学习模型开发。
AI.motivation: 工业废料分拣中，磁选后仍需人工干预去除铜杂质，缺乏高质量标注数据集来支持自动化分拣算法的开发与评估。
AI.method: 在受控实验室环境中采集传送带上E40级钢和铜废料的高分辨率视频，包含5个子集共24,297帧标注数据，提供像素级分割掩码和材料类别标签，并改变物体间距与密度以模拟真实工业条件。
AI.result: 构建了含396个钢铁和101个铜物体（按尺寸分类）的标注数据集，涵盖材料分类、目标检测和实例分割任务，可作为自动化分拣算法的基准测试。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集为复杂异构废钢流中铜杂质识别的自动化分拣算法提供了标准化的评估基准，有利于推动工业废料分拣的自动化进程。

title: CNNs, Transformers, Hybrid, and Vision Language Models for Skin Cancer Detection
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, accepted at ICPRAI 2026, The Fifth International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence. To appear in Lecture Notes in Computer Science
summary: Skin cancer is a common and fast rising malignancy worldwide. Early detection is critical for improving outcomes. Deep learning models trained on dermoscopic and clinical images can support automated and fast triage. However, many studies evaluate only a limited set of architectures. Experimental setups also vary across studies. In this paper, we present a unified evaluation of twelve deep learning models for binary skin cancer detection on the PAD-UFES-20 dataset. The models span four families: convolutional neural networks (CNN), vision transformers (ViT), hybrid convolution transformer backbones, and vision language models (VLM). Performance is assessed using AUC, the maximum F1 score with its precision and recall, and sensitivity at 80% specificity, reflecting screening oriented requirements. Our results show that well tuned CNNs already provide strong baselines, but transformer based families consistently improve discrimination. Hybrid models (MaxViT Tiny, CoAtNet0) and a SigLIP based VLM achieve the best overall trade off between ranking performance and clinically relevant operating points, while CLIP based model offers high precision. The full codebase for all experiments is publicly released. Together, these findings offer practical guidance on which model families are most suitable for real world deployment in skin cancer screening and establish a reproducible reference point for future work on PAD-UFES-20.

AI.tldr: 本文在PAD-UFES-20数据集上对12种深度学习模型（含CNN、ViT、混合卷积Transformer骨干及视觉语言模型）进行了统一的二元皮肤癌检测评估，发现调优后的CNN提供强基线，但Transformer类模型表现更优，其中混合模型（MaxViT Tiny、CoAtNet0）和SigLIP视觉语言模型在排序性能与临床操作点间达到最佳平衡。
AI.motivation: 皮肤癌发病率高且快速上升，早期检测至关重要；现有深度学习研究常局限于少数架构且实验设置不统一，缺乏系统性的跨模型家族对比评估。
AI.method: 在PAD-UFES-20数据集上统一评估12种深度学习模型，涵盖CNN、ViT、混合卷积Transformer骨干和视觉语言模型四大类；使用AUC、最大F1及其精确率和召回率、80%特异性下的灵敏度等指标进行评估。
AI.result: 调优CNN提供强基线但Transformer类模型一致性更优；混合模型（MaxViT Tiny、CoAtNet0）和SigLIP VLM在排序性能与临床操作点间取得最佳平衡；CLIP模型具有高精确率。
AI.conclusion: 为真实世界皮肤癌筛查中的模型选择提供实用指导，并在PAD-UFES-20上建立了可复现的参考基准。

title: Max-Window Scale Estimation for Near-Lossless HiF8 W8A8 Quantization-Aware Training
summary: Quantization-aware training (QAT) with low-bit floating-point formats enables efficient LLM deployment, yet introduces subtle failure modes invisible to standard training metrics. We present a systematic study of HiF8 W8A8 QAT for OpenPangu-Embedded-1B through the lens of Delayed Tensor Scaling (DTS). Across eight controlled experiments, we identify and disentangle two orthogonal failure modes: (i)amax saturation, where delayed scale estimates silently corrupt knowledge-sensitive representations via forward-pass clipping, and (ii)catastrophic forgetting, where an aggressive learning rate overwrites pretrained commonsense knowledge independently of quantization. Neither is detectable from training loss alone. We address amax saturation with a conservative max-algorithm DTS strategy over a 64-step history window, and mitigate forgetting via a 500-step BF16 warmup followed by QAT at lr=10^{-5}. Both fixes are necessary and sufficient: our final configuration achieves 0.43% MMLU drop, 0.58% HellaSwag drop, and 0.22% ARC-Challenge drop versus a matched BF16 baseline, with a training loss APE of only 0.11% over 10,000 steps.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了HiF8 W8A8量化感知训练（QAT）在OpenPangu-Embedded-1B模型中的失效模式，识别并解决了amax饱和与灾难性遗忘两个正交问题，通过保守最大算法DTS策略和BF16预热+低学习率QAT，最终在MMLU、HellaSwag、ARC-Challenge上分别仅下降0.43%、0.58%、0.22%，训练损失APE仅0.11%。
AI.motivation: 低比特浮点格式的量化感知训练在LLM部署中会引入标准训练指标无法检测的细微失效模式，现有方法对此缺乏系统性理解，需要识别并解决这些隐藏故障。
AI.method: 通过延迟张量缩放（DTS）视角，在8个受控实验中解耦两种失效模式：(i)amax饱和——延迟缩放估计导致前向裁剪破坏知识敏感表征；(ii)灾难性遗忘——激进学习率覆盖预训练常识知识。采用64步历史窗口的保守最大算法DTS策略缓解amax饱和，通过500步BF16预热+lr=10^{-5}的QAT缓解遗忘。
AI.result: 最终配置在MMLU上仅下降0.43%，HellaSwag下降0.58%，ARC-Challenge下降0.22%，训练损失APE仅0.11%（10,000步）。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的两种修复策略（保守DTS和BF16预热+低学习率QAT）对于实现低比特浮点QAT的高质量部署是必要且充分的，且训练损失无法反映这些失效模式。

title: Look Further: Socially-Compliant Navigation System in Residential Buildings
comment: 2025 ACM/IEEE International Conference on Human-Robot Interaction
summary:
The distance at which a mobile robot reacts to a person strongly impacts various qualities of the human-robot interaction. In this paper, we focus on the navigation of a mobile delivery robot platform in a residential indoor hallway environment. Social navigation methods typically focus on avoiding uncomfortable human-robot interactions, such as when a robot encroaches on someone's personal space. Since personal space has been shown to be in the range of just a few meters, social navigation methods typically focus on deconflicting and resolving these short-range interactions. In this work, however, we demonstrate that by extending the reaction distance to over eight meters, far beyond the typical interaction distance, we can improve the human's perception of the robot's motion. We introduce the Proactive Lane-Changing (PLC) motion pattern and a navigation system that leverages it to react to people at an increased distance. This pattern consists of changing the robot's lateral position as it navigates down the hallway from the center to the side at an eight-meter distance from an oncoming person.
  We conducted a user study with 42 participants to assess their impressions of the delivery robot based on three service objectives: safety, smoothness, and politeness. In the straight hallway scenario (Frontal Approach), results showed significant improvement in each of these three objectives compared to typical motion patterns found in the literature: slowing down, stopping, and reactive collision avoidance in the proximity of a person. In contrast, in the intersection (Blind Corner) scenarios, none of the approaches performed significantly better than any other, with participants having a diverse range of preferences among robot motion patterns.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种主动变道（PLC）导航模式，通过将移动机器人的反应距离延长至8米以上（远超传统社交导航的短距离范围），显著提升了人在直走廊场景中对机器人运动的安全性、平滑性和礼貌性感知，但在路口盲角场景中未表现出显著优势。
AI.motivation: 现有社交导航方法通常仅在短距离（几米内）处理人机交互以避免侵入个人空间，然而作者认为将反应距离扩展至远超过典型交互距离，可能改善人类对机器人运动的主观感知。
AI.method: 提出主动变道（Proactive Lane-Changing, PLC）运动模式：机器人在走廊中距迎面行人8米时，从中心位置主动向一侧横向偏移；并构建了配套导航系统。通过用户研究（42名参与者）在直走廊正面接近和路口盲角两种场景下，对比PLC与现有常见模式（减速、停止、近距离反应式避碰）的效果。
AI.result: 在直走廊正面接近场景中，PLC在安全性、平滑性和礼貌性三个维度上均显著优于对比方法。在路口盲角场景中，各方法间无显著差异，参与者偏好呈现多样化。
AI.conclusion: 远距离主动变道模式在开阔走廊环境中能有效提升人机交互感知质量，但复杂场景（如盲角）需更个性化的处理策略，单一模式难以满足所有用户偏好。

title: Sleep-stage efficient classification using a lightweight self-supervised model
summary: Accurate classification of sleep stages is crucial for diagnosing sleep disorders and automating this process can significantly enhance clinical assessments. This study aims to explore the use of a self-supervised model (more specifically, an adapted version of mulEEG) combined with a Linear SVM classifier to improve sleep stage classification. \textbf{Methods:} The mulEEG model, which learns electroencephalogram signal representations in a self-supervised manner, was simplified here by replacing ResNet-50 with 1D-convolutions used as time series encoder by a ResNet-18 backbone. Two other adaptations were conducted: the first one evaluated different configurations of the model and data volume for training, while the second tested the effectiveness of time series features, spectrogram features, and their concatenation as inputs to a Linear SVM classifier. \textbf{Results:} The results showed that reducing the volume of data offered a better cost-benefit ratio compared to simplifying the model. Using the concatenated features with ResNet-18 also outperformed the linear evaluations of the original mulEEG model, achieving higher classification performance. \textbf{Conclusions:} Simplifying the mulEEG model to extract features and pairing it with a robust classifier leads to more efficient and accurate sleep stage classification. This approach holds promise for improving clinical sleep assessments and can be extended to other biological signal classification tasks.

AI.tldr: 本研究将自监督mulEEG模型简化（ResNet-18替代ResNet-50），结合线性SVM分类器进行睡眠分期分类，发现减少数据量比简化模型更具成本效益，且拼接特征优于原始模型，实现了更高效准确的分类。
AI.motivation: 睡眠分期准确分类对诊断睡眠障碍至关重要，自动化该过程可显著提升临床评估效率，因此探索更优的自监督模型与分类器组合方案。
AI.method: 采用简化版mulEEG模型（1D卷积+ResNet-18替代ResNet-50作为时序编码器），提取时序特征、频谱特征及其拼接特征，输入线性SVM分类器进行睡眠分期分类，并与原始模型进行对比评估。
AI.result: 减少训练数据量比简化模型结构具有更好的成本效益比；使用ResNet-18提取的拼接特征结合线性SVM，分类性能超越原始mulEEG模型的线性评估结果。
AI.conclusion: 简化mulEEG模型提取特征并搭配强分类器（线性SVM）可实现更高效准确的睡眠分期分类，该方法有望改善临床睡眠评估，并可推广至其他生物信号分类任务。

title: HRVConformer: Neonatal Hypoxic-Ischemic Encephalopathy Classification from the Heart Rate signals
comment: Paper submitted to Journal of Engineering Applications of Artifical Intelligence
summary: This paper presents the HRVConformer, a novel deep learning architecture for the classification of hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) using the instantaneous heart rate (HR) signal. Unlike conventional approaches that rely on handcrafted features, HRVConformer directly processes raw HR signals in an end-to-end manner, capturing both local and long-range dependencies through a hybrid Convolution-Transformer framework. By integrating convolutional layers for local feature extraction and Transformer-based attention mechanisms for global context modelling, the architecture effectively enhances signal representation and classification performance. The model was trained using supervised learning on a large HR dataset consisting of 1,573 one-hour epochs, including 259 one-hour expert-annotated epochs and a substantial set of weakly labelled data. A 314-hour validation set provided a robust performance estimation, while an independent 215-hour dataset with expert annotations was reserved for final testing. HR signals were extracted from electrocardiogram (ECG) recordings using an improved Pan-Tompkins algorithm, which significantly enhanced both signal quality and data availability. Experimental results demonstrate that the HRVConformer achieves an AUC of 83.23\% and accuracy of 74.56\% on the test set. These results surpass the performance of the Transformer, ResNet50 and fully convolutional networks baselines, highlighting the advantages of integrating convolutional and Transformer-based components for HR-based HIE classification. The proposed method provides a promising step toward a more accurate and automated assessment of HIE using HR signals. The code is available at: https://github.com/syu-kylin/HRVConformer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了HRVConformer，一种结合卷积和Transformer的混合深度学习架构，用于基于瞬时心率信号对缺氧缺血性脑病（HIE）进行端到端分类，在包含1,573小时epoch的大型数据集上训练，在测试集上达到83.23%的AUC和74.56%的准确率，优于Transformer、ResNet50和全卷积网络基线。
AI.motivation: 传统HIE分类方法依赖手工特征，无法充分利用心率信号中的信息。本文旨在开发一种端到端的深度学习方法，直接处理原始HR信号，避免手工特征工程的局限性，提高HIE分类的准确性。
AI.method: 采用混合Convolution-Transformer框架：卷积层提取局部特征，Transformer注意力机制建模全局上下文依赖。使用改进的Pan-Tompkins算法从ECG中提取HR信号。训练数据包括1,573小时epoch（其中259小时专家标注+弱标注数据），314小时验证集，215小时独立测试集。
AI.result: 在测试集上AUC达到83.23%，准确率74.56%，优于Transformer、ResNet50和全卷积网络基线。改进的Pan-Tompkins算法显著提升了信号质量和数据可用性。
AI.conclusion: HRVConformer结合卷积和Transformer组件的优势，为基于HR信号的HIE自动评估提供了一种更准确、更自动化的方法，是该领域一个有前景的研究方向。

title: Manipulating Tangible Virtual Object Dynamics to Promote Learning of Precision Force Generation
summary: Robotic haptic devices combined with virtual reality offer novel opportunities to train fine force generation, an essential yet overlooked component of post-stroke rehabilitation. This study proposes that manipulating the rendered dynamics of tangible virtual objects can be leveraged to train precise force control while engaging the somatosensory system. We conducted an experiment with fifty healthy participants who performed a curling-inspired task in which they had to stretch a virtual spring to generate a target release force to propel the stone to a predefined location on the ice sheet. During training, the spring's force-elongation relationship was modeled as either a linear or non-linear function, i.e., a Gaussian or antisymmetric Gaussian (AS-Gaussian) function with zero derivative at the release target force. Results indicate that the AS-Gaussian group consistently achieved higher force accuracy during training than the linear group, while the Gaussian group only outperformed the linear group toward the end of training. Analysis of personality traits revealed that higher Free Spirit scores were associated with poorer performance and reduced task exploration under Gaussian dynamics, whereas higher Transform-of-Challenge scores correlated with increased exploration. Despite these training effects, no significant differences in long-term retention were found across spring types or personality traits. Participants primarily relied on learned target elongation rather than target force, as evidenced by performance in a transfer task with a different stiffness but the same target force. While promising for somatosensory neurorehabilitation, these methods require refinement to reduce reliance on proprioceptive cues before testing with neurological patients.

AI.tldr: 本文研究利用可触虚拟物体的非线性动力学（AS-高斯/高斯弹性模型）训练健康被试的精细力控制能力，发现非线性模型（尤其是AS-高斯）在训练中能提升力精度，但长期保留效果不显著，且被试主要依赖位移而非力感学习。
AI.motivation: 机器人触觉设备结合虚拟现实为训练中风后康复中常被忽视的精细力生成能力提供了新机会，本研究旨在通过调控虚拟物体的物理动力学来训练精确力控制并激活躯体感觉系统。
AI.method: 50名健康被试执行冰壶投掷任务，需拉伸虚拟弹簧产生目标释放力。训练中弹簧力-伸长关系被建模为线性、高斯或反对称高斯（AS-高斯）函数（后两者在目标力处导数为零）。分析训练表现、人格特质影响及转移任务中的学习策略。
AI.result: AS-高斯组在整个训练中力精度始终优于线性组；高斯组仅在训练后期优于线性组。高Free Spirit人格特质在高斯动力学下与较差表现和低探索相关，而高Transform-of-Challenge与高探索相关。长期保留无显著差异。转移任务显示被试主要依赖目标伸长量而非目标力。
AI.conclusion: 非线性触觉动力学在训练力控制方面有前景，但目前被试主要依赖本体感觉线索（位移），需改进方法以用于神经系统患者的康复。

title: E$^3$C: Video Generation with 3D Environmental Memory and Ego-Exo Human Pose Control
summary: Controllable and physically grounded egocentric video generation is essential for embodied agents to reason about how their own and others' actions manifest and change the world. Compared to generic video synthesis, egocentric generation is especially challenging: the camera is tightly coupled to the actor, leading to rapid viewpoint changes and frequent self-occlusions; the underlying actions are subtle, articulated, and often only partially visible; and both the people and the scene state must evolve consistently with the specified controls. We present E$^3$C, a controllable video diffusion framework for egocentric generation that builds structured and compact conditions disentangling persistent scene structure from human-driven dynamics. From context frames, E$^3$C constructs a semi-dense point cloud-based 3D memory and augments each point with appearance descriptors from video-VAE features. Rendering this memory into target viewpoints produces conditioning aligned with the target frames. Human dynamics are modeled separately. The observed people in the scene are controlled by skeleton renderings (exo human control), while the camera wearer is specified by their 3D body joints and 6DoF wrist motion (ego human control). To preserve ego human control when the wearer's body parts are invisible, we introduce an ego motion encoder that produces persistent cross-attention tokens. Experiments on Nymeria show that E$^3$C improves visual fidelity, camera-motion accuracy, object consistency, and ego & exo human control over strong baselines, while also enabling intuitive scene editing.

AI.tldr: E$^3$C是一个可控视频扩散框架，通过构建基于半稠密点云的3D记忆和分离的人体动力学建模，实现物理可信的第一人称视频生成，支持自我中心与外部的双重人体控制，在Nymeria数据集上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体需要可控且物理可信的第一人称视频生成，以推理自身及他人动作如何改变世界。然而自我中心视频生成面临挑战：相机与演员紧密耦合导致视角快速变化和频繁自遮挡；动作细微、关节化且仅部分可见；人物与场景状态需与指定控制一致演化。
AI.method: 提出E$^3$C框架：1) 从上下文帧构建半稠密点云3D记忆，用视频VAE特征增强每个点，渲染到目标视角提供条件；2) 人体动力学建模分离为外部人体控制（通过骨架渲染）和自我人体控制（3D身体关节+6DoF手腕运动）；3) 引入自我运动编码器，在穿戴者身体部位不可见时生成持久交叉注意力令牌以保持控制。
AI.result: 在Nymeria数据集上，E$^3$C在视觉保真度、相机运动准确性、物体一致性和自我/外部人体控制方面均显著优于强基线方法，并支持直观的场景编辑。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦场景结构与人驱动动力学，并分别建立条件控制机制，E$^3$C有效解决了自我中心视频生成的独特挑战，为具身智能体的视觉推理提供了可控且物理可信的生成工具。

title: Modeling Dynamic Mixtures of Time-Delay Systems from Streaming Time Series
summary: This research addresses the problem of adaptive modeling in time-series data streams with clear input-output relationships. This problem is challenging because rapid system changes (regime shifts) caused by environmental factors or input delay changes degrade model performance, and the trade-off among accuracy, robustness, and memory usage arises when using multiple small models for each time-series pattern. To address these issues, this paper presents an online framework/method that treats streaming time series as dynamic mixtures of time-delay systems. This framework maintains robustness of model tracking and reduces memory usage by summarizing past regimes using a fixed-length representation that captures both the system dynamics and input-output delays. Concretely, this approach constructs a summary system tensor using the system's Markov parameter series, capturing both dynamic behavior and delay characteristics. If necessary, a tensor decomposition algorithm extracts relevant past models from the tensor and helps select the system that best fits the current regime. This method enables rapid adaptation to environmental changes and is computationally efficient. Tests on real datasets show that DelayMix consistently outperforms other methods, achieving superior forecast accuracy and faster adaptation to delays, especially for highly non-stationary data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DelayMix，一种将流式时间序列视为动态混合时滞系统的在线框架，通过构建系统马尔可夫参数张量并利用张量分解提取相关模型，在保持低内存占用的同时实现快速自适应建模，实验证明其在非平稳数据上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 时间序列数据流中存在清晰的输入输出关系，但环境因素或输入延迟变化导致的系统快速变化（机制转移）会降低模型性能，且使用多个小模型时需要在精度、鲁棒性和内存占用之间权衡。
AI.method: 将流式时间序列建模为动态混合的时滞系统，通过构造基于系统马尔可夫参数序列的摘要系统张量来捕获动态行为和延迟特性，必要时使用张量分解算法从张量中提取相关历史模型并选择最适合当前机制的系统。
AI.result: 在真实数据集上，DelayMix在预测准确性上持续优于其他方法，特别是在高度非平稳数据上能更快适应延迟变化。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能快速适应环境变化且计算高效，通过固定长度表示总结历史机制，在保持模型跟踪鲁棒性的同时降低了内存使用。

title: Can VLA Models Learn from Real-World Data Continually without Forgetting?
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide a promising foundation for general-purpose robotics. However, their successful deployment in real-world scenarios requires the ability to continually acquire new skills while retaining previously learned behaviors. While pioneering research has studied the continual learning of VLA models in narrowly simulated environments, this challenge remains largely unexplored under realistic conditions. To address this limitation, we construct a real-world continual learning dataset comprising four sequential manipulation tasks, spanning rigid-object pick-and-place, contact-rich pressing, and deformable-object folding. Using this dataset, we conduct comprehensive experiments and find that VLA models suffer significant catastrophic forgetting when continually learning from heterogeneous real-world demonstrations. We then systematically evaluate experience replay and uncover key implementation factors that govern its success. In summary, this work provides the first empirical study of real-world continual VLA learning and offers practical guidance for deploying long-lived robot policies.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在真实世界场景下研究视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型的持续学习问题，构建了包含四种连续操作任务的数据集，发现VLA模型存在严重灾难性遗忘，并系统评估了经验回放方法及其关键实现因素。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在通用机器人领域具有潜力，但现实部署需要持续获取新技能同时保留旧知识。现有研究仅在狭窄模拟环境中探索持续学习，缺乏真实条件下的系统研究。
AI.method: 构建包含刚性物体抓取放置、接触式按压、可变形物体折叠等四个连续操作任务的真实世界持续学习数据集，进行VLA模型持续学习实验，并系统评估经验回放策略。
AI.result: VLA模型在持续学习异构真实世界演示时表现出显著的灾难性遗忘；经验回放方法的成功取决于多个关键实施因素。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了真实世界持续VLA学习的首个实证研究，为部署长期运行的机器人策略提供了实践指导。

title: RadarSim: Simulating Single-Chip Radar via Multimodal Neural Fields
summary: Radars are an ideal complement to cameras: both are inexpensive, solid-state sensors, with cameras offering fine angular resolution, while radars provide metric depth and robustness under adverse weather. However, radar data is more difficult to interpret than camera images and varies significantly between sensors, necessitating increased reliance on simulation for prototyping sensors and processing pipelines. Recent work treating radar reconstruction as a novel view synthesis problem has shown great promise in reconstructing radar-relevant geometry and simulating low-level radar data. However, such methods are constrained by the low spatial resolution of the underlying radar. To address this, we propose a unified differentiable renderer, RadarSim, which leverages the high angular resolution of RGB cameras to generate Doppler radar range images from a camera-initialized neural field. Using a novel data set of calibrated radar camera recordings from a custom hand-held rig, we demonstrate that RadarSim produces sharper geometry and Doppler range frames than radar-only reconstructions.

AI.tldr: RadarSim是一种统一的可微分渲染器，利用RGB相机的高角分辨率从相机初始化的神经场生成多普勒雷达距离图像，相比仅雷达重建能产生更清晰的几何和Doppler距离帧。
AI.motivation: 雷达数据难以解读且传感器间差异大，需要依赖仿真。现有基于新视图合成的雷达重建方法受限于雷达的低空间分辨率，因此需要利用相机的高角分辨率来提升雷达重建质量。
AI.method: 提出RadarSim统一可微分渲染器，从相机初始化的神经场生成多普勒雷达距离图像，利用RGB相机的高角分辨率来补充雷达的低分辨率缺陷。
AI.result: 在自建校准雷达-相机数据集上，RadarSim生成的几何和Doppler距离帧比纯雷达重建更清晰。
AI.conclusion: RadarSim通过融合相机信息有效提升了雷达重建的分辨率和质量，证明了相机-雷达联合建模的优越性。

title: Co-folding model guided by structural proteomics
summary: Protein structure generative models excel at predicting single protein static structures from sequence, but routinely fail to capture the correct conformational state of protein complexes, critical for protein design and induced proximity modalities such as antibodies and PROTACs. While structural proteomics techniques like Cross-Linking Mass Spectrometry (XL-MS) and Hydrogen-Deuterium Exchange (HDX-MS) offer valuable spatial and dynamic insights, integrating these sparse, heterogeneous measurements into these models remains an open challenge. Here, we bridge this gap by combining structural proteomics data with the rich biophysical priors learned by pretrained diffusion models. We introduce AIMS-Fold, an inference-time guided-diffusion framework that actively steers the generative sampling trajectory using differentiable physical potentials derived from XL-MS spatial restraints and HDX-MS solvent accessibility profiles. We demonstrate that these structural methods individually enhance predictive accuracy, and their integration yields synergistic improvement. Crucially, by leveraging these experimental restraints, AIMS-Fold achieves higher accuracy on challenging induced proximity targets than purely computational, unguided state-of-the-art models like Boltz-2. This establishes our framework as a powerful, integrative computational approach for the structure based drug design of induced proximity drugs. Evaluation code will be made publicly available upon publication.

AI.tldr: AIMS-Fold是一个推理时引导扩散框架，通过整合XL-MS空间约束和HDX-MS溶剂可及性图谱的微分物理势能，主动引导生成采样轨迹，在诱导接近靶标上实现优于Boltz-2等纯计算方法的结构预测精度，为基于结构的诱导接近药物设计提供了强大的整合计算途径。
AI.motivation: 现有蛋白质结构生成模型虽能预测静态结构，但无法捕获蛋白复合物的正确构象状态，这对蛋白质设计和抗体/PROTAC等诱导接近模态至关重要。结构蛋白质组学数据（XL-MS和HDX-MS）虽能提供空间和动态信息，但将这些稀疏、异质的测量数据整合到现有模型中仍是一个未解决的挑战。
AI.method: 提出AIMS-Fold，一个推理时引导扩散框架，通过从XL-MS空间约束和HDX-MS溶剂可及性图谱中导出的可微分物理势能，主动引导预训练扩散模型的生成采样轨迹，实现结构蛋白质组学数据与预训练扩散模型学习的丰富生物物理先验的结合。
AI.result: 单独使用XL-MS或HDX-MS约束均可提升预测准确性，两者整合产生协同效应。在具有挑战性的诱导接近靶标上，AIMS-Fold相比Boltz-2等纯计算无引导的SOTA模型取得了更高的精度。
AI.conclusion: AIMS-Fold建立了一个强大的整合计算框架，通过实验约束引导扩散模型，为基于结构的诱导接近药物（如抗体和PROTACs）设计提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Learning Compositional Symbolic Task Rules from Demonstrations with Inductive Logic Programming
comment: In: ICRA 2026 Workshop on Semantics for Reliable Robot Autonomy: From Environment Understanding and Reasoning to Safe Interaction, Vienna, 2026 In: ICRA 2026, International Joint Workshop on Ontologies, Semantic Maps and Autonomous Robotics Standardization (J-WOSMARS 2026), Vienna, 2026
summary: Learning from Demonstration~(LfD) should capture not only how a task is executed, but also its high-level task structure that explains the demonstrated behavior. As robots become more autonomous, such task representations must be inspectable, reusable, and human-interpretable. To address this, we study how to represent and learn robotic tasks with inductive logic programming~(ILP) by decomposing a complex task into a series of simpler learning objectives at different abstraction (ontological) levels. The system infers symbolic rules from demonstrations and prior (domain) knowledge, and reuses learned rules when learning higher-level task structure. We evaluate the approach in a synthetic block-assembly scenario and show that the learned abstractions are interpretable and support strong generalization to harder, held-out tasks with unseen objects. These results provide preliminary evidence that decomposed ILP is a feasible approach to task-level LfD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用归纳逻辑编程（ILP）通过将复杂任务分解为不同抽象层级的简单学习目标，从示范中学习可解释、可重用、可检查的符号化任务结构，并在积木组装场景中验证了其泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 从示范中学习不仅要捕获任务的执行方式，还要解释其高层任务结构。随着机器人自主性提高，任务表示需要具备可检查性、可重用性和人类可解释性。
AI.method: 使用归纳逻辑编程（ILP）将复杂任务分解为不同抽象（本体论）层级的多个简单学习目标，从示范和先验（领域）知识中推断符号规则，并在学习高层任务结构时重用已学规则。
AI.result: 在合成积木组装场景中，学习到的抽象具有可解释性，并支持对包含未见物体的更难、保留任务的强泛化。
AI.conclusion: 分解式ILP是任务级示教学习（LfD）的一种可行方法。

title: Erased but Exploitable: Black-box Embedding-Aware Prompting Against Unlearned Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
summary:
Machine unlearning aims to remove specific concepts from pretrained text-to-image diffusion models, yet several white- and black-box attacks have been introduced to make the model generate such unlearned concepts. These attacks, nevertheless, do not assume a realistic threat model, i.e. they either assume access to the model weights, or result in gibberish adversarial prompts that could be easily detected even through naive rule-based safeguarding. We aim to address this gap in this paper.
  We introduce BEAP, a black-box, embedding-aware adversarial prompting attack that leverages a large language model (LLM) to iteratively generate effective adversarial prompts and exploit such hidden vulnerabilities.
  BEAP performs an embedding-aware search in text space, combining multiple reward signals: unlearned concept presence, text-image alignment, and image quality, to refine generated prompts.
  Unlike previous attack methods, BEAP keeps its prompts undetectable to safety filters while producing high-quality images.
  Extensive experiments show that BEAP improves the Attack Success Rate (ASR) by more than 60% over prior methods, while requiring only an average of fifteen prompts per successful attack. Warning: This paper contains model outputs that may be offensive or upsetting in nature.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BEAP，一种黑盒、嵌入感知的对抗性提示攻击方法，利用大语言模型迭代生成有效对抗提示，以暴露文本到图像扩散模型中机器遗忘机制的隐藏漏洞。BEAP在文本空间中进行嵌入感知搜索，结合多种奖励信号（未学习概念存在性、文本-图像对齐、图像质量）来优化生成的提示。与以往攻击方法不同，BEAP能够绕过安全过滤器并生成高质量图像。实验表明，BEAP的攻击成功率相比先前方法提升超过60%，每次成功攻击仅需平均15个提示。
AI.motivation: 现有针对文本到图像扩散模型机器遗忘的对抗攻击存在两个主要局限：一是白盒攻击需要访问模型权重，不现实；二是黑盒攻击往往生成无意义的对抗提示，容易被基于规则的检测机制识别。本文旨在弥合这一差距，提出更符合现实威胁模型的攻击方法。
AI.method: BEAP（Black-box, Embedding-Aware adversarial Prompting）方法：利用大语言模型（LLM）在文本空间中迭代搜索，通过嵌入感知的方式生成对抗提示，并结合多种奖励信号（未学习概念存在性、文本-图像对齐度、图像质量）对生成的提示进行优化，同时保持提示不被安全过滤器检测。
AI.result: BEAP的攻击成功率（ASR）相比先前方法提升超过60%，每次成功攻击平均仅需15个提示，且生成的对抗提示难以被安全过滤器检测。
AI.conclusion: BEAP揭示了现有扩散模型机器遗忘机制存在隐藏的脆弱性，表明黑盒、嵌入感知的对抗提示攻击是一种现实且有效的威胁，需要更鲁棒的遗忘防御机制。

title: Bridging Classification and Reconstruction: Cooperative Time Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) has long been a hot research topic in data mining due to its various applications. Recent studies challenge the effectiveness of popular deep learning methods for TSAD, suggesting their failure in detecting subtle and prolonged anomalies. Outlier Exposure (OE) and Masked Autoencoder (MAE) emerge as two promising paradigms (classification and reconstruction) for solving the above problems. However, OE-based methods are constrained by poor generalization, while MAE-based methods are limited by masking misalignment issues. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a novel framework, CoAD, which unifies the two paradigms to leverage their complementary strengths while mitigating their respective weaknesses. In this framework, the classification module generates probability-informed soft masks for the reconstruction module, which in turn alleviates the generalization problem of the classification module. This cooperative design enables CoAD to effectively detect subtle and complex anomalies that are often overlooked by existing methods. Additionally, the classification module is carefully designed to resolve issues related to improper classification granularity and the neglect of frequency information. Extensive experiments on high-quality benchmark datasets, conducted under rigorous evaluation protocols, demonstrate that CoAD significantly outperforms both state-of-the-art deep learning and traditional data mining methods, highlighting the potential of deep learning in TSAD. Moreover, CoAD is lightweight and substantially faster than existing SOTA methods, demonstrating its practical value for large-scale, real-time applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoAD框架，统一了分类（Outlier Exposure）和重建（Masked Autoencoder）两种范式用于时间序列异常检测，通过分类模块生成概率软掩码指导重建模块，同时重建模块缓解分类模块的泛化问题，从而有效检测细微和复杂异常，在多个基准数据集上显著超越现有方法，且轻量高效。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习方法在时间序列异常检测中难以检测细微和持续性异常；Outlier Exposure方法泛化能力差，Masked Autoencoder方法存在掩码对齐问题，两种范式各有优劣但未得到有效结合。
AI.method: 提出CoAD框架，包含分类模块和重建模块的协同设计。分类模块生成概率信息的软掩码用于指导重建模块，重建模块反过来缓解分类模块的泛化问题。分类模块还针对分类粒度过粗和忽略频率信息的问题进行了专门设计。
AI.result: 在高质量基准数据集上，采用严格的评估协议，CoAD显著优于现有的深度学习和传统数据挖掘方法，并且比现有最佳方法更轻量、速度更快。
AI.conclusion: CoAD通过统一分类与重建两种范式，实现了优势互补，有效提升了时间序列异常检测的性能，尤其是在细微和复杂异常检测方面，同时具备实际应用中的大规模实时部署价值。

title: A Bioinspired Underwater Robot with a Latch-Mediated Soft Bistable Mechanism
summary: Underwater robotics has advanced significantly over recent decades. however, the development of miniaturized underwater robots remains limited by low energy densities of traditional power sources. Nature offers compelling solutions-organisms like mantis shrimps and fleas utilize latch-mediated spring actuation (LaMSA) systems that achieve rapid movements through a decoupled energy storage and release mechanism. Despite extensive studies of LaMSA, replicating such rapid, asymmetric actuation within simple, compact structures remains challenging. In this work, we introduce a bioinspired, soft bistable actuator with an integrated latch mechanism that enables asymmetric energy input and release using a single motor. Coupled with fin structures, this design facilitates efficient underwater propulsion and maneuverability. Experimental results demonstrate stable periodic flapping, precise steering, and a maximum thrust of 0.528 N, impulse of 0.147 Ns, and vertical displacement of 30 mm. By modulating fin angles, the robot achieves versatile motions, including vertical ascent, diagonal forward movement, and lateral translation. This study presents a novel, energy-efficient approach for controlling motion in compact underwater robots, paving the way for advanced biomimetic designs with potential applications in exploration, environmental monitoring, and inspection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种受生物启发的软体双稳态致动器，集成闩锁机制，通过单电机实现非对称能量输入与释放，结合鳍结构实现高效水下推进与机动控制，实验验证了稳定拍动、精确转向及多种运动模式。
AI.motivation: 微型水下机器人受限于传统能源的低能量密度，而自然界中螳螂虾、跳蚤等生物利用闩锁-弹簧驱动系统（LaMSA）实现了快速运动，但如何在简单紧凑结构中复现这种快速非对称驱动仍具挑战。
AI.method: 设计了一种仿生软体双稳态致动器，集成闩锁机制，使用单一电机实现非对称能量输入与释放；耦合鳍结构实现水下推进与机动。
AI.result: 实现了稳定的周期性拍动、精确转向，最大推力0.528 N、冲量0.147 Ns、垂直位移30 mm；通过调节鳍角实现垂直上升、斜向前进和横向平移等多种运动。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了一种紧凑型水下机器人的节能运动控制新方法，为先进仿生设计在探索、环境监测和检测等领域的应用奠定了基础。

title: Personalized Generative Models for Contextual Debiasing
comment: CVPR 2026 Workshop on Synthetic Data for Computer Vision and Generative Models for Computer Vision. Code available at https://github.com/princetonvisualai/DecoupleGen
summary: Different visual patterns appear with different frequencies in the world: e.g., beach balls appear on sand more often than they do on a road. These statistics are reflected in vision datasets, and as a result trained models more easily recognize objects in common scenarios. However, recognizing a beach ball on a road may arguably be even more important than recognizing it on sand. We study how to mitigate this discrepancy. Since collecting uncommon images in the real world may be difficult, we explore whether generating images with less frequent contexts can serve as effective training augmentation. A key challenge is guiding generations to remain close to the original dataset distribution while creating diverse images with uncommon contexts. We introduce Decoupling Contextual Patterns with Generations (DecoupleGen), a method that personalizes text-to-image diffusion models to facilitate coherent synthesis of images with rare contexts while preserving original visual details. The generated images contain semantically meaningful content and remain visually aligned with the original datasets. We further apply verification constraints to ensure relevance of the augmented data. We evaluate our approach on object classification and recognition tasks on complex scene datasets. Our experiments demonstrate consistent improvements over previous approaches, and our analyses identify factors underlying these improvements.

AI.tldr: 提出DecoupleGen方法，利用文本到图像扩散模型生成罕见上下文场景的训练图像，以缓解模型在常见场景上表现好但罕见场景上表现差的问题，在目标分类和识别任务上取得了持续改进。
AI.motivation: 现实世界中不同视觉模式出现频率不同，导致训练模型在常见场景中识别效果好，但在罕见场景中识别效果差。然而，识别罕见场景中的物体（如沙滩球在路上）可能比识别常见场景更重要。由于收集真实世界中的罕见图像困难，探索是否可以通过生成具有不常见上下文的图像作为有效的训练增强手段。
AI.method: 提出DecoupleGen方法，个性化文本到图像扩散模型，在保持与原始数据集分布接近的同时，生成具有罕见上下文的连贯合成图像。通过解耦上下文模式与生成过程，确保生成的图像包含语义上有意义的内容，并与原始数据集在视觉上保持一致。进一步应用验证约束确保增强数据的相关性。
AI.result: 在复杂场景数据集上的目标分类和识别任务中，DecoupleGen方法相较于之前的方法取得了一致的改进。
AI.conclusion: 生成具有罕见上下文的图像可以作为有效的训练增强手段，缓解模型在常见和罕见场景之间性能差异的问题。DecoupleGen方法通过个性化扩散模型生成保持原始分布但具有罕见上下文的图像，并辅以验证约束，有效提升了模型的泛化能力。

title: On the Role of Inductive Bias in Time-Series Pretraining: A Case Study in Learning Generalizable Representations for Clinical Time Series
summary: Clinical time-series learning is routinely constrained by small, heterogeneous cohorts and protocol drift, while its downstream use spans both classification (e.g., pathology diagnosis) and regression (e.g., temporal forecasting). These constraints make foundation-model pretraining appealing, but raises an important question of which inductive biases should the pretraining objective impose so that representations transfer across task types and subjects. We study this question in pathological gait analysis for spinal cord injury (SCI) via PathoFM, an encoder-centric transformer pretrained on multivariate gait windows with three complementary objectives: Local Completion (reconstruct contiguous masked spans to enforce local structure), Temporal Continuity (predict a masked mid-horizon continuation from an observed prefix to enforce smoothness and causal consistency), and Unsupervised In-Context Dynamics (support-query reconstruction conditioned on subject exemplar windows via attention). Empirically comparing objective families (grouping/contrastive, dynamics-based, and generative reconstruction), we find that dynamics-centric mixtures produce the most balanced transfer: grouping objectives favor discriminative margins but can degrade magnitude fidelity needed for continuous targets, whereas reconstruction-only objectives preserve waveform structure but may underperform on classification. Overall, combining local reconstruction with temporal continuity, and adding in-context conditioning when exemplar access is realistic, yields robust subject-generalizing representations.

AI.tldr: PathoFM是一个面向脊髓损伤病理步态分析的编码器中心Transformer，通过局部补全、时间连续性和无监督上下文动力学三种互补目标预训练，发现动态中心目标组合能产生最均衡的跨任务迁移表示。
AI.motivation: 临床时间序列学习受限于小规模异质队列和协议漂移，而下游任务涵盖分类和回归，因此需要研究预训练目标应施加何种归纳偏置才能使表示跨任务类型和跨主体迁移。
AI.method: 提出PathoFM，一个编码器中心Transformer，在多元步态窗口上使用三种互补目标预训练：局部补全（重构连续掩码跨度以强化局部结构）、时间连续性（预测掩码中期延续以强化平滑性和因果一致性）、无监督上下文动力学（基于支持-查询重构，通过注意力机制条件化于主体样本窗口）。
AI.result: 动态中心目标组合产生最均衡的迁移性能：分组目标有利于判别边界但降低连续目标所需的幅度保真度，重构目标保留波形结构但在分类上可能表现不足。结合局部重构与时间连续性，并在样本访问现实时添加上下文条件化，能产生鲁棒的主体泛化表示。
AI.conclusion: 对于临床时间序列的预训练，动态中心的目标混合策略（局部重构+时间连续性+上下文条件化）能最好地平衡分类与回归任务的迁移需求，优于纯分组/对比或纯重构方法。

title: Object Pose and Shape Estimation for Grasping: Does it Work?
summary: The problem of object pose and shape estimation has seen key advancements lately. Encoder-decoder (e.g., SAM3D, LRM, CRISP) and diffusion-based models (e.g., InstantMesh, Zero123, SceneComplete) have shown category-agnostic shape encoding capacity and open-set generalizability. In this work, we ask the question: Are the object pose and shape estimation methods mature enough, such that when used with antipodal grasp sampling, can outperform the end-to-end grasp synthesis methods? We explore this question in detail by scoping our study to parallel jaw grippers, 7-DoF grasps, and single-view RGB(-D) image as input. We implement and compare a state-of-the-art, end-to-end grasp synthesis method and three modular methods, which first estimate the object pose and shape for all objects in the scene, and generate grasps using antipodal sampling. We observe that the modular methods outperform the end-to-end method in all our experiments. The modular methods are able to synthesize plenty of grasps, even for small objects, where the end-to-end methods fail. The effectiveness of the modular methods is contingent on the accuracy of the pose and shape estimation, and suffers partial degradation in cluttered scenes - a limitation of the existing pose and shape estimation methods. We also analyze the failure modes and run-times for the three modular methods, which use two different ways of object pose and shape estimation: one based on an encoder-decoder model, while another a diffusion model. Finally, we demonstrate that the single-view object pose and shape estimation methods can be augmented with vision-language models to yield language-conditioned grasps from just single-view RGB-D image as input. We notice comparable performance to the state-of-the-art LERF-TOGO baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文探究了基于物体位姿与形状估计的模块化方法（先估计再抓取）与端到端抓取合成方法的性能对比。实验表明，在平行爪夹持器、7自由度抓取和单视图RGB(-D)输入条件下，模块化方法在抓取合成上全面优于端到端方法，尤其对小物体更有效，但其性能依赖于位姿与形状估计的准确性，在杂乱场景中会退化。此外，模块化方法可结合视觉语言模型实现语言条件抓取，性能与现有基线相当。
AI.motivation: 探究当前物体位姿与形状估计方法是否已足够成熟，以至于结合对极抓取采样后能够超越端到端抓取合成方法。
AI.method: 将一种端到端抓取合成方法与三种模块化方法（先估计场景中所有物体的位姿和形状，再通过对极采样生成抓取）进行对比实验。模块化方法采用两种不同的位姿与形状估计方式：编码器-解码器模型和扩散模型。此外，将单视图物体位姿与形状估计方法与视觉语言模型结合，实现语言条件抓取。
AI.result: 模块化方法在所有实验中均优于端到端方法，能够合成大量抓取，包括端到端方法失败的小物体场景。模块化方法的有效性依赖于位姿与形状估计的精度，在杂乱场景中性能会部分退化。结合视觉语言模型的语言条件抓取性能与LERF-TOGO基线相当。
AI.conclusion: 基于物体位姿与形状估计的模块化抓取范式在当前条件下优于端到端方法，但受限于现有位姿与形状估计方法在杂乱场景中的精度。模块化方法具有可扩展性，可结合视觉语言模型实现语言条件抓取。

title: Unified Panoramic Geometry Estimation via Multi-View Foundation Models
summary: Geometry estimation from perspective images has greatly advanced, maturing to the point where off-the-shelf foundation models are able to reconstruct 3D scene structure not only from multi-view imagery, but even from a single view. A natural extension is 3D reconstruction from panoramas, with the exciting prospect of recovering a full 360-degree scene from a single panoramic image. In this work, we introduce PaGeR (Panoramic Geometry Reconstruction), a framework to lift powerful 3D foundation models designed for perspective imagery to the panorama domain. Our strategy is to start from a pre-trained transformer for 3D reconstruction and turn it into a unified high-performance model that predicts scale-invariant depth, metric depth, surface normals, and sky masks from both perspective and omnidirectional images, in a single forward pass. By keeping architectural changes to a minimum and mixing perspective and panoramic images during training, PaGeR retains the rich 3D prior of the underlying foundation model while learning to also estimate geometrically consistent 360-degree scenes from single panoramas. We extensively test our method in both indoor and outdoor environments and find that it delivers state-of-the-art performance and excellent zero-shot performance across a wide range of scenes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PaGeR框架，通过最小化架构修改并将全景与透视图像混合训练，将预训练的3D重建基础模型扩展到全景域，实现从单张全景图像一步预测尺度不变深度、度量深度、表面法线和天空掩码，在室内外场景中达到最先进性能及优秀的零样本泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 将专为透视图像设计的成熟3D基础模型扩展到全景图像领域，实现从单张全景图像恢复完整360度场景的3D结构。
AI.method: 基于预训练的3D重建Transformer模型，保持最小架构改动，在训练中混合透视与全景图像，使模型保留原有3D先验的同时学习预测几何一致的全景360度场景。
AI.result: 在室内外场景中均达到最先进性能，并在广泛场景下展现出优秀的零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: PaGeR成功将透视图像的3D基础模型高效迁移到全景域，实现了从单张全景图进行统一、高精度的3D几何重建。

title: From Privacy to Generalization: Linear Max-Information Bounds for DP-SGD
summary: Understanding the relationship between generalization and privacy remains a central challenge in modern machine learning theory, particularly for deep networks trained by variants of differentially private stochastic gradient descent (DP-SGD). In this work we make progress on this persistent open problem by proving a finite-sample bound on the approximate max-information of DP-SGD that exhibits scaling properties comparable with (Dwork et al, 2015)'s classic result for $ε$-differentially private algorithms, namely at most linear in the dataset size. From our result we obtain a general-purpose PAC-Bayes generalization bound in which the necessary prior distribution can be learned by DP-SGD, as well as a generalization bound for DP-SGD-trained models themselves, with a complexity term that is fully explicit and controlled by the optimization hyperparameters.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了DP-SGD的近似最大信息量具有与数据集大小呈线性关系的有限样本界，并据此推导出PAC-Bayes泛化界以及DP-SGD训练模型的显式泛化界。
AI.motivation: 理解泛化与隐私之间的关系是现代机器学习理论的核心挑战，特别是对于通过差分隐私随机梯度下降（DP-SGD）变体训练的深度网络而言，这一问题长期悬而未决。
AI.method: 证明DP-SGD的近似最大信息量具有与数据集大小至多呈线性关系的有限样本界，类似(Dwork et al, 2015)针对ε-差分隐私算法的经典结果。
AI.result: 获得了通用PAC-Bayes泛化界（其中先验分布可由DP-SGD学习），以及DP-SGD训练模型本身的泛化界，其复杂度项完全显式且由优化超参数控制。
AI.conclusion: 本文在隐私与泛化关系的理论分析上取得了重要进展，为DP-SGD的泛化行为提供了可操作的显式边界。

title: Trust, Geometry, and Rules: A Credibility-Aware Reinforcement Learning Framework for Safe USV Navigation under Uncertainty
summary: Autonomous navigation of Unmanned Surface Vehicles (USVs) that is safe and compliant with the International Regulations for Preventing Collisions at Sea (COLREGs) remains a formidable challenge in dynamic maritime environments, particularly when perception systems exhibit miscalibrated uncertainty. Existing Reinforcement Learning (RL)-based methods often falter because state-estimation errors induce unreliable belief states that mislead the value function, while discrete traffic rules introduce discontinuity in the learning objective. To address these challenges, we propose a framework integrating credibility-aware learning, geometric safety shielding, and continuous rule-aware embedding. First, Credibility-Weighted Value Learning (CW-VL) introduces a dynamic trust factor derived from the discrepancy between filter-estimated covariance and empirical error statistics to modulate the critic's heteroscedastic loss, preventing policy overfitting to noisy samples. Second, the Covariance-Inflated Velocity Obstacle (CI-VO) maps position-estimation uncertainty into set-wise angular margins, forming a conservative geometric shield that overrides hazardous exploratory actions. Third, Risk-Aware COLREGs Duty Embedding relaxes binary encounter duties into continuous rule-aware signals, providing smooth sector-transition information and suppressing oscillation from sparse rule rewards. Simulated encounter studies demonstrate improved training robustness against perceptual inconsistency and superior collision avoidance and COLREGs compliance over baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合可信度感知学习、几何安全屏蔽和连续规则感知嵌入的框架，用于解决USV在动态海洋环境中存在感知不确定性的自主导航与COLREGs合规问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于RL的方法因状态估计误差导致信念状态不可靠、离散交通规则导致学习目标不连续，难以在感知系统存在未校准不确定性的动态海事环境中实现安全且合规的自主导航。
AI.method: 1) 可信度加权值学习(CW-VL)：利用滤波器估计协方差与经验误差统计之间的差异构建动态信任因子，调节评论家异方差损失；2) 协方差膨胀速度障碍(CI-VO)：将位置估计不确定性映射为集合角裕度，形成保守几何屏蔽；3) 风险感知COLREGs职责嵌入：将二元避碰职责松弛为连续规则感知信号，抑制稀疏规则奖励引起的振荡。
AI.result: 仿真遭遇研究表明，该方法在感知不一致条件下具有更强的训练鲁棒性，在避碰和COLREGs合规方面优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过可信度加权、几何屏蔽和连续规则嵌入三方面的创新，有效解决了感知不确定性下的USV自主导航与规则合规问题。

title: Joint Instance Segmentation and Geometric Attribute Regression for Roof Structures in Aerial Imagery
summary: We present a method for jointly predicting instance-level roof segment masks together with three continuous geometric attributes -- building height, roof slope, and roof azimuth -- from a single aerial orthophoto. Our approach extends Mask R-CNN with a dedicated attribute regression branch and introduces two key innovations: a conditional azimuth loss that suppresses supervision for flat roof segments where azimuth labels are inherently noisy, and a log-normalized height representation that addresses the heavily skewed distribution of building heights. We train and evaluate on a large-scale dataset of Dutch aerial images paired with automatically derived ground truth from 3DBAG, a nationwide LiDAR-based 3D building dataset. Using a DINOv3 ConvNeXt-Base backbone, our method achieves a mean absolute error of approximately 4 degrees for roof slope, 7 degrees for azimuth, and 1 meter for building height, with an instance segmentation AP$_{50}$ of 0.566. The predicted per-segment masks and attributes are sufficient to reconstruct simplified 3D building models (LoD2) from a single overhead image, requiring expensive 3D reference data only for training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种从单张航空正射影像中联合预测屋顶实例分割掩码及三个连续几何属性（建筑高度、屋顶坡度、屋顶方位角）的方法。该方法扩展了Mask R-CNN，增加了属性回归分支，并引入了两个关键创新：条件方位角损失（抑制平屋顶段噪声标签）和对数归一化高度表示（处理建筑高度偏态分布）。基于荷兰航空影像和3DBAG数据集训练，使用DINOv3 ConvNeXt-Base骨干网络，在屋顶坡度、方位角和建筑高度上分别达到约4度、7度和1米的平均绝对误差，实例分割AP₅₀为0.566。预测结果足以从单张航拍图像重建简化的LoD2级3D建筑模型。
AI.motivation: 从单张航空正射影像中自动提取建筑屋顶的实例级分割掩码及其几何属性（高度、坡度、方位角），以支持大规模3D建筑模型重建，降低对昂贵3D参考数据的依赖。
AI.method: 基于Mask R-CNN框架，增加专用属性回归分支；提出条件方位角损失（对平屋顶段抑制监督）和对数归一化高度表示（处理高度分布偏态）；使用DINOv3 ConvNeXt-Base骨干网络；在荷兰航空影像与3DBAG LiDAR数据集上训练和评估。
AI.result: 屋顶坡度MAE约4度，方位角MAE约7度，建筑高度MAE约1米，实例分割AP₅₀为0.566。预测结果足以从单张图像重建LoD2级简化3D建筑模型。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够从单张航空正射影像中有效预测屋顶级实例掩码和几何属性，仅需训练时使用昂贵的3D参考数据，即可在推理时仅依赖单张2D图像重建3D建筑模型。

title: Provably Communication-Efficient and Privacy-Preserving Federated Graph Neural Networks
summary: Graph neural networks (GNNs) achieve strong performance on relational data, but real-world graphs are often distributed across organizations that cannot share raw data due to privacy and policy constraints. Existing federated GNN methods either ignore cross-client links, leading to degraded accuracy, or require frequent embedding exchanges, incurring substantial communication and privacy costs. We propose CE-FedGNN, a communication-efficient and privacy-preserving federated GNN framework for learning over such coupled graphs. Our approach avoids sharing raw data or per-round embeddings by infrequently exchanging aggregated node representations. To handle cross-client dependency and staleness, we introduce a moving-average estimator that continuously tracks node representations and enables their stable reuse across rounds. To provide formal privacy guarantees for the released representations, we adopt the metric differential privacy (metric-DP) framework, which measures privacy with respect to distances in the learned embedding space rather than worst-case input perturbations. This yields meaningful guarantees at noise levels where standard differential privacy becomes overly conservative. We establish convergence to a stationary point at a rate of $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ with $O(T^{3/4})$ communication complexity. In addition, we derive $(\varepsilon,δ)$-metric-DP guarantees via Rényi differential privacy composition under a public-cohort threat model. Experiments on synthetic interbank anti-money laundering benchmarks and citation networks demonstrate that CE-FedGNN achieves strong performance while significantly reducing communication and maintaining robustness under privacy-preserving noise.

AI.tldr: 提出CE-FedGNN框架，通过低频交换聚合节点表示、移动平均估计器处理跨客户端依赖与过时性问题，并采用度量差分隐私提供形式化隐私保证，在联邦图学习中实现通信高效与隐私保护。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦GNN方法要么忽略跨客户端链接导致精度下降，要么需要频繁嵌入交换产生巨大通信和隐私开销，亟需一种兼顾通信效率与隐私保护的联邦图学习方法。
AI.method: 1) 低频交换聚合节点表示而非原始数据或每轮嵌入；2) 移动平均估计器持续追踪节点表示，支持跨轮稳定重用；3) 采用度量差分隐私（metric-DP）框架，基于嵌入空间距离度量隐私而非最坏情况扰动。
AI.result: 收敛到驻点的速率为$O(1/\sqrt{T})$，通信复杂度为$O(T^{3/4})$；在合成反洗钱基准和引文网络上达到强性能，显著降低通信开销，并在隐私噪声下保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: CE-FedGNN有效解决了跨客户端图数据联邦学习中的通信效率与隐私保护权衡问题，证明了在合理隐私预算下仍能保持模型性能。

title: Towards Shared Embodied Intelligence in Humanoid Robots through Optimization Development and Testing of the Human Aware ergoCub Robot
summary: Collaboration is central to human behavior, enabling tasks beyond individual capability. This ability arises from coordinating actions through internal representations of others, a concept known as shared intelligence. Additionally, humans are characterized by physical bodies and cognitive abilities that are optimized in response to their environment, a phenomenon referred to as embodied cognition. Designing humanoid robots that collaborate safely and effectively with people requires unifying these principles. Here we propose an architecture that integrates shared intelligence and embodied cognition to enable robots to physically collaborate with humans, where robot hardware and control are optimized for human metrics, using representations of the human body and motion intelligence. The ultimate goal is to achieve a form of shared embodied intelligence. Specifically, our architecture optimizes robot hardware and physical intelligence parameters with respect to human ergonomic metrics. This is accomplished by modeling human-robot interaction as a function of hardware configurations and embedding human models into the robot's physical intelligence. As a concrete implementation, we present the humanoid robot ergoCub, whose morphology and control have been optimized for collaborative tasks with humans. Our approach provides a framework for designing humanoid robots that prioritize human ergonomics at both the hardware and physical intelligence levels, with applications in industrial and assistive robotics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种融合共享智能与具身认知的架构，通过将人体模型嵌入机器人硬件与控制优化中，实现了人形机器人与人类的安全有效协作。具体实现为ergoCub机器人，其形态和控制均针对人类工效学指标进行了优化。
AI.motivation: 人类协作依赖于共享智能（内部表征他人）和具身认知（身体与认知适应环境），而设计能与人类安全有效协作的人形机器人需要统一这两大原则。
AI.method: 提出集成共享智能与具身认知的架构，将人体模型嵌入机器人的物理智能中，并以人类工效学指标为优化目标，联合优化机器人硬件配置与物理智能参数，将人机交互建模为硬件配置的函数。
AI.result: 实现了ergoCub人形机器人，其形态与控制均针对人类协作任务进行了工效学优化。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为设计优先考虑人类工效学的人形机器人提供了方法论，可在硬件和物理智能层面实现以人为本的优化，适用于工业与辅助机器人领域。

title: BioFact-MoE: Biologically Factorized Mixture of Experts for Vision-Language Prognostic Modeling in Hepatocellular Carcinoma
summary: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is biologically heterogeneous, shaped by the interplay between hepatic functional reserve and tumor-related oncologic factors; thus, similar survival outcomes may reflect fundamentally different underlying biological processes. Prognostic modeling in HCC is informed by rich multimodal information from multiparametric MRI and radiology reports from routine clinical practice. Existing prognostic vision-language models (VLMs) learn a single entangled latent representation that blends hepatic and tumor-related factors, limiting both accuracy and biological interpretability. We present BioFact-MoE, a biologically factorized Mixture of Experts (MoE) framework that explicitly decomposes liver and tumor factors via biologically supervised experts within a residual MoE survival architecture. On a HCC cohort of N=588 patients (pretrained on 4,582 3D MRI image-report pairs), BioFact-MoE consistently improves survival prediction over all baselines across time horizons, achieving 12-, 18-, and 24-month AUCs of 75.33%, 75.85%, and 73.96%. Beyond scalar risk prediction, gated expert weights enable phenotype-aware risk stratification. Pathway-informed gating uncovers clinically meaningful treatment-associated survival heterogeneity. In held-out validation, hepatic and tumor embeddings show selective associations with liver function and tumor burden markers, respectively (p<0.05), without supervision. The code is available at https://github.com/jy-639/BioFact-MoE.

AI.tldr: 提出BioFact-MoE框架，通过生物因子化的混合专家模型，将肝脏功能与肿瘤因素显式解耦，在HCC生存预测中超越现有基线，并实现可解释的风险分层。
AI.motivation: HCC预后受肝功能储备与肿瘤癌因素共同影响，现有视觉-语言模型将两者编码为单一纠缠的潜在表示，限制了预测精度和生物学可解释性。
AI.method: 提出BioFact-MoE，包含：(1) 生物因子化的混合专家（MoE）架构，通过生物学监督的专家显式分解肝脏和肿瘤因素；(2) 残差MoE生存体系结构；(3) 基于通路调控的门控机制实现表型感知的风险分层。
AI.result: 在N=588的HCC队列（预训练于4,582对3D MRI图像-报告）上，12、18、24个月AUC分别达75.33%、75.85%、73.96%，一致优于所有基线。肝脏和肿瘤嵌入在无监督条件下分别与肝功能标志物和肿瘤负荷指标显著相关（p<0.05）。
AI.conclusion: BioFact-MoE通过显式因子化解耦提升了HCC生存预测的准确性与生物学可解释性，门控权重可揭示治疗相关的生存异质性，为临床精准预后提供新范式。

title: The Bridge-Garden Dilemma in LLM Distillation: Why Mixing Hard and Soft Labels Works
summary: Knowledge distillation (KD) transfers knowledge from a large teacher model to a smaller student. In language modeling, the student is trained either on tokens sampled from the teacher (hard labels) or the teacher's full next-token distribution (soft labels). Despite soft labels appear strictly richer, we find that mixing hard and soft labels consistently yields better results. Crucially, we show that this gain cannot be explained by closer teacher matching during training. Instead, it comes from reduced exposure bias, the mismatch between training and inference distributions. To explain this phenomenon, we introduce the Bridge-Garden Decomposition theory, which categorizes generation steps into two types: Bridges, where the next token must be exact, and Gardens, where it can be flexible. We show that hard-only KD excels in Bridges by avoiding risky deviations, while soft-only KD preserves diversity in Gardens. A hybrid strategy handles both cases and, as a result, reduces exposure bias across the sequence. Guided by this theory, we develop a family of Bridge-Garden hybrid supervision methods that adaptively balance hard and soft labels. Across a primary suite of seven teacher-student pairs (including Qwen, Llama, Gemma, and DeepSeek) and benchmarks in reasoning and coding, our approach outperforms divergence-based and on-policy KD baselines while reducing training cost by 9.7x, enabling efficient model compression. Code is available at https://github.com/ghwang-s/bridge_garden_hybrid_kd_release.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Bridge-Garden分解理论，揭示了知识蒸馏中硬标签与软标签混合策略能降低曝光偏差，并通过自适应混合方法在7个教师-学生对上实现超越基线性能，同时降低9.7倍训练成本。
AI.motivation: 尽管软标签理论上更丰富，但混合硬标签与软标签在语言模型知识蒸馏中始终表现更好，且这种增益不能用更接近教师分布来解释，需要探究其根本原因。
AI.method: 提出Bridge-Garden分解理论将生成步骤分为两类：Bridge（需精确匹配）和Garden（可灵活选择）；基于该理论开发自适应平衡硬软标签的混合监督方法。
AI.result: 在Qwen、Llama、Gemma、DeepSeek等7个教师-学生对的推理与代码基准上，优于基于散度和on-policy的KD基线，训练成本降低9.7倍。
AI.conclusion: 混合硬软标签策略通过减少曝光偏差提升性能，Bridge-Garden理论为该现象提供了合理解释，且自适应混合方法实现了高效模型压缩。

title: TPS-Drive: Task-Guided Representation Purification for VLM-based Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) provide a promising foundation for autonomous driving planning, yet bridging semantic reasoning and precise 3D spatial forecasting remains a critical challenge. Existing representation strategies generally follow two paths: text-aligned methods flatten continuous spatial states into symbols, which compromises geometric structure and induces "spatial hallucinations"; dense visual methods preserve spatial topology but overwhelm standard tokenizers with redundant background textures, leading to "representation interference". To address these limitations, we introduce TPS-Drive, a novel framework centered on Task-Guided Representation Purification that empowers VLMs to Think in Purified Space. At its core, an Agent-Centric Tokenizer utilizes a task-guided vector quantization mechanism supervised by a frozen 3D detection head, which explicitly reallocates limited codebook capacity from pervasive static backgrounds to critical dynamic agents and effectively isolates spatial redundancy. Leveraging this purified spatial vocabulary, TPS-Drive employs a decoupled reasoning pipeline that sequentially performs scene understanding, future forecasting, and action generation. The framework is optimized via a progressive three-stage training paradigm, culminating in reward-driven refinement that surpasses pure imitation learning. Extensive experiments validate our approach: TPS-Drive achieves accurate agent spatial state forecasting and reduces collision rates in open-loop nuScenes evaluations, while establishing new safety records on the rigorous closed-loop NAVSIMv1 and NAVSIMv2 benchmarks.

AI.tldr: TPS-Drive提出了一种任务引导的表示纯化框架，通过智能体中心分词器将有限码本容量从静态背景重新分配给关键动态智能体，并结合解耦推理管道和三阶段训练范式，显著提升了VLM在自动驾驶规划中的空间推理能力，在nuScenes、NAVSIMv1和NAVSIMv2基准上实现了低碰撞率和新安全记录。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM在自动驾驶规划中面临两难：文本对齐方法将连续空间状态扁平化为符号，导致几何结构受损和"空间幻觉"；密集视觉方法保留空间拓扑但引入冗余背景纹理，造成"表示干扰"。两者均无法有效桥接语义推理与精确3D空间预测。
AI.method: 1) Agent-Centric Tokenizer：利用冻结的3D检测头监督的任务引导向量量化机制，将有限码本容量从静态背景重分配给关键动态智能体；2) 解耦推理管道：依次执行场景理解、未来预测和动作生成；3) 渐进式三阶段训练范式：最终通过奖励驱动细化超越纯模仿学习。
AI.result: 在开环nuScenes评估中实现精确的智能体空间状态预测并降低碰撞率；在严格闭环NAVSIMv1和NAVSIMv2基准上建立新的安全记录。
AI.conclusion: TPS-Drive通过任务引导的表示纯化有效解决了VLM在自动驾驶规划中的空间幻觉和表示干扰问题，为将视觉语言模型应用于安全关键的空间推理任务提供了一种可行的范式。

title: VisualNeedle: Benchmarking Active Visual Search in Information-Dense Scenes
summary: Frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have been reported to achieve over 90% accuracy on fine-grained perception benchmarks. However, such scores do not necessarily imply faithful use of visual evidence. Prior studies have identified three shortcuts that inflate benchmark performance. First, linguistic priors and lexical cues in questions often enable models to infer plausible answers without seeing the image. Second, coarse global semantics from the visual encoder can bypass fine-grained local details. Third, in some ``think-with-images'' benchmarks, corrupting the intermediate images returned by visual tools barely affects the final answer. These findings suggest that higher input resolution or larger question pools alone do not elicit genuine active visual search. To address this, we introduce VisualNeedle, a challenging, information-dense, and fine-grained benchmark for scenes where critical evidence is spatially constrained to minute regions and not discernible at a glance. We further propose a counterfactual crop-black setting, which replaces crops returned by tools with black images of the same size, to test whether tool-enabled performance truly relies on intermediate visual evidence. We evaluate 9 promninent MLLMs across three settings: no-tool, standard tool-enabled, and crop-black. No-tool accuracy stays below 20\%, and the best tool-enabled model reaches only 56.01\%, still trailing the 63.00% human majority-vote accuracy. These results reveal persistent limitations in fine-grained visual search, while the crop-black ablation confirms that success on VisualNeedle hinges on genuine intermediate visual evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现有多模态大语言模型在细粒度感知基准上超90%的准确率存在虚假表现，揭示了三种捷径（语言先验、粗粒度全局语义、中间图像损坏不影响答案）。为此提出VisualNeedle基准（信息密集、关键证据局限于微小区域）和反事实裁剪-黑化设置，评估9个模型发现无工具准确率低于20%，最佳工具模型仅56.01%，落后人类多数投票63.00%。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLMs在细粒度感知基准上高准确率并不代表真实依赖视觉证据，存在三种捷径导致性能虚高，需要更严格的基准来检验模型是否进行真正的主动视觉搜索。
AI.method: 提出VisualNeedle基准（关键证据局限于微小区域、信息密集的细粒度场景）和反事实裁剪-黑化（crop-black）设置（将工具返回的裁剪区域替换为同尺寸黑图），在无工具、标准工具、裁剪-黑化三种设置下评估9个主流MLLMs。
AI.result: 无工具准确率低于20%，最佳工具模型仅56.01%，落后人类多数投票63.00%；裁剪-黑化消融实验确认成功依赖于真实的中间视觉证据。
AI.conclusion: 现有MLLMs在细粒度视觉搜索中仍存在根本性局限，高分辨率或更大问题池无法引发真正主动视觉搜索，需要更严格的评估范式。

title: Unified Neural Scaling Laws
summary: We present a functional form (that we refer to as a Unified Neural Scaling Law (UNSL)) that accurately models and extrapolates the scaling behaviors of deep neural networks as multiple dimensions all vary simultaneously (i.e. how the evaluation metric of interest varies as one simultaneously varies the number of model parameters, training dataset size, number of training steps, number of inference steps, amount of compute, and various hyperparameters) for various architectures and for each of various tasks within a varied set of upstream and downstream tasks. This set includes large-scale vision, language, math, and reinforcement learning. When compared to other functional forms for neural scaling, this functional form yields extrapolations of scaling behavior that are considerably more accurate on this set.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种统一神经缩放定律（UNSL），能够同时建模和 extrapolate 深度神经网络在多个维度（参数、数据、训练步数、推理步数、计算量、超参数）同步变化时的缩放行为，在视觉、语言、数学、强化学习等多个任务上比现有缩放定律更准确。
AI.motivation: 现有神经缩放定律通常只考虑单一维度（如仅参数规模或仅数据规模）的缩放行为，无法准确描述多个维度同时变化时的复杂交互效应，缺乏一个统一的形式来跨架构、跨任务地预测缩放行为。
AI.method: 提出了一种新的函数形式（UNSL），该形式同时将模型参数量、训练数据量、训练步数、推理步数、计算量和各种超参数作为变量，拟合和预测评估指标随这些维度变化的缩放规律。
AI.result: 在涵盖视觉、语言、数学、强化学习等多种上游和下游任务的广泛场景中，UNSL 对缩放行为的 extrapolation 准确性显著优于其他现有神经缩放定律函数形式。
AI.conclusion: UNSL 提供了一种更准确、更通用的框架来理解和预测深度神经网络在多维度协同缩放下的行为，有望指导更高效的大规模模型训练和资源分配决策。

title: Learning to Balance Motor Thermal Safety and Quadrupedal Locomotion Performance with Residual Policy
summary: Motor thermal management is often overlooked in the context of electrically-actuated robots, particularly legged robots, but motor overheating is a key factor that limits long-duration locomotion especially under payload conditions. This paper integrates a whole-body thermal model of a quadruped robot into the reinforcement learning pipeline to update motor temperatures, and proposes a two-stage training framework for motor thermal management. In this framework, a nominal policy is first pre-trained as a locomotion baseline capable of traversing diverse terrains. A residual policy is then trained on top of the nominal policy to provide corrective actions based on the robot's thermal state, ensuring high performance under low-temperature conditions and preventing motor overheating under high-temperature conditions. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed policy achieves an effective balance between motor thermal safety and locomotion performance. Real-world experiments on a Unitree A1 quadruped robot further validate the approach: under a 3 kg payload, the robot achieves stable locomotion across multiple terrains for over 13 minutes, while the nominal policy alone leads to motor overheating in about 5 minutes.

AI.tldr: 本文针对电驱动四足机器人在负重条件下的电机过热问题，将全身热模型集成到强化学习框架中，提出了一种两阶段训练策略（先预训练名义策略作为运动基线，再训练残差策略根据热状态提供修正动作），在仿真和Unitree A1实物上验证了该方法能有效平衡电机热安全与运动性能，实现3kg负载下多地形稳定运动超过13分钟（对比名义策略仅约5分钟过热）。
AI.motivation: 电机热管理在电驱动机器人（尤其是足式机器人）中常被忽视，但电机过热是限制长时间运动的关键因素，特别是在负重条件下。
AI.method: 将四足机器人的全身热模型集成到强化学习流程中，用于更新电机温度；提出两阶段训练框架：第一阶段预训练名义策略作为能够穿越多样地形的运动基线，第二阶段在名义策略之上训练残差策略，基于热状态提供修正动作，在低温下保持高性能、高温下防止过热。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明所提策略能在电机热安全与运动性能之间取得有效平衡。在Unitree A1实物上，3kg负载下机器人可实现多地形稳定运动超过13分钟，而仅用名义策略约5分钟即发生电机过热。
AI.conclusion: 将热模型集成到强化学习中的两阶段训练方法能够有效管理电机温度，显著延长负重条件下的运动持续时间，具有实际应用价值。

title: Multi-Modal Building Inspection via Perceiver IO Fusion of Satellite and Street-Level Imagery
summary: We present a multi-modal classification framework that fuses satellite and street-level imagery through a Perceiver IO architecture operating on spatial patch tokens from a shared DINOv2 backbone. The design naturally handles a variable number of street-level views per building without padding or fixed-size pooling, and jointly predicts multi-label roof element and roof material classes. We construct a large-scale dataset of 32,135 buildings (61,672 segments) spanning ten countries, pairing satellite images with up to eight street-level views per segment and evaluating four masking strategies for isolating the target building. We propose an RGB-M masking strategy that appends the building footprint mask as a fourth input channel, providing a soft spatial prior that outperforms hard cropping across both modalities. The Perceiver IO fusion model improves over all other fusion strategies and yields substantial per-class gains for attributes visible from street level (e.g., +11.3 AP for slate, +1.3 AP for dormers), though the satellite-only baseline retains a slight advantage in macro-averaged mAP for classes that are predominantly visible from above. These results establish a scalable, flexible architecture for multi-modal building inspection that can accommodate heterogeneous inputs and multiple output tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出基于Perceiver IO的多模态分类框架，融合卫星与街景图像，使用DINOv2骨干网络和RGB-M掩膜策略，在跨10个国家的32135栋建筑数据集上实现了优于其他融合策略的屋顶要素与材料分类性能。
AI.motivation: 现有建筑检测方法多依赖单一模态数据，难以充分利用卫星与街景图像的互补信息；且不同建筑的街景图像数量不固定，传统方法需要填充或固定尺寸池化，造成信息损失。
AI.method: 1) 使用共享DINOv2骨干提取两种模态的空间patch token；2) Perceiver IO架构处理可变数量的街景视图；3) 提出RGB-M掩膜策略，将建筑足迹掩膜作为第四通道输入；4) 构建跨10国的32135栋建筑数据集，每建筑最多8张街景图。
AI.result: Perceiver IO融合在所有融合策略中表现最优，街景可见属性获得显著提升（石板+11.3 AP，老虎窗+1.3 AP），但卫星单模态在宏观平均mAP上对俯视主导类别仍有轻微优势。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了一个可扩展、灵活的多模态建筑检测架构，能够处理异构输入并支持多任务输出。

title: Quantized Keys Steal Attention: Bias Correction for KV-Cache Compression in Video Diffusion
comment: Variants of this manuscript were accepted to the ICML 2026 workshops SCALE and F2S
summary: Chunk-wise autoregressive video diffusion models rely on a KV cache of previously generated chunks to avoid redundant computation, but this cache quickly becomes a memory bottleneck as videos grow longer. Methods that quantize the KV cache to low bitwidths reduce memory pressure but degrade video quality. We show that a key driver of this degradation is a systematic bias in attention weights: due to the convexity of the exponential in softmax attention, quantization noise inflates the contribution of cached keys, a phenomenon we call the Jensen bias. This effect causes quantized keys to steal attention mass from the unquantized current chunk. We derive a per-attention-score correction that removes this bias in expectation, computed on the fly from the quantization step sizes of the cached keys and the query norm. Using a second-order Taylor approximation, the additional computational overhead is negligible, and no additional memory is needed alongside the cache. Evaluated on MAGI-1, SkyReels-V2, and HY-WorldPlay at INT2 quantization, our correction recovers most of the quality lost to aggressive quantization, reaching near-BF16 video quality, and can outperform INT4 quantization while using 50% less memory.

AI.tldr: 针对自回归视频扩散模型中KV缓存量化导致的质量下降问题，本文发现根本原因是softmax指数的凸性导致量化噪声产生Jensen偏差，使量化键窃取未量化当前块的注意力权重。作者推导了一种基于量化步长和查询范数的逐注意力分数在线修正方法，在INT2量化下几乎恢复BF16质量，比INT4节省50%内存。
AI.motivation: 长视频自回归生成中KV缓存成为内存瓶颈，量化虽能缓解但严重降低视频质量，亟需在不增加额外内存开销的前提下恢复量化后的视频质量。
AI.method: 从理论上揭示量化噪声通过softmax指数的凸性产生Jensen偏差（量化键窃取未量化当前块的注意力权重），推导出基于量化步长和查询范数的二阶泰勒近似修正项，在线计算每注意力分数偏差的期望值，计算开销可忽略且无需额外内存。
AI.result: 在MAGI-1、SkyReels-V2、HY-WorldPlay上INT2量化下，所提修正恢复了大部分质量损失，接近BF16精度，且性能优于INT4同时节省50%内存。
AI.conclusion: 通过理论分析识别并修正了量化KV缓存中的系统性注意力偏差，实现了极低位宽量化下接近全精度的视频质量，为长视频高效生成提供了可行方案。

title: VR-DAgger: Immersive VR for Dexterous Data Collection and Uncertainty-Guided On-Policy Correction
summary: Learning from demonstrations is effective for robotic manipulation, but collecting sufficient task-specific data remains a major bottleneck. Under distribution shift, small errors compound, performance degrades, and expert time is often spent on redundant, low-value corrections instead of the few critical failure cases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用演示学习进行机器人操作，重点解决数据收集瓶颈和分布偏移导致的性能退化问题。
AI.motivation: 演示学习对机器人操作有效，但收集足够任务特定数据是主要瓶颈。在分布偏移下，小误差累积导致性能下降，专家时间常浪费在冗余、低价值的修正上，而非关键的失败案例。
AI.method: 未在摘要中明确说明具体方法，仅指出问题背景。
AI.result: 未在摘要中明确说明具体结果。
AI.conclusion: 需要更高效的数据收集策略，重点应对分布偏移问题，将专家精力集中在关键失败案例上。

title: Detail Consistent Stage-Wise Distillation for Efficient 3D MRI Segmentation
summary: Deploying high-performing 3D medical image segmenters (e.g., nnU-Net) is often limited by memory footprint and inference latency. Compression is therefore necessary, but compact 3D encoders tend to lose fine structural cues (small lesions and sharp boundaries) as downsampling repeats across multi-resolution stages. We propose Detail Consistent Distillation (DCD), a stage-wise distillation framework that preserves structural detail across scales by aligning teacher-student features in a wavelet-decomposed representation. At each encoder stage, DCD distills directional detail components in the wavelet domain while leaving the coarse approximation comparatively unconstrained, avoiding over-regularization of global semantics. DCD is used only during training and introduces no inference-time overhead. Experiments on the BraTS 2024 and ISLES 2022 benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves superior performance in MRI segmentation using 3D multi-modal data. Code and implementation details for DCD are publicly available at https://github.com/ClinicaAlpha/DCD-3D-MedSeg.

AI.tldr: 本文提出细节一致蒸馏（DCD），一种阶段式知识蒸馏框架，通过在频域（小波分解）对齐教师-学生编码器各阶段的特征，保留三维医学图像分割中的精细结构信息（如小病灶和锐利边界），在不增加推理开销的前提下提升压缩后模型的分割性能。
AI.motivation: 高精度3D医学图像分割模型（如nnU-Net）因内存占用和推理解码延迟难以部署，需要压缩。但压缩后的轻量级3D编码器在跨多分辨率阶段的下采样过程中容易丢失精细结构线索（小病灶和锐利边界），现有方法未能有效解决这一结构细节退化问题。
AI.method: 提出DCD（Detail Consistent Distillation）阶段式蒸馏框架：在教师和学生编码器的每个阶段，将特征通过小波分解为方向细节分量和粗略近似分量，仅对方向细节分量进行蒸馏对齐，粗略近似分量不作约束，从而避免对全局语义的过度正则化。DCD仅在训练阶段使用，不增加推理开销。
AI.result: 在BraTS 2024和ISLES 2022基准上，使用3D多模态MRI数据，DCD实现了优越的分割性能，证明了其在压缩模型上保留结构细节的有效性。
AI.conclusion: DCD通过小波域阶段式蒸馏，在模型压缩场景下实现了结构细节保持，是一种高效且无推理开销的3D医学图像分割知识蒸馏方法。

title: Scaling World-Model Reinforcement Learning Through Diffusion Policy Optimization
summary: Model-based reinforcement learning (RL) can be effectively supported at scale through the use of world models. However, in practice, scaling such approaches remains fundamentally limited. A commonly recognized challenge is model bias and error compounding, which degrade long-horizon predictions. Beyond these issues, we identify a more critical yet underexplored bottleneck: a structural misalignment between search and value learning in existing world model approaches. In particular, policy improvement often relies on value functions induced by a separate, non-search policy, resulting in training inconsistency and ultimately suboptimal learning. To address this limitation, we propose Model-Based Diffusion Policy Optimization (MBDPO) in world models, a framework that unifies search and policy optimization through diffusion policy representations, thereby unlocking the potential of world models for scalable policy learning. Instead of constructing an explicit planner over a learned world model, we reformulate policy optimization as a diffusion process over searched trajectories in latent world models. In this view, we extract an implicit energy function from the collected dataset that anchors the policy, enabling MBDPO to refine the score field for policy optimization while mitigating misalignment. We evaluate MBDPO across a wide range of settings, including multi-task offline pretraining, online learning, and offline-to-online fine-tuning. In the offline regime, we further investigate its scaling behavior by pretraining on large-scale datasets, observing consistent and monotonic performance gains with increasing model capacity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MBDPO，一种基于扩散策略的世界模型框架，统一了搜索与策略优化，解决了现有方法中搜索与价值学习之间的结构错位问题，在离线预训练、在线学习和微调场景中均表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有基于世界模型的强化学习方法存在模型偏差和误差累积问题，但更关键的是搜索与价值学习之间存在结构错位——策略改进依赖于非搜索策略诱导的价值函数，导致训练不一致和次优学习。
AI.method: 提出MBDPO框架，将策略优化重新表述为在潜在世界模型中对搜索轨迹的扩散过程，从收集的数据集中提取隐式能量函数来锚定策略，通过改进评分场来实现策略优化，同时缓解错位问题。
AI.result: 在多任务离线预训练、在线学习、离线到在线微调等多种场景下评估，在离线场景中通过大规模数据集预训练，观察到模型容量增加时性能持续单调提升。
AI.conclusion: MBDPO通过扩散策略表示统一搜索与策略优化，有效解锁了世界模型在可扩展策略学习中的潜力，解决了结构错位这一关键瓶颈。

title: TCBiRRT: Rapid Motion Planning for Tightly Coupled Dual-arm Space Manipulator Using Task-space Random Expansion
summary: Planning the motion path for a tightly coupled dual-arm space manipulator under closed-chain constraints is a fundamental yet challenging problem in on-orbit assembly of large-scale space structures. The closed-chain constraints significantly reduce the feasible configuration space, making it difficult for existing planners to efficiently generate collision-free motions, especially in cluttered environments. To address this issue, this paper proposes a task-space constrained bidirectional rapidly-exploring random tree algorithm, termed TCBiRRT. Unlike conventional methods that operate in the high-dimensional configuration space, the proposed approach performs random sampling and node expansion directly in the task space defined by the manipulated object pose. A task-space node expansion strategy is developed to generate candidate object motions, which are then mapped to continuous joint paths using a path inverse kinematics algorithm. The method is further integrated with a bidirectional RRT framework and a regrasp mechanism to efficiently connect two random trees. Extensive simulations are conducted in representative on-orbit assembly scenarios with varying levels of environmental complexity. The results demonstrate that TCBiRRT achieves significantly higher success rates and orders-of-magnitude improvements in planning time compared to state-of-the-art planners. The proposed method provides an efficient and robust solution for motion planning of tightly coupled dual-arm space manipulators.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TCBiRRT算法，通过在任务空间进行随机采样和节点扩展，结合双向RRT框架和重抓取机制，解决闭环约束下双机械臂运动规划难题，在仿真中显著提升了成功率和规划效率。
AI.motivation: 闭环约束严重缩小了可行构型空间，现有规划器在复杂环境中难以高效生成无碰撞运动，亟需一种更高效的路径规划方法。
AI.method: 提出TCBiRRT算法：在任务空间（被操作物体位姿）进行随机采样和节点扩展，采用路径逆运动学映射到关节空间，结合双向RRT框架和重抓取机制连接两棵随机树。
AI.result: 在多种复杂程度的在轨装配场景仿真中，TCBiRRT相比现有最优规划器显著提高了成功率，规划时间提升数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: TCBiRRT为闭环约束下紧密耦合双机械臂的运动规划提供了高效且鲁棒的解决方案。

title: Zero-Shot Object Re-Identification in Egocentric Kitchen Videos via Multi-Stage SAM3 Feature Fusion
summary: Object re-identification (ReID) in egocentric kitchen videos is challenging due to rapid viewpoint changes, frequent occlusions, cluttered scenes, and large intra-class appearance variations. Objects may leave and re-enter the field of view, and the large diversity of instances with limited annotations makes supervised ReID difficult to scale, motivating zero-shot approaches. We study zero-shot object ReID on the EPIC-Kitchens benchmark, where the goal is to match active food and kitchen-tool instances across frames using only pre-trained visual features. We first evaluate five state-of-the-art feature extractors, including Vision-Language Models (VLMs) - CLIP, DINOv2, DreamSim, I-JEPA, and SAM3 - and show that zero-shot methods fail, with the best baseline achieving only 45.3% mAP. We then propose an Enhanced SAM3 ReID Pipeline, a zero-shot multi-stage method built around SAM3 segmentation as the core component. Stage 1 uses SAM3 to suppress background clutter. Stage 2 fuses embeddings from SAM3, DINOv2, and CLIP into a single L2-normalized descriptor. Stage 3 augments cosine similarity with mask-shape IoU for geometric consistency, and Stage 4 applies k-reciprocal re-ranking. The full pipeline improves performance by 7.5% mAP to 52.8%.

AI.tldr: 本文针对第一人称厨房视频中的零样本物体重识别（ReID）难题，评估了五种预训练特征提取器（CLIP、DINOv2、DreamSim、I-JEPA、SAM3），发现最佳基线仅达45.3% mAP。为此提出增强型SAM3 ReID流水线，通过SAM3分割去背景、多模型特征融合、掩码IoU几何约束和k倒数重排序四阶段改进，将mAP提升至52.8%。
AI.motivation: 第一人称厨房视频中的物体重识别面临视角快速变化、频繁遮挡、场景杂乱和类内外观差异大等挑战，且监督方法因标注不足难以扩展，因此需要探索零样本方法。
AI.method: 提出增强型SAM3 ReID流水线：Stage 1用SAM3分割抑制背景杂波；Stage 2融合SAM3、DINOv2和CLIP嵌入为L2归一化描述子；Stage 3用掩码形状IoU增强余弦相似度以引入几何一致性；Stage 4应用k倒数重排序。
AI.result: 在EPIC-Kitchens基准上，最佳基线（零样本）仅45.3% mAP，所提流水线提升至52.8% mAP，提升7.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 零样本ReID在第一人称厨房视频中仍有较大挑战，但多阶段流水线通过分割、多模态特征融合和几何约束可带来显著改进。

title: Two-Parameter Flows for Learning Population Dynamics of Physical Systems
summary: This work addresses the problem of learning the dynamics of high-dimensional probability densities over time using unlabeled samples, without assuming access to trajectory information. We introduce two-parameter flows that learn only sampling-time transports from a base distribution to each marginal and then extract a physics-time velocity by regressing on coupled synthetic trajectories. We prove that the resulting physics-time dynamics are unique and inherit regularity from the sampling-time transports.
