Because we can build on standard, well-developed conditional flow matching techniques for learning the base-to-marginal transports, our approach scales to high dimensions and avoids per-step optimal-transport couplings, while allowing admissible non-gradient dynamics that can naturally explain rotational or circulating physics phenomena.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需轨迹数据、仅利用无标签样本学习高维概率密度随时间演化动力学的方法，通过两参数流从基分布学习到各边缘分布的采样时间传输，再对合成的耦合轨迹进行回归提取物理时间速度，证明该动力学唯一且继承正则性，可扩展到高维并解释旋转/环流等非梯度现象。
AI.motivation: 现有方法学习概率密度动力学需要轨迹信息或每步最优传输耦合，难以扩展到高维且无法处理旋转/环流等非梯度动力学。本文旨在设计一种仅利用无标签样本、无需轨迹信息即可学习高维概率密度演化动力学的方法。
AI.method: 引入两参数流：首先通过条件流匹配技术学习从基分布到各边缘分布的采样时间传输（跨不同时间点的分布），然后利用这些传输合成耦合的轨迹数据，对其回归提取物理时间速度场，从而得到完整的动力学描述。
AI.result: 理论上证明了得到的物理时间动力学具有唯一性，并且继承了采样时间传输的正则性；方法可扩展到高维，无需每步最优传输耦合，且能够学习非梯度动力学（如旋转/环流现象）。
AI.conclusion: 该方法克服了传统方法对轨迹数据的依赖和高维扩展性限制，通过两参数流框架有效学习概率密度演化动力学，尤其在可解释非梯度物理现象方面具有优势。

title: Towards Drone-based Mapping of Volcanic Gases using Gas Tomography
summary: Volcanoes emit large amounts of CO2, directly influencing human lives. Mapping volcanic gas emissions helps to forecast eruptions and understand the impact of volcanoes on climate and the environment. Drone-based gas sensing significantly reduces risks in volcanic monitoring but faces technical limitations when measuring gas, as rotor downwash disperses the gas plume before detection. Gas Tomography using remote gas sensing addresses this challenge. At the Salinelle dei Cappuccini mud volcanoes, we demonstrate that while drone-mounted in-situ sensors failed to detect CO2 emissions due to aerodynamic disturbance, open-path sensing successfully enabled remote gas distribution mapping. We present a novel model-based gas tomographic reconstruction approach that incorporates a Lagrangian model to compensate for wind-induced advection. The resulting gas distribution maps align with manually collected in-situ measurements, confirming that model-based gas tomography effectively overcomes downwash limitations and enables accurate mapping of volcanic emissions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于模型的无人机气体层析成像方法，通过开放光路遥感技术克服旋翼下洗流对火山气体采样的干扰，成功实现了泥火山CO₂排放的高精度分布测绘。
AI.motivation: 火山排放大量CO₂影响人类生活，无人机气体传感可降低监测风险，但旋翼下洗流会驱散气体羽流导致传统原位传感器失效，亟需解决这一技术瓶颈以实现准确的火山气体分布测绘。
AI.method: 采用开放光路径程遥感替代原位传感器；引入基于模型的层析成像重建方法，结合拉格朗日模型补偿风致平流效应。
AI.result: 在Salinelle dei Cappuccini泥火山实验中，无人机原位传感器因气动干扰未能检测到CO₂排放，而开放光路径程遥感成功实现了远程气体分布测绘，重建的气体分布图与手动原位测量结果一致。
AI.conclusion: 基于模型的气体层析成像有效克服了无人机旋翼下洗流限制，能够实现对火山排放气体的准确测绘。

title: OmniGF: A Dual-Branch Vision-Language Framework for Unified Gaze Following
summary: Understanding human gaze behavior is essential for complex scene comprehension and human-computer interaction. Traditional gaze following models are typically restricted to pure spatial localization, lacking the high-level capacity to reason about semantic targets or complex social contexts. Furthermore, these models often process individuals sequentially, requiring redundant computations over the same scene image for multi-person inference. While recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) offer the exceptional semantic reasoning needed to address gaze-related semantic tasks, their reliance on discrete text generation inherently limits precision in continuous spatial tasks like gaze localization. To bridge this gap, we propose OmniGF, a unified vision-language framework that adapts foundational VLMs for highly scalable multi-person gaze reasoning. The model adopts a dual-branch decoding strategy: a structured language branch generates discrete reasoning states, while a continuous spatial branch directly taps into the VLM's dense hidden states. Supervising these extracted representations with high-resolution gaze target heatmaps effectively overcomes the spatial bottleneck of text-only coordinate generation. Furthermore, to explicitly ground the model in multi-person scenes, we augment the input with head embeddings encoded from cropped head images, providing fine-grained appearance and orientation cues for all individuals simultaneously. By modeling all individuals and leveraging the strong semantic capability of VLMs, OmniGF seamlessly integrates precise spatial gaze target estimation, semantic gaze prediction, and complex social gaze reasoning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework establishes new state-of-the-art performance across multiple standard benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/cvlab-stonybrook/omnigf.

AI.tldr: OmniGF是一个统一的视觉-语言框架，通过双分支解码策略（语言分支+连续空间分支）将基础VLM适配到高可扩展的多人群组注视推理任务中，同时解决语义推理和空间定位的瓶颈，在多个基准上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 传统注视跟随模型局限于纯空间定位，缺乏对语义目标或复杂社会上下文的推理能力，且多人物推理时需冗余计算；而现有VLM虽具备语义推理能力，但依赖离散文本生成在连续空间任务（如注视定位）中精度受限。
AI.method: 提出OmniGF框架，采用双分支解码策略：1）结构化语言分支生成离散推理状态；2）连续空间分支直接利用VLM的密集隐藏状态，并用高分辨率注视目标热图进行监督，克服文本坐标生成的空间瓶颈。同时，通过编码裁剪头部图像的头嵌入提供细粒度外观和方向线索，显式地将模型锚定在多人物场景中。
AI.result: 在多个标准基准上建立了新的最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: OmniGF通过将VLM的语义能力与连续空间分支相结合，统一了精确的空间注视估计、语义注视预测和复杂社会注视推理任务。

title: Stateful Inference for Low-Latency Multi-Agent Tool Calling
summary:
Multi-agent tool calling is becoming the dominant interaction pattern for LLM-based systems, yet existing inference frameworks treat each tool call as an independent request, re-processing the entire conversation from scratch even though 85-95% of the prompt is unchanged from the previous turn.
  We present a stateful inference architecture that converts the $O(n_t)$ per-turn cost of conventional serving into an $O(Δ_t)$ delta-only cost: a persistent KV cache lives across turns and advances by ingesting only the new tokens, while a radix prefix cache extends this across interleaved multi-agent traffic and a prompt-lookup speculative decoder accelerates structured output. Against vLLM and SGLang on novel, fully-generated workloads, the reference implementation is $2.1\times$ faster per turn on a 6-turn agentic workflow and $4.2\times$ on the median turn of a 35-turn one, halving end-to-end wall time. The advantage comes from stateful reuse and speculation, not caching.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种有状态推理架构，通过持久化KV缓存、基数前缀缓存和提示查找推测解码，将多智能体工具调用的每次推理成本从O(n_t)降至O(Δ_t)，在6轮和35轮工作流中分别实现2.1倍和4.2倍的每轮加速，端到端耗时减半。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM推理框架在多智能体工具调用场景中，将每次工具调用视为独立请求，重复处理整个对话历史（其中85-95%的提示内容与前一轮相同），导致计算效率极低。
AI.method: 提出有状态推理架构，核心包括：（1）持久化KV缓存，跨轮次存活，仅处理新增token的O(Δ_t)成本；（2）基数前缀缓存，支持交错的多智能体流量复用；（3）提示查找推测解码器，加速结构化输出生成。
AI.result: 在全新生成的工作负载上，相较于vLLM和SGLang，参考实现在6轮智能体工作流中每轮加速2.1倍，35轮工作中中位数每轮加速4.2倍，端到端耗时减半。优势来源于有状态复用和推测执行，而非传统缓存。
AI.conclusion: 有状态推理架构通过消除冗余的重复计算，显著提升多轮多智能体工具调用场景下的LLM推理效率，为构建高效交互式LLM系统提供了新范式。

title: FineVLA: Fine-Grained Instruction Alignment for Steerable Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are increasingly expected to not only complete robot tasks, but also follow human instructions about how those tasks should be executed. However, existing robot datasets usually pair trajectories with coarse goal-level language, leaving execution-critical details such as active arm, approach direction, and contact region unspecified. This limits steerable policy learning and robotic video understanding. We introduce FineVLA, an open framework for action-aligned fine-grained VLA supervision. The framework includes: (1) a data construction tool that unifies 972,247 trajectories across 85K tasks from 10 open-source robot datasets and builds FineVLA-Data, a human-verified dataset of 47,159 fine-grained trajectories; (2) a held-out benchmark with 500 videos, 10,816 atomic facts, and 1,030 VQA questions; (3) a robotics-specialized VLM annotator for scalable fine-grained annotation; and (4) a steerable VLA policy trained with controlled mixtures of fine-grained and raw goal-level instructions. Our experiments yield three findings. First, fine-grained supervision does not sacrifice goal-level success: FG-only improves over Raw-only by +1.4 to +8.1 success-rate points across settings. Second, fine-grained and raw instructions are complementary, following a consistent inverted-U trend peaking at FG:Raw = 1:2 to 1:1. The best mixed setting reaches 86.8%/82.5% in RoboTwin simulation and 62.7/100 in real-world dual-arm manipulation (vs. 49.9 Raw-only). Third, fine-grained supervision improves steerable control: the largest real-world gains appear on pose (+23), color (+18), and approach direction (+18)--factors where goal-level instructions provide no guidance. Overall, fine-grained language should augment goal-level instructions: specifying how to execute alongside what to achieve. Project page: https://finevla.xlang.ai/

AI.tldr: FineVLA是一个开放框架，为机器人VLA模型提供动作对齐的细粒度语言监督，通过构建包含47,159条细粒度轨迹的数据集、专用基准和可操控策略，证明细粒度指令与目标指令互补，能显著提升任务成功率和可操控性。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人数据集通常仅将轨迹与粗粒度的目标级语言配对，缺乏执行关键的细节（如活动臂、接近方向、接触区域），限制了策略的可操控性和机器人视频理解能力。
AI.method: (1) 构建FineVLA-Data：统一10个开源数据集的972,247条轨迹，经人工验证生成47,159条细粒度轨迹；(2) 构建保留基准：500个视频、10,816个原子事实、1,030个VQA问题；(3) 开发机器人专用VLM标注器；(4) 训练可操控VLA策略，混合细粒度和原始目标级指令。
AI.result: 细粒度监督不牺牲目标级成功率（提升+1.4~+8.1）；细粒度与原始指令互补，最佳混合比FG:Raw=1:2~1:1，达到模拟86.8%/82.5%、真实62.7/100（原始仅49.9）；细粒度在姿态(+23)、颜色(+18)、接近方向(+18)上提升最大。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度语言应作为目标级指令的增强：在指定"做什么"的同时说明"如何执行"。

title: The Rescue Effect: Spatio-Semantic Early Exit Bypasses Quantization Collapse in CLIP
summary: Deploying Vision-Language Models on resource-constrained hardware typically requires INT8 quantization, but in joint-embedding architectures such as CLIP this introduces a failure mode distinct from quantized CNN classifiers: activation noise accumulated across transformer blocks perturbs the direction of the multimodal embedding, eroding the cosine alignment on which zero-shot retrieval depends. We characterize this as Quantization-Induced Representation Collapse (QIRC) and quantify it on INT8 CLIP ViT-B/32, where the layer-wise noise-to-signal ratio grows from below 10% in shallow blocks to 52% at Layer 11. We propose LRA-EE (Layer-wise Representation-Aware Early Exit), which bypasses noise-saturated deep layers via Spatio-Semantic Aggregation (replacing the immature shallow [CLS] with a global patch-token average), a learned multi-feature gate (confidence, top-2 margin, spatial-activation variance), and Layer-adaptive Confidence Thresholding calibrated to each layer's Information-to-Noise Ratio. On ImageNet-1K zero-shot classification, LRA-EE reduces FLOPs by 13.4% and improves Top-1 accuracy by +2.44%p (58.72% -> 61.16%) over the INT8 baseline. A four-quadrant decomposition isolates the Rescue Effect: 9.5% of samples are correctly classified at shallow exits but lost to noise at full depth, against only 7.1% suffering the inverse.

AI.tldr: 针对视觉-语言模型在INT8量化下出现的"量化诱导表征坍缩"(QIRC)问题——Transformer深层激活噪声破坏多模态嵌入的余弦对齐，本文提出LRA-EE方法，通过时空语义聚合、学习型多特征门控和逐层自适应阈值，在减少13.4% FLOPs的同时将ImageNet-1K零样本分类Top-1准确率从58.72%提升至61.16%，并揭示9.5%的样本因早期退出而被正确分类（而深层噪声导致其错误）。
AI.motivation: 在资源受限硬件上部署视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）需使用INT8量化，但联合嵌入架构中，量化噪声在Transformer各层累积，扰动多模态嵌入方向，破坏零样本检索依赖的余弦对齐，这一问题区别于传统量化CNN分类器，亟需解决。
AI.method: 提出LRA-EE (Layer-wise Representation-Aware Early Exit)方法，包含三个组件：(1) 时空语义聚合 (Spatio-Semantic Aggregation)，用全局patch token平均替代浅层不成熟的[CLS] token；(2) 学习型多特征门控，融合置信度、top-2边际、空间激活方差；(3) 逐层自适应置信度阈值，按每层信息噪声比校准。
AI.result: 在INT8 CLIP ViT-B/32上，层间噪声信号比从浅层低于10%增至第11层52%。LRA-EE在ImageNet-1K零样本分类上减少13.4% FLOPs，Top-1准确率提升+2.44个百分点（58.72%→61.16%）。四象限分解显示9.5%样本在浅层正确但被深层噪声误导，仅7.1%相反。
AI.conclusion: 量化诱导表征坍缩(QIRC)是视觉-语言模型INT8部署中的关键失效模式；通过早期退出机制在噪声饱和前退出可同时提升效率和准确率，验证了表示质量比计算深度更重要的观点。

title: Dynamic Link Prediction with Temporally Enhanced Signed Graph Neural Networks
summary: Temporal signed networks (TSNs) model the time evolution of cooperative and adversarial relationships that arise in applications such as social media analysis, trust and reputation systems, and financial transaction networks. While graph neural networks (GNNs) perform well for static or unsigned link prediction, effective learning in temporal signed graphs remains challenging due to the interaction of signed relations, evolving structure, and balance-theoretic constraints. To address this gap, we propose a \emph{modular} temporal enhancement framework for signed GNNs that integrates historical context into otherwise static architectures. The framework introduces a Historical Context Integration Module (HCIM) that combines learnable recency-aware temporal weighting, LSTM-based embedding trajectory modeling, and multi-head temporal attention to capture both short- and long-term signed interaction dynamics. Historical information is fused with current node representations using either global or node-adaptive weighting, allowing the architecture-agnostic framework to accommodate heterogeneous temporal behaviors. We instantiate the approach on the Self-Explainable Signed Graph Transformer (SE-SGformer), preserving interpretability while extending it with temporal awareness. Experiments on real-world and synthetic TSNs, including Bitcoin OTC, Bitcoin Alpha, Reddit, and small-world network models, demonstrate consistent and statistically significant improvements over the static baseline.

AI.tldr: 针对时序符号网络中的链接预测问题，提出了一种模块化的时序增强框架，通过历史上下文整合模块（HCIM）结合可学习的时效性权重、LSTM嵌入轨迹建模和多头时序注意力机制，将静态符号图神经网络扩展到时序动态场景，在多个真实与合成数据集上取得了显著提升。
AI.motivation: 时序符号网络在社交媒体分析、信任与声誉系统、金融交易网络等应用中广泛存在，但现有的图神经网络主要针对静态或无符号的链接预测，难以有效处理符号关系、结构演化与平衡理论约束之间的复杂交互。
AI.method: 提出模块化的时序增强框架，核心为历史上下文整合模块（HCIM），包含三部分：可学习的时效性加权、基于LSTM的嵌入轨迹建模、多头时序注意力机制。历史信息通过全局或节点自适应加权方式与当前节点表示融合，该框架架构无关，可适配现有静态符号GNN。以SE-SGformer为实例化对象，保留其可解释性并扩展时序感知能力。
AI.result: 在Bitcoin OTC、Bitcoin Alpha、Reddit以及小世界网络模型等真实与合成时序符号网络上，该方法相较于静态基线模型取得了一致且统计显著的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 模块化的时序增强框架能有效将静态符号图神经网络扩展到时序场景，通过捕捉长短期符号交互动态，显著提升时序符号网络的链接预测性能，且具有架构无关性和良好的可扩展性。

title: Riding the Shifting Potential: When Reactive Control Suffices for Multi-Goal Behavior
summary: Reactive control is often considered insufficient for multi-objective tasks because conflicting objectives give rise to local minima. We argue this limitation is not inherent but arises from static encodings that fail to reflect how objectives currently interact. We exploit the interaction structure encoded in a graph-based world model by extending it with nullspace projections: conflicts are resolved where they arise by projecting lower-priority gradients into the nullspace of higher-priority ones, with priorities determined continuously from the current state. We demonstrate this in two domains where conflicts between objectives are central: navigation around non-convex obstacles, where static potential fields fundamentally fail, and planar pushing of non-convex objects, where our method achieves $100\%$ success across one-hundred configurations versus $0\%$ for the steepest-descent baseline and ${\sim}55\%$ for diffusion policy, without demonstrations or retraining. The same formulation transfers directly to a real robot with additional perceptual and kinematic constraints, accommodating them through the same mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于零空间投影的动态优先级反应式控制方法，通过图结构世界模型动态解决多目标冲突，在非凸障碍物导航和非凸物体平面推动任务中显著优于静态势场法和扩散策略，并可直接迁移到真实机器人。
AI.motivation: 反驳"反应式控制对多目标任务不足"的普遍观点，指出问题源于静态编码无法反映目标间的动态交互关系，而非反应式控制本身的局限性。
AI.method: 在图结构世界模型中扩展零空间投影：将低优先级梯度投影到高优先级梯度的零空间中，优先级根据当前状态连续确定，从而在冲突产生处就地解决。
AI.result: 在非凸障碍物导航（静态势场法根本上失败）和非凸物体平面推动任务中，该方法在100个配置上达到100%成功率，而最速下降基线为0%，扩散策略约55%，且无需演示或重训练。
AI.conclusion: 该公式可直接迁移到真实机器人，通过相同机制处理额外的感知和运动学约束，验证了反应式控制在多目标任务中的有效性。

title: HydraPrompt: An Adaptive and Asymmetric Framework of Vision-Language Models for Synthetic Image Detection
summary: The rapid evolution of generative models has precipitated a proliferation of fabricated content, posing significant challenges to existing Synthetic Image Detection (SID) methods. Capitalizing on advancements in vision-language models (e.g., CLIP), recent attempts have leveraged learnable textual prompts to identify synthetic images. However, they still leverage static prompt as a fixed boundary for real and fake images, failing to adapt to the varying types of forgery that emerge during inference. To overcome this issue, we propose **HydraPrompt**, an asymmetric prompting framework that dynamically adjusts the category centers by aligning with fine-grained image cues. Specifically, we propose an Asymmetric Prompt Adapter (**APA**): (1) for authentic category, we introduce a single set of prompts to capture the consistent representative patterns, which serves as a unified anchor for real content. While (2) for fake category, we construct sample-adaptive prompts that specialize in capturing diverse cues from different samples, enabling adaptive modeling of forgery image variations. To increase pronounced discriminability within different synthetic images, we further introduce a Conditional Supervised Contrastive (**CSC**) objective, which compacts the authentic representations while capturing fine-grained forgery clues. Extensive experiments on popular SID benchmarks demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of our framework.

AI.tldr: 提出HydraPrompt非对称提示框架，通过自适应调整类别中心来检测合成图像，在多个SID基准上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于CLIP的合成图像检测方法使用静态提示作为真假图像的固定边界，无法适应推理过程中不断出现的新类型伪造图像。
AI.method: 提出非对称提示适配器(APA)：真实类别使用单一提示集捕获一致代表性模式作为统一锚点；伪造类别构建样本自适应提示，从不同样本捕获多样化线索。另引入条件监督对比学习(CSC)目标，压缩真实表示同时捕获细粒度伪造线索。
AI.result: 在多个主流SID基准上达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: HydraPrompt通过非对称提示设计有效解决了静态提示无法适应新兴伪造类型的问题，为合成图像检测提供了新的思路。

title: Classification and detection of multiple UAVs using rational Gaussian wavelet neural networks
summary: The detection of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is important for the protection of civilian and military infrastructure. In this paper we propose a cost effective UAV detection system using sound signals obtained from microphones. The recorded signals are passed through a signal processing pipeline which employs interpretable adaptive feature extractors using so-called rational Gaussian wavelets. These adaptive wavelet transformations are embedded into and trained together with an underlying small neural network which detects and classifies UAVs based on the obtained features. This leads to a physically interpretable machine learning algorithm that in addition to classifying UAVs is also capable of detecting UAV swarms. We demonstrate our results using data collected in indoor studio and noisy outdoor environments. We conclude that the proposed method outperforms traditional machine learning approaches for detecting and classifying single UAVs as well as drone swarms, while retaining a high degree of interpretability. Our implementation of the proposed methods is made publicly available for reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于声音信号的经济型无人机检测系统，采用可解释的自适应有理高斯小波特征提取器嵌入小型神经网络，能够检测和分类单个无人机及无人机集群，在室内和室外噪声环境中 outperforms 传统机器学习方法，且保持高可解释性。
AI.motivation: 保护民用和军用基础设施需要有效的无人机检测手段，现有方法通常成本高昂或缺乏可解释性。
AI.method: 使用麦克风采集声音信号，通过可解释的自适应有理高斯小波变换提取特征，将其嵌入并与小型神经网络联合训练，实现无人机检测和分类。
AI.result: 在室内录制环境和室外噪声环境下的实验表明，该方法在检测和分类单个无人机及无人机集群方面优于传统机器学习方法。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在保持高可解释性的同时实现了优越的无人机检测性能，且代码已公开以便复现。

title: OSMa-Bench++: Toward Open-Ended Benchmarking of Semantic Mapping for Manipulation with Prompt-Generated Synthetic Scenes
summary: Semantic mapping methods are increasingly used as intermediate scene representations for downstream robotic reasoning and manipulation, yet their evaluation is still largely tied to fixed benchmark datasets with limited coverage of manipulation-relevant corner cases. In this work, we extend OSMa-Bench toward controllable benchmarking with prompt-generated synthetic indoor scenes. Our pipeline automatically generates scene descriptions, synthesizes corresponding environments with SceneSmith, and adapts the resulting assets into an OSMa-Bench-compatible simulation format. This adaptation requires a nontrivial intermediate layer, including semantic normalization, material and texture repair, shader fallback policies, floor handling, navigation setup, and controlled lighting configuration. A key advantage of the proposed setup is that the original scene-generation prompt is known in advance and can therefore serve as an auxiliary semantic specification of the intended scene. We use this property to extend the VQA component of OSMa-Bench with a prompt-grounded question category. The resulting framework supports targeted stress-testing of semantic scene representations under conditions such as clutter, small objects, partial occlusions, and lighting variation, and makes benchmarking more extensible and better aligned with downstream manipulation requirements. Our code is available at https://github.com/be2rlab/OSMa-Bench-v2.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了OSMa-Bench，通过提示生成的合成室内场景实现可控基准测试，包括场景描述自动生成、环境合成、语义归一化等适配层，并利用已知场景提示扩展VQA评估，支持对语义场景表示在杂乱、小物体、遮挡和光照变化等条件下的压力测试。
AI.motivation: 现有语义建图方法的评估仍局限于固定基准数据集，覆盖的操作相关边缘案例有限，缺乏可控的测试环境来评估场景表示在杂乱、小物体、遮挡和光照变化等条件下的表现。
AI.method: 提出基于提示生成的合成室内场景可控基准测试流程：(1) 自动生成场景描述；(2) 使用SceneSmith合成环境；(3) 通过语义归一化、材质纹理修复、着色器回退策略、地板处理、导航设置和光照配置等中间适配层，将生成资产转换为OSMa-Bench兼容格式；(4) 利用已知场景提示扩展VQA组件，增加提示接地问题类别。
AI.result: 构建了支持针对性压力测试的框架，能够评估语义场景表示在杂乱、小物体、部分遮挡和光照变化等条件下的鲁棒性，使基准测试更具可扩展性并与下游操作需求对齐。
AI.conclusion: 通过可控的合成场景生成和已知提示作为语义规范，实现了对语义建图方法的更全面评估，弥补了现有基准在操作相关边缘案例覆盖方面的不足。

title: Rethinking Weakly-supervised Video Temporal Grounding From a Game Perspective
summary: This paper addresses the challenging task of weakly-supervised video temporal grounding. Existing approaches are generally based on the moment proposal selection framework that utilizes contrastive learning and reconstruction paradigm for scoring the pre-defined moment proposals. Although they have achieved significant progress, we argue that their current frameworks have overlooked two indispensable issues: 1) Coarse-grained cross-modal learning: previous methods solely capture the global video-level alignment with the query, failing to model the detailed consistency between video frames and query words for accurately grounding the moment boundaries. 2) Complex moment proposals: their performance severely relies on the quality of proposals, which are also time-consuming and complicated for selection. To this end, in this paper, we make the first attempt to tackle this task from a novel game perspective, which effectively learns the uncertain relationship between each vision-language pair with diverse granularity and flexible combination for multi-level cross-modal interaction.Specifically, we creatively model each video frame and query word as game players with multivariate cooperative game theory to learn their contribution to the cross-modal similarity score. By quantifying the trend of frame-word cooperation within a coalition via the game-theoretic interaction, we are able to value all uncertain but possible correspondence between frames and words. Finally, instead of using moment proposals, we utilize the learned query-guided frame-wise scores for better moment localization.Experiments show that our method achieves superior performance on both Charades-STA and ActivityNet Caption datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将弱监督视频时序定位任务建模为博弈视角，利用多元合作博弈理论建模视频帧与查询词之间的细粒度跨模态交互，替代传统时刻提案选择框架，在Charades-STA和ActivityNet Caption数据集上取得优异性能。
AI.motivation: 现有弱监督视频时序定位方法存在两个关键问题：1）粗粒度跨模态学习——仅捕捉全局视频级对齐，忽略帧与词之间的细粒度一致性；2）复杂的时刻提案生成与选择过程耗时且性能依赖提案质量。本文旨在解决上述问题，探索更高效、细粒度的跨模态交互方式。
AI.method: 本文创新性地将视频帧和查询词建模为博弈玩家，引入多元合作博弈理论，通过学习帧-词在联盟中的合作趋势来量化它们对跨模态相似度得分的贡献，从而建模所有不确定但可能的帧-词对应关系。最终利用学习到的查询引导的逐帧得分进行时刻定位，无需预定义的时刻提案。
AI.result: 在Charades-STA和ActivityNet Caption两个基准数据集上的实验表明，所提方法取得了优越的性能。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了博弈论视角下的细粒度跨模态交互能够有效克服传统弱监督时序定位方法的局限，为弱监督视频时序定位任务提供了新的解决范式。

title: Curriculum Learning for Safety Alignment
comment: Accepted at the ICML 2026 GlobalSouthML Workshop
summary: Direct Preference Optimisation (DPO) is widely used for safety alignment in large language models. However, prior work shows it is brittle and exhibits poor out-of-distribution (OOD) generalisation. In this paper, we investigate whether Curriculum Learning can improve the robustness of DPO-based safety alignment. We propose Staged-Competence, a curriculum-based framework that organises preference data by difficulty, employs competence-based sampling, and progressively updates the reference model during training. Averaged across three model families, Staged-Competence reduces OOD harmful response rates by 16% and jailbreak attack success rates by 20%, while preserving general capabilities with near-zero over-refusal. We further show that Staged-Competence (1) matches baseline safety with only 75% of the training data and (2) yields better separation between safe and unsafe responses. Staged-Competence is agnostic to the policy optimisation loss and can extend to other DPO variants and alignment domains. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/Sandeep5500/curriculum-learning-for-safety.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Staged-Competence，一种基于课程学习的框架，通过按难度组织偏好数据、采用基于能力的采样并渐进更新参考模型，显著提升了DPO安全对齐的鲁棒性和OOD泛化能力，使有害响应率降低16%，越狱攻击成功率降低20%。
AI.motivation: DPO在安全对齐中表现脆弱，尤其在分布外（OOD）场景下泛化能力差，亟需提升其鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出Staged-Competence框架：按难度组织偏好数据（课程学习），采用基于能力的采样策略，并在训练过程中渐进更新参考模型。
AI.result: 在三个模型族上，OOD有害响应率降低16%，越狱攻击成功率降低20%，同时保持通用能力且几乎无过度拒绝；仅用75%训练数据即可达到基线安全水平；能更好分离安全与不安全响应。
AI.conclusion: Staged-Competence是一种与策略优化损失无关的通用框架，可扩展至其他DPO变体和对齐领域。

title: Trust Region Q Adjoint Matching
summary: Off-policy reinforcement learning of pretrained flow policies remains challenging due to the instability of optimization arising from the multi-step sampling process. Recently, Q-learning with Adjoint Matching (QAM) addressed this issue by reformulating into a memoryless stochastic optimal control (SOC) problem with a learned critic. However, QAM inherits a fundamental fragility of critic-guided improvement: small critic errors are amplified when critics are ill-conditioned, often leading to model collapse. This paper introduces Trust Region Q-Adjoint Matching (TRQAM), a stable off-policy fine-tuning algorithm that adaptively controls the path-space KL with pretrained flow policies through projected dual descent. Specifically, we optimize the trust-region parameter $λ$ in SOC dynamics, and theoretically show that the path-space KL can be represented by a closed-form function of $λ$. As a result, our method can precisely control the exact deviation from pretrained flow policies, achieving stable off-policy RL. Through experiments on 50 OGBench tasks, TRQAM consistently outperforms prior arts in both offline RL and offline-to-online RL. In particular, TRQAM achieves an overall success rate of 68% in offline RL, substantially improves the strongest baseline at 46%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRQAM算法，通过信赖域投影对偶下降自适应控制预训练流策略的路径空间KL散度，解决基于评论家的离策略强化学习中的优化不稳定和模型崩溃问题。在50个OGBench任务上，TRQAM在离线RL和离线到在线RL中均取得优异性能，离线RL成功率达68%，远超最强基线的46%。
AI.motivation: 离策略强化学习预训练流策略时，多步采样过程导致优化不稳定；现有QAM方法通过将问题重写为无记忆随机最优控制问题来缓解，但继承了基于评论家策略改进的根本脆弱性——当评论家条件不佳时，微小误差会被放大，常导致模型崩溃。
AI.method: 提出Trust Region Q-Adjoint Matching (TRQAM)算法，通过投影对偶下降自适应控制预训练流策略的路径空间KL散度。具体地，在SOC动力学中优化信赖域参数λ，并从理论上证明路径空间KL可表示为λ的闭式函数，从而精确控制与预训练流策略的偏差，实现稳定的离策略强化学习。
AI.result: 在50个OGBench任务上，TRQAM在离线RL和离线到在线RL中均持续优于现有方法。离线RL任务中，TRQAM总体成功率达68%，显著超过最强基线（46%）。
AI.conclusion: TRQAM通过自适应信赖域机制有效解决了基于评论家的离策略流策略微调中的不稳定性和模型崩溃问题，为预训练流策略的稳定离策略强化学习提供了有效方案。

title: Underwater360: Reconstructing Underwater Scenes from Panoramic Images with Omnidirectional Gaussian Splatting
summary: Underwater scene reconstruction is essential for immersive exploration of aquatic environments, yet remains challenging due to complex participating-media effects such as absorption and scattering, as well as the limited field of view (FoV) of conventional cameras. Although combining panoramic imaging with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) offers a promising direction for photorealistic underwater rendering, traditional 3DGS struggles with both spherical projection distortion and underwater medium degradation. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Underwater360}, a physics-informed omnidirectional 3DGS framework for underwater panoramic scene reconstruction. First, we introduce an Omnidirectional Gaussian Splatting module that performs ray casting directly in spherical camera space instead of relying on 2D projection approximations, thereby reducing geometric distortions under 360$^\circ$ FoV. Second, we design a physics-based appearance-medium modeling architecture with pose-conditioned appearance embeddings to explicitly decouple intrinsic scene radiance from depth-dependent backscatter and attenuation, enabling physically grounded scene appearance restoration. Finally, we establish a new panoramic underwater benchmark dataset containing both synthetic and real-world scenes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Underwater360 achieves superior performance in underwater novel view synthesis and scene appearance restoration, delivering improved rendering quality and cross-view consistency in complex underwater environments. The code and datasets are released at https://github.com/SwcK423/Underwater360

AI.tldr: 提出Underwater360，一种物理感知的全景3D高斯泼溅框架，通过球面光线投射和物理介质建模实现水下场景高质量重建与外观恢复。
AI.motivation: 水下场景重建受吸收、散射等介质效应和相机有限视场的限制，传统3DGS无法处理球面投影畸变和水下介质退化。
AI.method: 1) 全向高斯泼溅模块：直接在球面相机空间进行光线投射，避免2D投影近似引起的几何畸变；2) 物理感知外观-介质建模架构：引入姿态条件外观嵌入，显式解耦场景固有辐射与深度依赖的后向散射及衰减；3) 建立包含合成与真实场景的全景水下基准数据集。
AI.result: 在新视角合成和场景外观恢复任务上优于现有方法，在复杂水下环境中实现了更优的渲染质量和跨视角一致性。
AI.conclusion: Underwater360有效解决了全景水下场景重建中的投影畸变和介质退化问题，为沉浸式水下环境探索提供了可行方案。

title: MULTISEISMO: A Multimodal Seismic Dataset and Model for Cross-Modal Seismic Understanding
summary: The application of generalist multimodal models (GMMs) to specialized scientific domains remains limited due to the scarcity of comprehensive domain-specific datasets that integrate multiple data modalities beyond text and images. In seismology, understanding earthquake phenomena requires the synthesis of timeseries waveform data, geographical imagery, and contextual metadata, a multimodal integration absent in existing seismic datasets. We present MultiSeismo, a large scale structured multimodal seismic dataset, comprising over 16K seismic events spanning 13 years (2010 to 2023) across diverse geographical regions. Each event data integrates waveform recordings from global station networks, intensity maps, population exposure visualizations, and a comprehensive textual description within a standardized JSON format. We additionally develop MISCE, a multimodal instruction set on top of raw data to enable supervised training and evaluation of GMMs on seismic reasoning tasks ranging from basic information retrieval to complex cross modal analysis. We leverage MISCE to finetune an existing multimodal model (Unified IO 2) enhanced with a specialized timeseries encoder, which yields SeisModal, the first domain specific multimodal model for comprehensive seismic analysis. Evaluation of state of the art multimodal models on MultiSeismo reveals significant challenges, particularly with time-series data processing for general purpose models, while demonstrating SeisModal's superior performance on seismic multimodal reasoning tasks. These results prove that MultiSeismo provides a rigorous benchmark for future multimodal research in seismology and validate the success of our domain specific architectural adaptations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MultiSeismo，一个大规模结构化多模态地震数据集，包含16K+地震事件、13年跨度、整合波形、强度图、人口暴露数据和文本描述。同时构建了MISCE指令集和SeisModal领域专用多模态模型，实验证明该模型在地震多模态推理任务上优于现有通用多模态模型。
AI.motivation: 通用多模态模型在科学领域应用受限，缺乏整合文本、图像以外多种数据模态的领域专用数据集。地震学中理解地震现象需要综合时序波形、地理图像和上下文元数据，而现有地震数据集缺乏这种多模态整合。
AI.method: 构建MultiSeismo数据集（16K+地震事件，2010-2023年，整合波形、强度图、人口暴露数据及文本描述）；开发MISCE多模态指令集用于监督训练；基于Unified IO 2模型并增强专用时序编码器，微调得到SeisModal领域专用多模态模型。
AI.result: 通用多模态模型在MultiSeismo上表现挑战显著，尤其在时序数据处理方面；SeisModal在地震多模态推理任务上展现出优越性能。
AI.conclusion: MultiSeismo为未来地震学多模态研究提供了严格基准，领域特定的架构适应策略是成功的。

title: YOLO26-RipeLoc Lite: A lightweight architecture for tomato ripeness detection and picking point localization in greenhouse robotic harvesting
summary: In greenhouse tomato production, automated harvesting requires accurate detection of ripe tomatoes, ripeness classification, and precise picking-point localization for robotic end-effectors. This paper proposes YOLO26-RipeLoc Lite, a lightweight deep learning architecture based on YOLO26 for simultaneous detection, ripeness classification, and center-point localization of greenhouse tomatoes. The model introduces three modifications: (1) a Lightweight Feature Pyramid Network (LFPN) with depthwise separable convolutions for efficient multi-scale fusion, (2) a Ripeness-Aware Attention Module (RAAM) with dual pooling and a learnable ripeness bias vector for enhanced color-texture discrimination, and (3) a Compact Detection Head (CDH) with shared convolutions and an integrated center-point regression branch for direct grasp planning. The model is evaluated on a custom dataset of 1,500 images with 6,227 instances (3,566 ripe, 2,661 unripe) from the SILAL greenhouse, Abu Dhabi, UAE. YOLO26-RipeLoc Lite achieves mAP@0.5 of 92.9% (95.2% ripe, 90.6% unripe) with the highest precision (95.2%) among all evaluated architectures using only 2.38M parameters. Post-training BatchNorm pruning at 30% reduces parameters to ~1.8M with negligible accuracy loss. Ablation studies confirm that greenhouse-aware HSV augmentation provides the largest improvement (+2.02 pp mAP@50), backbone freezing achieves peak precision (93.8%), and 3-phase progressive unfreezing yields the best localization quality (mAP@50:95 of 64.6%). Comparisons with YOLOv8n/s, YOLO11n/s, YOLO12n/s, and YOLO26s confirm superior accuracy-efficiency: 2.9 pp higher precision than YOLO12n with 7.0% fewer parameters and integrated center-point localization for robotic end-effector guidance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出YOLO26-RipeLoc Lite，一种基于YOLO26的轻量级深度学习架构，用于温室番茄的同步检测、成熟度分类和中心点定位。模型引入轻量化特征金字塔网络(LFPN)、成熟度感知注意力模块(RAAM)和紧凑检测头(CDH)三项改进，在SILAL温室数据集上以2.38M参数量达到92.9% mAP@0.5，最高精度95.2%，并通过BatchNorm剪枝可压缩至约1.8M参数且精度损失可忽略。
AI.motivation: 温室番茄自动化采收需要准确检测成熟番茄、分类成熟度并精确定位采摘点以引导机器人末端执行器，现有方法在精度、效率和轻量化之间难以取得良好平衡。
AI.method: 基于YOLO26提出三项改进：(1) 轻量化特征金字塔网络(LFPN)，使用深度可分离卷积实现高效多尺度融合；(2) 成熟度感知注意力模块(RAAM)，采用双池化和可学习成熟度偏置向量增强颜色-纹理判别；(3) 紧凑检测头(CDH)，采用共享卷积和集成中心点回归分支直接规划抓取。此外采用温室感知HSV增强、骨干冻结、3阶段渐进解冻等训练策略。
AI.result: 在1500张图像、6227个实例的数据集上，YOLO26-RipeLoc Lite以2.38M参数达到mAP@0.5 92.9%（成熟95.2%，未成熟90.6%），最高精度95.2%。30% BatchNorm剪枝后参数降至约1.8M，精度损失可忽略。消融实验显示温室感知HSV增强贡献最大（+2.02 pp mAP@50）。与YOLOv8n/s、YOLO11n/s、YOLO12n/s、YOLO26s相比，精度比YOLO12n高2.9 pp，参数少7.0%，且集成了中心点定位功能。
AI.conclusion: YOLO26-RipeLoc Lite在精度、效率和模型大小之间取得了优异的平衡，适用于温室番茄的自动化采收场景，能为机器人末端执行器提供直接的抓取定位指导。

title: Cross-scale Aligned Supervision for Training GANs
summary: Modern GANs often introduce adversarial supervision on intermediate generator outputs and interpret the resulting multi-stage synthesis as coarse-to-fine hierarchical generation. In this work, we challenge this interpretation. We argue that standard scale-wise adversarial supervision does not construct a proper coarse-to-fine hierarchy: each intermediate image is independently pushed toward the real distribution at its own resolution, but this scale-wise realism does not ensure that outputs across stages represent the identical generated sample. Moreover, the scale-specific image produced at each stage is not used as an explicit refinement target for the subsequent stage. Therefore, its adversarial loss can improve a scale-specific output without constraining later stages to preserve the same sample trajectory, allowing them to move toward a different sample rather than refine the previous output. We refer to this problem as a cross-scale trajectory misalignment problem. To resolve it, we propose CAT, a Cross-scale Aligned Transformer for multi-scale adversarial generation. CAT keeps the discriminator scale-wise, so each intermediate output is evaluated at its own resolution, while adding a simple generator-side consistency regularization that aligns intermediate outputs with the final output. On class-conditional ImageNet-256, CAT-H/2 achieves an FID-50K of 1.56 with one-step inference after only 60 training epochs, outperforming strong one-step GAN and diffusion/flow baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现有GAN的多阶段生成存在跨尺度轨迹不对齐问题，并提出CAT（跨尺度对齐Transformer）通过生成器侧的一致性正则化，在对中间输出施加判别器监督的同时，将其与最终输出对齐。在ImageNet-256上，CAT-H/2在仅训练60个epoch后实现FID-50K为1.56，超越了一步GAN和扩散/流基线。
AI.motivation: 现有GAN将多阶段生成解释为粗到细的层次化生成，但标准尺度级对抗监督存在根本性问题：中间输出被独立推向各自分辨率的真实分布，但不同尺度的输出并不保证是同一生成样本的轨迹，且前一阶段的输出并未显式作为后一阶段的细化目标，导致跨尺度轨迹不对齐。
AI.method: 提出CAT（Cross-scale Aligned Transformer），保持判别器的尺度级结构（每个中间输出在其自身分辨率下被评估），同时在生成器侧添加一致性正则化，将中间输出与最终输出对齐，确保多阶段生成沿同一样本轨迹进行细化而非漂移到不同样本。
AI.result: 在类条件ImageNet-256上，CAT-H/2在仅60个训练epoch后，一步推理下FID-50K达到1.56，优于强的一步GAN和扩散/流基线。
AI.conclusion: 跨尺度轨迹不对齐是现有粗到细层次化GAN的根本问题，CAT通过生成器侧一致性正则化有效解决了该问题，显著提升了一步生成质量。

title: Semigroup Consistency as a Diagnostic for Learned Physics Simulators
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Accepted to the AI4Physics Workshop at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning
summary: Learned physics simulators are often evaluated by one-step or short-horizon prediction error, but these metrics can miss failures in temporal composition and long-horizon rollout. For autonomous, state-complete systems, exact solution maps satisfy a semigroup law: direct evolution over $s+t$ should agree with evolution over $s$ followed by $t$. We propose normalized semigroup error as a post hoc, model-agnostic diagnostic comparing these direct and composed learned predictions. On one-dimensional heat and Burgers dynamics with time-conditioned ConvNet and FNO baselines, semigroup error is positively associated with rollout degradation, with trajectory-level Spearman correlation $ρ= 0.635$ and $95%$ CI $[0.621, 0.649]$. Semigroup regularization has mixed effects, supporting semigroup consistency primarily as an evaluation diagnostic rather than a universally beneficial training objective.

AI.tldr: 本文提出归一化半群误差（Normalized Semigroup Error）作为评价学习型物理模拟器长期推演能力的诊断指标，通过在热传导和Burgers动力学上的实验验证其与 rollout 退化正相关（Spearman ρ=0.635），并指出半群正则化更适合作为评估工具而非通用训练目标。
AI.motivation: 现有学习型物理模拟器常用单步或短时预测误差评估，但无法捕捉长时间推演中的时序组合失败问题，因此需要一种能反映长期推演质量的后验诊断指标。
AI.method: 利用自治、状态完备系统的解映射满足半群律（semigroup law）的性质，定义归一化半群误差，比较直接推演 s+t 步与先推演 s 步再推演 t 步的预测差异，作为模型无关的诊断指标。在1D热传导和Burgers方程上使用ConvNet和FNO基线进行验证。
AI.result: 半群误差与 rollout 退化呈正相关，轨迹级Spearman相关系数 ρ=0.635（95% CI [0.621, 0.649]）。半群正则化的效果不一，并未普遍提升训练效果。
AI.conclusion: 归一化半群误差主要作为评估诊断工具而非普适有效的训练目标，为学习型物理模拟器的长期推演评估提供了新视角。

title: FoundObj: Self-supervised Foundation Models as Rewards for Label-free 3D Object Segmentation
comment: ICML 2026. Zihui and Zhixuan are co-first authors. Code and data are available at: https://github.com/vLAR-group/FoundObj
summary: We address the challenging task of 3D object segmentation in complex scene point clouds without relying on any scene-level human annotations during training. Existing methods are typically constrained to identifying simple objects, primarily due to insufficient object priors in the learning process. In this paper, we present FoundObj, a novel framework featuring a superpoint-based object discovery agent that incrementally merges suitable neighboring superpoints, guided by our innovative semantic and geometric reward modules. These modules synergistically leverage semantic and geometric priors from self-supervised 2D/3D foundation models, providing complementary feedback to the object discovery agent and enabling robust identification of multi-class objects through reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments on diverse benchmarks demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms existing baselines. Notably, our method exhibits strong generalization in zero-shot and long-tail scenarios, underscoring its potential for scalable, label-free 3D object segmentation.

AI.tldr: FoundObj提出了一种无需场景级人工标注的3D点云物体分割框架，通过超点物体发现代理结合语义与几何奖励模块，利用自监督2D/3D基础模型的先验知识，在多种基准上实现了优于现有方法的性能，尤其在零样本和长尾场景中表现出强大的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有3D点云分割方法通常局限于识别简单物体，主要原因是学习过程中缺乏足够的物体先验知识，且依赖场景级人工标注，限制了其可扩展性。
AI.method: 提出FoundObj框架，包含基于超点的物体发现代理，该代理通过强化学习逐步合并相邻超点，并由语义和几何奖励模块引导；这两个模块分别利用自监督2D/3D基础模型的语义和几何先验提供互补反馈。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上一致优于现有基线方法，在零样本和长尾场景中展现出强大的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: FoundObj证明了无需标注即可实现多类物体鲁棒分割的可行性，为可扩展、无标签的3D物体分割提供了新范式。

title: Sparse-LiDAR Prompting of Monocular Geometry Foundations: An Empirical Study Toward Long-Range Driving Depth
summary: Sparse-LiDAR-prompted depth foundation models (PromptDA, Prior Depth Anything, DMD3C) have shown strong results on indoor scenes or within KITTI's standard 80-meter evaluation cap. However, two limitations remain: (i) systematic distance-stratified evaluation in long-range driving regimes (50-150 m) is largely absent; (ii) prior approaches built on disparity-based foundations rely on pre-interpolated dense priors, leaving truly sparse LiDAR injection on point-map foundations (e.g., MoGe-2, NeurIPS 2025) unexplored. We present SLIM (Sparse-LiDAR Injected Monocular geometry), the first adaptation of MoGe-2 to accept truly sparse LiDAR input. SLIM integrates a partial-convolution sparse encoder with a multi-scale fusion neck that fuses LiDAR features into the point-map decoder at five scales. We adopt density-agnostic training (random injection ratio in [0.005, 0.30]) so a single model serves diverse input densities. On Virtual KITTI and CARLA, SLIM reduces the absolute relative error of the MoGe-2 baseline by approximately 39-51% at 100-150 m. Ablation across six injection ratios shows partial-convolution injection improves both AbsRel and RMSE on Virtual KITTI in all six settings; on CARLA, AbsRel improves in five of six settings (one near-tie at 0.015 differs by 0.0013), and RMSE is comparable across encoders, with partial-convolution improving in three settings (by up to 0.31 unit) and losing by at most 0.11 unit in the other three.

AI.tldr: SLIM首次将MoGe-2适配为接受真正稀疏LiDAR输入的深度基础模型，通过部分卷积稀疏编码器和多尺度融合颈部，在远距离驾驶场景（100-150米）将绝对相对误差降低39-51%。
AI.motivation: 现有稀疏LiDAR提示的深度基础模型（PromptDA、Prior Depth Anything、DMD3C）存在两个局限性：(i) 缺乏对远距离驾驶场景（50-150米）的系统性距离分层评估；(ii) 基于视差基础的方法依赖预插值密集先验，而真正稀疏LiDAR注入到点图基础模型（如MoGe-2）尚未被探索。
AI.method: SLIM将MoGe-2适配为接受真正稀疏LiDAR输入，集成部分卷积稀疏编码器和多尺度融合颈部，在五个尺度上将LiDAR特征融合到点图解码器中。采用密度无关训练（随机注入率在[0.005, 0.30]之间），单一模型即可服务多种输入密度。
AI.result: 在Virtual KITTI和CARLA上，SLIM在100-150米范围内将MoGe-2基线的绝对相对误差降低约39-51%。在六个注入率上的消融实验显示：部分卷积注入在Virtual KITTI上所有六种设置中均改善了AbsRel和RMSE；在CARLA上，AbsRel在六种设置中有五种改善，RMSE在三种设置中改善。
AI.conclusion: SLIM是首个将真正稀疏LiDAR注入到点图基础模型的方法，显著提升了远距离深度估计性能，验证了部分卷积稀疏编码器在多尺度融合下的有效性。

title: Reparametrizing Shampoo and SOAP for Subspace Basis Updates and BFloat16 Storage
summary: Shampoo-based methods, such as KL-Shampoo and SOAP, have demonstrated strong performance in training neural networks and rely on QR decomposition. Because existing QR implementations require single-precision (FP32) arithmetic and remain computationally expensive, these methods become time- and memory-intensive when their preconditioning matrices are large. Moreover, using BFloat16 (BFP16) storage to reduce memory usage can degrade the performance of Shampoo-based methods. We propose a reparametrization of the preconditioner that supports BFP16 storage and forms a complete basis by combining updated basis vectors with unchanged ones. By updating only part of the basis through QR decomposition in a subspace, our approach reduces computational overhead while mitigating the performance degradation caused by BFP16 storage. Our approach applies broadly to Shampoo-based methods that employ QR decomposition, including KL-Shampoo, SOAP, and KL-SOAP. In particular, it improves the performance of SOAP and KL-SOAP under BFP16 storage, enabling KL-SOAP to match or exceed KL-Shampoo. Overall, our approach makes Shampoo-based methods more memory- and time-efficient.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种重参数化方法，通过子空间QR分解仅更新部分基向量，支持BFP16存储并降低计算开销，使基于Shampoo的优化器（KL-Shampoo、SOAP、KL-SOAP）在保持性能的同时更节省内存和时间。
AI.motivation: 现有Shampoo类方法依赖QR分解，需FP32精度且计算昂贵；使用BFP16存储虽能降低内存但会损害性能。需要一种方法在降低计算与内存开销的同时，缓解BFP16带来的性能退化。
AI.method: 提出对预条件矩阵进行重参数化，支持BFP16存储，将更新的基向量与未改变的基向量组合形成完整基；通过在子空间中对部分基进行QR分解来降低计算开销。
AI.result: 该方法可广泛应用于使用QR分解的Shampoo类方法（KL-Shampoo、SOAP、KL-SOAP）；在BFP16存储下提升了SOAP和KL-SOAP的性能，使KL-SOAP达到或超过KL-Shampoo；整体上使Shampoo类方法更内存和时间高效。
AI.conclusion: 所提重参数化方法有效解决了Shampoo类方法中QR分解计算昂贵和BFP16性能退化的问题，在不牺牲性能的前提下实现了更优的内存和时间效率。

title: LocateAnything: Fast and High-Quality Vision-Language Grounding with Parallel Box Decoding
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) commonly formulate visual grounding and detection as a coordinate-token generation problem, serializing each 2D box into multiple 1D tokens that are learned and decoded largely independently. This token-by-token decoding mismatches the coupled structure of box geometry and creates a practical inference bottleneck due to strictly sequential generation. We introduce LocateAnything, a unified generative grounding and detection framework based on Parallel Box Decoding (PBD). By decoding geometric elements such as bounding boxes and points as atomic units in a single step, LocateAnything preserves intra-box geometric coherence and unlocks substantial parallelism. We show that PBD improves both decoding throughput and localization accuracy. We further develop a scalable data engine and curate LocateAnything-Data, a large-scale dataset with more than 138 million training samples, substantially increasing data diversity for high-precision localization. Extensive evaluations show that LocateAnything advances the speed-accuracy frontier, achieving significantly higher decoding throughput while improving high-IoU localization quality across diverse benchmarks. The results highlight the complementary benefits of Parallel Box Decoding and large-scale training data in enabling efficient and precise unified visual grounding and detection.

AI.tldr: LocateAnything提出并行框解码（PBD）方法，将边界框等几何元素作为原子单元单步解码，取代传统的序列化坐标生成方式，并结合大规模数据集（1.38亿样本），在保持几何一致性的同时显著提升解码吞吐量和定位精度。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM将视觉定位和目标检测转化为坐标token序列生成问题，每个2D框被序列化为多个1D token独立学习与解码，这种逐token解码方式与框几何结构的耦合性质不匹配，且严格顺序生成造成推理瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出并行框解码（Parallel Box Decoding, PBD），将边界框和点等几何元素作为原子单元在单步中解码，保持框内几何一致性并实现并行化；同时构建大规模数据集LocateAnything-Data（超过1.38亿训练样本）以增强数据多样性。
AI.result: PBD同时提升了解码吞吐量和定位精度；在多个基准上实现了更高的解码吞吐量和更好的高IoU定位质量，推进了速度-精度前沿。
AI.conclusion: 并行框解码与大规模训练数据具有互补优势，能够实现高效且精确的统一视觉定位与检测框架。

title: AnchorDiff: Training-Free Concept Grounding for MM-DiTs via Anchor-Based Graph Propagation
summary: Multi-Modal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs) encode rich representations for training-free concept grounding, but existing attention-based methods often produce overlapping activations on visually confusable concepts, a failure mode we call concept leakage, where target responses spill over to non-target objects. To address this issue, we propose AnchorDiff, a training-free grounding method that decouples semantic localization from structural refinement. AnchorDiff selects a high-confidence anchor from concept-to-image attention map and propagates it as a one-hot seed over a hybrid graph derived from image-to-image self-attention. The graph uses output-space similarity for dense within-object propagation and a row-wise attention gate to suppress cross-object connections. Additionally, we introduce the Multi-Concept Confusion Dataset, which contains images with multiple visually similar concepts and separate masks, enabling explicit evaluation of concept leakage. Experiments show that AnchorDiff achieves strong grounding performance on ImageNet-Segmentation and PascalVOC, while substantially reducing concept leakage on our Multi-Concept Confusion Dataset.

AI.tldr: AnchorDiff是一种无需训练的 grounding 方法，通过从概念到图像的注意力图中选择高置信度锚点，并在基于图像自注意力的混合图上传播 one-hot 种子，来解耦语义定位与结构细化，有效减少多模态扩散 Transformer 中的概念泄漏问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于注意力的方法在视觉上易混淆的概念上会产生重叠激活（即概念泄漏），目标响应会溢出到非目标对象上，需要解决这一问题。
AI.method: AnchorDiff 包含两步：(1) 从概念到图像的注意力图中选择高置信度锚点；(2) 将锚点作为 one-hot 种子在混合图上传播。混合图利用图像自注意力，通过输出空间相似性实现密集的类内传播，并通过行级注意力门控抑制跨对象连接。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet-Segmentation 和 PascalVOC 上实现了强 grounding 性能，并在所提出的 Multi-Concept Confusion Dataset 上显著减少了概念泄漏。
AI.conclusion: AnchorDiff 通过解耦语义定位与结构细化，有效抑制了概念泄漏，为无需训练的 grounding 提供了更鲁棒的方案。

title: QAM-W: Joint 2D Codebook Quantization for LLM Weights via Hadamard Rotation and Activation-Aware Scaling
summary: Scalar post-training quantizers discard pairwise coordinate structure within weight rows. We introduce QAM-W (Quadrature Amplitude Modulation for Weights), a codec that recovers this structure: each row is L2-normalized, block-Hadamard rotated, paired into 2D coordinates, and quantized against a single Lloyd-Max codebook trained on the unit circular Gaussian, with activation-aware per-channel scaling. In a cross-model study spanning five LLMs from four families (1.1B--13B parameters) and eight quantized configurations, the activation-aware variant at $\approx 5.5$ bpw stays within $\pm 0.4\%$ of BF16 WikiText-2 perplexity on every model, matching the SmoothQuant W8A8 quality envelope at $32\%$ fewer weight bits. Joint 2D coding outperforms polar (amplitude $\times$ phase) coding by 2--15~pp $Δ$PPL at equal bitrate, and paired KL against BF16 tracks $Δ$PPL\% at Spearman $ρ= 0.99$ across 37 (method, model) rows, consistent with a monotone composite bound from codec distortion to KL divergence. A 3.5~bpw variant is competitive on quantization-tolerant architectures. At strict 4~bpw, the rotated-codebook frontier method QTIP outperforms QAM-W; the contribution is the quality-preserving 5--6~bpw band.

AI.tldr: 提出QAM-W编解码器，通过L2归一化、块哈达玛旋转、2D坐标配对和Lloyd-Max量化恢复权重行内成对坐标结构，在约5.5 bpw下实现与SmoothQuant W8A8相当的困惑度，权重位数减少32%。
AI.motivation: 标量后训练量化器丢弃了权重行内的成对坐标结构，本文旨在恢复该结构以提升量化效率。
AI.method: 每行先L2归一化，再经块哈达玛旋转，将权重配对为2D坐标，使用针对单位圆高斯分布训练的单一Lloyd-Max码本进行量化，并引入激活感知的逐通道缩放。
AI.result: 在五个LLM（1.1B–13B参数）的八种量化配置下，约5.5 bpw时困惑度与BF16差异在±0.4%以内，权重位数比SmoothQuant W8A8少32%；2D编码比极坐标编码在同等比特率下ΔPPL提升2–15个百分点；配对KL与ΔPPL%的Spearman ρ=0.99。
AI.conclusion: QAM-W在5–6 bpw范围内能保持质量，3.5 bpw在量化容忍架构上有竞争力；4 bpw严格约束下QTIP更优，本文贡献在于5–6 bpw高质量区域。

title: LAD-VF: LLM-Automatic Differentiation Enables Fine-Tuning-Free Robot Planning from Formal Methods Feedback
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can translate natural language instructions into executable action plans for robotics, autonomous driving, and other domains. Yet, deploying LLM-driven planning in the physical world demands strict adherence to safety and regulatory constraints, which current models often violate due to hallucination or weak alignment. Traditional data-driven alignment methods, such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), require costly human labeling, while recent formal-feedback approaches still depend on resource-intensive fine-tuning. In this paper, we propose LAD-VF, a fine-tuning-free framework that leverages formal verification feedback for automated prompt engineering. By introducing a formal-verification-informed text loss integrated with LLM-AutoDiff, LAD-VF iteratively refines prompts rather than model parameters. This yields three key benefits: (i) scalable adaptation without fine-tuning; (ii) compatibility with modular LLM architectures; and (iii) interpretable refinement via auditable prompts. Experiments in robot navigation and manipulation tasks demonstrate that LAD-VF substantially enhances specification compliance, improving success rates from 60% to over 90%. Our method thus presents a scalable and interpretable pathway toward trustworthy, formally-verified LLM-driven control systems.

AI.tldr: LAD-VF 提出一种免微调框架，通过形式化验证反馈结合 LLM-AutoDiff 进行自动提示词工程，在机器人导航与操作任务中将规范符合率从 60% 提升至 90% 以上。
AI.motivation: LLM 驱动的规划在物理世界部署时存在安全与法规约束违规问题（幻觉或对齐不足），而传统数据驱动对齐方法需要昂贵的人工标注，形式化反馈方法仍需资源密集的微调。
AI.method: 提出 LAD-VF 框架，免微调，通过引入形式化验证信息文本损失与 LLM-AutoDiff 结合，迭代优化提示词而非模型参数。
AI.result: 在机器人导航与操作任务中，规范符合率从 60% 提升至 90% 以上。
AI.conclusion: LAD-VF 提供了一种可扩展、可解释的途径，实现值得信赖的、经过形式化验证的 LLM 驱动控制系统。

title: Triadic Dynamics Aware Diffusion Posterior Sampling for Inverse Problems: Optimizing Guidance and Stochasticity Schedules
summary: Generative posterior sampling using diffusion models has emerged as a dominant paradigm for solving inverse problems in imaging, which usually consists of three main components: data consistency (DC) guidance, classifier-free guidance (CFG) and stochasticity. While prior arts have focused on how to develop each or all components, less attention has given to how to schedule them, leading to heuristically fixed or partially adjusted suboptimal schedules. In this work, we argue that the interactions among all three components in terms of scheduling are crucial for significantly improved performance in solving inverse problems in imaging. Our analysis shows that aggressive CFG early in sampling conflict with DC guidance, while stochasticity brings the trajectory back to higher-probability regions. Based on these findings, we propose Triadic Dynamics Aware Posterior Sampling (TriPS), which reformulates posterior sampling as a time-varying control problem and optimizes schedules following a triadic trend of decreasing DC and stochasticity scales alongside increasing CFG scale. TriPS achieves this through two strategies: template-based search over functional priors for reliable baseline schedules, and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)-based reinforcement learning for more flexible temporal curves. Experiments demonstrate TriPS outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in data fidelity and perceptual realism.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TriPS方法，将扩散模型的后验采样重新定义为时变控制问题，通过优化数据一致性、无分类器引导和随机性三个组件的调度策略（递减DC和随机性、递增CFG），显著提升成像逆问题的数据保真度和感知真实感。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型求解成像逆问题的方法中，数据一致性引导、无分类器引导和随机性三者的调度策略多采用启发式固定或部分调整的方式，忽略了三者交互对性能的关键影响，导致次优调度。
AI.method: 提出Triadic Dynamics Aware Posterior Sampling (TriPS)，将后验采样建模为时变控制问题，遵循三元趋势：递减DC和随机性尺度、递增CFG尺度。采用两种策略：基于模板的搜索（寻找可靠基线调度）和基于GRPO的强化学习（学习更灵活的时序曲线）。
AI.result: 实验表明TriPS在数据保真度和感知真实感上均优于当前最先进的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: DC、CFG和随机性三者的动态调度策略对扩散模型求解逆问题至关重要，合理的调度能显著提升性能，证明了将调度视为控制问题的有效性。

title: A PAC-Bayesian View of Generalisation for Physics-Informed Machine Learning
summary: Physics-informed machine learning (PIML) integrates mechanistic knowledge, typically in the form of partial differential equations (PDE), into data-driven models. Despite strong empirical performance, its statistical generalisation properties remain poorly understood, particularly in the regression setting with unbounded losses. Existing analyses rely on approximation or stability arguments and do not fully capture how physical structure influences generalisation from finite data. In this work, we develop a PAC-Bayesian framework for PIML that provides high-probability generalisation guarantees in the presence of unbounded losses. We adopt a multi-task perspective that jointly treats data fidelity, PDE residuals, initial and boundary conditions, avoiding the looseness induced by standard union-bound approaches. Our analysis leverages the structure of physics-informed objectives to derive novel bounds where the complexity scales with input-gradient norms of the losses, revealing a direct link between physical regularity and generalisation. We instantiate this framework under Sobolev and Poincaré-type assumptions, yielding two classes of bounds that trade off statistical complexity and smoothness in different regimes. Building on these results, we propose a self-bounding-aware learning algorithm that directly optimises tractable surrogates of the derived bounds, along with a practical procedure to estimate the associated constants in realistic settings. Empirical evaluations on standard PDE benchmarks demonstrate that our bounds are non-vacuous, significantly tighter than union-bound baselines, and can be effectively minimised during training. Overall, our results provide a principled statistical foundation for the generalisation of physics-informed models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个PAC-Bayesian框架，用于分析物理信息机器学习（PIML）在无界损失下的泛化性能。通过多任务视角联合处理数据保真度、PDE残差以及初始/边界条件，推导出与输入梯度范数相关的泛化界，并基于Sobolev和Poincaré假设得到两类权衡统计复杂度和光滑性的界的类别。同时提出了自界感知学习算法和常数估计方法，实验表明所得界非平凡且显著优于联合界基线。
AI.motivation: 尽管物理信息机器学习（PIML）在经验上表现优异，但其统计泛化性质，尤其是在无界损失回归设置下的泛化性质，尚未得到充分理解。现有分析依赖于近似或稳定性论证，未能充分刻画物理结构如何影响有限数据下的泛化。
AI.method: 1) 采用PAC-Bayesian框架，联合建模数据保真度、PDE残差、初始和边界条件，避免联合界的松驰；2) 利用物理信息目标的结构，导出复杂度与损失输入梯度范数相关的泛化界；3) 在Sobolev和Poincaré型假设下实例化框架，得到两类权衡统计复杂度和光滑性的界；4) 提出自界感知学习算法和实用常数估计方法。
AI.result: 在标准PDE基准上的实验表明，所推导的界是非平凡的（non-vacuous），显著比联合界基线更紧，且可以在训练过程中有效最小化。
AI.conclusion: 本文为物理信息模型的泛化提供了原则性的统计基础，揭示了物理规律的正则性与泛化之间的直接联系，并提供了可实际优化和评估的泛化保证工具。

title: AdaMorph: Unified Motion Retargeting via Embodiment-Aware Adaptive Transformers
summary: Retargeting human motion to heterogeneous robots is a fundamental challenge in robotics, primarily due to the severe kinematic and dynamic discrepancies between varying embodiments. Existing solutions typically resort to training embodiment-specific models, which scales poorly and fails to exploit shared motion semantics. To address this, we present AdaMorph, a unified neural retargeting framework that enables a single model to adapt human motion to diverse robot morphologies. Our approach treats retargeting as a conditional generation task. We map human motion into a morphology-agnostic latent intent space and utilize a dual-purpose prompting mechanism to condition the generation. Instead of simple input concatenation, we leverage Adaptive Layer Normalization (AdaLN) to dynamically modulate the decoder's feature space based on embodiment constraints. Furthermore, we enforce physical plausibility through a curriculum-based training objective that ensures orientation and trajectory consistency via integration. Experimental results on 12 distinct humanoid robots demonstrate that AdaMorph effectively unifies control across heterogeneous topologies, exhibiting strong zero-shot generalization to unseen complex motions while preserving the dynamic essence of the source behaviors.

AI.tldr: AdaMorph是一个统一的神经重定向框架，通过将人体运动映射到形态无关的潜在意图空间，并利用自适应层归一化（AdaLN）机制，实现单一模型将人体运动适配到多种异构机器人形态，在12种不同人形机器人上展示了零样本泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的人体运动重定向到异构机器人的方法通常需要针对每种机器人形态训练独立的模型，扩展性差且无法利用共享的运动语义。需要一种统一的框架来克服不同机器人之间严重的运动学和动力学差异。
AI.method: 将重定向视为条件生成任务，首先将人体运动映射到形态无关的潜在意图空间，然后利用双用途提示机制（通过AdaLN动态调制解码器的特征空间）来条件化运动生成，并采用基于课程学习的训练目标（通过积分保证方向与轨迹一致性）来强制执行物理合理性。
AI.result: 在12种不同人形机器人上的实验表明，AdaMorph能够有效统一跨异构拓扑的控制，对未见过的复杂运动展现出强零样本泛化能力，同时保留了源行为的动态本质。
AI.conclusion: AdaMorph证明了通过形态无关的潜在表示和自适应条件调制，单一模型可以成功处理多种异构机器人的人体运动重定向任务，显著提升可扩展性和泛化能力。

title: Comparative Study of Vision-Based Metric Measurement for Large-Scale Planar Scenes
summary: Vision-based metric distance and area measurement remains challenging in large-scale outdoor environments due to long-range sensing, camera zoom, and unstable imaging conditions. This work studies planar metric measurement in a real-world reservoir monitoring scenario using PTZ cameras and compares three representative approaches: geometry-based monocular ranging, image stitching with birds-eye-view transformation, and stereo-based ranging using two jointly calibrated monocular cameras. For monocular ranging, planar localization models are derived from camera geometry and the effect of camera pitch angle is analyzed. Image stitching is investigated for large-area mapping, while a stereo-based scheme is developed for long-range measurement without dedicated stereo hardware. Experiments show clear trade-offs: monocular ranging achieves meter-level accuracy under sufficiently large pitch angles, stereo-based ranging achieves decimeter-level accuracy with reduced sensitivity to pitch variations, and image stitching is effective for small-scale scenes but degrades in stability and scalability as scene size increases.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于PTZ摄像机的大规模户外场景平面度量测量，比较了单目测距、图像拼接与鸟瞰变换、以及立体视觉三种方法的性能与适用条件。
AI.motivation: 在大规模户外环境中，由于远距离感知、相机变焦和不稳定成像条件，基于视觉的度量距离和面积测量仍然具有挑战性。本文旨在解决实际水库监测场景中的平面度量测量问题。
AI.method: 研究了三种代表性方法：基于几何的单目测距（推导平面定位模型并分析俯仰角影响）、基于图像拼接与鸟瞰变换的大面积映射、以及基于两个联合标定单目相机的立体视觉测距方案（无需专用立体硬件）。
AI.result: 单目测距在足够大的俯仰角下可达米级精度；立体测距可达分米级精度且对俯仰角变化不敏感；图像拼接适用于小场景，但在场景增大时稳定性和可扩展性下降。
AI.conclusion: 三种方法存在明确的性能权衡，实际应用中需根据场景规模、精度需求和硬件条件选择合适方案。

title: MechRL: Reinforcement Learning Agents Perform Circuit Discovery for Mechanistic Interpretability
summary: Mechanistic interpretability has identified small sets of attention heads that implement specific behaviours in transformer language models, but recovering these circuits typically requires a bespoke analytical pipeline for each new task. We recast circuit discovery as a reinforcement-learning problem. An agent operates over the 144 attention heads of GPT-2 small as a discrete action space; each action triggers a zero-ablation and a contrastive reward that subtracts the ablation's damage to general next-token prediction from its damage to the target task. A single PPO policy, trained on two tasks (induction and IOI) in a vectorised multi-task environment, attains the per-episode oracle on both training tasks and on a held-out third task (docstring completion). Its preferred heads coincide with the canonical heads of established literature on precisely the axes those papers identify as causally non-redundant under single-head ablation; the categories they identify as redundant are correctly de-prioritised by the agent. On the held-out task, best-of-five planning recovers 96\% of the oracle ceiling with no task signal supplied at evaluation. These results indicate that reinforcement learning over causal interventions is a viable, transferable substrate for identifying the single-head bottlenecks of mechanistic circuits, complementary to existing path-patching approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将电路发现重构为强化学习问题：一个PPO智能体以GPT-2 small的144个注意力头为离散动作空间，通过零消融和对比奖励学习识别因果关键头。单一策略在两个训练任务（induction和IOI）上达到每回合最优，并在未见任务（docstring completion）上通过best-of-five规划恢复96%的oracle上限，识别出的关键头与经典文献完全一致。
AI.motivation: 现有 mechanistic interpretability 的电路发现方法需要为每个新任务构建定制化的分析流程，缺乏可迁移性和自动化。本文旨在探索是否能将电路发现泛化为一个可跨任务迁移的强化学习问题。
AI.method: 将电路发现建模为强化学习问题：智能体动作空间为GPT-2 small的144个注意力头（每个动作执行零消融）；奖励函数为对比奖励（目标任务损失变化减去通用next-token预测损失变化）；使用PPO算法在向量化多任务环境中训练单一策略，同时优化induction和IOI两个任务；在未见任务上使用best-of-five规划进行评估。
AI.result: 单一PPO策略在两个训练任务上均达到每回合最优；识别出的关键头与经典文献中因果非冗余的头完全一致，文献中归为冗余的头也被正确降权；在未见任务上，best-of-five规划恢复96%的oracle上限。
AI.conclusion: 强化学习结合因果干预是识别机械可解释性电路中单头瓶颈的可行且可迁移的方法，与现有的path-patching方法互补。

title: Zero-Shot MARL Benchmark in the Cyber-Physical Mobility Lab
summary: We present a reproducible benchmark for evaluating sim-to-real transfer of Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) policies for Connected and Automated Vehicles (CAVs). The platform, based on the Cyber-Physical Mobility Lab (CPM Lab) [1], integrates simulation, a high-fidelity digital twin, and a physical testbed, enabling structured zero-shot evaluation of MARL motion-planning policies. We demonstrate its use by deploying a SigmaRL-trained policy [2] across all three domains, revealing two complementary sources of performance degradation: architectural differences between simulation and hardware control stacks, and the sim-to-real gap induced by increasing environmental realism. The open-source setup enables systematic analysis of sim-to-real challenges in MARL under realistic, reproducible conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个可重复的基准平台，用于评估多智能体强化学习（MARL）策略在网联自动驾驶车辆（CAVs）中的仿真到真实迁移，该平台基于CPM Lab，集成了仿真、高保真数字孪生和物理测试平台，支持零样本评估。通过部署SigmaRL训练的策略，揭示了性能下降的两个来源：仿真与硬件控制栈的架构差异，以及环境真实性增加导致的仿真-真实差距。
AI.motivation: 现有的多智能体强化学习（MARL）策略在CAVs中的应用缺乏一个可重复、结构化的基准来评估从仿真到真实环境（sim-to-real）的迁移效果，特别是零样本部署中的性能退化原因尚不清晰。
AI.method: 基于CPM Lab构建了一个集成仿真、高保真数字孪生和物理测试平台的三层评估框架，通过将SigmaRL训练的策略零样本部署到这三个域中，对比分析性能差异，分离出架构差异和环境真实性两种退化来源。
AI.result: 成功部署了SigmaRL训练的策略，并揭示了两种互补的性能退化来源：一是仿真与硬件控制栈之间的架构差异，二是由环境真实性增加引起的仿真-真实差距。
AI.conclusion: 该开源平台能够在可重复的现实条件下系统性地分析MARL中的仿真到真实迁移挑战，为未来研究提供了标准化评估基准。

title: Clinically-Grounded Counterfactual Reasoning for Medical Video Diagnosis
summary: Medical video diagnosis involves inferring clinical decisions from dynamic tissue responses throughout examination processes. Existing methods rely on an end-to-end learning paradigm that i) focuses on appearance rather than pathology, ii) lacks clinical priors, and iii) reasons solely from observations without counterfactual comparison. This work introduces MedVCR, a counterfactual reasoning framework that mimics clinical diagnostic thinking. MedVCR comprises three components: a Counterfactual Generator that synthesizes tissue evolution under specified pathological states via a diffusion-based manner; a Counterfactual Representation Learning module that encodes diagnostic knowledge through clinical rules (i.e., temporal consistency, pathological separability, and counterfactual alignment); and a Dual Diagnostic Prediction strategy that integrates video-level assessment with frame-level counterfactual analysis. MedVCR is evaluated under both fully supervised (e.g., colposcopy) and weakly supervised (e.g., colonoscopy) video diagnosis settings, yielding 2.6%-10.2% performance gains compared with leading baselines. Comprehensive ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of each component. The code will be released.

AI.tldr: MedVCR是一个基于反事实推理的医学视频诊断框架，通过扩散模型生成反事实组织演化、临床规则编码诊断知识以及双重诊断预测策略，在完全监督和弱监督的医学视频诊断任务上相比基线方法提升2.6%-10.2%的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有医学视频诊断方法采用端到端学习范式，存在三个关键缺陷：1）关注外观而非病理特征；2）缺乏临床先验知识；3）仅从观察结果推理而没有反事实对比。这促使作者提出模拟临床诊断思维的反事实推理框架。
AI.method: MedVCR包含三个核心组件：1）反事实生成器（Counterfactual Generator）：基于扩散模型合成指定病理状态下的组织演化过程；2）反事实表示学习模块（Counterfactual Representation Learning）：通过临床规则（时间一致性、病理可分性、反事实对齐）编码诊断知识；3）双重诊断预测策略（Dual Diagnostic Prediction）：结合视频级评估和帧级反事实分析进行综合诊断。
AI.result: 在完全监督（阴道镜）和弱监督（结肠镜）视频诊断设置下进行验证，相比主流基线方法获得2.6%-10.2%的性能提升。消融实验进一步验证了每个组件的有效性。
AI.conclusion: MedVCR通过引入反事实推理机制有效模拟了临床诊断思维，显著提升了医学视频诊断的性能，且适用于不同监督程度的实际医疗场景。

title: When Correct Demonstrations Hurt: Rethinking the Role of Exemplars in In-Context Learning
summary: In-context learning (ICL) is often motivated by the intuition that demonstrations help because they provide correct input-output examples. However, we reveal a counterintuitive phenomenon: correctness does not guarantee exemplar utility, and some correct demonstrations can even reduce ICL accuracy. To study this correctness-utility gap, we introduce task-preserving perturbations, where only the exemplar input is changed, while the example remains a correct instance of the same task. Concretely, each perturbed exemplar is assigned the target induced by the task mapping. This framework covers both label-updating perturbations, where task-relevant semantics change and targets are recomputed, and stricter target-preserving perturbations, where the original target remains valid. We formalize the resulting failure mode as contextual evidence shift: task-preserving perturbations can change the effective mixture of evidence used by the model for contextual inference, thereby separating exemplar correctness from exemplar utility. Across sentiment classification, logical reasoning, and math word problems, we find that task-preserving perturbed demonstrations can substantially degrade ICL performance, especially for smaller models, harder tasks, and higher perturbation ratios. Our results show that robust ICL requires evaluating not only whether demonstrations are correct, but also how they influence contextual inference. Code is available at https://github.com/Chenghao-Qiu/Task-Preserving-ICL.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了上下文学习（ICL）中的一个反直觉现象：示范样例的正确性并不保证其效用，某些正确的示范甚至可能降低ICL性能。作者引入任务保持扰动框架来研究这种正确性-效用差距，通过改变输入但保持输出与任务映射一致，发现扰动后的正确示范会改变模型用于上下文推理的证据混合，从而损害性能，尤其在小模型、困难任务和高扰动比例下更为显著。
AI.motivation: 现有ICL研究通常认为示范样例通过提供正确的输入-输出示例来帮助模型，但这种直觉忽略了正确示范可能带来负面影响的潜在情况。作者旨在探究正确示范为何不一定有用的深层原因及其机制。
AI.method: 提出任务保持扰动（Task-Preserving Perturbations）框架，包括两类扰动：标签更新扰动（label-updating）和更严格的标签保持扰动（target-preserving）。在此框架下定义"上下文证据偏移"（contextual evidence shift）作为失败模式，并在情感分类、逻辑推理和数学应用题三个任务上进行实验。
AI.result: 任务保持扰动的正确示范会显著降低ICL性能，该效应在更小的模型、更困难的任务和更高的扰动比例下更加明显。
AI.conclusion: ICL的鲁棒性不仅需要评估示范的正确性，还需要评估它们如何影响上下文推理过程。示范的正确性与效用之间存在根本性分离。

title: Vector Fields for Path Following on Lie Groups with Application in Robot Control
comment: Manuscript revised: new title, reframed abstract and introduction for robotics, and added a coauthor
summary: Many robotic systems allow independent control of position and orientation (pose), including omnidirectional aerial vehicles, underwater robots, and manipulator end-effectors. In many applications, these systems must follow a continuous sequence of poses, leading to either trajectory-tracking or path following formulations. Compared to trajectory-tracking, path following offers important practical advantages. In particular, we focus on the problem of path following on Lie groups. Considering the robots as rigid bodies moving in the 3D space, this path-following problem can be posed as a problem of designing guiding vector fields on the matrix Lie group SE(3). In this paper, we develop a general vector-field framework for path following on connected matrix Lie groups, of which SE(3) is a prominent special case. The proposed vector field guarantees convergence to a desired parametric curve from almost all initial conditions while ensuring continuous motion along the path. Furthermore, another interesting feature is that, as opposed to previous works, the control input is "minimal" in terms of representation and closer to the engineering application (e.g., the body twist in the case SE(3)). After establishing the general case, the framework is then specialized to SE(3), of special interest in robotics, yielding an efficient algorithm suitable for real-time robotic control. Experiments with a robotic manipulator tracking complex pose paths demonstrate the effectiveness of the approach. An open-source implementation is also provided.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在矩阵李群（特别是SE(3)）上的路径跟随通用向量场框架，通过设计引导向量场实现刚体从几乎任意初始状态收敛到期望参数曲线并持续运动，该方法表示"最小化"且更贴近工程应用，在机械臂复杂位姿路径跟踪实验中验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 许多机器人系统（如全向飞行器、水下机器人、机械臂末端执行器）需要独立控制位置和姿态（位姿），且需跟随连续位姿序列。相比轨迹跟踪，路径跟随具有重要的实际优势，但在李群上的路径跟随问题尚未得到充分解决。
AI.method: 在连通矩阵李群上开发通用向量场框架，以SE(3)为特例。设计引导向量场保证从几乎全部初始条件收敛到期望参数曲线并持续运动，控制输入采用更贴近工程应用的表示（如SE(3)情形下的身体 twist）。
AI.result: 建立了李群路径跟随的通用向量场理论框架，并特化到SE(3)，得到适用于实时机器人控制的高效算法。机械臂复杂位姿路径跟踪实验验证了方法有效性，并提供了开源实现。
AI.conclusion: 该向量场框架实现了李群上路径跟随的全局收敛性，表示方式更贴近工程实践，适用于多种机器人系统的实时控制。

title: OmniInteract: Benchmarking Real-World Streaming Interaction for Real-Time Omnimodal Assistants
summary: We introduce OmniInteract, a streaming benchmark for real-time omnimodal large language models evaluated through native online inference over audio-visual streams. Unlike offline video understanding or text-prompted streaming QA, OmniInteract preserves the original audio-visual stream and requires models to process it online, without access to future content. User queries and ambient sounds are embedded in the audio track, requiring models to detect multimodal triggers, decide when to respond, and answer while the stream unfolds. OmniInteract contains 250 videos with 1,430 temporally grounded response slots: 1,062 1Q1A slots across real-time, proactive, and nested scenarios, and 368 1QnA slots for continuous task monitoring and step guidance. Each slot includes a trigger, response window, and target answer. We evaluate response correctness, timing, invalid outputs, interruption handling, and context continuity using Interaction-Aware Quality-Timeliness F1, Interruption Diagnostic Suite, and Nested Chain Completion Score. Experiments show that current models remain weak in streaming interaction, with the best overall IA-QTF1 reaching only 0.368 and the best 1QnA IA-QTF1 only 0.052. Further study on mathematical reasoning in full-duplex settings shows that offline capability does not necessarily transfer to online interaction. Code and datasets will be made publicly accessible at https://github.com/Lucky-Lance/OmniInteract.

AI.tldr: OmniInteract是一个面向全模态大语言模型的流式交互基准，要求模型在音视频流在线推理中实时检测触发、决定响应时机并回答问题。包含250个视频、1430个时间锚定响应槽，实验表明当前模型在流式交互中表现薄弱，最佳IA-QTF1仅0.368，连续任务场景仅0.052。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多采用离线视频理解或文本提示的流式QA，无法评估模型在真实音视频流中在线处理、自主决定响应时机及处理多模态触发的能力，缺乏对实时全双工交互的系统性评测。
AI.method: 构建OmniInteract基准，包含250个视频和1430个时间锚定响应槽（1062个1Q1A槽涵盖实时、主动、嵌套场景；368个1QnA槽用于连续任务监控与步骤指导），每槽包含触发条件、响应窗口和目标答案。设计IA-QTF1、中断诊断套件和嵌套链完成分数三类评估指标。
AI.result: 当前最优模型的整体IA-QTF1仅为0.368，1QnA场景的IA-QTF1仅0.052；数学推理实验表明离线能力并不必然迁移到在线交互场景。
AI.conclusion: 现有模型在流式交互方面表现薄弱，在线全双工交互与离线能力存在显著差距，该基准为评估和推动全模态流式交互模型的发展提供了重要测试平台。

title: Energy-Gated Attention and Wavelet Positional Encoding: Complementary Inductive Biases for Transformer Attention
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Part 2 of a five-paper series on spectral methods in transformer attention. Code: https://github.com/AthanasiosZeris/energy-gated-attention
summary: Standard transformer attention computes pairwise token similarity but treats all tokens as equally salient and all positions as equally local, regardless of the informational structure of the input. We identify two complementary inductive biases that standard attention lacks: energy salience (which tokens concentrate informational energy, learned end-to-end without explicit frequency decomposition) and scale-selective locality (how far positional influence extends at each frequency, implemented via Morlet wavelet encoding). We address both with two simple components. Energy-Gated Attention (EGA) gates value aggregation by a learned energy estimate of key token embeddings, computed via a single linear projection; it selects what to attend to. Morlet Positional Encoding (MoPE) replaces fixed sinusoidal encodings with learned Gaussian-windowed wavelets that adapt the joint position-frequency localization to the corpus; it specifies where attention operates at each scale. On TinyShakespeare, EGA alone achieves +0.092 validation loss improvement over standard attention (+0.103 over Phase 1-3 baseline); MoPE alone is -0.032 (below baseline as a standalone encoding); but their combination achieves +0.119 -- more than the sum of parts. This superadditivity, observed across two independent training runs, is the central empirical finding: salience and locality are complementary inductive biases, each addressing a gap the other cannot fill alone. Ablations confirm that structured spectral priors (Morlet wavelet gates, scale-initialized heads, fixed sinusoidal PE) consistently underperform their unconstrained learned counterparts, while complementary learned components interact superadditively. All experiments are at small scale (<=6M parameters, character-level benchmarks, single seed); larger-scale multi-seed validation is the most important direction for future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出能量门控注意力和莫莱特位置编码两种互补归纳偏置，分别解决标准注意力缺乏的显著性和局部性，两者组合在字符级任务上表现出超加性提升。
AI.motivation: 标准Transformer注意力平等对待所有token和位置，缺乏对输入信息结构的感知，即缺乏能量显著性（哪些token集中信息能量）和尺度选择性局部性（不同频率下位置影响范围）两种归纳偏置。
AI.method: 提出两个组件：1) 能量门控注意力(EGA)：通过单线性投影学习键token嵌入的能量估计，门控值聚合；2) 莫莱特位置编码(MoPE)：用学习的高斯窗口小波编码替代固定正弦编码，自适应调整位置-频率联合定位。
AI.result: 在TinyShakespeare上，EGA单独提升0.092验证损失，MoPE单独降低0.032（低于基线），但两者组合提升0.119，呈现超加性效应；消融实验表明结构化谱先验始终不如无约束的对应学习组件。
AI.conclusion: 显著性和局部性是互补的归纳偏置，各自填补对方无法单独解决的空缺；组合产生超加性提升是核心实证发现；实验规模有限（≤6M参数），大规模多种子验证是未来方向。

title: RoboMME: Benchmarking and Understanding Memory for Robotic Generalist Policies
summary: Memory is critical for long-horizon and history-dependent robotic manipulation. Such tasks often involve counting repeated actions or manipulating objects that become temporarily occluded. Recent vision-language-action (VLA) models have begun to incorporate memory mechanisms; however, their evaluations remain confined to narrow, non-standardized settings. This limits systematic understanding, comparison, and progress measurement. To address these challenges, we introduce RoboMME: a large-scale standardized benchmark for evaluating and advancing VLA models in long-horizon, history-dependent scenarios. Our benchmark comprises 16 manipulation tasks constructed under a carefully designed taxonomy that evaluates temporal, spatial, object, and procedural memory. We further develop a suite of 14 memory-augmented VLA variants built on the π0.5 backbone to systematically explore different memory representations across multiple integration strategies. Experimental results show that the effectiveness of memory representations is highly task-dependent, with each design offering distinct advantages and limitations across different tasks. Videos and code can be found at our website https://robomme.github.io.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RoboMME，一个大规模标准化基准，用于评估和推进VLA模型在长时序、历史依赖的机器人操作任务中的记忆能力。基准包含16个基于时空对象和程序记忆分类学构建的操作任务，并基于π0.5骨干开发了14种记忆增强VLA变体。实验表明记忆表示的有效性高度任务相关。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型虽开始引入记忆机制，但评估局限于狭窄且非标准化的场景，缺乏系统性理解、比较和进展衡量。
AI.method: 构建了包含16个操作任务的RoboMME基准，基于时空对象和程序记忆分类学设计；开发了14种基于π0.5骨干的记忆增强VLA变体，探索不同记忆表示和集成策略。
AI.result: 记忆表示的有效性高度依赖于具体任务，每种设计在不同任务上有不同的优势与局限。
AI.conclusion: RoboMME为长时序、历史依赖的VLA模型记忆研究提供了标准化评估平台，揭示了记忆机制的任务依赖性，为后续研究奠定基础。

title: LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.5 Technical Report
summary: Despite advances in audio-driven video generation, achieving commercial-grade stability remains challenging. We present LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.5, an upgraded open-source framework prioritizing systematic engineering and production-readiness over architectural novelty. By upgrading the audio encoder to Whisper Large and meticulously scaling our training recipes, v1.5 achieves accurate lip-synchronization, full-body temporal stability, and robust long-video generation with strict identity consistency. Through rigorous data curation and RLHF Training, the model readily generalizes to stylized domains such as anime and animals, and natively handles complex real-world conditions, such as multi-person interactions and object handling. Furthermore, addressing the practical demands of industrial deployment, we employ advanced step distillation to accelerate inference to an optimal 8 NFE, achieving a favorable trade-off between serving efficiency and visual fidelity. The superiority of our approach is validated through extensive quantitative metrics and a rigorous human evaluation conducted on a comprehensive benchmark of over 500 diverse test cases. Results show that v1.5 achieves competitive or superior performance compared to leading closed-source systems (e.g., HeyGen, OmniHuman 1.5, Kling Avatar 2.0) across human-likeness ratings and expert-level quality assessments on our benchmark. With its open-source release, LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.5 narrows the gap between academic research prototypes and commercial-grade deployment.

AI.tldr: LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.5 是一个开源的音频驱动视频生成框架升级版，通过工程优化（Whisper Large 编码器、数据清洗、RLHF训练、蒸馏加速）在唇形同步、全身稳定性、长视频一致性上达到商业级水平，在500+测试集上超越HeyGen等闭源系统，弥合了学术研究与工业部署之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 现有音频驱动视频生成方法在商用时稳定性不足，且缺乏面向生产环境的系统工程化方案，开源系统与闭源商业系统之间存在明显性能差距。
AI.method: 1) 将音频编码器升级为Whisper Large；2) 精细化的训练配方和数据清洗；3) RLHF训练提升泛化能力；4) 高级步骤蒸馏将推理加速至8 NFE，在效率与保真度间取得平衡。
AI.result: 在500+多样化测试基准上，定量指标和人工评估显示v1.5在类人度评分和专家级质量评估上达到或超越了HeyGen、OmniHuman 1.5、Kling Avatar 2.0等领先闭源系统。
AI.conclusion: LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.5 通过系统性的工程优化而非架构创新，有效缩小了学术研究原型与商业级部署之间的差距，且以开源形式发布。

title: Balancing Plasticity and Stability with Fast and Slow Successor Features
comment: Main Paper: 9 pages, 9 figures. Accepted at The International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) 2026
summary: A hallmark of intelligence is the ability to adapt in non-stationary environments, yet deep Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents often struggle in such settings. Prior studies introduce non-stationarity through abrupt shifts in features or dynamics, whereas real-world environments often evolve gradually through continual drift. This distinction has important implications for the "stability-plasticity dilemma" in RL, as abrupt task changes may demand more plasticity than naturalistic settings. To address this, we modify existing 3D Miniworld and MuJoCo environments to incorporate naturalistic, continual non-stationarity, and use them to examine how stability and adaptation affect performance under continuous environmental change. We find that methods favoring stability, such as synaptic consolidation, outperform approaches focused on plasticity, such as parameters resetting. Motivated by this result, and prior evidence that Successor Features (SFs) reduce interference, we investigate whether SFs are better consolidation targets than Q-values. Across both environments, applying neuro-inspired synaptic consolidation to SFs yields superior performance on continually changing settings. Moreover, consolidation is most effective when SFs are stabilized across multiple timescales, which capture complementary aspects of gradual environmental change.
