summary: Learning an energy-based model from data samples is a central problem in machine learning. Many recent and popular methods, such as denoising score matching for training energy-based diffusion models, use stochastic interpolants to corrupt data samples at different noise levels indexed by a time variable. This defines a joint density over both the data space and time, and most methods learn its energy through either spatial or temporal differences. We identify distinct failure modes for both of these approaches. To solve them, we propose Spatiotemporal Noise-Contrastive Estimation (stNCE), a framework for learning the energy through joint spatiotemporal differences. stNCE unifies many existing methods and leads to new training objectives. Experiments on images and molecules demonstrate performance competitive with state-of-the-art density estimation methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 stNCE 框架，通过联合时空差异学习基于随机插值的能量模型，解决了现有方法中空间和时间差异各自的失败模式，在图像和分子密度估计上达到 SOTA 水平。
AI.motivation: 现有基于随机插值的能量模型学习（如去噪分数匹配）存在两种失败模式：仅用空间差异或仅用时间差异均无法有效学习联合时空密度中的能量。需要一种统一框架来联合利用时空信息。
AI.method: 提出 Spatiotemporal Noise-Contrastive Estimation (stNCE)，通过联合时空差异来学习能量函数，统一了多种现有方法并推导出新的训练目标。
AI.result: 在图像和分子数据集上的密度估计实验中，stNCE 达到了与最先进方法竞争的性能。
AI.conclusion: stNCE 有效解决了基于随机插值的能量模型学习中的关键问题，为密度估计提供了统一且有效的框架。

title: Pop-Up Distractions Reveal Bag-of-Events Behavior in Video Large Language Models
summary: A key capability for video understanding is reliably linking subjects to events across time, yet whether Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) actually achieve this remains unclear. In this work, we introduce DistractionBench to evaluate whether VideoLLMs can robustly link subjects and events in the presence of unrelated video segments. Through controlled interventions, such as inserting short advertisement clips into longer videos, we show that VideoLLMs frequently hallucinate interactions between entities from different segments, incorrectly attributing actions from injected advertisements to subjects in the main video. We characterize this systematic hallucination as bag-of-events (BoE) behavior, where models process videos as collections of events rather than temporally structured sequences. Evaluating 11 popular VideoLLMs, we find that all models exhibit substantial BoE behavior. Our findings suggest that VideoLLMs lack reliable mechanisms for temporal grounding and motivate the development of models with more robust subject-event association.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DistractionBench基准，通过向视频中插入无关广告片段，发现VideoLLMs普遍存在"事件袋"幻觉：模型将不同片段中的主体与事件错误关联，缺乏可靠的时序 grounding 能力。
AI.motivation: 现有VideoLLMs能否将主体与事件在时间上可靠地关联尚不明确，亟需系统性的评估方法。
AI.method: 设计DistractionBench基准，通过在长视频中插入短广告片段进行受控干预，评估模型在无关干扰下关联主体与事件的能力。定义"事件袋"行为来表征模型将视频视为事件集合而非时序序列的幻觉模式。
AI.result: 11个流行的VideoLLMs均表现出显著的事件袋行为，即在插入广告后，模型错误地将广告中的动作归因于主视频中的主体。
AI.conclusion: VideoLLMs缺乏可靠的时间grounding机制，需要发展具有更强主体-事件关联能力的模型。

title: RAPNet: Accelerating Algebraic Multigrid with Learned Sparse Corrections
comment: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, Seoul, South Korea Code available at https://github.com/idoby/rapnet
summary: The scalable solution of large sparse linear systems is a bottleneck in scientific computing and graph analysis. While algebraic multigrid (AMG) offers optimal linear scaling, its performance is severely constrained by the trade-off between the sparsity and convergence quality of coarse-grid operators. Classical AMG heuristics struggle to balance these objectives, often sacrificing stability or performance for sparsity. We propose RAPNet, a graph neural network (GNN) framework that resolves this trade-off by learning to generate sparse, robust coarse operators directly from the sparse algebraic system. Key to our approach is a level-wise training strategy that enables learning from small subgraphs and generalization to million-node domains, bypassing the bottlenecks of prior neural AMG attempts. RAPNet executes exclusively during the solver setup phase, ensuring that the solve phase retains its favorable computational properties. We show that our method outperforms classical non-Galerkin baselines on diverse PDE discretizations and graph Laplacians, making it particularly effective for multi-query tasks such as eigenproblems, time-dependent simulations, and inverse or design problems.

AI.tldr: 提出RAPNet，一种图神经网络框架，通过学习直接从稀疏代数系统生成稀疏且鲁棒的粗网格算子，解决了代数多重网格中稀疏性与收敛质量之间的权衡问题。采用逐层训练策略，可从小子图泛化到百万节点领域，在求解器设置阶段执行，不影响求解阶段的计算效率。
AI.motivation: 大规模稀疏线性系统的可扩展求解是科学计算和图分析的瓶颈。代数多重网格虽具有最优线性缩放特性，但其性能受限于粗网格算子的稀疏性与收敛质量之间的权衡，经典AMG启发式方法难以同时兼顾这两者。
AI.method: 提出RAPNet，一种GNN框架，通过学习直接从稀疏代数系统生成稀疏且鲁棒的粗网格算子。关键创新是逐层训练策略，允许从小子图学习并泛化到百万节点规模域。该方法仅在求解器设置阶段执行，不干涉求解阶段。
AI.result: 在多种PDE离散化和图拉普拉斯问题上，RAPNet优于经典非Galerkin基线方法，尤其在特征值问题、时变模拟、逆问题或设计问题等多查询任务中表现突出。
AI.conclusion: RAPNet有效解决了AMG中稀疏性与收敛质量的权衡问题，通过GNN学习生成更优的粗网格算子，为科学计算中的多查询任务提供了高效的求解方案。

title: JLT: Clean-Latent Prediction in Latent Diffusion Transformers
summary: Flow matching with clean-data prediction has shown that regressing the clean point can exploit low-dimensional structure more effectively than predicting an ambient noised quantity. We ask whether this principle remains useful after images are mapped into a learned latent space, where compression has already removed much of the raw pixel variability. We introduce JLT, a 130M latent diffusion Transformer over frozen FLUX.2 VAE codes, and compare clean-latent prediction with a matched velocity-prediction DiT under the same representation, backbone, and training settings. Although the three variables x, epsilon, and v are linearly convertible for a fixed corruption time, a local Gaussian analysis shows that velocity regression inherits an isotropic target-covariance floor and amplifies low-variance latent directions, while clean prediction damps them. On ImageNet 256 x 256, JLT-B/1 obtains FID-50K 2.50 with classifier-free guidance, with a large matched-target gap over velocity prediction. These results suggest that prediction targets in latent diffusion are representation-dependent geometric choices, rather than interchangeable algebraic parameterizations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JLT，一个130M参数的潜在扩散Transformer，在FLUX.2 VAE潜在空间中进行干净潜在预测。研究发现，与速度预测相比，干净预测在潜在空间中仍然更优，因为它能有效抑制低方差潜在方向。在ImageNet 256×256上，JLT-B/1在无分类器引导下达到FID-50K 2.50。
AI.motivation: 探索干净数据预测（clean-data prediction）这一在像素空间中有效的原则，在已经经过压缩和低维结构提取的潜在空间中是否仍然保持优势。即验证预测目标选择在潜在扩散模型中是否仍是表示依赖的几何选择。
AI.method: 引入JLT（130M潜在扩散Transformer），使用冻结的FLUX.2 VAE编码器。在相同骨干网络、表示和训练设置下，对比干净潜在预测与匹配的速度预测DiT。通过局部高斯分析揭示两种预测目标的方差特性差异。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 256×256上，JLT-B/1在无分类器引导下达到FID-50K 2.50。干净预测与速度预测之间存在显著的匹配目标差距，干净预测表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 潜在扩散中的预测目标是表示依赖的几何选择，而非可互换的代数参数化。干净预测在潜在空间中仍然优于速度预测，因为它能有效抑制低方差潜在方向，而速度预测会放大这些方向。

title: Generalist Graph Anomaly Detection via Prototype-Based Distillation
summary: Driven by the pressing demand for graph anomaly detection (GAD) in high-stakes domains, the generalist GAD paradigm, which trains a single detector transferable across new graphs, has recently gained growing attention. However, existing methods often rely on scarce and costly annotations for training and sometimes even require few-shot support at inference, which limits their robustness to diverse and unseen anomaly patterns. To address this limitation, we introduce ProMoS, the first unsupervised generalist GAD framework, which detects anomalies by modeling the abundant normality in unlabeled data. ProMoS adopts a knowledge-distillation paradigm to distill normality priors from a frozen self-supervised graph neural network (GNN) teacher to a mixture-of-students model with shared global and lightweight personalized branches, enabling efficient and expressive normality modeling without learning from scratch. We further propose prototype-guided soft-label distillation to align teacher and student in a shared prototype space, enhancing cross-graph generalizability. During inference, ProMoS performs zero-shot anomaly detection on unseen graphs via distillation bias and prototype geometric deviation. Extensive experiments show the effectiveness and efficiency of ProMoS, charting a practical path toward label-free, zero-shot generalist GAD.

AI.tldr: ProMoS是首个无监督通用图异常检测框架，通过知识蒸馏从冻结的自监督GNN教师模型向混合学生模型传递正常性先验，结合原型引导的软标签蒸馏实现零样本跨图异常检测。
AI.motivation: 现有通用图异常检测方法依赖稀缺且昂贵的标注数据，甚至需要在推理时提供少样本支持，对多样化和未见过的异常模式鲁棒性不足。亟需一种无需标注、无需样本支持的通用图异常检测方法。
AI.method: 1) 采用知识蒸馏范式，从冻结的自监督GNN教师模型中提取正常性先验；2) 构建混合学生模型（共享全局分支+轻量个性化分支），实现高效且表达力强的正常性建模；3) 提出原型引导的软标签蒸馏，在共享原型空间中对齐教师和学生，增强跨图泛化能力；4) 推理时通过蒸馏偏差和原型几何偏差进行零样本异常检测。
AI.result: 大量实验验证了ProMoS的有效性和高效性，实现了无标签、零样本的通用图异常检测。
AI.conclusion: ProMoS为无标签、零样本的通用图异常检测开辟了实用路径，是首个无监督通用GAD框架。

title: COVD: Continual Open-Vocabulary Object Detection with Novel Concept Injection
summary: Open-vocabulary object detection (OVD) has made significant progress, enabling detectors to generalize from seen to unseen categories. However, real-world category spaces continually evolve, and existing OVD models still struggle with newly emerging concepts, while repeated full retraining is prohibitively expensive. To this end, we introduce a new task setting, termed Continual OVD with Novel Concept Injection (COVD), where models sequentially learn incoming novel concept groups while preserving prior concepts and original open-vocabulary knowledge, along with a new benchmark, Novel-114. Our key observation is that pretrained visual encoders often already perceive and represent many novel concepts, and the main bottleneck lies in the lack of stable semantic alignment between visual representations and textual concepts. Based on this, we propose NoIn-Det, an efficient continual injection framework without additional parameters. NoIn-Det freezes the visual encoder, preserves the text representation space using only texts of common concepts and previously injected concepts, and injects novel concepts by updating only a small subset of text-branch parameters beneficial to novel concept learning. Extensive experiments show that NoIn-Det effectively learns novel concepts, preserves old knowledge, and consistently outperforms existing continual learning methods for VLMs without introducing additional parameters.Novel-114 and the code will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出持续开放词汇目标检测（COVD）新任务及Novel-114基准，并设计无需额外参数的NoIn-Det框架，通过冻结视觉编码器、仅更新文本分支少量参数实现新概念有效注入与旧知识保留。
AI.motivation: 现实世界中类别空间持续演化，现有OVD模型难以处理不断涌现的新概念，而重复全量训练成本过高。
AI.method: 提出NoIn-Det框架：冻结视觉编码器；仅用常见概念和已注入概念的文本保留文本表示空间；通过更新文本分支中有利于新概念学习的一小部分参数来注入新概念。
AI.result: NoIn-Det能有效学习新概念、保留旧知识，且在不引入额外参数的情况下持续优于现有VLM持续学习方法。
AI.conclusion: 视觉编码器已能感知和表示许多新概念，主要瓶颈在于视觉表示与文本概念间缺乏稳定的语义对齐。

title: The Strongest Teacher Is Not Always the Best Teacher: Student-Centric Answer Selection
summary: LLM training increasingly relies on teacher-generated supervision, from synthetic responses to reasoning traces and tool-use demonstrations. Current practice often chooses the highest-performing teacher to generate student training data, implicitly treating teacher test performance as a proxy for teaching quality. We show that this assumption can fail: even when multiple teachers provide correct answers to the same question, the answer from the strongest teacher is not necessarily the best supervision for a given student. To address this gap, we propose Student-Centric Answer Sampling (SCAS), a framework that selects from verified teacher-generated answers according to their estimated student-centric learning cost. Motivated by a token-wise gradient decomposition, we derive an efficient forward-only proxy for this cost and use it to guide answer selection during training. Experiments across 30 teacher models, 6 student base models, and 8 tasks show that SCAS consistently improves student performance, suggesting that effective distillation should prioritize supervision matched to the current student rather than teacher strength alone.

AI.tldr: 论文提出学生中心答案采样（SCAS）框架，证明最强教师的答案并非对特定学生最优，通过估计学生中心学习成本来选择教师生成的正确答案，实验表明该方法优于传统以教师性能为标准的蒸馏策略。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM训练中普遍采用最强教师生成学生训练数据，隐含假设教师测试性能可代理教学质量。作者证明这一假设可能失败：即使多个教师对同一问题给出正确答案，最强教师的答案对学生并非最优监督信号。
AI.method: 提出Student-Centric Answer Sampling (SCAS)框架：基于token级梯度分解推导出仅需前向传播的学习成本代理，用于从多个已验证正确的教师答案中选择对学生最优的监督信号。
AI.result: 在30个教师模型、6个学生基座模型、8个任务上的实验表明，SCAS持续提升学生模型性能，验证了蒸馏应匹配学生当前状态而非仅依赖教师强度。
AI.conclusion: 有效的知识蒸馏应优先选择与学生当前能力相匹配的监督信号，而非单纯追求最强教师的答案。学生中心视角的答案选择比教师中心视角更优。

title: PILOT: A Data-Free Continual Learning Approach for Real-Time Semantic Segmentation via Boundary Guidance
summary: Real-time semantic segmentation models offer an excellent balance between accuracy and inference speed. However, deploying these models in dynamic real world environments often requires the ability to learn novel classes incrementally without retraining on the entire dataset. This capability is known as continual learning. In this regard, the standard fine-tuning methods in deep learning often fail due to catastrophic forgetting, where the model learns new information but forgets previously trained and learned classes. Contributing to this crucial domain, the current paper proposes a novel continual learning framework tailored for PIDNet, which is a widely cited state-of-the-art real-time semantic segmentation model. Our method, PILOT(Parallel Incremental Learning Over Time), introduces a real-time and lightweight strategy by implementing a parallel Derivative-branch (D-branch) designed to capture the high frequency boundary information of novel classes while freezing the trained parameters of the original segmentation network. This novel setup allows the model to adapt to new semantic categories while preserving the knowledge of previously learned classes. By using only data associated with the new class, our model significantly reduces training overhead. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach successfully segments new classes while maintaining high mean Intersection over Union (mIoU) on the original base classes, thereby comfortably outperforming all major continual learning approaches in this domain. Overall, PILOT is shown to effectively mitigate catastrophic forgetting with minimal impact on inference latency, thus maintaining real-time performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PILOT框架，针对实时语义分割模型PIDNet，通过并行衍生分支（D-branch）学习新类高频边界信息，在冻结原有参数的情况下实现增量学习，有效缓解灾难性遗忘，保持实时推理性能。
AI.motivation: 动态真实环境中，实时语义分割模型需要能够增量学习新类别而无需重新训练整个数据集，但标准微调方法因灾难性遗忘而失败，现有方法难以在保持实时性的同时兼顾新旧类别性能。
AI.method: 基于PIDNet提出PILOT框架，引入并行的衍生分支（D-branch），专门捕获新类别的高频边界信息；冻结原始分割网络的已训练参数，仅使用新类数据训练D-branch，实现轻量级增量学习。
AI.result: 在保持原有基类高mIoU的同时成功分割新类别，全面优于主流持续学习方法；有效缓解灾难性遗忘，且对推理延迟影响极小，维持了实时性能。
AI.conclusion: PILOT为实时语义分割领域的持续学习提供了一种高效、轻量的解决方案，在增量学习新类别与保持旧类别知识之间取得了良好平衡，兼具实时性与高性能。

title: Negligible in Size, Significant in Effect: On Scale Vectors in Large Language Models
summary: Normalization layers in modern large language models (LLMs) consist of a deterministic normalization operation and a learnable scale vector. While the normalization operation has been extensively studied, the scale vector remains poorly understood despite its ubiquitous use. In this work, we present a systematic study of scale vectors in LLMs from the perspectives of expressivity, optimization, and architectural structure. First, we show empirically that although scale vectors constitute only a negligible fraction of model parameters, removing them substantially degrades LLM pre-training. Our theory further shows that, in Pre-Norm architectures, scale vectors do not increase expressivity; instead, they improve optimization through a self-amplifying preconditioning effect on subsequent linear mappings. Second, we investigate the role of weight decay for scale vectors. By distinguishing Input-Norm and Output-Norm layers, we theoretically show that weight decay is beneficial for the former but harmful for the latter, due to their distinct roles in optimization and expressivity. Third, motivated by this understanding, we propose three lightweight and complementary improvements to scale vectors: branch-specific heterogeneity, improved placement around linear mappings, and magnitude-direction reparameterization. Both theory and experiments show that each improvement yields consistent gains. Finally, we combine these improvements into a unified scale-vector strategy and evaluate it through extensive LLM pre-training experiments on dense and mixture-of-experts models ranging from 0.12B to 2B parameters, across multiple optimizers and learning rate schedules, under industrial-scale token budgets. The unified strategy consistently achieves lower terminal loss than well-tuned baselines and exhibits more favorable scaling behavior, while adding negligible parameter and computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了大型语言模型中归一化层可学习缩放向量的作用，发现其虽只占极少参数但对预训练至关重要。通过理论和实验，揭示了缩放向量在优化中的自放大预条件效应，区分了输入-归一化和输出-归一化层中权重衰减的不同作用，并提出了三种轻量改进方法，在0.12B到2B参数的密集和混合专家模型上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现代LLM中归一化层的缩放向量被广泛使用但理解不足，本文旨在系统研究缩放向量在表达能力、优化和架构结构中的作用。
AI.method: 首先通过消融实验验证缩放向量对预训练的重要性，并结合理论分析其在Pre-Norm架构中的自放大预条件效应。其次区分Input-Norm和Output-Norm层，理论分析权重衰减的不同影响。在此基础上提出三种改进：分支特异性异质性、线性映射周围的改进放置、幅度-方向重参数化。最后将这些改进统一为缩放向量策略，在多种规模的密集和MoE模型上评估。
AI.result: 缩放向量虽只占极少参数但移除后严重降低预训练性能；权重衰减对Input-Norm有利但对Output-Norm有害；提出的三种改进均带来一致性提升；统一策略在0.12B-2B参数的密集和MoE模型上，使用多种优化器和学习率调度，在工业级token预算下始终优于调优基线，具有更优的扩展行为且几乎不增加参数和计算开销。
AI.conclusion: 缩放向量在LLM中通过优化而非表达能力发挥作用，其改进策略能高效提升大模型预训练性能。

title: SPHERE-JEPA: Spherical Prediction with Homogeneous Embeddings
summary: A fundamental open question in self-supervised learning (SSL) is the explicit characterization of the optimal geometry of the learned representations. Recently, LeJEPA identified isotropic Gaussian embeddings as optimal for minimizing downstream prediction risk in Euclidean spaces. However, the corresponding problem for distributions supported on lower-dimensional manifolds, such as the hypersphere, remains unexplored. In this work, we demonstrate that extending this minimax analysis to smooth distributions on Riemannian manifolds fundamentally changes the optimal solution. We show that, under a worst-case formulation, both k-nearest neighbors and kernel ridge regression induce hyperspherical uniformity. More precisely, we show that uniform distributions on manifolds are optimal for k-nearest neighbors, and that the uniform distribution on the sphere is optimal for kernel ridge regression with both the exponential dot-product kernel and the linear kernel. This theoretical insight reveals a fundamental limitation of Gaussian embeddings: their non-uniform density induces anisotropic k-NN neighborhoods, severely biasing the estimator. To correct this, we introduce SPHERE-JEPA, a theoretically grounded SSL framework. We adapt LeJEPA's Cram{é}r-Wold projection mechanism to enforce hyperspherical uniformity rather than a Gaussian prior. Empirically, SPHERE-JEPA yields significant improvements, boosting texture retrieval mAP by over 6%, while consistently matching or outperforming LeJEPA on standard benchmarks-including a +1.8% linear probing gain on ImageNet-1K (ViT-B/14).

AI.tldr: 本文证明在黎曼流形上的自监督学习中，均匀分布（尤其是超球面均匀分布）是最优表示几何，并提出SPHERE-JEPA框架，在ImageNet-1K上实现+1.8%线性探测提升，纹理检索mAP提升超6%。
AI.motivation: 自监督学习中表示几何的最优表征问题尚未解决，LeJEPA在欧氏空间中找到各向同性高斯嵌入为最优，但在低维流形（如超球面）上的情况尚不清楚。
AI.method: 1) 将极小极大分析扩展到黎曼流形上的光滑分布；2) 证明k近邻和核岭回归在流形上诱导超球面均匀性；3) 提出SPHERE-JEPA，修改LeJEPA的Cramér-Wold投影机制以强制超球面均匀性而非高斯先验。
AI.result: SPHERE-JEPA在纹理检索mAP上提升超6%，在ImageNet-1K (ViT-B/14)上线性探测提升+1.8%，在标准基准上一致匹配或超越LeJEPA。
AI.conclusion: 高斯嵌入存在非均匀密度导致各向异性k-NN邻域的根本性局限，超球面均匀分布是更优的表示几何选择。

title: Image Thresholding: Understanding Bias of Evaluation Metrics towards Specific Evaluation Functions
summary: Multilevel image thresholding is widely used for segmentation in applications ranging from medical imaging to remote sensing. Classical objective functions, such as Otsu's between-class variance and Kapur's entropy, are often optimized using metaheuristic algorithms, with performance evaluated via metrics like Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) and Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR). These evaluations implicitly assume that SSIM and PSNR provide unbiased measures of segmentation quality. In this study, we examine this assumption by analyzing the correlation between thresholding objective functions and quality metrics across all possible thresholds for images in the BSDS500 dataset. Results show that Otsu's criterion consistently exhibits high correlation with both SSIM and PSNR, while Kapur's entropy demonstrates weaker and more variable correlation. Otsu outperforms Kapur in correlation with PSNR for all images and with SSIM for over 91%. Our findings reveal an inherent metric-objective-function bias. This work highlights the need for more neutral evaluation frameworks and motivates extending the analysis to additional thresholding criteria and domains. Source code of this paper can be found at https://w3id.org/met-dp/icpr26-95

AI.tldr: 本文通过BSDS500数据集上所有可能阈值的系统分析，发现多级图像阈值分割中Otsu准则与SSIM/PSNR质量指标高度相关，而Kapur熵相关性较弱且不稳定，揭示了评价框架中固有的目标函数-度量偏差。
AI.motivation: 经典阈值分割评价隐式假设SSIM和PSNR提供无偏的质量度量，但这一假设从未被严格检验。研究人员试图验证该假设是否成立。
AI.method: 在BSDS500数据集上，对所有可能的阈值计算Otsu类间方差和Kapur熵，并分析它们与SSIM、PSNR之间的相关性。
AI.result: Otsu准则与SSIM和PSNR始终高度相关；Kapur熵相关性较弱且波动大。Otsu在PSNR相关性上优于Kapur（所有图像），在SSIM相关性上优于Kapur（超过91%的图像）。
AI.conclusion: 存在固有的度量-目标函数偏差，需要更中立的评价框架；未来应扩展至更多阈值准则和应用领域。

title: EEG-FM-Audit: A Systematic Evaluation and Analysis Pipeline for EEG Foundation Models
summary: Large EEG Foundation Models (FMs) have shown great potential for decoding EEG signals across diverse cognitive tasks. However, existing EEG-FM studies exhibit three critical limitations: opaque supervised baseline tuning, unverified contributions of complex learning paradigms, and a lack of transparency in model decision-making. To address these, we propose EEG-FM-Audit, a comprehensive evaluation and analysis pipeline designed to systematize the assessment of EEG-FMs. EEG-FM-Audit consists of three primary components: (1) an ASHA-driven benchmarking protocol that ensures fair comparisons by transparently optimizing supervised baselines; (2) paradigm-level ablation studies to evaluate the effectiveness of learning paradigms in FMs; and (3) a neurophysiological probing (NPP) framework, which explores whether FMs leverage valid temporal, spatial, and spectral EEG properties. We apply EEG-FM-Audit to four state-of-the-art EEG-FMs and five representative supervised models across three public datasets. Our results reveal that properly tuned supervised baselines can match or outperform advanced FMs, despite requiring significantly fewer parameters. Furthermore, we find that the effectiveness of learning paradigms of FMs is highly dependent on dataset scale and architecture. Finally, NPP analysis demonstrates how FMs rely on specific physiological features, establishing a framework for more interpretable neural decoding.

AI.tldr: 提出EEG-FM-Audit评估框架，系统审视大型EEG基础模型的三大缺陷：监督基线调优不透明、学习范式贡献未验证、决策缺乏可解释性。实验表明，适当调优的监督模型可媲美甚至超越基础模型，且基础模型的学习范式有效性高度依赖数据集规模和架构。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG基础模型研究存在三个关键局限：(1)监督基线调优过程不透明，无法保证公平比较；(2)复杂学习范式（如自监督、对比学习等）的实际贡献未被验证；(3)模型决策过程缺乏透明度和可解释性。这些缺陷阻碍了对EEG基础模型真实能力的客观评估。
AI.method: 提出EEG-FM-Audit评估分析管道，包含三个核心组件：(1)基于ASHA（异步连续减半算法）的基准测试协议，透明优化监督基线；(2)范式级消融研究，评估不同学习范式的有效性；(3)神经生理学探测（NPP）框架，检验模型是否利用了有效的时域、空域和谱域EEG特征。在三个公开数据集上对四个先进EEG基础模型和五个代表性监督模型进行评估。
AI.result: (1)适当调优的监督基线模型在参数更少的情况下，能够匹配甚至超越先进的基础模型；(2)基础模型学习范式的有效性高度依赖于数据集规模和模型架构；(3)NPP分析揭示了基础模型依赖于特定的生理特征，为可解释的神经解码建立了框架。
AI.conclusion: EEG-FM-Audit为系统评估EEG基础模型提供了标准化框架，揭示了当前EEG基础模型研究中的过度承诺问题，强调了公平比较和可解释性分析的重要性，为未来更可靠和可解释的EEG基础模型研究指明了方向。

title: Leveraging Visual Signals for Robust Token-Level Uncertainty in Vision-Language Generation
summary: Uncertainty quantification (UQ) remains a critical challenge in Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs) for reliable predictions and real-world deployment. However, most existing methods are adapted from the LLM literature and primarily focus on the language modality, leaving the contribution of visual information to LVLM uncertainty largely underexplored. In this paper, we investigate how LVLMs process visual information and whether this process can be used to improve uncertainty estimation. By analyzing hidden representations after the integration of visual features during the generation process, we observe that high-confidence predictions rely more heavily on visual content than uncertain ones. Building on this insight, we propose Visual-Grounded Token UQ (VIG-TUQ), a training-free framework that explicitly incorporates visual grounding into uncertainty estimation by weighting token-level language uncertainty with visual grounding scores. We evaluate VIG-TUQ on multiple datasets and across diverse LVLM architectures, including early-fusion, late-fusion, and native-fusion models. Results indicate that our method often improves upon existing token-level uncertainty approaches. Code and data will be made available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VIG-TUQ，一种无需训练的框架，通过将视觉接地分数与令牌级语言不确定性加权结合，来提升LVLM的不确定性估计。实验表明该方法在多种融合架构上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有LVLM不确定性量化方法多从LLM文献改编，仅关注语言模态，忽略了视觉信息对不确定性的贡献，因此需要探索视觉信息处理过程以改进不确定性估计。
AI.method: 通过分析视觉特征集成后的隐藏表示，发现高置信度预测更依赖视觉内容。基于此，提出VIG-TUQ框架，利用视觉接地分数对令牌级语言不确定性进行加权，实现视觉与语言模态的融合不确定性量化。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和多种LVLM架构（早期融合、晚期融合、原生融合）上的评估表明，VIG-TUQ在令牌级不确定性方法上取得了改进。
AI.conclusion: 视觉信息对LVLM不确定性估计有重要作用，将视觉接地显式融入不确定性量化可以有效提升性能，且无需额外训练。

title: Agile Online Model Selection: Resolving Adaptation Lag via Safeguarded Large Learning Rates
summary: Maintaining predictive accuracy in non-stationary environments requires online model selection to adapt autonomously to unknown distribution shifts. However, existing tuning-free algorithms face a fundamental trade-off between robustness and agility. Specifically, to ensure dynamic regret bounds, they must restrict learning rates to small constants (e.g., $O(1)$). This restriction inevitably causes significant adaptation lag during abrupt changes. To resolve this, we propose a novel optimistic online mirror descent that utilizes safeguarded large learning rates up to $Θ(T)$, where $T$ is the number of rounds. Our key technical contribution is a post-hoc penalty mechanism that dynamically monitors unstable updates and excludes learning rates incurring excessive regret, eliminating the need for restrictive a priori constraints. We show that the cumulative penalty remains $O(\log T)$, allowing our algorithm to match near-optimal worst-case guarantees while achieving superior rates in benign cases. Empirical evaluations on synthetic and eleven diverse real-world datasets demonstrate that our approach reduces the adaptation lag from hundreds of rounds to a few rounds, consistently outperforming tuning-free baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用受保护的大学习率（最高可达Θ(T)）的乐观在线镜像下降算法，通过事后惩罚机制动态监控不稳定更新并排除导致过度遗憾的学习率，无需严格先验约束，在保持近最优最坏情况保证的同时，在良性情况下实现更优速率，将适应滞后从数百轮减少到几轮。
AI.motivation: 现有无调参算法在非平稳环境中面临鲁棒性与敏捷性的根本权衡：为保证动态遗憾界，它们必须将学习率限制为小常数（如O(1)），这导致在突变发生时产生显著的适应滞后。本文旨在解决这一矛盾，在保持鲁棒性的同时提升对分布突变的响应速度。
AI.method: 提出一种乐观在线镜像下降算法，使用受保护的大学习率（最高Θ(T)），并引入事后惩罚机制：动态监控不稳定更新，排除导致过度遗憾的学习率，无需先验约束。累积惩罚量仅为O(log T)。
AI.result: 理论上，算法在保持近最优最坏情况保证的同时，在良性情况下实现了更优的遗憾速率；实验上，在合成数据和11个真实数据集上，将适应滞后从数百轮减少到几轮，持续优于无调参基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功打破了非平稳环境下在线模型选择中鲁棒性与敏捷性之间的固有权衡，通过事后惩罚机制实现了大学习率的安全使用，为动态环境下的自适应学习提供了新的有效范式。

title: Is an Image Also Worth 16x16=256 Superpixels? A Framework for Attentional Image Classification
summary: Superpixel-based image classification has traditionally leveraged graph neural networks (GNNs) for processing irregular image representations. Recent advances in computer vision, driven by Vision Transformers (ViTs), have introduced new paradigms in self-attentional models, surpassing convolutional neural networks (CNNs) in various tasks. However, a synergistic connection between GNNs, superpixels, and transformers remains unexplored. In this work, we propose Superpixel Transformers (SPT), a novel framework that unifies superpixel-based image classification and ViTs. SPT generalizes the Superpixel Image Classification with Graph Attention Networks (SICGAT) model and ViT to support arbitrary superpixel-based chunking strategies, connectivity graphs, and positional encodings. We introduce refinements including a multidimensional sine-cosine positional encoding and an enriched patch data structure that fully incorporates superpixel shape and color information. By testing SPT across datasets such as CIFAR10, FashionMNIST, and Imagenette, with various superpixel generation and graph connectivity strategies, we demonstrate that SPT achieves superior performance compared to previous superpixel-based GNN methods and remains competitive with ViTs. Notably, our approach addresses the limitations of SICGAT, such as information loss during pixel aggregation, and shows how constrained graph connectivity can enhance ViT performance. SPT bridges the gap between superpixel-based and transformer models, opening avenues for cross-domain generalization and future innovations in hybrid attentional frameworks, and showing that an image can also be worth $16\times16$ superpixels.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Superpixel Transformers (SPT)框架，统一了超像素图像分类与Vision Transformers，通过多维正弦-余弦位置编码和增强补丁数据结构，在多个数据集上优于传统超像素GNN方法，并与ViT保持竞争力。
AI.motivation: GNN、超像素与Transformer三者之间的协同连接尚未被探索，传统超像素GNN方法（如SICGAT）存在像素聚合过程中的信息损失问题。
AI.method: SPT框架统一了SICGAT和ViT，支持任意超像素分块策略、连接图与位置编码；引入多维正弦-余弦位置编码和包含超像素形状与颜色信息的丰富补丁数据结构。
AI.result: 在CIFAR10、FashionMNIST和Imagenette数据集上，SPT优于先前基于超像素的GNN方法，且与ViT保持竞争力；约束图连接能增强ViT性能。
AI.conclusion: SPT弥合了超像素模型与Transformer模型之间的差距，为跨域泛化和混合注意力框架的未来创新开辟了道路。

title: When Muon Optimizer Meets Adversarial Training: A Theoretical and Empirical Study
summary: Adversarial training (AT) remains one of the most reliable empirical defenses against adversarial attacks. Its robustness critically depends on how the underlying min-max objective is optimized. In practice, Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) optimizer remains the default optimization choice for AT, whereas adaptive optimizers often improve standard training but may yield inferior robustness. Recently, the Muon optimizer, which orthogonalizes matrix-valued updates via an approximate polar decomposition, has achieved notable success in large-scale training at a memory cost comparable to SGD. This raises a security-relevant question: \textit{can orthogonalized optimization improve AT under strong and heterogeneous threat models?} Focusing on this problem, we conduct a comprehensive theoretical and empirical study. Theoretically, we show that Muon imposes a spectral-norm stability ceiling on matrix updates, limiting uncontrolled spectral growth in the training dynamics without explicitly shrinking the learned weights. Empirically, across five architectures and three $\ell_p$ threat models ($\ell_\infty$, $\ell_1$, $\ell_2$) and their union, Muon is competitive with SGD on CNNs and substantially outperforms AdamW on both CNNs and ViTs. These results identify optimizer geometry as a security-relevant factor in adversarial training, while clarifying the empirical regimes in which orthogonalized updates are beneficial. Overall, our findings highlight optimizer design as a security-critical component of AT.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了正交化优化器（Muon）在对抗训练中的效果，理论上证明Muon能限制矩阵更新的谱范数增长，实验上在多种架构和威胁模型下表明Muon在CNN上媲美SGD、显著优于AdamW，揭示了优化器几何特性是影响对抗训练安全性的关键因素。
AI.motivation: SGD是对抗训练的默认优化器，而自适应优化器（如AdamW）在标准训练中表现优异但在对抗训练中鲁棒性较差。Muon优化器通过近似极分解正交化矩阵更新，在大规模训练中取得了成功且内存成本与SGD相当，因此本文探究正交化优化是否能改进强威胁模型下的对抗训练。
AI.method: 理论分析证明Muon对矩阵更新施加了谱范数稳定性上限，限制训练动态中谱的不可控增长而不显式收缩权重；实验在5种架构、3种ℓ_p威胁模型（ℓ_∞, ℓ_1, ℓ_2）及其联合威胁下，对比Muon与SGD、AdamW在对抗训练中的表现。
AI.result: Muon在CNN上性能与SGD相当，在CNN和ViT上均显著优于AdamW；正交化优化在多种威胁模型下均表现出竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 优化器的几何特性是对抗训练中的安全关键因素，正交化更新在特定经验范围内有益，优化器设计应被视为对抗训练的安全关键组件。

title: Chaos-SSL: An Attention-Based Self-Supervised Learning Framework with Chaotic Transformation for Medical Image Classification
summary: Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) has emerged as a powerful paradigm to mitigate the reliance on large, annotated datasets, a common bottleneck in medical image analysis. However, standard SSL methods, which rely on simple geometric and color augmentations, may fail to capture the fine-grained, complex textural details necessary for classifying subtle pathologies. This paper introduces Chaos-SSL, a novel two-stage framework for medical image classification. In the first stage, we propose a new self-supervised pre-training strategy that leverages 1D chaotic maps (Logistic, Tent, and Sine) as a complex, non-linear augmentation for contrastive learning. We hypothesize that these chaotic transformations create ``harder'' and more semantically-rich views, forcing a network to learn robust representations of fine-grained medical textures. In the second stage, we introduce an attention-based fusion model that dynamically combines the specialized features from our Chaos-SSL model with the general-purpose features of a larger, ImageNet-pre-trained model. We validate our method on two public datasets: ISIC 2018 (skin lesions) and APTOS 2019 (diabetic retinopathy). Our results demonstrate that the Chaos-SSL model pre-trained with a Tent map for 30 epochs, followed by attention fusion, achieves performance fully competitive with the state-of-the-art, yielding an accuracy of 0.9261 on ISIC 2018 and 0.8726 on APTOS 2019. This significantly outperforms existing SSL methods, including several recent approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Chaos-SSL，一种两阶段自监督学习框架。第一阶段利用一维混沌映射（Logistic、Tent、Sine）作为非线性增强，生成更难、语义更丰富的视图，迫使网络学习细粒度医学纹理的鲁棒表示；第二阶段引入注意力融合模型，动态结合Chaos-SSL的专用特征与ImageNet预训练模型的通用特征。在ISIC 2018和APTOS 2019上，Tent映射预训练30轮后经注意力融合，准确率达0.9261和0.8726，显著优于现有SSL方法。
AI.motivation: 标准自监督学习方法仅依赖简单的几何和颜色增广，无法捕捉医学图像中区分细微病理所需的细粒度、复杂纹理细节，因此需要一种能生成更复杂视图的预训练策略。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：阶段一提出基于一维混沌映射（Logistic、Tent、Sine）的非线性增广策略，用于对比学习自监督预训练，生成更困难的视图以学习鲁棒的医学纹理表示；阶段二设计注意力融合模型，动态融合Chaos-SSL专用特征与ImageNet预训练模型的通用特征。
AI.result: 在ISIC 2018（皮肤病变）和APTOS 2019（糖尿病视网膜病变）上，Tent映射预训练30轮+注意力融合达到0.9261和0.8726的准确率，显著超过现有SSL方法及多种近期方法，与最先进方法性能相当。
AI.conclusion: 混沌映射作为非线性增广能有效提升自监督学习在医学图像分类中的表现，注意力融合机制可有效结合专用与通用特征，为医学图像分析提供了一种高效的预训练范式。

title: RLVR Datasets and Where to Find Them: Tracing Data Lineage for Better Training Data
summary: The proliferation of Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) datasets has exacerbated provenance collapse due to unclear lineage among existing datasets. To bridge this fragmented RLVR data landscape, we propose Atomic-source Tracing via Lineage-Aware Search (ATLAS), a systematic framework for tracing RLVR datasets back to their atomic sources, attributing over 99.7% of 1.45M instances to 20 atomic sources. Our analysis reveals that most RLVR datasets are variants of a small set of shared upstream sources, with few introducing genuinely new data, and many facing data contamination risks. These findings naturally motivate us to curate a new RLVR dataset, DAPO++, and to benchmark existing datasets from a lineage-aware perspective. To this end, we propose Source-level Counterfactual Attribution (SCA) as a guiding principle to curate a decontaminated training dataset with concentrated learning signals. Essentially, SCA measures a sample's marginal utility by comparing per-atomic-source RL checkpoints against a shared base model. Building upon these attribution signals, we further design a composite dataset quality score Q that strongly correlates with downstream RLVR performance. Experiments on Qwen3 series models verify that DAPO++ consistently improves performance on held-out benchmarks, while Q reliably predicts downstream RLVR training effectiveness. Our code and data is available at https://github.com/Celine-hxy/ATLAS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ATLAS框架，将145万个RLVR实例追溯至20个原子来源（覆盖99.7%），揭示了RLVR数据集高度同源且存在污染问题。基于此，提出SCA归因原则和复合质量分数Q，构建去污染数据集DAPO++，在Qwen3系列模型上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: RLVR数据集的激增导致来源崩溃（provenance collapse），数据集之间谱系不清、碎片化严重，亟需系统性的溯源框架来理清数据来源关系。
AI.method: 提出ATLAS（Atomic-source Tracing via Lineage-Aware Search）框架，将RLVR实例追溯至原子来源；提出SCA（Source-level Counterfactual Attribution）原则，通过比较各原子来源的RL检查点与共享基线的边际效用衡量样本价值；设计复合质量分数Q。
AI.result: ATLAS将99.7%的1.45M实例归因至20个原子来源；大多数RLVR数据集来自少数共享上游来源变体，少有真正新数据；DAPO++在Qwen3系列模型上持续提升留出基准性能；Q分数与下游RLVR训练效果强相关。
AI.conclusion: RLVR数据领域存在严重的来源同质化和污染问题，基于谱系意识的数据归因和去污染策略能有效提升下游RLVR训练效果，为数据集构建提供了可量化的质量评估方法。

title: Touch-R1: Reinforcing Touch Reasoning in MLLMs
comment: Our code and data will be made public on the https://laiyingxin2.github.io/Projects
summary: While rule-based reinforcement learning has recently catalyzed explicit reasoning in multimodal models, tactile reasoning remains largely underexplored. Existing tactile-language models primarily rely on supervised or contrastive objectives, which limits their capacity to ground predictions in physical evidence or rectify misleading visual priors. Tactile reasoning introduces two modality-specific challenges: the ordinal nature of physical attributes (e.g., hardness, roughness) and the cross-sensor distribution shifts inherent in optical tactile hardware. In this work, we introduce TouchReason-1M, a large-scale multimodal dataset comprising over 1M synchronized tactile pairs across four distinct sensors, and TouchReason-Bench, a rigorous framework for evaluating tactile perception and visual-tactile conflict resolution. Building upon these, we propose Touch-R1, a tactile reasoning MLLM based on Qwen2.5-VL-7B. Touch-R1 is trained via a tactile-grounded GRPO objective that combines ordinal-aware accuracy, cross-sensor physical consistency, structured-format control, and an input-side tactile grounding objective. Specifically, the tactile-use reward assigns credit only when authentic tactile inputs yield superior correctness relative to counterfactual controls where the tactile stream is removed, shuffled, or noise-masked. On TouchReason-Bench, Touch-R1-7B outperforms Octopi-13B by 18.4\% and GPT-4o by 24.7\% on average. Its structured reasoning traces reveal emergent behaviors of probing, comparison, and revision, demonstrating that R1-style reasoning can be effectively grounded in physical contact.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TouchReason-1M大规模触觉数据集和TouchReason-Bench评估框架，并基于Qwen2.5-VL-7B训练Touch-R1触觉推理多模态大模型，通过触觉驱动的GRPO目标（结合序数感知、跨传感器一致性、结构格式控制和触觉接地奖励）实现物理接地推理，在基准上超过Octopi-13B和GPT-4o，展现出触觉R1风格的探索、比较和修正推理行为。
AI.motivation: 现有触觉-语言模型主要依赖监督或对比学习目标，限制了其将预测基于物理证据或纠正误导性视觉先验的能力。触觉推理面临两个独特挑战：物理属性的序数性质（如硬度、粗糙度）和跨光学触觉传感器的分布偏移。
AI.method: 构建TouchReason-1M（四种传感器的超百万同步触觉对）和TouchReason-Bench评估框架；提出Touch-R1模型，基于Qwen2.5-VL-7B，采用触觉驱动的GRPO目标训练，包含序数感知准确率、跨传感器物理一致性、结构化格式控制以及输入侧触觉接地目标（通过反事实控制对触觉使用进行奖励分配）。
AI.result: 在TouchReason-Bench上，Touch-R1-7B平均性能超过Octopi-13B 18.4%、超过GPT-4o 24.7%。
AI.conclusion: 结构化推理轨迹展现出探索、比较和修正等涌现行为，证明R1风格推理可有效接地于物理接触信号中。

title: Convergence of Spectral Descent for Non-smooth Optimization
summary: The Muon optimizer has recently demonstrated remarkable empirical success in training large language models. However, the theoretical understanding of its mechanisms remains limited. Current convergence guarantees for Muon rely heavily on smoothness assumptions, leaving its non-smooth convergence behavior largely unexplored. In this work, we take a step toward bridging this gap by investigating Spectral Descent (SD), a simplified variant of Muon, together with its truncated counterpart, Truncated Spectral Descent (TSD). Under convexity, Lipschitz continuity, and sharpness conditions, we establish global linear convergence for both SD and TSD in non-smooth convex formulations. We also study regularized variants equipped with decoupled weight decay and derive sublinear convergence guarantees through their connection with Frank-Wolfe methods. Finally, we apply our theoretical framework to robust low-rank matrix recovery under mixed sparse and dense noise regimes and provide rigorous recovery guarantees. Numerical experiments support the theoretical findings and demonstrate the effectiveness of Muon-type methods for non-smooth optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Muon优化器在非光滑凸优化中的理论收敛性。通过分析其简化变体Spectral Descent (SD)和Truncated Spectral Descent (TSD)，在凸性、Lipschitz连续性和sharpness条件下建立了全局线性收敛保证，并探讨了带解耦权重衰减的正则化变体与Frank-Wolfe方法的联系。理论框架应用于鲁棒低秩矩阵恢复，数值实验验证了Muon型方法在非光滑优化中的有效性。
AI.motivation: Muon优化器在大语言模型训练中表现优异，但其理论机制尚不明确。现有收敛保证严重依赖光滑性假设，其在非光滑情况下的收敛行为尚属空白。本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.method: 提出Muon的简化变体Spectral Descent (SD)及其截断版本Truncated Spectral Descent (TSD)；在凸性、Lipschitz连续性和sharpness条件下建立非光滑凸优化的全局线性收敛保证；通过解耦权重衰减将正则化变体与Frank-Wolfe方法建立联系，推导次线性收敛保证；将理论框架应用于鲁棒低秩矩阵恢复问题。
AI.result: 建立了SD和TSD在非光滑凸优化中的全局线性收敛保证；证明了正则化变体的次线性收敛率；为鲁棒低秩矩阵恢复提供了理论恢复保证；数值实验验证了理论结果和Muon型方法在非光滑优化中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本研究初步弥合了Muon优化器在非光滑凸优化中的理论空白，证明了其简化变体在更宽松条件下的收敛性，拓展了Muon型方法的应用场景。

title: Semantic Robustness Probing via Inpainting: An Interactive Tool for Safety-Critical Object Detection
summary: Testing object detectors in safety-critical domains requires semantically meaningful probes beyond pixel-level corruptions. We present SemProbe, a tool for semantic robustness probing: users upload deployment images, create masks manually or automatically, select operational design domain-derived factors (or custom prompts), and run diffusion-based controlled inpainting. The system supports batch jobs, parallel seed/workflow variations, and configurable generation parameters. After each output, model inference runs automatically and displays annotated before/after comparisons with performance deltas. All probes are logged as structured artifacts, enabling traceable robustness evidence aligned with safety evaluation workflows. We demonstrate \textsc{SemProbe} on hand detection for dimension saws, targeting factors from insurance-oriented test criteria.

AI.tldr: SemProbe是一个用于语义鲁棒性探测的工具，通过基于扩散的受控图像修补生成语义上有意义的测试样本，支持批量处理、并行变化和结构化日志记录，用于安全关键领域的目标检测器评估。
AI.motivation: 安全关键领域的目标检测器测试需要超越像素级损坏的语义上有意义的探测方法，而现有工具缺乏对语义鲁棒性探测的系统性支持。
AI.method: 用户上传部署图像，手动或自动创建掩码，选择操作设计域派生因素或自定义提示，运行基于扩散的受控图像修补。系统支持批量作业、并行种子/工作流变化和可配置生成参数。每次输出后自动运行模型推理并显示带性能差异的注释前后对比。所有探测记录为结构化工件。
AI.result: 在手锯场景的手部检测任务上进行了演示，针对保险导向测试标准中的因素进行了目标定位。
AI.conclusion: SemProbe提供了可追溯的鲁棒性证据，与安全评估工作流保持一致，能够有效评估目标检测器在语义层面的鲁棒性。

title: TED: Related Party Transaction guided Tax Evasion Detection on Heterogeneous Graph
comment: Accepted by Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery (DMKD25)
summary: Tax evasion causes severe losses of government revenues and disturbs the economic order of fair competition. To help alleviate this problem, the latest tax evasion detection solutions utilize expert knowledge to extract features and then train classifiers to determine whether a company is suspected of tax evasion. However, existing solutions mainly focus on the statistical features of the company, but fail to exploit the rich interactive information in tax scenarios, which affect the detection performance. In this paper, we first model the tax scenario as a heterogeneous graph and study the tax evasion detection problem under the heterogeneous graph model. To improve the performance of tax evasion detection, a novel graph neural network model is proposed to extract the comprehensive information of heterogeneous graphs. Specifically, we use heterogeneous and complex related party transaction groups to filter low-level noise information. Moreover, a hierarchical attention mechanism is designed to capture the deeper structure and semantic information hidden in the related party transaction group. We apply our method to the real risk management system of the tax bureau, and evaluate it on two human-labeled real-world tax datasets. The results demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art in the tax evasion detection task.

AI.tldr: 本文针对税务场景中现有逃税检测方法未能充分利用丰富交互信息的问题，将税务场景建模为异质图，并提出了一种新颖的图神经网络模型。该模型利用异质且复杂的关联方交易群组过滤低层噪声，并设计了层次注意力机制捕获交易群组中隐藏的结构和语义信息。在真实税务数据集上的评估表明，该方法显著优于现有最先进技术。
AI.motivation: 逃税导致政府税收严重损失并扰乱公平竞争经济秩序。现有检测方案主要依赖专家知识提取公司统计特征，未能利用税务场景中丰富的交互信息，检测性能受限。
AI.method: 首先将税务场景建模为异质图；提出新颖的图神经网络模型，利用异质且复杂的关联方交易群组过滤低层噪声；设计层次注意力机制捕获关联方交易群组中隐藏的深层结构和语义信息。
AI.result: 在真实税务风控系统和两个人工标注的真实税务数据集上进行了评估，该方法在逃税检测任务中显著优于现有最先进技术。
AI.conclusion: 将税务场景建模为异质图并利用图神经网络提取综合信息，能够有效提升逃税检测性能，且该方法已在实际风控系统中得到应用。

title: Model discovery for dynamical systems with complex-valued product units
summary: Discovering the governing equations of a dynamical system from observed trajectories provides deeper insight into its structure than mere prediction of future states. We present a data-driven approach to model discovery based on complex-valued product-unit networks, in which each unit represents a complex monomial and the network output is a sparse linear combination of such monomials. In contrast to established library-based methods such as SINDy, our approach does not require a predefined set of candidate functions: the relevant monomials, including those with fractional or negative exponents, are learned directly from data. Across four chaotic benchmark systems (Lorenz63, Lorenz84, the Four-Wing attractor, and a fractional variant of Lorenz63), we recover the exact governing equations in 90% of trials for the first three systems, and in 70-90% of trials for the fractional case, using at least 3000 training points. Applied to real-world human-gait accelerometer signals, the model produced stable trajectories with bounded prediction errors, corresponding to an RMSE of approximately 12-14% of the signal amplitude range over a test horizon three times longer than the training interval, demonstrating its potential for high-dimensional systems in which analytic equations are unavailable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于复值乘积单元网络的数据驱动方法，用于从观测轨迹中发现动力系统的控制方程。该方法直接学习包含分数或负指数的单项式，无需预定义候选函数集。在四个混沌基准系统（Lorenz63、Lorenz84、Four-Wing吸引子及分数阶Lorenz63变体）上，前三者90%的试验中恢复了精确控制方程，分数阶案例达70-90%。应用于真实人体步态加速度计信号，模型在训练区间三倍长的测试范围内产生稳定轨迹，RMSE约为信号振幅范围的12-14%，证明了其在解析方程未知的高维系统中的潜力。
AI.motivation: 从观测轨迹中发现动力系统的控制方程，相比仅预测未来状态能提供更深入的结构洞察。现有方法（如SINDy）依赖预定义的候选函数库，限制了发现未知形式方程的能力。
AI.method: 采用复值乘积单元网络，每个单元表示一个复数单项式，网络输出为这些单项式的稀疏线性组合。直接从数据中学习相关单项式（包括分数或负指数），无需预定义候选函数集。
AI.result: 在Lorenz63、Lorenz84和Four-Wing吸引子中90%试验恢复精确方程；分数阶Lorenz63变体中70-90%恢复；人体步态信号预测RMSE为信号振幅范围的12-14%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法无需预定义候选函数库即可从数据中学习动力系统方程，适用于混沌系统和真实世界高维信号，具有推广到解析方程未知领域的潜力。

title: Probabilistic Recurrent Intention Switching Model
summary: Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) recovers reward functions from observed behavior, yet traditional methods assume a single stationary reward that cannot capture goal switching within an episode. Recent multi-intention IRL methods address this by segmenting trajectories, but model intention transitions as either a memoryless Markov chain or via manual state augmentation with a fixed history window. We propose the Probabilistic Recurrent Intention Switching Model (PRISM), which replaces both mechanisms with a lightweight recurrent network that maps observation history to a per-step intention distribution. We prove that the resulting EM objective decomposes exactly into independent per-intention reward subproblems, each solvable in closed form, yielding an $\mathcal{O}(nK)$ E-step with no variational approximation. We evaluate PRISM on a non-Markovian gridworld, a mouse labyrinth, and BridgeData~V2 robotic manipulation, the first large-scale robotic application of multi-intention IRL. Across all settings PRISM achieves the highest held-out log-likelihood while recovering nameable, temporally coherent intentions from unlabeled demonstrations, suggesting that discrete goal switching is present in both biological and artificial agents.

AI.tldr: 提出PRISM模型，用轻量级循环网络替代马尔可夫链或固定历史窗口，在逆强化学习中建模多意图切换，实现O(nK)的EM步骤且无需变分近似，在网格世界、鼠迷宫和BridgeData V2机器人操作任务上取得最优似然。
AI.motivation: 传统逆强化学习假设单一平稳奖励函数，无法捕捉回合内目标切换行为；现有多意图IRL方法要么用无记忆马尔可夫链建模意图转换，要么通过固定历史窗口手动增广状态，两种方式均存在局限性。
AI.method: 提出概率循环意图切换模型(PRISM)，用轻量级循环网络将观测历史映射到每步的意图分布；证明EM目标可精确分解为独立的每意图奖励子问题，每个子问题存在闭式解，E-step复杂度为O(nK)且无需变分近似。
AI.result: 在非马尔可夫网格世界、鼠迷宫和BridgeData V2机器人操作任务上，PRISM在保留对数似然上取得最高值，同时从无标签演示中恢复了可命名的、时间上连贯的意图模式。
AI.conclusion: PRISM有效建模了多意图切换行为，证明离散目标切换在生物和人工智能体中普遍存在。

title: Sampling Data with Chains of Forward-Backward Diffusion Steps
summary: Sampling from learned high-dimensional distributions is a foundational computational problem. We introduce U-turn chains: Markov chains obtained by iterating short forward-backward steps of a diffusion model, in which each step proposes a move that remains on the learned data manifold and, paired with a Metropolis-Hastings correction, samples from energy-modified targets. For synthetic languages, we show that minimal U-turn dynamics undergoes an ergodicity-breaking phase transition driven by fragmentation of the data manifold; ergodicity is restored at larger U-turn magnitude. In the non-ergodic regime, low-level features relax faster than high-level ones, an ordering that inverts only at sufficiently large U-turn magnitude. We test these predictions on natural language and natural images. In both modalities, minimal U-turns relax slowly, especially for high-level features approximated by deep representations in CNNs or LLMs. The layer-ordering inversion appears only at large noise when mixing is efficient -- signatures consistent with strongly constrained, weakly mixing local dynamics. We discuss the implications of these results for sampling with diffusion models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出U-turn链（基于扩散模型短前-后步迭代的马尔可夫链），并发现其存在遍历性破缺相变：数据流形碎片化导致低层特征先于高层特征松弛，仅在大U-turn幅度下才出现层序反转。自然语言和图像实验证实该现象，揭示了强约束弱混合局部动力学的采样特性。
AI.motivation: 从学习到的高维分布中采样是基础计算问题，现有扩散模型采样方法存在混合效率与遍历性不足的问题。
AI.method: 提出U-turn链：迭代扩散模型的短前向-后向步骤，每步在数据流形上提议移动，结合Metropolis-Hastings校正从能量修正目标中采样。通过合成语言、自然语言和自然图像进行验证。
AI.result: 最小U-turn动力学经历由数据流形碎片化驱动的遍历性破缺相变，大U-turn幅度恢复遍历性。非遍历区域中低层特征松弛快于高层特征；仅在足够大的U-turn幅度下出现层序反转。自然模态中最小U-turn松弛缓慢，CNN/LLM深层表征的高层特征尤甚，大噪声下才出现层序反转。
AI.conclusion: U-turn链的动力学特性揭示了强约束弱混合局部动力学对扩散模型采样的影响，为理解高维分布采样中的混合效率与遍历性提供了新见解。

title: Generative Animations: A Multi-Model Pipeline for Prompt-Driven Motion Synthesis
summary: Animation elevates digital documents into immersive experiences, yet creating custom motion paths remains cumbersome, requiring designers to manually select presets, plot Bézier points, and configure timing properties. We introduce Generative Animations, a system that transforms natural language prompts into production-ready animations. By chaining Large Language Models (LLMs) for semantic parsing with the Segment Anything Model (SAM) for visual grounding, our pipeline automatically generates motion paths that respect scene geometry, handle depth-based occlusions, and honor 3D perspective transforms. We demonstrate the system through three use cases: contour-following trajectories, orbital animations with z-order awareness, and perspective-aligned motion on transformed objects.

AI.tldr: 提出Generative Animations系统，通过LLM语义解析与SAM视觉定位的链式管道，将自然语言提示自动转换为符合场景几何、深度遮挡和3D透视的生产级动画路径。
AI.motivation: 现有动画路径创建流程繁琐，设计师需手动选择预设、绘制贝塞尔曲线和配置时序属性，缺乏从自然语言到动画的自动化转换方法。
AI.method: 链式结合大语言模型（LLM）进行语义解析与Segment Anything Model（SAM）进行视觉定位，自动生成尊重场景几何、处理深度遮挡并支持3D透视变换的运动路径。
AI.result: 系统在三种用例中有效：轮廓跟随轨迹、具有Z轴顺序感知的轨道动画、以及变换对象上的透视对齐运动。
AI.conclusion: Generative Animations可将自然语言提示直接转化为生产级动画，显著降低动画创建门槛。

title: SCENT: Aligning Mass Spectra with Molecular Structure for Olfactory Perception
summary: Predicting human olfactory perception from molecular structure has seen remarkable progress, yet these approaches require explicit chemical structure at inference, which is not available in practical sensing settings. We address this gap by exploring direct electron ionization mass spectrometry (EI-MS), a sensing technique that acquires chemically informative fragmentation fingerprints in seconds, as an alternative input modality for olfactory prediction. We contribute Spectrum-to-Chemical Embedding alignmeNT (SCENT), a multi-modal contrastive learning framework that aligns EI-MS representations with pretrained chemical structure embeddings, while requiring only mass spectra at inference. On the multi-label odor descriptor prediction task, SCENT significantly outperforms MS-only baselines and achieves performance comparable to structure-based models, despite requiring no explicit molecular structure at test time. The learned representations also better approximate continuous human perceptual ratings and generalize to real-world lab-measured spectra, suggesting that cross-modal alignment is an effective strategy for grounding analytical spectra in chemical semantics.

AI.tldr: 提出SCENT框架，通过对比学习将电子电离质谱（EI-MS）表示与化学结构嵌入对齐，在推理时仅需质谱即可实现与结构模型相当的嗅觉预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有从分子结构预测嗅觉感知的方法在推理时需要显式化学结构，但在实际传感场景中无法获取，因此探索EI-MS这一可直接获取的传感模态作为替代输入。
AI.method: 提出SCENT（Spectrum-to-Chemical Embedding alignmeNT），一个多模态对比学习框架，将EI-MS表示与预训练的化学结构嵌入进行跨模态对齐，推理时仅需质谱数据。
AI.result: 在多标签气味描述词预测任务上，SCENT显著优于仅使用质谱的基线，性能与基于结构模型相当；学习到的表示能更好地逼近连续人类感知评分，并泛化到真实实验室测量的质谱数据。
AI.conclusion: 跨模态对齐是将分析光谱 grounding 到化学语义中的有效策略，无需显式分子结构即可实现高质量嗅觉预测。

title: MRT: Masked Region Transformer for Layered Image Generation and Editing at Scale
summary: Layered image generation and editing is a fundamental capability that enables layer-wise reuse, editing, and composition of generated visual content, analogous to word-level editing in natural language. Despite its importance, this remains an underexplored area at scale. To address this gap, we present MRT, a 20B-parameter masked region diffusion model tailored for multi-layer transparent image generation and editing, trained on over 10M multilingual design samples spanning diverse aspect ratios and textual prompts. To fully leverage this scale, we make two key technical contributions. First, we unify three complementary tasks including text-to-layers, image-to-layers, and layers-to-layers within a shared masked region diffusion framework, where selective token masking enables flexible layer-wise generation and editing. Second, to enable overflow layer generation, we introduce an overflow-aware canvas layer that handles boundary inconsistencies and supports semi-transparent background synthesis, enabling complete editable layers extending beyond visible canvas boundaries. Additionally, we apply diffusion distillation to achieve 8-step, real-time multi-layer generation with minimal quality degradation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework substantially outperforms prior state-of-the-art approaches, including various commercial systems, across all three tasks, establishing a new benchmark for multi-layer transparent image generation. Notably, our model significantly outperforms the concurrent Qwen-Image-Layered model in image-to-layers quality according to user-study results, while achieving 10-100\times faster inference and reducing activation GPU memory consumption by 50-90\% during image-to-layer inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MRT，一个200亿参数的掩码区域扩散模型，用于多层透明图像的生成与编辑。该模型在超1000万多语言设计样本上训练，通过统一文本到层、图像到层、层到层三种任务于共享的掩码区域扩散框架，并引入溢出感知画布层处理边界不一致并支持半透明背景合成。模型还采用扩散蒸馏实现8步实时多图层生成。实验表明，MRT在三个任务上均显著超越现有最优方法（包括商业系统和Qwen-Image-Layered），在图像到层任务中实现10-100倍更快推理，并将激活GPU内存消耗降低50-90%。
AI.motivation: 多层图像生成与编辑是视觉内容创作中的基础能力，支持层的复用、编辑和组合，类似于自然语言中的词汇级编辑。然而，这一领域在大规模上仍未得到充分探索。现有方法在生成完整可编辑层、处理边界不一致以及实现快速推理方面存在不足，亟需一个统一的规模化解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 统一三个互补任务（文本到层、图像到层、层到层）于共享的掩码区域扩散框架中，通过选择性token掩码实现灵活的逐层生成与编辑；2) 提出溢出感知画布层，处理超出可见画布边界的层内容，并支持半透明背景合成；3) 应用扩散蒸馏技术实现8步实时多图层生成，大幅降低推理延迟和GPU内存消耗。
AI.result: 在三个任务上均大幅超越先前最优方法（包括多个商业系统）。在图像到层任务中，用户研究显示显著优于Qwen-Image-Layered模型，同时推理速度提升10-100倍，激活GPU内存消耗降低50-90%。
AI.conclusion: MRT为多层透明图像生成建立了新的基准，证明了大模型在结构化视觉内容生成中的潜力，同时通过蒸馏技术实现了高效实时推理，为实际应用提供了可行方案。

title: SQARL: A Size-Agnostic Reinforcement Learning approach for Circuit Allocation in Distributed Quantum Architectures
summary:
The scaling of quantum processors is currently limited by technical challenges such as decoherence and cross-talk. As the number of qubits grows, interference increases the computational noise. Distributed quantum computing addresses these limitations by interconnecting smaller, easier-to-handle quantum processors (cores), but it introduces the challenge of minimizing slow, error-prone inter-core communication. The task of distributing quantum circuits across cores while minimizing communication costs is known as the Qubit Allocation problem. This work focuses on developing a deep learning approach to this problem, emphasizing flexibility to quantum hardware topology and improving state-of-the-art performance.
  Heuristic and non-learning algorithms, such as the Hungarian Qubit Allocation (HQA), currently represent the state of the art. Reinforcement Learning (RL) approaches leverage learned allocation policies but often lack flexibility, requiring retraining when hardware configurations change, and they fall short of the solution quality achieved by non-learning methods. However, learning mechanisms could outperform human-crafted heuristics.
  To overcome these limitations, this work proposes a flexible, transformer-based architecture that can handle arbitrary numbers of qubits and cores without retraining. Results show that the trained policy consistently outperforms the previous RL state of the art and narrows the gap between RL and HQA for the most common circuits. It achieves a 33% reduction in allocation cost relative to the HQA for the Cuccaro Adder and 25% on average for random circuits. These findings show that learning-based approaches can effectively match the performance of hand-crafted heuristics, a crucial step towards their application in real-world scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于Transformer的灵活量子比特分配架构，无需重新训练即可处理任意数量和核心，在分配成本上比匈牙利算法（HQA）降低33%（Cuccaro加法器）和平均25%（随机电路），弥合了强化学习与启发式算法之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 分布式量子计算中，最小化核间通信成本的量子比特分配问题目前由非学习启发式算法（如HQA）主导，而强化学习方法虽具学习能力但灵活性和效果均不及前者。需要一种兼具灵活性和高性能的学习方法。
AI.method: 提出基于Transformer架构的深度学习模型，可处理任意数量的量子比特和核心而无需重新训练，通过学习分配策略来优化核间通信成本。
AI.result: 在Cuccaro加法器上实现33%的分配成本降低，在随机电路上平均降低25%，持续优于以往的强化学习方案，缩小了与HQA的差距。
AI.conclusion: 基于学习的方法能够有效匹敌人工设计的启发式算法性能，这是迈向实际应用的关键一步。

title: Can Retrieval Heads See Images? Multimodal Retrieval Heads in Long-Context Vision-Language Models
summary: Large vision-language models increasingly rely on long-context modeling to reason over documents, hour-level videos, and long-horizon agent trajectories, requiring them to locate relevant evidence across interleaved text and images. Prior work has studied this behavior using retrieval heads in large language models, but its copy-based criterion does not directly apply when evidence appears in images. We introduce a multimodal retrieval head detection method that scores attention from question tokens to textual or visual evidence. With this method, we show that multimodal retrieval heads are sparse, intrinsic, and causally important: only 4.4-10.2% of attention heads account for 50% of the positive retrieval-score mass, and masking the top-5% selected heads drops MMLongBench-Doc from 48.2% to 5.7% and SlideVQA from 71.2% to 8.9%, while random-head masking is far less damaging. Further analysis shows that these heads are partly shared across modalities yet remain dynamic within each modality, with image retrieval heads changing more than text retrieval heads as context length and haystack modality change. Without further training, we find that these heads can also be used directly to rank visually rich documents: on MMDocIR, Qwen3-VL-8B selected-head scoring improves Recall@1 by 7.7/7.4 macro/micro points for page retrieval and 6.3/6.8 points for layout retrieval over the strongest reported baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多模态检索头检测方法，发现多模态大语言模型中仅有4.4-10.2%的注意力头是关键检索头，这些头稀疏、固有且因果重要；掩码前5%的检索头会使模型性能大幅下降（如MMLongBench-Doc从48.2%降至5.7%），而随机掩码影响较小；这些头跨模态部分共享，模态内动态变化；无需额外训练即可直接用于视觉丰富文档的排序任务，在MMDocIR上显著提升检索性能。
AI.motivation: 现有研究在纯文本大语言模型中发现了检索头（retrieval heads）现象，但其基于复制（copy-based）的判据不适用于证据出现在图像中的场景。因此，需要一种能够跨文本和图像模态检测检索头的方法，以理解多模态大语言模型如何定位长上下文中的相关证据。
AI.method: 提出多模态检索头检测方法，通过评分注意力从问题token到文本或视觉证据的注意力权重来识别检索头。分析了检索头的稀疏性、内在性、因果重要性、跨模态共享性以及模态内动态性，并验证了其在文档检索任务中的直接应用。
AI.result: 1) 多模态检索头稀疏，仅占4.4-10.2%，贡献50%的正检索分数质量；2) 掩码前5%检索头导致MMLongBench-Doc从48.2%降至5.7%，SlideVQA从71.2%降至8.9%，远高于随机掩码的损害；3) 检索头跨模态部分共享，模态内动态变化，图像检索头随上下文长度和海量模态变化更大；4) 无需训练直接用于文档排序，Qwen3-VL-8B在MMDocIR上Recall@1提升7.7/7.4（macro/micro）页面检索和6.3/6.8布局检索。
AI.conclusion: 多模态检索头是多模态大语言模型中稀疏且因果关键的结构，其检测方法不仅能解释模型的长上下文推理机制，还能直接应用于视觉丰富文档的检索任务，无需额外训练即可取得显著性能提升。

title: Less is More: Early Stopping Rollout for On-Policy Distillation
summary:
On-policy distillation has recently emerged as a promising alternative to standard sequence-level imitation, training a student by scoring its own rollouts with a teacher model. However, we observe ``Off-policy Teacher Decay'' problem in this paradigm: for the later tokens, with student's earlier trajectory as context that is off-policy to the teacher, the teacher's ability to produce a corrective score would decay, and may fall back to token-completion behavior learned in the pre-training stage. We empirically verify this problem, and we propose Early Stopping Rollout (ESR) to fix it: a simple yet effective distillation strategy that simply restricts the rollout generation to the first
  response tokens. We show that ESR both surpasses the full rollout OPD performance across model size, family, tasks and training regime, and exhibit much higher GPU efficiency and training stability, especially under cross model family scenarios. We further investigate the mechanism behind this surprising performance and discovered "Cascading Alignment" and "Sub-mode Commitment" effect of ESR that may explain why it works effectively and even sometimes exceeding the teacher model performance. Besides, we show that this position-based token selection strategy cannot be fully explainable by KL divergence and entropy signals.

AI.tldr: 本文发现“离策略教师衰减”问题：在策略蒸馏中，教师对基于学生早期轨迹（离策略）的后续token评分能力下降。提出早期停止 rollout（ESR）方法——仅对前K个响应token进行 rollout 生成，显著提升性能、GPU效率和训练稳定性，甚至超越教师模型，并揭示了“级联对齐”和“子模式承诺”两种效应机制。
AI.motivation: 在策略蒸馏（On-policy Distillation）中，教师模型基于学生自身 rollout 进行评分。然而，当生成较长的 token 序列时，学生早期生成的轨迹（作为后续 token 的上下文）与教师训练时的数据分布存在偏差（off-policy），导致教师评分能力退化（Off-policy Teacher Decay），甚至退化为预训练阶段的 token 补全行为。本文旨在解决该问题。
AI.method: 提出 Early Stopping Rollout (ESR)：在策略蒸馏过程中，限制 rollout 生成仅进行到前K个响应 token，截断后续 token 的生成，从而避免因学生早期轨迹偏差导致的教师评分退化问题。
AI.result: ESR 在全 rollout 策略蒸馏方法上表现更优，跨模型大小、家族、任务和训练设定均有效；GPU 效率更高，训练更稳定，尤其在跨模型家族场景下。此外，ESR 甚至可能超越教师模型性能。
AI.conclusion: ESR 有效的背后机制是“级联对齐”（Cascading Alignment）和“子模式承诺”（Sub-mode Commitment）效应。同时，这种基于位置的 token 选择策略不能完全由 KL 散度和熵信号解释。

title: A Dynamic Programming Framework for Discovering Count and Values of Multilevel Image Thresholding
summary: Multilevel Image thresholding is an important preprocessing algorithm in computer vision applications nowadays. Since most common thresholding methods take the desired count of thresholds as input by the user, thresholding methods that automatically determines a suitable count of thresholds from the input image itself are advantageous. In this article, a novel thresholding method based on a dynamic programming algorithm and a modification of Minimum Error Thresholding (MET) criterion is thoroughly presented. An empirical statistical study is performed to pinpoint why this proposed method is superior. Moreover, an extended comparison between this proposed method and other state-of-the-art methods is performed on a comprehensive set of natural, satellite and medical test images. The numerical results show that the proposed MET-DP method takes much less time than traditional dynamic programming thresholding methods when the number of thresholds is high. The proposed method can detect a suitable count of thresholds for most of tested images of different types. However, traditional methods that take the count of thresholds as input produce thresholded images of higher structural similarity index measure (SSIM) and peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) values than MET-DP. Source code can be found on https://w3id.org/met-dp/article1-code

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于动态规划和改进最小误差阈值法的多级图像阈值分割方法（MET-DP），能自动确定合适的阈值数量。实验表明，该方法在高阈值数量时比传统DP方法快得多，并能自动检测合适阈值数，但传统方法在SSIM和PSNR指标上表现更好。
AI.motivation: 大多数常见阈值方法需要用户手动输入期望的阈值数量，缺乏自动确定合适阈值数量的能力。因此，需要一种能够从输入图像本身自动确定合适阈值数量的阈值分割方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于动态规划（DP）算法和改进的最小误差阈值法（MET）相结合的阈值分割方法（MET-DP），并通过实证统计研究分析其优越性。
AI.result: 在高阈值数量下，MET-DP比传统动态规划阈值方法耗时更少；该方法能为大多数不同类型的测试图像检测出合适的阈值数量；但传统方法在SSIM和PSNR指标上优于MET-DP。
AI.conclusion: MET-DP方法在自动确定阈值数量方面具有优势，且在计算效率上有明显提升，但在图像质量指标（SSIM、PSNR）上不如传统输入阈值数量的方法。

title: Learning Dynamic Graph Representations through Timespan View Contrasts
summary: The rich information underlying graphs has inspired further investigation of unsupervised graph representation. Existing studies mainly depend on node features and topological properties within static graphs to create self-supervised signals, neglecting the temporal components carried by real-world graph data, such as timestamps of edges. To overcome this limitation, this paper explores how to model temporal evolution on dynamic graphs elegantly. Specifically, we introduce a new inductive bias, namely temporal translation invariance, which illustrates the tendency of the identical node to keep similar labels across different timespans. Based on this assumption, we develop a dynamic graph representation framework CLDG that encourages the node to maintain locally consistent temporal translation invariance through contrastive learning on different timespans. Except for standard CLDG which only considers explicit topological links, our further proposed CLDG++ additionally employs graph diffusion to uncover global contextual correlations between nodes, and designs a multi-scale contrastive learning objective composed of local-local, local-global, and global-global contrasts to enhance representation capabilities. Interestingly, by measuring the consistency between different timespans to shape anomaly indicators, CLDG and CLDG++ are seamlessly integrated with the task of spotting anomalies on dynamic graphs, which has broad applications in many high-impact domains, such as finance, cybersecurity, and healthcare. Experiments demonstrate that CLDG and CLDG++ both exhibit desirable performance in downstream tasks including node classification and dynamic graph anomaly detection. Moreover, CLDG significantly reduces time and space complexity by implicitly exploiting temporal cues instead of complicated sequence models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CLDG和CLDG++框架，通过引入时序平移不变性这一归纳偏置，利用对比学习在不同时间跨度上建模动态图的时序演化，并扩展到多尺度对比学习（局部-局部、局部-全局、全局-全局），同时无缝集成动态图异常检测任务，在节点分类和异常检测上取得优异性能，且CLDG通过隐式利用时序线索显著降低时空复杂度。
AI.motivation: 现有无监督图表示学习主要依赖静态图中的节点特征和拓扑属性来构造自监督信号，忽略了真实图数据中的时序成分（如边的时间戳），因此需要探索如何在动态图上优雅地建模时序演化。
AI.method: 提出时序平移不变性归纳偏置（同一节点在不同时间跨度上倾向于保持相似标签）；基于此构建CLDG框架，通过对比学习在不同时间跨度上保持局部一致的时序平移不变性；CLDG++进一步引入图扩散挖掘全局上下文关联，设计多尺度对比学习目标（局部-局部、局部-全局、全局-全局）；将不同时间跨度间的一致性度量作为异常指标，无缝集成异常检测任务。
AI.result: CLDG和CLDG++在节点分类和动态图异常检测任务上均表现出理想性能；CLDG通过隐式利用时序线索替代复杂序列模型，显著降低时间和空间复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 时序平移不变性是一种有效的动态图表示学习归纳偏置；基于对比学习的多尺度框架能同时提升表示能力和异常检测能力，且具有计算效率优势。

title: Gemini Embedding 2: A Native Multimodal Embedding Model from Gemini
summary: We introduce Gemini Embedding 2, a native multimodal embedding model that allows embedding video, audio, image, and text modalities in a unified representation space. We leverage the multimodal capabilities of Gemini to produce embeddings for arbitrary combinations of interleaved inputs across all these modalities that generalize well across a wide variety of tasks. Applying large-scale contrastive learning in a multi-task multi-stage training setup, we achieve state-of-the-art performance on key embedding benchmarks including unimodal, cross-modal, and multimodal retrieval spanning a diverse set of tasks. We show that our embedding model demonstrates strong performance (with a score of 62.9 R@1 on MSCOCO, 68.8 NDCG@10 on Vatex, 69.9 on MTEB multilingual and 84.0 on MTEB Code) across a variety of tasks surpassing the performance of specialized models. These unified capabilities make Gemini Embedding 2 a promising candidate for downstream use cases such as RAG, recommendation and search. Furthermore, its robust zero-shot performance across distinct fields - from astronomy and bioscience to fine arts and the culinary arts - establishes it as a highly reliable, out-of-the-box representation even for specialized domains.

AI.tldr: Gemini Embedding 2 是一个原生多模态嵌入模型，能够在统一表示空间中处理视频、音频、图像和文本模态，通过多任务多阶段对比学习在各类检索任务上达到SOTA性能，并在零样本场景下跨专业领域表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有嵌入模型通常针对单一模态设计，缺乏对视频、音频、图像和文本等多模态信息的统一表示能力，难以处理交错输入和跨模态检索任务。
AI.method: 基于Gemini的多模态能力，采用大规模对比学习在多任务多阶段训练框架下进行训练，支持任意组合的交错多模态输入。
AI.result: 在MSCOCO上R@1达62.9，Vatex上NDCG@10达68.8，MTEB多语言达69.9，MTEB代码达84.0，在多项任务上超越专用模型。
AI.conclusion: Gemini Embedding 2作为统一多模态嵌入模型，在RAG、推荐和搜索等下游任务中具有广阔应用前景，且零样本能力使其在从天文到烹饪等专业领域均可直接使用。

title: Learning to Orchestrate Agents under Uncertainty
summary: Adaptive orchestration of heterogeneous agents requires making sequential delegation decisions under uncertain and evolving agent behaviour, e.g., coordinating specialised AI models with varying reliability, cost, and response quality. While prior work on agent orchestration focuses on performance or cost, uncertainty in agent reliability and output distributions is typically not modelled explicitly at the orchestration level. In this work, we study the problem of adaptive orchestration of heterogeneous agents under uncertainty, where a meta-controller must decide when to delegate to an agent, accounting for reliability, cost, and uncertainty. We propose BOT-Orch, a lightweight framework that recasts orchestration as a bandit problem over agents, regularized by OT distances between agent output distributions and task-specific reference distributions. We show that the regularised orchestration enjoys $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T})$ regret under standard assumptions, and provably induces preference ordering among agents with identical mean rewards but differing distributional alignment. Empirically, we demonstrate that BOT-Orch outperforms standard bandit and heuristic baselines in synthetic but adversarial task allocation settings with heterogeneous, non-i.i.d. agent behaviour.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BOT-Orch框架，将异构智能体自适应编排问题转化为带最优传输（OT）距离正则化的多臂老虎机问题，在理论上证明了$\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T})$的遗憾界，并在实验上优于标准基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体编排方法主要关注性能或成本，未在编排层面显式建模智能体可靠性和输出分布的不确定性，导致在面对异构、非独立同分布智能体行为时缺乏鲁棒性。
AI.method: 将编排问题转化为带OT距离正则化的多臂老虎机问题：元控制器在每一步决定是否将任务委托给某个智能体，通过计算智能体输出分布与任务特定参考分布之间的最优传输距离作为正则化项，平衡探索与利用，同时惩罚分布偏离参考的智能体。
AI.result: 理论上，在标准假设下实现了$\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T})$的遗憾界，并能对具有相同均值奖励但分布对齐程度不同的智能体诱导出偏好序。实验中，在合成对抗性任务分配场景下优于标准多臂老虎机和启发式基线方法。
AI.conclusion: BOT-Orch为异构智能体在不确定性下的自适应编排提供了一种轻量级、有理论保证的解决方案，能够显式建模智能体可靠性和输出分布的不确定性。

title: PlayClass: Automated Play Behaviour Classification in Poultry
summary: Automated monitoring of animal welfare has largely targeted negative indicators, leaving positive welfare behaviours such as play underexplored. To address this gap, we present PlayClass, a pipeline for play-behaviour classification in poultry from top-down pen video. The pipeline leverages long-duration tracking with SAM 3 via YOLO-guided chunk boundaries to minimise identity errors in point-based prompting, and frozen embeddings from image and video foundation models for play action classification. Although handcrafted motion features from tracked masks alone achieved competitive accuracy, V-JEPA 2.1 consistently outperformed all other backbones across model scales, reaching 77.0 macro-averaged F$_1$ when combined with handcrafted features. Despite this result, the dataset remains challenging due to play sub-types sharing similar kinematic profiles with non-play and inter-bird occlusion. Overall, our work provides encouraging evidence towards automated frameworks for play behaviour classification in poultry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了PlayClass，一种基于顶部俯视视频的家禽玩耍行为分类流水线，利用SAM 3长时跟踪和V-JEPA 2.1等基础模型进行行为分类，在宏平均F1上达到77.0，但数据集仍面临运动轮廓相似和遮挡等挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有动物福利自动监测主要关注负面指标，对玩耍等积极福利行为的研究不足，因此需要填补这一空白。
AI.method: 提出PlayClass流水线，包括：1) 使用YOLO引导的块边界结合SAM 3进行长时跟踪，减少点提示中的身份错误；2) 利用图像和视频基础模型的冻结嵌入进行玩耍动作分类，其中V-JEPA 2.1表现最佳。
AI.result: V-JEPA 2.1在结合手工特征后达到77.0的宏平均F1，但手工运动特征也有竞争力；数据集仍具挑战性，因玩耍子类型与非玩耍行为运动轮廓相似，且存在个体间遮挡。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为家禽玩耍行为自动分类提供了有希望的证据，但需进一步解决运动相似性和遮挡问题。

title: Two Speeds of Learning: A Representation-Readout Decomposition of Grokking and Double Descent
summary: Training loss and accuracy are the standard signals used to monitor generalization during deep neural network training. Two well-documented phenomena complicate this picture: in grokking, train loss falls rapidly while test performance improves abruptly only after a long delay; in epoch-wise double descent, train loss decreases monotonically while test loss or error rises and falls. Existing accounts are often task-specific, and a task-agnostic analysis framework for diagnosing and explaining these phenomena across realistic tasks and architectures is missing. We address this challenge by analyzing two competing processes that underlie learning dynamics: representation learning in the encoder and readout calibration in the final classifier. Using tools from representational geometry, neural tangent kernels, and linear probing, we show that both processes are active throughout training, with the fluctuations of their relative speed giving rise to seemingly anomalous generalization dynamics. Applying the representation-readout decomposition to grokking across a wide range of tasks and architectures, we find that the readout is train-biased before grokking onset, and representation learning is gradual but not absent, contrary to the lazy-to-rich account. The framework further provides diagnostic signatures distinguishing spurious from genuine generalization: in a previously reported MNIST grokking example and an epoch-wise double descent example, apparent delayed or non-monotone generalization is shown to arise from representation degradation and readout misalignment induced by non-standard training recipes. Together, these results establish the representation-readout decomposition as a top-down framework for understanding learning dynamics and revealing underlying algorithms for interpretability research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了表征-读出分解框架，通过分析编码器表征学习与最终分类器读出校准这两个竞争过程的相对速度波动，解释深度学习中的反常泛化现象（如grokking和epoch-wise double descent），并在多种任务和架构上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有对grokking和epoch-wise double descent等反常泛化现象的解释通常是任务特定的，缺乏一个跨任务、跨架构的通用分析框架。作者旨在建立一种任务无关的顶层分析框架，用于诊断和解释这些现象。
AI.method: 利用表征几何、神经切线核(NTK)和线性探测(linear probing)等工具，将学习动态分解为编码器表征学习(representation learning)和最终分类器读出校准(readout calibration)两个竞争过程，分析两者相对速度的波动如何导致反常泛化行为。
AI.result: 在grokking实验中，发现读出在grokking onset之前存在训练偏差，表征学习是渐进而非缺失的，这与lazy-to-rich观点相悖。该框架还能区分真假泛化：在MNIST grokking和epoch-wise double descent案例中，表面上的延迟或非单调泛化实际源于非标准训练导致的表征退化和读出失配。
AI.conclusion: 表征-读出分解是一个有效的顶层框架，可用于理解学习动态并揭示底层算法，为可解释性研究提供了新的分析工具。

title: How and What to Imagine? Visual Thinking in Unified Multimodal Models for Cross-View Spatial Reasoning
summary: Cross-view spatial reasoning remains a weak spot for vision-language models (VLMs): they often reason in language and lose the fine-grained geometry needed for the task. Thinking with images aims to address this by generating an intermediate thinking image, but recent work shows that models often ignore the visual evidence in these traces. We therefore ask how to make visual thinking matter, and what kind of visual thinking works best. We study these questions in unified multimodal models (UMMs), which natively support interleaved image-text generation. For the first question, we propose View Dropout (VDrop), a training-time intervention that hides parts of one input view from the answer span while keeping them visible to the thinking-image tokens. This encourages the model to use the thinking image when answering, instead of relying only on the input views. Once the thinking image is used for answer prediction, we study which type of visual thinking is most effective. We frame this as a learnability-informativeness tradeoff and compare three thinking-image variants: top-down, panoramic, and point-matching renderings. Trained on synthetic scenes and evaluated on five real-world out-of-domain benchmarks, panoramic visual thinking with VDrop is the only configuration that is both informative and learnable, and it achieves the best out-of-domain generalization.

AI.tldr: 针对VLM在跨视角空间推理中忽视中间推理图像的问题，提出View Dropout训练策略强制模型利用思维图像进行推理，并对比三种视觉思维类型，发现全景视觉思维结合VDrop在领域外泛化上表现最佳。
AI.motivation: VLMs在跨视角空间推理中表现薄弱，它们倾向于用语言推理而丢失细粒度几何信息。虽然"用图像思考"试图通过生成中间思维图像来解决这一问题，但近期工作表明模型常常忽视这些视觉痕迹中的证据。因此，需要探究如何使视觉思维真正发挥作用，以及哪种视觉思维类型最有效。
AI.method: 在统一多模态模型（UMMs）框架下，提出View Dropout（VDrop）训练策略——在训练时隐藏输入视图的部分内容，使其对答案生成不可见但对思维图像可见，强制模型依赖思维图像进行回答。同时，将视觉思维设计框架化为"可学习性-信息量"权衡，比较三种思维图像变体：俯视图、全景图和点匹配渲染图。
AI.result: 在合成场景上训练并在5个真实世界域外基准上评估，全景视觉思维结合VDrop是唯一同时具备信息量和可学习性的配置，取得了最佳的域外泛化性能。
AI.conclusion: VDrop能有效强制模型利用思维图像进行推理，全景视觉思维在可学习性与信息量之间取得最佳平衡，是实现跨视角空间推理的有效方案。

title: Q-GeoMem: Question-Guided Geometric Memory for Video Spatial Reasoning
summary: Video spatial reasoning requires accumulating viewpoint-dependent evidence over time while retaining information useful to the question being asked. Existing spatial video-language models improve geometric perception and long-range context modeling, but often treat memory as a generic temporal cache, which can introduce redundant or irrelevant geometry and weaken long-horizon reasoning. We propose \textbf{\ours}, a question-guided geometric memory framework for video spatial reasoning. \ours injects camera-conditioned geometry into visual tokens and maintains two complementary memories: a Fine-Grained Context Bank for recent dense features and camera states, and a Semantic-Geometric Evidence Bank for compact long-range evidence. Each candidate frame is scored by the product of Q-Former-based question relevance and novelty with respect to the retained bank; this score is stored and reused during reading, while a capacity-based replacement rule keeps the bank compact. During reasoning, both memories are read before update and adaptively fused with the current frame representation. Experiments on VSI-Bench and VSTI-Bench show that \ours achieves state-of-the-art performance among evaluated spatial reasoning models, validating the effectiveness of question-guided geometric memory. Ablations further verify the contribution of the proposed evidence scoring mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种问题引导的几何记忆框架（Ours），通过注入相机条件的几何信息到视觉标记中，并维护细粒度上下文记忆和语义-几何证据记忆两种互补记忆，利用基于Q-Former的问题相关性和新颖性分数进行证据评分，在视频空间推理任务中实现了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视频空间语言模型将记忆视为通用时间缓存，会引入冗余或无关的几何信息，削弱了长期推理能力。需要一种更高效、更具选择性的记忆机制来增强视频空间推理。
AI.method: 提出Ours框架：1) 将相机条件的几何信息注入视觉标记；2) 维护两个互补记忆——细粒度上下文银行（存储近期密集特征和相机状态）和语义-几何证据银行（存储紧凑的长期证据）；3) 通过Q-Former计算每个候选帧的问题相关性和相对于已有银行的新颖性分数，用于证据评分和存储；4) 基于容量的替换规则保持银行紧凑；5) 推理时先读取两个记忆，再与当前帧表示自适应融合。
AI.result: 在VSI-Bench和VSTI-Bench基准上，Ours在评估的空间推理模型中达到了最先进的性能，消融实验验证了所提出的证据评分机制的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 问题引导的几何记忆框架能够有效提升视频空间推理的性能，通过选择性保留与问题相关且新颖的几何证据，解决了现有方法中记忆冗余和长程推理弱化的问题。

title: ReMoE: Boosting Expert Reuse through Router Fine-Tuning in Memory-Constrained MoE LLM Inference
comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary:
Fine-grained Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models sparsely activate only a subset of experts per token, reducing activated computation while maintaining high model capacity. However, in memory-constrained inference scenarios, only a small set of experts can be cached. Experts not in the cache must be fetched from slow external storage (e.g., UFS), leading to frequent evictions and substantial I/O overhead.
  We propose ReMoE, a router fine-tuning framework designed to boost token-wise expert reuse. ReMoE biases the router toward recently selected experts, producing temporally stable routing that better matches cache locality constraints. By increasing short-horizon expert reuse, ReMoE reduces expert fetches from storage without adding inference-time computation.
  Experiments on DeepSeek and Qwen models show that ReMoE improves expert reuse by 26% while maintaining downstream task performance. Real-system evaluations further confirm these benefits, improving output throughput by 8.4% under vLLM GPU-CPU expert offloading and reducing TPOT by 43.6-49.8% under llama.cpp on Jetson Orin NX, corresponding to a 1.77-1.99$\times$ decode speedup across diverse workloads. Checkpoints and usage instructions are available at https://github.com/BUAA-OSCAR/ReMoE.

AI.tldr: ReMoE是一种路由器微调框架，通过使路由倾向于最近被选中的专家，提高专家重用时序稳定性，减少MoE模型在内存受限推理场景中的I/O开销，实现8.4%的吞吐量提升和最高1.99倍的解码加速。
AI.motivation: 在内存受限的推理场景中，MoE模型因只能缓存少量专家，未命中专家需从外部存储频繁加载，导致大量I/O开销，严重影响推理效率。
