AI.method: 提出ReMoE路由器微调框架，通过偏置路由器使其倾向于选择最近被选中的专家，产生时序上稳定的路由决策，从而更好地匹配缓存局部性约束，增加短期专家重用。
AI.result: 在DeepSeek和Qwen模型上，专家重用率提升26%；在vLLM GPU-CPU专家卸载场景下输出吞吐量提升8.4%；在Jetson Orin NX上TPOT降低43.6-49.8%，实现1.77-1.99倍解码加速。
AI.conclusion: ReMoE通过轻量级路由器微调，在不增加推理计算量的前提下显著提升专家重用，有效缓解内存受限场景下的I/O瓶颈，是一种实用的MoE推理优化方法。

title: PARE: Pruning and Adaptive Routing for Efficient Video Generation
summary: Video Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) generate high-quality videos but demand substantial compute due to wide blocks, deep architectures, and iterative sampling. Recent methods reduce cost by compressing width, depth, or sampling steps, but typically commit to a fixed architecture that cannot adapt to individual inputs or denoising stages. We propose PARE (Pruning and Adaptive Routing for Efficient video generation), which jointly compresses width and depth with structure-aware pruning and input-adaptive routing. For width, we observe that attention heads specialize into spatial and temporal roles, and design importance scoring that accounts for this distinction to prevent motion-critical temporal heads from being pruned prematurely. For depth, we train a lightweight router conditioned on denoising timestep and visual content to dynamically select which blocks to execute at each step, enabling per-input compute adaptation rather than static block removal. A progressive pipeline first recovers width-pruned quality via distillation, then jointly optimizes the student and router to decouple the two learning objectives. Experiments on Wan2.1-14B for both image-to-video and text-to-video generation show that PARE substantially reduces per-step computation while preserving quality across VBench dimensions, and composes with step distillation for further acceleration.

AI.tldr: PARE通过结构感知的宽度剪枝和输入自适应的深度路由，联合压缩视频DiT的宽度和深度，在Wan2.1-14B上实现每步计算量显著降低同时保持生成质量，并可结合步蒸馏进一步加速。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散Transformer生成高质量视频但计算成本极高（由于宽块、深架构和迭代采样），现有方法固定架构无法适应不同输入或去噪阶段，需要一种能动态自适应压缩宽度和深度的方法。
AI.method: 提出PARE框架，包含两个核心：(1) 宽度压缩：观察到注意力头分化为空间和时间角色，设计区分性重要性评分以防止运动关键的时间头被过早剪枝；(2) 深度压缩：训练轻量级路由器，以去噪时间步和视觉内容为条件，动态选择每个步执行的块，实现按输入自适应计算。渐进式流水线先通过蒸馏恢复宽度剪枝质量，再联合优化学生和路由器以解耦两个学习目标。
AI.result: 在Wan2.1-14B上对图像到视频和文本到视频生成任务进行实验，PARE在VBench各维度上显著减少了每步计算量，同时保持生成质量，并能与步蒸馏组合实现进一步加速。
AI.conclusion: PARE通过联合剪枝和自适应路由有效降低了视频DiTs的计算成本，其核心在于区分不同类型注意力头的重要性以及动态选择执行块，为高效视频生成提供了新思路。

title: Adversarial Dual On-Policy Distillation from Expressive Flow-based Teacher
summary: Learning from demonstrations in embodied control is often cast as behavioral cloning, and recent diffusion or flow-matching policies improve this paradigm by modeling multi-modal expert actions. Yet these methods remain offline supervised learners: the policy is trained only on expert states and receives no corrective signal on the states it actually visits. On-policy distillation (OPD) offers a natural remedy, but standard OPD assumes a strong fixed teacher, which is unavailable in demonstration-only control. We propose \textbf{FA-OPD}, an \emph{adversarial dual on-policy distillation} method in which a Flow Matching (FM) teacher is learned from demonstrations and co-trained with a lightweight MLP student. The teacher provides two complementary signals on student rollouts. The reward channel learns an expert-likeness objective over state-action pairs and drives online exploration through long-horizon policy optimization. The action channel supplies dense local targets at student-visited states, stabilizing exploitation. FA-OPD couples them so that reward distillation enables generalization beyond point-wise demonstrations, while action distillation keeps exploration anchored near expert-like behavior. Across six robot navigation, manipulation, and locomotion benchmarks, FA-OPD beats strong baselines and shows much stronger robustness under noisy or limited demonstrations.

AI.tldr: 提出FA-OPD方法，通过在线对抗性双通道蒸馏（奖励通道+动作通道）将流匹配教师策略的知识蒸馏给轻量MLP学生策略，在机器人导航、操作和 locomotion 任务上优于强基线，且在噪声或有限演示下表现鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 现有基于演示的行为克隆方法（如扩散/流匹配策略）是离线监督学习，策略仅在专家状态上训练，无法在自己访问的状态上获得纠正信号；而标准在线策略蒸馏需要强固定教师，在纯演示学习场景中不可用。
AI.method: 提出FA-OPD（对抗性双通道在线策略蒸馏），包含：(1) 从演示中学习流匹配教师策略；(2) 教师通过奖励通道对学生访问的状态-动作对进行专家似然评分，驱动长程策略优化；(3) 教师通过动作通道提供学生访问状态上的密集局部目标动作，稳定利用过程；(4) 双通道耦合：奖励蒸馏实现超越点式演示的泛化，动作蒸馏将探索锚定在专家行为附近。
AI.result: 在六个机器人导航、操作和locomotion基准任务上，FA-OPD击败了强基线方法，且在噪声或有限演示条件下展现出更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过对抗性双通道蒸馏框架，有效弥合了离线行为克隆与在线策略优化之间的差距，为纯演示场景下的机器人学习提供了一种鲁棒且高效的范式。

title: Towards Controllable Image Generation through Representation-Conditioned Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models have emerged as powerful tools for high-quality image generation and editing, but guiding these models to produce specific outputs remains a challenge. Conventional approaches rely on conditioning mechanisms, such as text prompts or semantic maps, which require extensively annotated datasets. In this preliminary work, we explore diffusion models conditioned on representations from a pre-trained self-supervised model. The self-conditioning mechanism not only improves the quality of unconditional image generation, but also provides a representation space that can be used to control the generation. We explore this conditioning space by identifying directions of variations, and demonstrate promising properties in terms of smoothness and disentanglement.

AI.tldr: 本文探索了使用预训练自监督模型表征作为扩散模型的条件机制，该方法可在无需标注数据集的情况下提升无条件图像生成质量，并提供可用于控制生成的平滑且解耦的表征空间。
AI.motivation: 传统扩散模型依赖文本提示或语义图等条件机制，但这些方法需要大量标注数据集，限制了其应用。本文旨在探索一种无需标注数据的自监督条件方法。
AI.method: 使用预训练自监督模型的表征来条件化扩散模型，通过在该表征空间中识别变化方向来控制生成过程。
AI.result: 该方法不仅提升了无条件图像生成的质量，还提供了一个平滑且解耦的表征空间，可用于控制生成过程。
AI.conclusion: 自监督条件化机制是一种有前景的无需标注数据的扩散模型控制方法，其在平滑性和解耦性方面表现出良好特性。

title: Mildly Overparameterized ReLU Networks on Orthogonal Data: Incremental Learning and Implicit Bias
summary: The successful training of neural networks hinges on the use of first order optimization methods, yet the theoretical characterization of these methods remains incomplete. This is especially true in settings with mild overparameterization. In this work, we study the gradient flow dynamics of two-layer ReLU networks from small initialization with orthogonal training data. We prove the limiting flow converges to a saddle-to-saddle jump process as the initialization scale tends to zero, revealing an incremental learning phenomenon in which a new neuron activates at each saddle. This analysis recovers the known result of Dana et al. (2025, arXiv:2502.16977) that the network interpolates the training data with high probability as soon as $m \gtrsim \log(n)$, where $m$ is the network width and $n$ is the number of training samples. This incremental process characterization also allows us to derive a novel implicit bias result: the learned interpolator has a squared $\ell_2$-norm scaling as $\sqrt{n}$, which is within a constant factor of the minimal $\ell_2$-norm interpolator. More broadly, our work provides the first rigorous proof of an incremental learning process for ReLU networks, whilst suggesting mildly overparameterized networks can converge to interpolating solutions whose complexity is of the same order as that of the optimal interpolator.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了从微小初始化训练的两层ReLU网络在正交数据上的梯度流动力学。当初始化尺度趋近于零时，极限流收敛到一个鞍点到鞍点的跳跃过程，揭示了每个鞍点激活一个新神经元的增量学习现象。该分析恢复了已知结果：当宽度m ≳ log(n)时，网络以高概率插值训练数据。此外，推导出新的隐式偏差结果：学习到的插值器的平方ℓ₂范数缩放为√n，在常数因子内接近最小ℓ₂范数插值器。这是首次严格证明ReLU网络的增量学习过程，表明适度过参数化的网络可以收敛到复杂度与最优插值器同阶的插值解。
AI.motivation: 一阶优化方法的理论刻画仍不完整，尤其在适度过参数化设置下。本文旨在从理论上严格刻画两层ReLU网络在微小初始化下的梯度流动力学，揭示增量学习现象的数学本质。
AI.method: 采用理论分析的方法，研究从微小初始化训练的两层ReLU网络在正交训练数据上的梯度流动力学。通过证明极限流收敛到鞍点间的跳跃过程来刻画增量学习现象。
AI.result: 1) 恢复Dana等人(2025)的结果：当m ≳ log(n)时网络以高概率插值训练数据。2) 推导出新的隐式偏差结果：学习到的插值器的平方ℓ₂范数缩放为√n，在常数因子内接近最小ℓ₂范数插值器。
AI.conclusion: 首次严格证明ReLU网络的增量学习过程，表明适度过参数化网络可以收敛到复杂度与最优插值器同阶的插值解，为理解神经网络优化动力学提供了理论基础。

title: When Eyes Betray AI: Social Gaze Consistency as a Semantic Cue for AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: Recent generative models have largely closed the gap on low-level artifacts - pixel fingerprints, frequency anomalies, upsampling traces - particularly in person-centric and partial-edit settings where the manipulated region is small and surrounded by photometrically authentic content. We introduce Social Gaze Consistency, a high-level semantic cue defined as the mutual coherence of gaze direction, head-eye alignment, and pupil placement between interacting individuals, and show that it constitutes a previously underutilized detection axis orthogonal to existing low-level paradigms. We instantiate this insight through three coupled mechanisms: (i) a controlled diagnostic dataset with region-specific perturbations of gaze-consistent imagery, where strict pair-level grouping forecloses generator-fingerprint memorization as an optimization-time shortcut rather than relying on augmentation; (ii) Block-Compositional Caption Supervision, which holds a single 5-block reasoning skeleton invariant across 1,250 macro-combined captions, decoupling reasoning consistency from surface diversity; (iii) Cross-architecture validation showing the same supervision improves a vision-language backbone (FakeVLM) by +3.7 pp on the COCOAI Interaction subset (balanced accuracy 67.8 -> 71.5) and +1.3 pp on the COCOAI Person subset (83.0 -> 84.3), with consistent gains on a vision-only backbone (Effort), evidencing a backbone-agnostic cue. Real- and fake-class recalls rise simultaneously, ruling out a "predict-all-fake" artifact. A four-step mechanistic account - paired-edit shortcut blocking, hard-to-easy difficulty transfer, CLIP prior preservation, and diffusion-family shared spectral weakness in periocular structure - explains why training on a single inpainter (FLUX.1-Fill) transfers to multi-generator suites. We will release the code upon acceptance to facilitate reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出社交凝视一致性（Social Gaze Consistency）作为高维语义线索用于检测生成图像，通过构建诊断数据集、块组合描述监督和跨架构验证，证明该线索在多种生成器上有效，且训练于单一模型可迁移至多生成器场景。
AI.motivation: 现有生成模型已大幅缩小低层伪影（像素指纹、频率异常、上采样痕迹）的差距，尤其在人物中心和局部编辑场景中，被操纵区域小且被真实内容包围，传统检测方法失效。作者希望利用高维语义线索来弥补这一检测空白。
AI.method: (i) 构建受控诊断数据集，通过严格的对级分组阻止生成器指纹记忆；(ii) 块组合描述监督（Block-Compositional Caption Supervision），在1250个宏观组合描述中保持单一5块推理骨架不变，解耦推理一致性与表面多样性；(iii) 跨架构验证（FakeVLM +3.7 pp, Effort等），证明线索的骨干无关性。
AI.result: FakeVLM在COCOAI Interaction子集上平衡准确率从67.8提升至71.5（+3.7 pp），在Person子集上从83.0提升至84.3（+1.3 pp）；真实类和伪造类召回率同时提升，排除"全预测为假"的伪影。
AI.conclusion: 四步机制解释（对编辑捷径阻断、难到易难度迁移、CLIP先验保持、扩散模型在眼周结构的共享频谱弱点）表明，单一修补模型（FLUX.1-Fill）训练可迁移至多生成器测试套件，代码将开源。

title: High-Quality Synthetic Financial Time-Series using a GAN-Diffusion Framework
summary: In recent years, financial institutions and firms have increasingly adopted synthetic data to address data scarcity and to generate counterfactual market scenarios. However, reproducing all the statistical properties of financial time series, commonly known as stylized facts, remains an open challenge for many existing general-purpose architectures. In this paper, we present a quality-aware generative framework that combines two classes of generative methods, demonstrating how their integration addresses existing limitations while enhancing the realism of synthetic data. Specifically, we first introduce CoMeTS-GAN (Correlated Multivariate Time Series GAN), a Conditional Generative Adversarial Network (C-GAN) designed to jointly generate mid-price and volume time-series for correlated stocks. We then show how our GAN architecture can be incorporated into state-of-the-art diffusion models to enhance the quality of generated correlation structures. Specifically, the GAN's Critic serves as a quality evaluation module that guides the diffusion process, enforcing learned correlation structures in the generated time-series. Our framework offers a lightweight and responsive solution for realistic stock market simulation, explicitly modeling inter-asset correlation structures. We experimentally validate our framework against leading generative architectures, showing that it more effectively captures the stylized facts of stock markets and models inter-asset correlations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种质量感知的生成框架，结合条件生成对抗网络（CoMeTS-GAN）与扩散模型，通过GAN的Critic作为质量评估模块引导扩散过程，以更真实地生成具有跨资产相关结构的多变量金融时间序列，并有效捕捉股票市场的程式化事实。
AI.motivation: 金融机构和企业越来越多地采用合成数据来解决数据稀缺问题和生成反事实市场情景，但现有通用架构在复现金融时间序列的所有统计特性（即程式化事实）方面仍面临挑战，特别是跨资产相关结构的建模。
AI.method: 提出质量感知生成框架，首先设计CoMeTS-GAN（条件生成对抗网络）联合生成相关股票的中价和成交量时间序列；然后将GAN的Critic作为质量评估模块融入扩散模型，引导扩散过程强制生成时间序列中学习到的相关结构。
AI.result: 实验验证表明，该框架相比主流生成架构能更有效地捕捉股票市场的程式化事实，并更好地建模跨资产相关结构。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了一种轻量且响应迅速的股票市场模拟方案，通过显式建模跨资产相关结构，解决了现有生成方法在金融时间序列真实性和相关性建模方面的局限。

title: Feedforward 3D Editing Learns from Semantic-Part Transformation
summary: 3D editing is a fundamental capability for scalable 3D content creation. While image editing has rapidly evolved toward large-scale feedforward generative paradigms, 3D AI generation remains dominated by training-free editing pipelines. A central challenge of feedforward 3D editing lies in the lack of high-quality paired supervision. Editable 3D assets require simultaneous preservation of geometry, multi-view consistency, structural coherence, and localized edit controllability. Existing 3D editing datasets often rely on independently generated assets, image-mediated reconstruction or narrow edit taxonomies, leading to inaccurate localization, weak preservation, blurred edit boundaries, and limited semantic consistency. In this work, we introduce a new perspective: scalable feedforward 3D editing should be learned from semantic-part transformations. Based on this insight, we propose Pxform, a high-quality 3D editing dataset with over 100K consistent before/after editing pairs across seven edit types. Instead of treating objects as unstructured shapes, our pipeline grounds edits directly in semantic 3D parts. Built upon Pxform, we further propose PartFlow, a feedforward 3D editing network that injects source-aware latent control into pretrained 3D generative priors. PartFlow introduces mask-aware velocity preservation and render-space consistency supervision to jointly improve edit fidelity and source preservation, while requiring no 3D edit mask during inference. Extensive experiments demonstrate that high-quality semantic-part supervision substantially improves scalable 3D editing, enabling PartFlow to achieve state-of-the-art performance on both geometric and appearance editing benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Pxform（10万+对的高质量3D编辑数据集）和PartFlow（前馈式3D编辑网络），通过语义部件变换学习实现可扩展的前馈3D编辑，在几何和外观编辑基准上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 前馈式3D编辑面临高质量配对监督数据匮乏的挑战，现有数据集存在定位不准、结构保持弱、编辑边界模糊和语义一致性差等问题。
AI.method: 1) 构建Pxform数据集：基于语义3D部件的变换，包含10万+编辑对、7种编辑类型；2) 提出PartFlow网络：将源感知潜空间控制注入预训练3D生成先验，引入掩码感知的速度保持和渲染空间一致性监督。
AI.result: 在几何和外观编辑基准上达到SOTA性能，推理时无需3D编辑掩码。
AI.conclusion: 高质量语义部件监督能显著提升可扩展3D编辑能力，语义部件变换为前馈3D编辑提供了新的有效视角。

title: DEI: Diversity in Evolutionary Inference for Quality-Diversity Search
comment: Accepted to ICML 2026 Workshop Scalable Learning and Optimization for Efficient Multimodal AI Agents (SCALE)
summary: We present DEI: Diversity in Evolutionary Inference, a distributed Quality-Diversity (QD) search framework that assigns heterogeneous large language models (LLMs) as mutation operators across peer nodes communicating with non-blocking collective operations. Unlike homogeneous parallel search, which replicates a single model's inductive biases across all workers, DEI treats each LLM's distinct creative prior as a complementary source of behavioral novelty. Extending the Digital Red Queen framework with DEI, nodes share local optimal solutions at the end of each round to seed the next round's population. This creates cross-model adversarial pressure that drives robustness beyond intra-model self-play. Evaluated on the Core War domain, a competitive programming benchmark in which Redcode warrior programs battle inside a simulated machine, a four-node heterogeneous ensemble (GPT-5.4-mini, Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.2, and Claude Haiku 4.5) achieves 124 percent higher merged-archive QD-Score (45.90 vs. 20.46) and 28 percent higher coverage (80.6 percent vs. 63.0 percent of cells) than a single-node baseline at equal total LLM-call budget. The heterogeneous ensemble also outperforms an equally-budgeted homogeneous ensemble on QD-Score, coverage, and held-out solution generality across all four model families. These results provide the first empirical evidence that model diversity, not merely parallelism, is the key driver of gain in distributed LLM-based QD search.

AI.tldr: 提出DEI（多样性进化推理）框架，利用异构大语言模型作为变异算子进行分布式质量-多样性搜索。在Core War领域，四节点异构集成相比单节点基线在QD-Score上提升124%，覆盖度提升28%，证明了模型多样性而非仅仅并行性是分布式LLM-QD搜索增益的关键。
AI.motivation: 同质化并行搜索中所有工作节点复制单一模型的归纳偏差，限制了解空间的多样性。为克服这一局限，探索利用异构LLM的多样性创作先验作为行为新颖性的互补来源。
AI.method: 基于Digital Red Queen框架扩展，采用非阻塞集合通信的分布式QD搜索架构，将异构LLM分配为变异算子跨对等节点运行，节点在每轮结束时共享局部最优解以播种下一轮种群，形成跨模型的对抗压力。
AI.result: 在Core War领域，4节点异构集成（GPT-5.4-mini、Claude Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5.2、Claude Haiku 4.5）相比单节点基线：QD-Score提升124%（45.90 vs 20.46），覆盖度提升28%（80.6% vs 63.0%）；同时优于同等预算的同质集成。
AI.conclusion: 首次提供经验证据表明，模型多样性而非单纯的并行化是分布式LLM-based QD搜索中增益的关键驱动因素。

title: Deep-layer limit and stability analysis of the basic forward-backward-splitting induced network (II): learning problems
summary: Deep unfolding neural networks derived from iterative optimization schemes and numerical ordinary/partial differential equations (ODEs/PDEs) have attracted much attention in data science over the last decade. Therein, numerous important network architectures were constructed from the basic forward-backward-splitting (FBS) algorithm. In this paper, we continue our research on the most basic FBS-induced network, an architecture unrolled from the original FBS algorithm by incorporating direct parameter relaxations. Following the difference/differential inclusion formulations in our previous forward system analyses, we here consider some theoretical aspects of corresponding learning problems. Under some mild assumptions, we establish a general convergence property of the training problem of the basic FBS-induced network to the learning problem of the deep-layer limit system, implying a $Γ$-convergence argument showing that any cluster point of the optimal learning parameters for the network is a solution to the learning problem of the deep-layer limit system. A qualitative analysis of perturbation stabilities of these learning problems is also presented. A simple numerical experiment is conducted to validate our main general convergence result.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了由前向-后向分裂（FBS）算法展开得到的基础深度展开网络的收敛性，证明其训练问题在深层极限下Γ-收敛到极限系统的学习问题，并分析了扰动稳定性。
AI.motivation: 深度展开网络在数据科学中受到广泛关注，但关于基础FBS诱导网络的训练问题与深层极限系统学习问题之间的理论关系尚不明确，需要建立严格的收敛性分析。
AI.method: 基于前序工作的差分/微分包含形式，通过引入直接参数松弛构建FBS诱导网络；利用Γ-收敛理论证明网络训练问题向深层极限系统学习问题的收敛性；进行扰动稳定性定性分析并通过数值实验验证。
AI.result: 在温和假设下，建立了基础FBS诱导网络训练问题的通用收敛性质，证明了网络最优学习参数的任一聚点都是深层极限系统学习问题的解；同时给出了学习问题的扰动稳定性分析。
AI.conclusion: 该工作从理论上揭示了基础FBS展开网络与其深层极限之间的联系，为深度展开网络的设计和分析提供了理论支撑。

title: SpatialBench: Is Your Spatial Foundation Model an All-Round Player?
summary: While spatial foundation models have demonstrated impressive performance on standard datasets, a critical question remains: are they truly all-round players capable of generalizing robustly across diverse downstream tasks, arbitrary viewpoints, shifting scene domains, varying input densities, and specific hardware constraints? Answering this overarching question requires a holistic assessment, yet current models are mainly evaluated on specific domains for which they were specifically designed or trained. Such evaluations are intrinsically limited by narrow paradigm coverage, limited scene domains, and arbitrary frame sampling, making it fundamentally difficult to assess their true generalization capabilities. To address this gap, we present SpatialBench, a cross-paradigm, domain-diverse benchmark for spatial foundation models with deterministic sampling. SpatialBench features unprecedented scale and rigorous deterministic design, comprising 19 datasets and 546 scenes across 5 diverse spatial domains. It comprehensively evaluates 41 models across 6 paradigms on 5 task suites under 4 different input density settings. Our extensive evaluation reveals that current models are not yet all-round players, and uncovers crucial insights for future advancement. Specifically, we demonstrate that full-context attention maximizes accuracy while bounded-memory strategies unlock long-sequence scalability. Moreover, our empirical evaluations in challenging embodied and egocentric tasks demonstrate that strict domain alignment and high data quality are far more critical to performance than simple dataset scaling. Furthermore, to address the largest data gap identified in our analysis, we go beyond evaluation by introducing a large-scale dataset, DA-Next-5M, and a strong baseline model, DA-Next, pushing the boundaries of spatial representation learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SpatialBench——一个跨范式、多领域、确定性采样的空间基础模型基准，包含19个数据集、546个场景、5个空间领域，评估41个模型在6种范式、5个任务套件和4种输入密度下的表现。发现当前模型尚未达到全能水平，并揭示全上下文注意力最大化精度、有界记忆策略实现长序列可扩展性、领域对齐和数据质量比简单数据扩展更关键。同时引入DA-Next-5M数据集和DA-Next基线模型。
AI.motivation: 现有空间基础模型主要在特定领域上评估，受限于狭窄的范式覆盖、有限的场景域和任意帧采样，难以评估模型的真正泛化能力。因此需要构建一个全面、多样化、确定性采样的基准来系统评估模型的多任务泛化能力。
AI.method: 构建SpatialBench基准，包含19个数据集和546个场景覆盖5个空间领域（室内、室外、城市场景、具身场景、自我中心场景），采用确定性采样策略确保可复现性。评估41个模型（涵盖6种代表性范式）在5个任务套件（包括单目深度估计、法线估计、匹配等）和4种输入密度设置下的性能。同时引入DA-Next-5M大规模数据集（填补最大数据缺口）及DA-Next基线模型。
AI.result: 1) 当前空间基础模型尚未成为真正的"全能选手"；2) 全上下文注意力最大化精度，而有界记忆策略（如滑动窗口）实现长序列可扩展性；3) 在具身和自我中心等挑战性任务中，严格领域对齐和高数据质量远优于简单数据规模扩展。4) 识别出最大的数据缺口并通过DA-Next-5M数据集和DA-Next模型推动空间表示学习边界。
AI.conclusion: 空间基础模型尚未达到真正的通用泛化能力；未来进步需要关注领域对齐和数据质量，而非单纯的规模扩展；确定性采样和标准化基准（如SpatialBench）对于准确评估模型能力至关重要。

title: The Role of Causal Features in Strategic Classification for Robustness and Alignment
summary: In strategic classification, an institution (e.g., a bank) anticipates adaptation from users who change their features to increase utility in a classification task (e.g., loan repayment). Since a key challenge is the distribution shift induced by users, we turn to causal models, which have been shown to bound the worst-case out-of-distribution (OOD) risk, and establish several new results that link causality and strategic classification. First, we show that causal classification leads to optimal classification error after any sufficiently large adaptation, when the noise is bounded in a certain way. Second, when these assumptions do not hold, we show OOD cross-entropy risk of optimal classifiers decomposes into an OOD bias term and a term arising from not using all observable features, allowing us to understand when causal classifiers have an advantage. Finally, we show that the use of causal features can allow alignment of long-term incentives between institutions and users, contrasting with previous work that highlights social costs of such approaches. We validate our theory empirically on synthetic data, finding that our results predict behavior in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了因果模型如何与策略性分类相结合，证明了在某些噪声条件下因果分类在大规模用户适应后仍能保持最优，分析了因果分类器的OOD风险分解，并发现使用因果特征可以协调机构与用户之间的长期激励。
AI.motivation: 策略性分类中用户会调整特征以获取更有利的分类结果，导致分布偏移（distribution shift），传统方法难以应对。作者希望通过引入因果模型来理解和约束这种由用户自适应引起的分布偏移，从而提升分类器的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 首先从理论上证明在特定噪声有界条件下，因果分类在任意大规模用户适应后仍能达到最优分类误差；然后对更一般情形，将OOD交叉熵风险分解为OOD偏差项和未使用全部可观特征导致的误差项；最后分析了因果特征在长期激励对齐中的作用，并通过合成数据实验验证理论。
AI.result: （1）因果分类在噪声有界时对大规模适应具有鲁棒最优性；（2）OOD风险的分解揭示了因果分类器优势的来源；（3）因果特征能够促进机构与用户长期激励的一致性，而非造成社会成本。
AI.conclusion: 因果模型为策略性分类中的分布偏移提供了理论保障，并在特定条件下具有最优性；因果特征的使用不仅有助于鲁棒性，还能在长期视角下缓解机构与用户之间的利益冲突。

title: G3T Up! Gravity Aligned Coordinate Frames Simplify Pointmap Processing
summary: Modern feed-forward 3D reconstruction methods like VGGT predict pixel-aligned pointmaps in camera-centric coordinate frames. However, this choice of coordinate frame is not always optimal. We propose instead to predict pointmaps in upright, gravity-aligned frames that exploit strong structural cues present in many real-world scenes. Unlike camera-centric frames, gravity-aligned frames share a common vertical axis across viewpoints, reducing the rotational degrees of freedom needed to relate pointmaps to one another. To this end, we introduce the Gravity Grounded Geometry Transformer (G3T), fine-tuned from existing models on gravity-aligned 3D data. G3T produces highly accurate gravity-aware predictions, including upright pointmaps and camera-to-gravity poses. We further introduce G3T-Long, a submap-based incremental 3D reconstruction pipeline that leverages the reduced rotational degrees of freedom afforded by upright frames to achieve significantly improved reconstruction accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出G3T方法，通过在重力对齐的直立坐标系中预测点图替代传统相机中心坐标系，利用场景的结构先验减少点图间旋转自由度，提升3D重建精度；并扩展出G3T-Long增量重建流程。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈3D重建方法（如VGGT）在相机中心坐标系中预测点图，该坐标系并非最优；而真实场景中普遍存在重力方向这一强结构线索未被充分利用，导致跨视角点图关联时需要处理不必要的旋转自由度。
AI.method: 从现有模型微调得到G3T，预测重力对齐的直立点图和相机到重力姿态；进一步提出G3T-Long，利用直立坐标系减少的旋转自由度构建基于子图的增量式3D重建流程。
AI.result: G3T在重力感知预测上表现高精度；G3T-Long通过减少旋转自由度显著提升了重建精度。
AI.conclusion: 采用重力对齐的直立坐标系替代相机中心坐标系，能有效利用场景结构先验，简化点图间几何关系，从而提升3D重建的准确性和效率。

title: Nonlinear Data Integration via Kernel Methods for Data Collaboration Analysis
summary: Collaborative analysis of decentralized confidential datasets is important, but direct sharing of original datasets is often restricted by privacy and institutional constraints. Data collaboration (DC) analysis transforms each dataset into privacy-preserving intermediate representations via party-specific obfuscation functions and integrates them into common collaboration representations using an anchor dataset. However, many existing DC analysis methods rely on linear transformations for data obfuscation and integration, which may increase reconstruction risk. Although nonlinear dimensionality reduction can mitigate this risk, conventional linear integration methods cannot accurately align intermediate representations produced by nonlinear transformations. Moreover, existing integration methods mainly minimize discrepancies among parties and do not explicitly incorporate geometric or target-variable information useful for downstream analysis. To overcome these limitations, we first formulate linear kernel integration (LKI) as a linear integration method and then kernelize it to obtain nonlinear kernel integration (NKI). NKI admits a globally optimal solution via kernel ridge regression and an eigenvalue problem. We also introduce graph regularization and a centering constraint so that the target representation can capture geometric and target-variable information useful for downstream analysis. Experiments on image classification tasks demonstrate that NKI improves classification accuracy over existing linear integration methods under nonlinear dimensionality reduction, with further gains from target-variable-aware graph regularization and centering. The results also show that dimensionality reduction choices substantially affect both classification accuracy and reconstruction risk.

AI.tldr: 本文提出非线性核集成(NKI)方法，通过核化线性核集成(LKI)并结合图正则化和中心化约束，在非线性降维下实现隐私保护的分布式数据协作分析，提升了图像分类准确率并降低了重构风险。
AI.motivation: 现有数据协作(DC)分析方法依赖线性变换进行数据混淆与集成，存在重构风险高的问题；非线性降维虽能缓解该风险，但传统线性集成方法无法准确对齐非线性变换产生的中间表示；同时现有方法主要最小化各方间差异，未显式融入几何或目标变量信息，不利于下游分析。
AI.method: 首先形式化线性核集成(LKI)作为线性集成方法，然后通过核技巧将其核化为非线性核集成(NKI)，通过核岭回归和特征值问题获得全局最优解；引入图正则化和中心化约束，使目标表示能够捕获几何和目标变量信息。
AI.result: 在图像分类任务上，NKI在非线性降维条件下相比现有线性集成方法提升了分类准确率；引入目标变量感知的图正则化和中心化后带来进一步提升；降维选择显著影响分类准确率和重构风险。
AI.conclusion: NKI通过非线性核集成有效解决了非线性降维下中间表示的对齐问题，图正则化和中心化约束能显式融入有用信息，为隐私保护下的分布式数据分析提供了更优方案。

title: Explainable Comparison of Feature-Based and Deep Learning Models for TROPOMI Methane Plume Screening
summary: Continuous and global detection of large methane emissions is a crucial step for global warming mitigation. Satellite observations, such as from S5P/TROPOMI, combined with plume detection algorithms, can play a key role in this effort. However, not all TROPOMI plume detections that look like methane emission plumes are the result of actual emissions. A significant part of the plume-like features in the data are retrieval artifacts. Such artifacts could be the result of variations in elevation or albedo gradients, high concentrations of aerosols, coastal lines, water bodies, etc. Previous work approached the problem of plume-artifact classification by means of a Support Vector Machine Classifier (SVC), trained on an extensive set of observation-based scalar features designed by domain experts. However, such an approach limits the information scope received by the algorithm to what is deemed to be important by the experts, breaks the spatial relationship between pixels, and loses information during the process of statistical aggregation. In this study, we compare feature-based (SVC, Random Forest, XGBoost) and image-based (ResNet-18, ResNet-34) models for methane plume-artifact classification under balanced and imbalanced evaluation settings. To interpret the results, we apply SHAP-based explainability to both model families. Our findings provide practical guidance for model selection in operational methane-screening workflows such as the CAMS Methane Hotspot Explorer.

AI.tldr: 本研究对比了基于特征的传统机器学习模型（SVC、随机森林、XGBoost）和基于图像的深度学习模型（ResNet-18、ResNet-34）在甲烷羽流-伪影分类任务上的表现，并应用SHAP进行可解释性分析，为CAMS甲烷热点探测器的运营筛选流程提供模型选择指导。
AI.motivation: 卫星观测中的甲烷羽流检测存在大量由地形、反照率、气溶胶、海岸线等引起的伪影，需要可靠的分类方法区分真实排放羽流与伪影。现有基于专家手工特征的方法（如SVC）信息范围有限，破坏了像素空间关系，且统计聚合过程中丢失信息。
AI.method: 对比基于特征的模型（SVC、随机森林、XGBoost）与基于图像的模型（ResNet-18、ResNet-34），在平衡和不平衡评估设置下进行甲烷羽流-伪影分类，并使用SHAP进行模型可解释性分析。
AI.result: 研究给出了两类模型在平衡与不平衡设置下的性能对比结果，并通过SHAP解释揭示了两类模型的决策差异。
AI.conclusion: 为运营式甲烷筛选流程（如CAMS甲烷热点探测器）提供了实际的模型选择指导。

title: Symbolic Regression via Latent Iterative Refinement
summary: Symbolic regression (SR) seeks closed-form mathematical expressions that fit observed data. Neural SR methods amortize the search by training an encoder to map observations directly to expressions in a single pass, but this amortized inference leaves a residual amortization gap between its one-shot prediction and the true posterior. We propose Latent Equation Embedding (LEE), a framework that closes this gap through iterative amortized inference in a functionally grounded latent space. LEE learns a shared latent space Z equipped with three components: an encoder f_theta that jointly embeds symbolic tokens and numerical observations into a single latent vector z; an expression decoder g_expr that reconstructs formulas from z; and an evaluation decoder g_eval that predicts function values from z, explicitly grounding the latent space in functional behavior. At inference, LEE performs iterative refinement by re-encoding decoded expressions jointly with observations, progressively improving the latent estimate. LEE uses the encoder itself as a learned inference optimizer: each re-encoding step implicitly computes the mismatch between the candidate and the data. Because g_eval is differentiable in z, we additionally interleave continuous gradient descent with discrete re-encoding, yielding a hybrid iterative and gradient refinement procedure. On SRBench across three noise levels, against 19 baselines spanning genetic programming, symbolic-neural hybrids, and pre-trained Transformers, LEE produces expressions 2--10x simpler than the strongest accuracy-oriented baselines, including Operon, GP-GOMEA, TPSR, RAG-SR, and GenSR, with complexity 8--11 versus 20--90. These results advance the low-complexity region of the accuracy-complexity Pareto frontier and show graceful degradation as noise increases.

AI.tldr: LEE通过迭代摊销推理在函数基隐空间中缩小符号回归的摊销差距，在SRBench上以极低复杂度（8-11）实现了与强基线相当或更优的精度，将Pareto前沿推向低复杂度区域。
AI.motivation: 神经符号回归方法通过编码器将观测直接映射为表达式（摊销推理），但单次预测与真实后验之间存在残余的"摊销差距"，限制了表达式的质量和泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出LEE框架，学习共享隐空间Z，包含三个组件：编码器f_θ联合嵌入符号令牌和数值观测；表达式解码器g_expr从z重建公式；评估解码器g_eval从z预测函数值。推理时通过重新编码已解码表达式与观测进行迭代精炼，并交替使用连续梯度下降和离散重新编码进行混合优化。
AI.result: 在SRBench上三个噪声级别下对比19个基线（GP、符号-神经混合、预训练Transformer），LEE生成的表达式复杂度仅为2-10（8-11 vs 20-90），优于Operon、GP-GOMEA、TPSR、RAG-SR、GenSR等强精度基线，且随噪声增加性能退化更优雅。
AI.conclusion: LEE有效缩小了符号回归中的摊销差距，在精度-复杂度Pareto前沿的低复杂度区域取得显著进展，证明了迭代摊销推理与函数基隐空间相结合的有效性。

title: LUCoS: Latent Unsupervised Context Selection for Tabular Foundation Models
comment: Comments: 18 pages, 4 figures, supplementary appendices included
summary: Selecting which instances to label is a key challenge in low-label tabular learning. For recent Tabular Foundation Models such as TabPFN, context selection directly determines predictive performance. Supervised oracle experiments show that carefully chosen labeled context sets can strongly outperform random selection under the same labeling budget. However, the cold-start setting, where instances must be selected before any labels are available, has received little attention in the TFM literature. This problem is fundamentally geometric. In vision and language, foundation models induce embedding spaces where simple geometric selection methods are effective. In contrast, tabular instance selection has so far been performed predominantly in the original tabular space, which lacks a natural metric; heterogeneous types, mixed scales, and nonlinear interactions make raw-space distances unreliable for context construction, and original-space selection falls below random on the majority of datasets as the budget grows. We propose LUCoS (Latent Unsupervised Context Selection), which replaces raw-feature geometry with the latent geometry induced by embeddings from an unsupervised Prior-Fitted Network (PFN) and selects representative medoids as context. Evaluated on 67 OpenML-CC18 datasets across six low-label budgets, LUCoS ranks first under mean AUC, ACC, and F1, with conclusions stable across metrics and dataset-level robustness checks. A gain decomposition reveals a simple mechanism: at the smallest budgets, the main benefit comes from enforcing coverage; as the budget increases, the decisive factor becomes the representation space in which coverage is measured. LUCoS mitigates failures of original feature space selection, showing that reliable unsupervised context selection depends less on selector sophistication than on defining representativeness in a meaningful representation geometry.

AI.tldr: 针对表格基础模型中的冷启动无监督上下文选择问题，本文提出LUCoS方法，利用无监督Prior-Fitted Network的潜在几何表征替代原始特征空间来选择代表性medoid作为标注上下文。在67个OpenML-CC18数据集上，LUCoS在平均AUC、ACC和F1指标上均排名第一，并揭示了一个简单机制：小预算下覆盖率是主要收益来源，大预算下表征空间的质量成为决定性因素。
AI.motivation: 表格基础模型（如TabPFN）中，上下文选择直接影响预测性能，但冷启动场景（标注前需选择实例）在表格基础模型文献中鲜有关注。原始表格空间缺乏自然度量，异构类型、混合尺度和非线性交互使得原始空间距离不可靠，甚至随预算增长劣于随机选择。
AI.method: LUCoS方法：1）使用无监督Prior-Fitted Network（PFN）将原始表格数据映射到潜在嵌入空间；2）在潜在空间中计算距离，替代原始特征空间的不可靠度量；3）选择具有代表性的medoid（中心点）作为上下文集合。
AI.result: 在67个OpenML-CC18数据集上，跨越六个低标注预算设置，LUCoS在平均AUC、ACC和F1上排名第一。增益分解揭示：最小预算下主要收益来自覆盖率；预算增长后，决定性因素是测量覆盖率所用的表征空间质量。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的冷启动无监督上下文选择的关键不在于选择器本身的复杂程度，而在于在一个有意义的表征几何空间中定义代表性。LUCoS有效缓解了原始特征空间选择的失败。

title: Kan Extension Transformers: A Categorical Unification of Attention, Diffusion, and Predict-Detach Self-Conditioning
summary: We propose Kan Extension Transformers (KETs) as a unifying categorical framework for a diverse group of Transformer implementations. The core claim is that a Transformer layer can be viewed as a weighted structured extension operator: standard attention is the singleton-neighborhood case, Geometric Transformer style incidence mixing is a sparse edge-restricted case, and KET is the higher-order simplicial case. This lens also clarifies a bridge to diffusion-style completion. When the extension operator acts on detached predictive carriers instead of teacher-forced hidden states, it becomes a valid self-conditioning mechanism that exposes noncausal structure without leaking gold future tokens. We include a comprehensive experimental validation of 12 different Transformer implementations varying across strict-causal and predict-detach regimes on Penn Treebank, WikiText-2, and WikiText-103. In the strict-causal setting, quadratic KET is the strongest model among the compared causal architectures on WikiText-2 and WikiText-103. Across all datasets, however, the largest gains come from the predict-detach regime rather than from changing the neighborhood family alone.

AI.tldr: 提出Kan Extension Transformers (KETs)作为统一范畴框架，将Transformer层视为加权结构化扩展算子，涵盖标准注意力、几何Transformer和KET（高阶单纯复形）。扩展算子作用于分离预测载体时成为有效的自条件化机制。实验表明，严格因果设置下二次KET在WikiText-2和103上最强，但最大收益来自预测分离机制而非邻域结构变化。
AI.motivation: 现有Transformer实现多样但缺乏统一的理论框架理解其本质联系，需要建立一个范畴论视角下的统一描述，并探索更有效的自条件化机制。
AI.method: 提出KETs范畴框架，将Transformer层建模为加权结构化扩展算子，涵盖不同邻域结构（单点、稀疏边、高阶单纯复形）；引入预测分离机制（predict-detach）作为自条件化方法。
AI.result: 严格因果设置下二次KET在WikiText-2和WikiText-103上优于其他因果架构；但所有数据集上预测分离机制带来的增益大于邻域结构变化。
AI.conclusion: KETs提供了统一的Transformer理论框架，预测分离机制是比改进邻域结构更有效的性能提升手段。

title: Transfer Learning using 66 Diseases for Disease Forecasting Applications
summary: Disease forecasting models typically rely on a single data stream, making models brittle when histories are short or noisy. Recent top-performing models have shown that synthesizing multiple reporting systems for the same disease improves performance. Other recent work takes this idea a step further, using transfer learning to train a forecasting model for one disease using data from a different disease. We expand upon each of these approaches greatly, training machine learning models on data that span 66 infectious diseases and several data streams. We investigate the value of incorporating different data streams for forecasting 20 different disease data streams. We find that incorporating other data streams improves forecasting in the vast majority (84.9%) of time series and model structures considered. However, our work highlights that the quality of the added data matters, where adding data extremely different from the target data stream can sometimes degrade forecast performance. A major contribution of this work is in compiling a publicly-available database of data for use by the infectious disease forecasting community.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多数据流和跨疾病迁移学习对传染病预测模型的影响，构建了涵盖66种传染病和多数据流的数据库，发现整合其他数据流在84.9%的时间序列和模型结构中提升了预测性能，但数据质量至关重要，差异过大的数据可能降低预测效果。
AI.motivation: 传统疾病预测模型通常依赖单一数据流，在数据历史短或噪声大时表现脆弱。近期研究表明整合同一疾病的多报告系统可提升性能，以及利用跨疾病迁移学习训练预测模型。本文旨在大幅扩展这些方法，系统性地评估多数据流和跨疾病数据对预测模型的贡献。
AI.method: 本文训练了覆盖66种传染病和多数据流的机器学习模型，针对20种不同的疾病数据流进行预测，系统比较了整合不同数据流的效果，并构建了公开可用的传染病预测数据库。
AI.result: 整合其他数据流在84.9%的时间序列和模型结构中提升了预测性能。但添加与目标数据流差异极大的数据有时会降低预测效果，表明数据质量至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 多数据流整合可显著提升传染病预测性能，但需谨慎选择相关数据源；同时本文贡献了一个公开数据库以供社区使用。

title: Causal Risk Minimization for High-Dimensional Treatments
summary: Predicting the effect of interventions with many possible variations, e.g., therapeutic content that affects mental health outcomes or an earnings call transcript that drives movement in share price, is useful across several domains. However, classical causal estimators tend to assume that all possible interventions are observed, which is infeasible when interventions vary widely, for instance, in the space of all text strings. We adapt a well-known approach of recasting causal inference as a learning problem, to address high-dimensional treatment spaces. Specifically, under standard assumptions like no unobserved confounding, we show that causal error decomposes into a series of moment-balancing errors of increasing order, and design objectives that directly improve causal estimation. We also show how to project the effect of a high-dimensional treatment onto lower-dimensional treatment attributes, which allows a single model to answer several causal questions without additional attribute-specific training. We empirically evaluate our estimators in settings with high-dimensional continuous, discrete, and text treatments, the last of which used a semi-synthetic dataset of Amazon Reviews. Our experiments demonstrate the benefit of higher-order balance error optimization and competitive performance of projected causal estimates with attribute-specific estimators.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种处理高维干预空间（如文本）的因果推断方法，将因果估计分解为一系列矩平衡误差，并通过优化高阶矩平衡来提升因果估计精度，同时支持将高维干预投影到低维属性进行因果问答。
AI.motivation: 传统因果估计方法假设所有可能的干预都能被观测到，这在干预空间高维（如所有文本字符串）时不可行。论文旨在解决高维、连续、离散及文本等多种干预情境下的因果效应估计问题。
AI.method: 将因果推断重新表述为学习问题；在无未观测混杂等标准假设下，证明因果误差可分解为一系列递增阶数的矩平衡误差；设计直接优化因果估计的目标函数；提出将高维干预投影到低维属性上的方法，使单一模型可回答多个因果问题而无需额外训练。
AI.result: 在高维连续、离散和文本干预（使用Amazon Reviews半合成数据集）上进行了实验评估，结果表明高阶平衡误差优化能带来性能提升，投影因果估计与属性专用估计器具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 通过矩平衡误差分解和投影方法，有效解决了高维干预空间的因果推断问题，为文本等复杂干预的因果效应估计提供了可行方案。

title: Falcon-X: A Time Series Foundation Model for Heterogeneous Multivariate Modeling
summary: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) are transforming the forecasting paradigm through large-scale cross-domain pretraining. However, most existing TSFMs remain univariate, and recent efforts to enable cross-variate modeling still operate directly within the raw variate space. This design introduces fundamental limitations in semantic alignment and relational expressivity. Specifically, raw-space group mixing lacks a dedicated mechanism to align heterogeneous physical quantities, while standard non-negative attention fails to capture the complex synergistic and antagonistic interactions ubiquitous in real-world systems. To address these challenges, we propose Falcon-X, decouples variates from the raw space and maps them into a unified latent prototype space. Falcon-X employs a Unified Prototype Diff-Attention mechanism that explicitly evaluates both positive and negative semantic affinities to explicitly align heterogeneous variates. Cross-variate interactions are then efficiently performed within this shared space via Latent Entity Attention, naturally facilitating zero-shot structural transfer. Finally, a Variate Reassembly Router robustly reconstructs variate-specific trajectories via a request-and-dispatch mechanism. Extensive evaluations on the GIFT-Eval and fev-bench benchmarks demonstrate that Falcon-X achieves state-of-the-art forecasting performance, offering a principled and scalable paradigm for complex multivariate environments. Falcon-X is publicly released to support future research.

AI.tldr: Falcon-X通过将变量从原始空间解耦到统一潜原型空间，利用统一原型差异注意力机制同时捕捉正负语义亲和性，实现在复杂多变量环境中的最先进时间序列预测。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列基础模型多为单变量模型，而多变量建模直接在原始变量空间操作，存在语义对齐不足（异构物理量缺乏对齐机制）和关系表达能力有限（标准非负注意力无法捕捉真实系统中普遍存在的协同与拮抗交互）的根本性局限。
AI.method: Falcon-X将变量从原始空间解耦映射到统一潜原型空间，采用统一原型差异注意力机制显式评估正负语义亲和性以对齐异构变量，通过潜实体注意力在共享空间内高效执行跨变量交互，并使用变量重组路由器通过请求-分派机制鲁棒重建各变量轨迹。
AI.result: 在GIFT-Eval和fev-bench基准上达到最先进的预测性能。
AI.conclusion: Falcon-X为复杂多变量环境提供了一种有原则的、可扩展的预测范式，并已公开发布以支持未来研究。

title: UPOCR: Towards Unified Pixel-Level OCR Interface
summary: Existing optical character recognition (OCR) methods rely on task-specific designs with divergent paradigms, architectures, and training strategies, which significantly increases the complexity of research and maintenance and hinders the fast deployment in applications. To this end, we propose UPOCR, a simple-yet-effective generalist model for Unified Pixel-level OCR interface. Specifically, the UPOCR unifies the paradigm of diverse OCR tasks as image-to-image transformation and the architecture as a vision Transformer (ViT)-based encoder-decoder with learnable task prompts. The prompts push the general feature representations extracted by the encoder towards task-specific spaces, endowing the decoder with task awareness. Moreover, the model training is uniformly aimed at minimizing the discrepancy between the predicted and ground-truth images regardless of the inhomogeneity among tasks. Experiments are conducted on three pixel-level OCR tasks including text removal, text segmentation, and tampered text detection. Without bells and whistles, the experimental results showcase that the proposed method can simultaneously achieve state-of-the-art performance on three tasks with a unified single model, which provides valuable strategies and insights for future research on generalist OCR models. Code is available at https://github.com/shannanyinxiang/UPOCR.

AI.tldr: UPOCR提出了一种统一像素级OCR接口的通用模型，将文本去除、文本分割和篡改文本检测三种不同任务统一为图像到图像的转换范式，使用基于ViT的编码器-解码器架构加上可学习任务提示，以单一模型在三个任务上同时达到最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有OCR方法因任务特定设计导致范式、架构和训练策略各异，增加了研究和维护的复杂度，阻碍了快速部署。
AI.method: 将多样OCR任务统一为图像到图像转换范式；采用ViT-based编码器-解码器架构并引入可学习任务提示（task prompts）；训练目标统一为最小化预测图像与真实图像之间的差异。
AI.result: 在文本去除、文本分割和篡改文本检测三个像素级OCR任务上，单一统一模型同时达到了最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: UPOCR为通用OCR模型研究提供了有价值的策略和见解，验证了统一框架在多种像素级OCR任务上的有效性。

title: Detectability in Diversity: Improved Canary Crafting for Privacy Auditing in One Run
summary: Privacy auditing aims to empirically assess privacy leakage in machine learning models using membership inference attacks (MIAs), and to derive lower bounds on differential privacy (DP) parameters. Recent one-run auditing methods address the high cost of standard approaches by relying on a single training run with multiple "canary" points whose inclusion or exclusion must be detected by the auditor. In this work, we study the problem of efficiently crafting canaries for one-run privacy auditing. Motivated by recent theoretical insights suggesting that interference between canaries contributes to weaker leakage estimates compared to multi-run methods, we propose to optimize canaries to be both highly detectable and minimally interfering. Our approach combines a greedy initialization based on influence functions with a bilevel optimization procedure that maximizes distinguishability while promoting diversity in embedding space, enabling the use of computationally efficient bilevel algorithms. Experiments show that our method achieves stronger privacy leakage estimates at a lower computational cost than existing canary crafting approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文针对单次运行隐私审计中"金丝雀"点的设计问题，提出了一种结合影响函数贪婪初始化与双层优化的方法，生成高可检测性且低干扰的金丝雀，从而在更低计算成本下实现更强的隐私泄漏估计。
AI.motivation: 现有单次运行审计方法依赖多个"金丝雀"点进行隐私泄漏评估，但金丝雀之间的相互干扰导致泄漏估计弱于多次运行方法。为此，本文旨在设计一种既能高效检测又最小化相互干扰的金丝雀生成方法，以提升单次审计的效果。
AI.method: 提出一种结合影响函数贪婪初始化与双层优化的金丝雀构造方法：首先利用影响函数进行贪婪初始化，再通过双层优化同时最大化金丝雀的可区分性并促进嵌入空间的多样性，从而支持高效的双层优化算法。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在比现有金丝雀构造方法更低的计算成本下，实现了更强的隐私泄漏估计。
AI.conclusion: 通过优化金丝雀的可检测性与降低干扰，可以有效提升单次运行隐私审计的估计质量，为实际部署中的高效隐私审计提供了可行方案。

title: SRL-CLIP: Efficient CLIP Video Adaptation via Structured Semantic Role Labels
comment: Accepted to the CV4Smalls Workshop at CVPR 2026
summary: Adapting CLIP for videos has gained popularity due to its semantic and rich representation. While CLIP is a good starting point, it typically undergoes post-pretraining (contrastive finetuning) on large video narration or caption datasets (e.g. HowTo100M, WebVid2.5M). However, such narrations or captions often lack comprehensive information needed to represent a video holistically. As the learning signal from text is sparse, the visual learning is inefficient and adaptation requires millions of samples to post-pretrain. In this work, we ask: is it possible to efficiently adapt CLIP for general and holistic video understanding? We use videos labeled with structured and dense Semantic Role Labels (SRLs) that capture actions, people or objects, their attributes, adverbs (manner), and location in a structured format representing the entire video in a holistic way. We generate rule-based captions from SRLs and demonstrate that simple contrastive finetuning on a mere 23k video-caption pairs is adequate to learn powerful, transferable representations applicable across a diverse range of video understanding tasks that require varying levels of perceptual granularity. Our adapted CLIP model, SRL-CLIP, exhibits comparable or superior performance on zero-shot text-to-video retrieval compared to state-of-the-art models that possess 4-8x more parameters and are post-pretrained on up to 6000x more data. SRL-CLIP surpasses CLIP on multiple video benchmarks, underscoring the efficient learning and improved representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SRL-CLIP，利用结构化语义角色标注（SRL）生成的规则字幕，仅用23k视频-文本对进行对比微调，即可高效地将CLIP适配到视频理解任务，性能超越使用数百万数据后预训练的大模型。
AI.motivation: 现有CLIP视频适配方法依赖海量视频叙述/字幕数据进行对比微调，但这些文本标注信息稀疏、不全面，导致视觉学习效率低下，需要数百万样本才能完成后预训练。因此，研究者希望探索是否可以用更少的数据高效地将CLIP适配到通用的、整体的视频理解。
AI.method: 使用结构化且稠密的语义角色标签（SRLs）标注视频，SRLs以结构化格式捕获动作、人或物体及其属性、副词（方式）和位置，整体描述视频。从SRLs生成基于规则的字幕，仅用23k视频-字幕对进行简单的对比微调，得到SRL-CLIP模型。
AI.result: SRL-CLIP在零样本文本-视频检索任务上性能与或超过最先进模型（这些模型参数多4-8倍、训练数据多6000倍）。SRL-CLIP在多个视频基准上优于原版CLIP，展示了高效学习和改进的视频表示。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构化、稠密的视频标注（SRL）生成高质量字幕，可以极大地提高CLIP视频适配的数据效率，少量数据即可学到强大且可迁移的视频表示。

title: BASIS: Batchwise Advantage Estimation from Single-Rollout Information Sharing for LLM Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has become a standard recipe for improving the reasoning abilities of large language models. Existing algorithms face a tradeoff between computational efficiency and sample efficiency in value estimation and policy learning. We introduce BASIS, a critic-free post-training algorithm designed to address this tradeoff. At each online training step, BASIS samples only one rollout per prompt, but leverages rich information across prompts in the entire batch to improve value function estimation. Our experiments demonstrate that BASIS reduces MSE in value function estimation by 69% compared to REINFORCE++, a representative single-rollout baseline, and achieves lower MSE with one rollout than group mean estimators with 8 rollouts. This improvement in value estimation translates to better policy optimization: using substantially less training time, BASIS achieves performance close to multi-rollout GRPO-type baselines and often outperforms single-rollout REINFORCE-type baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BASIS，一种无评论家的后训练算法，通过利用批次内跨提示的丰富信息改进值函数估计，在仅采样一个轨迹的情况下，将值函数估计的MSE相比REINFORCE++降低69%，且优于使用8个轨迹的组均值估计器。BASIS在显著减少训练时间的同时，性能接近多轨迹GRPO基线，并常优于单轨迹REINFORCE基线。
AI.motivation: 现有基于可验证奖励的强化学习算法在计算效率与样本效率之间存在权衡：单次rollout方法计算高效但值估计不准，多次rollout方法值估计更准但计算开销大。本文旨在设计一种既保持单rollout计算效率、又能通过跨提示信息共享提升值估计质量的无评论家算法，以打破这一权衡。
AI.method: BASIS是一种无评论家（critic-free）后训练算法，每个在线训练步骤中每个提示仅采样一个rollout，但利用整个批次中所有提示的丰富信息来改进值函数估计。具体而言，它通过跨提示聚合信息来估计值函数，而非依赖评论家网络或多个rollout的平均。
AI.result: 1) 相比REINFORCE++，BASIS将值函数估计的MSE降低了69%；2) 使用单rollout即可达到比使用8个rollout的组均值估计器更低的MSE；3) 在显著减少训练时间的前提下，BASIS性能接近多rollout的GRPO类基线，并常优于单rollout的REINFORCE类基线。
AI.conclusion: BASIS成功解决了强化学习中单rollout与多rollout方法之间的效率-样本效率权衡，证明了通过跨提示信息共享可以在保持单rollout计算效率的同时实现高质量值估计，为大语言模型推理能力训练提供了一种高效且有效的替代方案。

title: CRoFT: Robust Fine-Tuning with Concurrent Optimization for OOD Generalization and Open-Set OOD Detection
summary: Recent vision-language pre-trained models (VL-PTMs) have shown remarkable success in open-vocabulary tasks. However, downstream use cases often involve further fine-tuning of VL-PTMs, which may distort their general knowledge and impair their ability to handle distribution shifts. In real-world scenarios, machine learning systems inevitably encounter both covariate shifts (e.g., changes in image styles) and semantic shifts (e.g., test-time unseen classes). This highlights the importance of enhancing out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization on covariate shifts and simultaneously detecting semantic-shifted unseen classes. Thus a critical but underexplored question arises: How to improve VL-PTMs' generalization ability to closed-set OOD data, while effectively detecting open-set unseen classes during fine-tuning? In this paper, we propose a novel objective function of OOD detection that also serves to improve OOD generalization. We show that minimizing the gradient magnitude of energy scores on training data leads to domain-consistent Hessians of classification loss, a strong indicator for OOD generalization revealed by theoretical analysis. Based on this finding, we have developed a unified fine-tuning framework that allows for concurrent optimization of both tasks. Extensive experiments have demonstrated the superiority of our method. The code is available at https://github.com/LinLLLL/CRoFT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种统一微调框架CRoFT，通过最小化训练数据上能量分数的梯度幅度来实现域一致的分类损失Hessian矩阵，从而在提升VL-PTMs对协变量偏移的泛化能力的同时，有效检测语义偏移的未见类别。
AI.motivation: VL-PTMs在下游微调后会扭曲通用知识，损害处理分布偏移的能力；现实场景中同时面临协变量偏移（如图像风格变化）和语义偏移（测试时未见类别），现有工作缺乏同时提升OOD泛化并检测开放集未见类别的统一方法。
AI.method: 提出最小化训练数据上能量分数的梯度幅度的目标函数，理论分析表明该操作可导致分类损失Hessian矩阵的域一致性，基于此构建统一微调框架，联合优化OOD检测与OOD泛化。
AI.result: 大量实验证明了该方法在OOD泛化和OOD检测任务上的优越性。
AI.conclusion: 能量分数梯度幅度最小化能同时提升VL-PTMs在协变量偏移下的泛化能力和语义偏移下的开放集检测能力，为视觉语言模型的鲁棒微调提供了有效统一框架。

title: Normal Guidance is what Attention Needs
summary: We consider training classifiers for 3D medical images using only one binary label for the entire volume rather than a label for each 2D slice. In such weakly supervised settings, can we learn accurate classifiers for slice-level predictions? Attention-based multiple instance learning (MIL) can produce an attention score for every slice. Yet recent work demonstrates that a simple center-focused baseline that ignores image content can outperform attention-based and transformer-based MIL at slice-level classification of 3D brain scans. We show this baseline also outperforms existing MIL at slice-level classification of thoracic and abdominal CT scans. Motivated by this baseline, we propose Normal Guidance, a regularization technique that encourages the learned attention distribution to follow a bell-shaped curve. Across three medical imaging datasets totaling over 4 million 2D slices, we show our Normal Guidance enables attention-based and transformer-based MIL methods to deliver significantly better slice-level localization than the state-of-the-art while remaining competitive at whole-scan classification.

AI.tldr: 针对3D医学图像仅有一个全局标签的弱监督场景，提出Normal Guidance正则化技术，引导注意力分布服从钟形曲线，使注意力机制和Transformer的MIL方法在切片级定位上显著优于现有方法，同时在整体扫描分类上保持竞争力。
AI.motivation: 在弱监督的3D医学图像分类中，仅使用整个体积的一个二分类标签来训练切片级分类器。已有研究表明，一个忽略图像内容的简单中心聚焦基线在切片级分类上反而优于基于注意力和Transformer的MIL方法。这暴露出现有MIL方法在弱监督切片定位上的不足，亟需改进。
AI.method: 提出Normal Guidance正则化技术，通过惩罚项鼓励学习到的注意力分布近似于钟形（高斯）曲线，从而约束注意力集中在扫描的中心区域附近，同时保留基于内容的重要性加权能力。
AI.result: 在三个医学影像数据集（共超过400万张2D切片）上，Normal Guidance使基于注意力和Transformer的MIL方法在切片级定位上显著优于现有最先进方法，同时在整体扫描分类上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: Normal Guidance是一种简单有效的正则化策略，能有效弥补弱监督3D医学图像分类中注意力MIL方法在切片定位上的不足，为临床可解释的切片级预测提供了实用方案。

title: AD-H: Language-guided Autonomous Driving with Hierarchical Agents
summary: Language-guided autonomous driving requires bridging a large abstraction gap between high-level natural-language instructions and low-level vehicle control. End-to-end approaches that use a single multimodal large language model (MLLM) to map language directly to actions struggle with this mismatch, often failing to exploit the reasoning capabilities of the model and exhibiting limited generalization beyond the distributions of driving datasets used for fine-tuning. To address this issue, we propose AD-H, a hierarchical multi-agent framework that explicitly separates high-level decision-making from low-level vehicle execution. At the upper level, an MLLM-based planner interprets natural-language commands and environmental context to generate coherent mid-level driving instructions. At the lower level, a lightweight controller converts these mid-level instructions into precise, continuous control actions. This decomposition aligns with the functional strengths of each component: the planner focuses on semantic reasoning and task decomposition, while the controller ensures stable and accurate actuation. To support large-scale training under this hierarchy, we design a rule-based pipeline that reconstructs mid-level commands from driving signals, producing 1.15 million hierarchical annotation pairs. Extensive experiments show that AD-H outperforms state-of-the-art models despite using fewer parameters, namely 3B plus 350M compared with 7B, and achieves superior long-horizon generalization and instruction-following performance. We make our data and code publicly accessible at https://github.com/zhangzaibin/AD-H

AI.tldr: AD-H提出一种层次化多智能体框架，将高层语义决策与低层车辆控制分离：上层MLLM规划器生成中层驾驶指令，下层轻量控制器执行连续控制。通过规则化管道从驾驶信号重建115万中层指令对，以3B+350M参数超越7B SOTA模型，在长程泛化和指令跟随上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端方法将自然语言直接映射到车辆控制，存在抽象鸿沟大、模型推理能力利用不足、对驾驶数据集分布外泛化有限的问题。
AI.method: 提出层次化多智能体框架AD-H：上层基于MLLM的规划器解析自然语言命令和环境上下文，生成中层驾驶指令；下层轻量控制器将中层指令转换为连续控制动作。设计规则化管道从驾驶信号重建中层指令，构建115万层次化标注对用于训练。
AI.result: AD-H以3B+350M参数（少于7B SOTA模型）取得更优性能，在长程泛化和指令跟随方面表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 层次化分解（语义推理+执行控制）能有效弥合语言与控制的抽象鸿沟，提升模型泛化能力；大规模层次化数据生成方法是有效的训练支撑。

title: Greening AI Inference with Accuracy and Latency-aware User Incentives
summary: The widespread use of AI services has raised concerns for its environmental sustainability, towards which recent studies have identified carbon emissions of AI inference as the major contributor. This paper introduces a framework for designing AI inference incentives based on the users' valuation for inference quality and latency, together with their environmental consciousness, while accounting for the tradeoff between carbon emissions and the two QoE parameters. Our approach can accommodate different tradeoffs, that depend on the size and complexity of the AI models and the allocation of resources to serve inference requests. The incentives can be offered through a practical two-tier service subscription that offers users a discount in exchange for reduced carbon emissions. The discounted service option gives the AI provider the flexibility to serve some percentage of inference requests at a lower quality and higher latency during periods of high carbon intensity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于用户对推理质量、延迟和环境意识的AI推理激励框架，通过两层服务订阅机制在减少碳排放的同时平衡用户体验质量。
AI.motivation: AI服务的广泛使用引发了环境可持续性担忧，而AI推理的碳排放是主要贡献者，现有研究缺乏有效的激励手段来引导用户行为以减少碳排放。
AI.method: 构建基于用户对推理质量和延迟的估值以及环境意识的激励框架，考虑碳排放与两个QoE参数之间的权衡，并通过两层服务订阅（提供折扣以换取减少碳排放）来实现。
AI.result: 该框架能够适应不同AI模型规模和资源分配下的碳排放-QoE权衡，折扣服务允许AI提供商在高碳强度期间以较低质量和较高延迟服务部分推理请求。
AI.conclusion: 通过经济激励（折扣）引导用户接受服务质量的适度下降，可以有效降低AI推理的碳排放，实现环境可持续性与用户体验之间的平衡。

title: Innovative Silicosis and Pneumonia Classification: Leveraging Graph Transformer Post-hoc Modeling and Ensemble Techniques
comment: Withdrawn by the authors because the manuscript contains incomplete and potentially misleading descriptions of the dataset construction and evaluation protocol, particularly in the Dataset and Experimental Setup sections. The work should not be cited or used as an independent reference in its current form
summary: This paper presents a comprehensive study on the classification and detection of Silicosis-related lung inflammation. Our main contributions include 1) the creation of a newly curated chest X-ray (CXR) image dataset named SVBCX that is tailored to the nuances of lung inflammation caused by distinct agents, providing a valuable resource for silicosis and pneumonia research community; and 2) we propose a novel deep-learning architecture that integrates graph transformer networks alongside a traditional deep neural network module for the effective classification of silicosis and pneumonia. Additionally, we employ the Balanced Cross-Entropy (BalCE) as a loss function to ensure more uniform learning across different classes, enhancing the model's ability to discern subtle differences in lung conditions. The proposed model architecture and loss function selection aim to improve the accuracy and reliability of inflammation detection, particularly in the context of Silicosis. Furthermore, our research explores the efficacy of an ensemble approach that combines the strengths of diverse model architectures. Experimental results on the constructed dataset demonstrate promising outcomes, showcasing substantial enhancements compared to baseline models. The ensemble of models achieves a macro-F1 score of 0.9749 and AUC ROC scores exceeding 0.99 for each class, underscoring the effectiveness of our approach in accurate and robust lung inflammation classification.

AI.tldr: 本文创建了SVBCX胸部X光数据集，并提出了一种融合图Transformer网络与传统深度神经网络的架构，结合平衡交叉熵损失函数，用于矽肺与肺炎的分类检测。集成模型在宏F1分数（0.9749）和AUC ROC（每类>0.99）上取得了优异表现。
AI.motivation: 矽肺相关肺部炎症的准确分类与检测在临床实践中具有重要意义，但现有数据集和模型在该特定任务上存在不足，亟需针对性的数据资源与更有效的深度学习方法。
AI.method: 1) 构建了专门针对矽肺与肺炎的胸部X光数据集SVBCX；2) 提出融合图Transformer网络与传统深度神经网络的混合架构；3) 采用平衡交叉熵（BalCE）损失函数处理类别不平衡；4) 探索集成学习策略以结合多个模型的优势。
AI.result: 在SVBCX数据集上，集成模型取得了宏F1分数0.9749，每类AUC ROC均超过0.99，显著优于基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 提出的方法在矽肺相关肺部炎症分类任务上实现了高精度与强鲁棒性，验证了图Transformer与平衡交叉熵损失函数在该领域的有效性，为矽肺诊断提供了可靠的技术方案。

title: Probabilistic Smoothing with Ratio-Monotone Transforms for Global Optimization
summary: Probabilistic smoothing is a standard tool for global optimization, but existing methods rely on Gaussian kernels and specific transforms, often resulting in strong hyperparameter sensitivity and limited robustness. We propose a general smoothing framework that combines flexible symmetric unimodal kernels with monotonic ratio-based transformations. Under mild conditions, we show that the smoothed objective preserves the global maximizer and that all stationary points concentrate near the true optimum for sufficiently large amplification, without requiring a decreasing smoothing schedule. We further provide explicit complexity bounds for stochastic gradient ascent and show that a leave-one-out baseline provably reduces variance. Experiments on high-dimensional benchmarks and black-box adversarial attacks demonstrate improved robustness and competitive performance.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合灵活对称单峰核与单调比率变换的通用概率平滑框架，无需递减平滑调度即可保持全局最优解，在随机梯度上升中具有显式复杂度界，实验证明其鲁棒性和竞争力。
AI.motivation: 现有基于高斯核的概率平滑方法对超参数敏感且鲁棒性有限，缺乏通用框架来处理非高斯核与非特定变换下的全局优化问题。
AI.method: 提出结合对称单峰核与单调比率变换的通用平滑框架；在温和条件下证明平滑目标保持全局最大值，且所有驻点在大放大因子下集中在真最优值附近；给出随机梯度上升的显式复杂度界；引入留一法基线降低方差。
AI.result: 在高维基准测试和黑盒对抗攻击实验中，该方法相比现有方法具有更优的鲁棒性和竞争性能。
AI.conclusion: 该通用平滑框架克服了传统高斯平滑的超参数敏感性问题，无需调度策略即可保证全局最优性，并提供了理论收敛保证。

title: ImViD: Immersive Volumetric Videos for Enhanced VR Engagement
summary:
User engagement is greatly enhanced by fully immersive multi-modal experiences that combine visual and auditory stimuli. Consequently, the next frontier in VR/AR technologies lies in immersive volumetric videos with complete scene capture, large 6-DoF interaction space, multi-modal feedback, and high resolution & frame-rate contents. To stimulate the reconstruction of immersive volumetric videos, we introduce ImViD, a multi-view, multi-modal dataset featuring complete space-oriented data capture and various indoor/outdoor scenarios. Our capture rig supports multi-view video-audio capture while on the move, a capability absent in existing datasets, significantly enhancing the completeness, flexibility, and efficiency of data capture.
  The captured multi-view videos (with synchronized audios) are in 5K resolution at 60FPS, lasting from 1-5 minutes, and include rich foreground-background elements, and complex dynamics. We benchmark existing methods using our dataset and establish a base pipeline for constructing immersive volumetric videos from multi-view audiovisual inputs for 6-DoF multi-modal immersive VR experiences. The benchmark and the reconstruction and interaction results demonstrate the effectiveness of our dataset and baseline method, which we believe will stimulate future research on immersive volumetric video production.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ImViD，一个多视角、多模态的沉浸式体积视频数据集，支持移动中的多视角视频-音频采集，包含多种室内外场景、5K分辨率60FPS、1-5分钟时长，并建立了从多视角视听输入构建6自由度多模态沉浸式VR体验的基线流程。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集缺乏移动中多视角视频-音频同步采集能力，无法满足沉浸式体积视频重建对数据完整性、灵活性和效率的需求。
AI.method: 设计并构建了支持移动中多视角视频-音频同步采集的捕获系统，采集了包含丰富前景-背景元素和复杂动态的5K@60FPS多视角视频数据集，并建立了从多视角视听输入到6-DoF多模态沉浸式VR体验的基线重建流程。
AI.result: 通过基准测试和重建及交互实验，验证了ImViD数据集和基线方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: ImViD数据集和基线方法将推动沉浸式体积视频制作的未来研究。

title: From Scores to Gibbs Correctors: Accelerating Uniform-Rate Discrete Diffusion Models
summary: Discrete diffusion models have achieved strong empirical performance in text and other symbolic domains, but, especially for uniform-rate models, they often require many steps to generate a single sample. Existing acceleration methods either rely on training additional quantities or suffer from slow mixing. In this work, we propose a novel Gibbs-based corrector for discrete diffusion models, termed Gibbs-Accelerated Discrete Diffusion (GADD). GADD leverages the structure of the concrete score function to construct Gibbs posterior likelihoods directly, without requiring any additional training beyond standard score estimation. We show that GADD achieves an overall sampling complexity of $\mathcal{O}(\mathrm{polylog} (\varepsilon^{-1}))$, yielding the first such rate for diffusion-based samplers for uniform-rate discrete diffusion models. We also conduct numerical experiments demonstrating the practical advantages of GADD across synthetic data, zero-shot text sampling, and zero-shot conditional music generation. These results corroborate the theory and show that GADD consistently improves sample quality and wall-clock efficiency over standard baselines, including vanilla Euler methods and CTMC correctors. Beyond this, our theoretical analysis introduces a novel framework for analyzing predictor-corrector methods in discrete diffusion models, which may be of independent interest. Unlike existing approaches that rely on the Girsanov change-of-measure technique, our method is based on an induction argument that tracks error propagation across predictor iterations while accounting for inaccuracies in the corrector updates.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于Gibbs的离散扩散模型校正器GADD，无需额外训练即可实现$\mathcal{O}(\mathrm{polylog} (\varepsilon^{-1}))$的采样复杂度，并在合成数据、零样本文本采样和条件音乐生成中验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散模型在文本等符号领域表现优异，但均匀速率模型需要大量采样步数，现有加速方法要么依赖额外训练，要么混合速度慢。
AI.method: 利用具体得分函数的结构直接构造Gibbs后验似然，无需在标准得分估计之外进行额外训练；提出基于归纳论证的预测-校正方法分析框架，追踪预测迭代中的误差传播并校正更新中的不准确性。
AI.result: GADD实现了$\mathcal{O}(\mathrm{polylog} (\varepsilon^{-1}))$的整体采样复杂度，这是均匀速率离散扩散模型的首个此类速率；实验表明GADD在样本质量和实际时间效率上持续优于标准基线。
AI.conclusion: GADD提供了一种无需额外训练的高效离散扩散模型加速方案，其理论分析框架对离散扩散模型中的预测-校正方法具有独立参考价值。

title: TailedCore: Few-Shot Sampling for Unsupervised Long-Tail Noisy Anomaly Detection
summary: We aim to solve unsupervised anomaly detection in a practical challenging environment where the normal dataset is both contaminated with defective regions and its product class distribution is tailed but unknown. We observe that existing models suffer from tail-versus-noise trade-off where if a model is robust against pixel noise, then its performance deteriorates on tail class samples, and vice versa. To mitigate the issue, we handle the tail class and noise samples independently. To this end, we propose TailSampler, a novel class size predictor that estimates the class cardinality of samples based on a symmetric assumption on the class-wise distribution of embedding similarities. TailSampler can be utilized to sample the tail class samples exclusively, allowing to handle them separately. Based on these facets, we build a memory-based anomaly detection model TailedCore, whose memory both well captures tail class information and is noise-robust. We extensively validate the effectiveness of TailedCore on the unsupervised long-tail noisy anomaly detection setting, and show that TailedCore outperforms the state-of-the-art in most settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TailSampler（基于对称性假设的类别数量预测器）和TailedCore（记忆库异常检测模型），解决无监督异常检测中正常数据集被污染且类别分布呈长尾分布的难题，缓解了尾部样本与像素噪声之间的权衡问题。
AI.motivation: 实际无监督异常检测场景中，正常数据集常被缺陷区域污染且产品类别分布呈未知长尾分布。现有模型面临尾部样本与像素噪声的权衡困境：对噪声鲁棒的模型在尾部类样本上性能下降，反之亦然。
AI.method: 1）提出TailSampler，基于嵌入相似度的类别级分布对称性假设来估计样本类别数量，实现尾部类样本的独立采样；2）构建基于记忆库的异常检测模型TailedCore，将尾部类样本与噪声样本分开处理，使记忆库既能捕捉尾部类信息又具备噪声鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在无监督长尾噪声异常检测设定下，TailedCore在大多数设置中优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过分离处理尾部类样本与噪声样本，可以有效缓解长尾噪声环境下的异常检测性能退化问题，验证了TailSampler和TailedCore的有效性。

title: Guiding LLM Post-training Data Engineering with Model Internals from Sparse Autoencoders
summary: Model internals encode rich information about how a large language model (LLM) processes its training data; however, post-training data engineering largely relies on external signals and ignores rich intrinsic signals lying in model internals. We propose SAERL, a data engineering framework for LLM reinforcement learning (RL). It models three intrinsic data properties: diversity, difficulty, and quality, using model internals extracted with Sparse Autoencoder (SAE), an advanced mechanistic interpretability tool. Each property grounds a concrete data engineering operation: SAE-space clustering with moderate batch mixing for batch diversity control, a difficulty proxy for easy-to-hard curriculum ordering, and a quality probe for data filtering. SAERL improves average accuracy by 3.00% over vanilla GRPO and reaches target accuracy with 20% fewer training steps on Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, with consistent gains across model scales and RL algorithms. Experiments show that SAE transfers effectively across model families and scales, serving as a lightweight and reusable data engineering tool. These results demonstrate that model internals are a powerful and practical source of signals for post-training data engineering.

AI.tldr: SAERL利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）提取模型内部信号，对LLM强化学习训练数据进行多样性、难度和质量三维度建模与工程化操作，在GRPO上提升3%准确率并节省20%训练步数。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM后训练数据工程（如强化学习中的数据筛选与排序）过度依赖外部信号（如奖励模型、人工标注），忽略了模型内部蕴含的丰富表征信息。作者希望利用可解释性工具SAE提取模型内在信号来指导数据工程。
AI.method: 提出SAERL框架，使用SAE提取模型内部表征，建模三个数据属性：（1）多样性——SAE空间聚类+适度批混合控制批次多样性；（2）难度——构建难度代理指标实现由易到难的课程排序；（3）质量——训练质量探针进行数据过滤。将这些操作集成到强化学习训练流程中。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B上，SAERL相比vanilla GRPO平均准确率提升3.00%，达到目标准确率时节省20%训练步数。SAE在不同模型家族和规模间有效迁移，作为轻量级可复用工具表现一致。
AI.conclusion: 模型内部信号（通过SAE提取）是后训练数据工程中强大且实用的信号来源，SAE可作为轻量级跨模型可迁移的数据工程工具。

title: MotionPRO: Exploring the Role of Pressure in Human MoCap and Beyond
summary: Existing human Motion Capture (MoCap) methods mostly focus on the visual similarity while neglecting the physical plausibility. As a result, downstream tasks such as driving virtual human in 3D scene or humanoid robots in real world suffer from issues such as timing drift and jitter, spatial problems like sliding and penetration, and poor global trajectory accuracy. In this paper, we revisit human MoCap from the perspective of interaction between human body and physical world by exploring the role of pressure. Firstly, we construct a large-scale human Motion capture dataset with Pressure, RGB and Optical sensors (named MotionPRO), which comprises 70 volunteers performing 400 types of motion, encompassing a total of 12.4M pose frames. Secondly, we examine both the necessity and effectiveness of the pressure signal through two challenging tasks: (1) pose and trajectory estimation based solely on pressure: We propose a network that incorporates a small kernel decoder and a long-short-term attention module, and proof that pressure could provide accurate global trajectory and plausible lower body pose. (2) pose and trajectory estimation by fusing pressure and RGB: We impose constraints on orthographic similarity along the camera axis and whole-body contact along the vertical axis to enhance the cross-attention strategy to fuse pressure and RGB feature maps. Experiments demonstrate that fusing pressure with RGB features not only significantly improves performance in terms of objective metrics, but also plausibly drives virtual humans (SMPL) in 3D scene. Furthermore, we demonstrate that incorporating physical perception enables humanoid robots to perform more precise and stable actions, which is highly beneficial for the development of embodied artificial intelligence. Project page is available at: https://nju-cite-mocaphumanoid.github.io/MotionPRO/

AI.tldr: 本文构建了包含压力、RGB和光学传感器的大规模人体运动捕捉数据集MotionPRO，提出通过压力信号进行姿态和轨迹估计，以及将压力与RGB融合的方法，显著提升了运动捕捉的物理合理性，并应用于虚拟人和人形机器人控制。
AI.motivation: 现有的人体运动捕捉方法过于关注视觉相似性而忽略物理合理性，导致驱动虚拟人或人形机器人时出现时序漂移、抖动、滑动、穿透以及全局轨迹精度差等问题。
AI.method: (1) 构建MotionPRO数据集：70名志愿者、400种动作类型、1240万帧姿态数据，包含压力、RGB和光学传感器信息。(2) 提出基于纯压力的姿态和轨迹估计网络，包含小核解码器和长短期注意力模块。(3) 提出压力与RGB融合方法，通过相机轴正交相似性约束和垂直轴全身接触约束增强跨注意力机制。
AI.result: 融合压力与RGB特征在客观指标上显著提升性能，能更合理地驱动3D场景中的虚拟人(SMPL)，并使机器人动作更精确稳定。
AI.conclusion: 引入物理感知（压力信号）能够有效提升人体运动捕捉的物理合理性，对虚拟人驱动和具身智能发展具有重要价值。

title: MobileMoE: Scaling On-Device Mixture of Experts
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) has become the de facto architecture for hundred-billion-parameter language models, yet its advantages at sub-billion scales for on-device deployment remain largely unexplored. To close this gap, we present MobileMoE, a family of on-device MoE language models with sub-billion active parameters (0.3-0.9B active and 1.3-5.3B total) that establish a new Pareto frontier for on-device LLMs. We first formulate an on-device MoE scaling law that jointly optimizes MoE architecture under mobile memory and compute constraints, identifying an on-device sweet spot - moderate sparsity with fine-grained and shared experts - that is simultaneously memory and compute-optimal. Building on the derived architectures, we train MobileMoE with a four-stage recipe covering pre-training, mid-training, instruction fine-tuning, and quantization-aware training, all on open-source datasets. Across 14 benchmarks, MobileMoE matches or exceeds leading on-device dense LLMs with 2-4$\times$ fewer inference FLOPs, and matches or surpasses the state-of-the-art MoE OLMoE-1B-7B with up to 60% fewer parameters. To bridge the last mile to mobile deployment, we provide the first efficient MoE inference on commodity smartphones with comprehensive on-device profiling. At comparable INT4 weight memory, MobileMoE-S delivers $1.8$-$3.8\times$ faster prefill and $2.2$-$3.4\times$ faster decode than the dense baseline MobileLLM-Pro.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MobileMoE，一组面向移动端的MoE语言模型（0.3-0.9B激活参数，1.3-5.3B总参数），通过新推导的移动端MoE缩放定律确定最优架构（适度稀疏+细粒度共享专家），配合四阶段训练流程，在14个基准上以2-4倍更少FLOPs匹配或超越现有密集模型，并在真实智能手机上实现高效推理加速（1.8-3.8倍prefill，2.2-3.4倍decode）。
AI.motivation: MoE架构在千亿参数大语言模型中已成为主流，但其在十亿参数以下、面向移动端部署场景的优势尚未被充分探索。现有工作缺乏针对移动设备内存和计算约束下MoE架构的系统性优化指导。
AI.method: (1) 推导面向移动端的MoE缩放定律，在内存和计算双重约束下联合优化MoE架构，发现"适度稀疏+细粒度共享专家"为最优配置；(2) 基于该架构训练MobileMoE系列模型，采用四阶段训练流程：预训练→中期训练→指令微调→量化感知训练，全部使用开源数据集；(3) 在真实智能手机上实现首个高效MoE推理引擎并完成全面性能剖析。
AI.result: MobileMoE在14个基准测试中，以2-4倍更少推理FLOPs匹配或超越领先的移动端密集LLM；相比最先进的MoE模型OLMoE-1B-7B，在参数减少60%的情况下性能相当或更优；在INT4量化下，MobileMoE-S相比密集基线MobileLLM-Pro实现1.8-3.8倍prefill加速和2.2-3.4倍decode加速。
AI.conclusion: MobileMoE证明了MoE架构在十亿参数以下移动端场景的有效性，通过架构-训练-推理的全链路优化，建立了移动端LLM的新Pareto前沿，为MoE模型在智能手机等资源受限设备上的实际部署提供了完整解决方案。

title: V2V3D: View-to-View Denoised 3D Reconstruction for Light-Field Microscopy
comment: CVPR 2025; New version: Fix NSFC ID
summary: Light field microscopy (LFM) has gained significant attention due to its ability to capture snapshot-based, large-scale 3D fluorescence images. However, existing LFM reconstruction algorithms are highly sensitive to sensor noise or require hard-to-get ground-truth annotated data for training. To address these challenges, this paper introduces V2V3D, an unsupervised view2view-based framework that establishes a new paradigm for joint optimization of image denoising and 3D reconstruction in a unified architecture. We assume that the LF images are derived from a consistent 3D signal, with the noise in each view being independent. This enables V2V3D to incorporate the principle of noise2noise for effective denoising. To enhance the recovery of high-frequency details, we propose a novel wave-optics-based feature alignment technique, which transforms the point spread function, used for forward propagation in wave optics, into convolution kernels specifically designed for feature alignment. Moreover, we introduce an LFM dataset containing LF images and their corresponding 3D intensity volumes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves high computational efficiency and outperforms the other state-of-the-art methods. These advancements position V2V3D as a promising solution for 3D imaging under challenging conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出V2V3D，一个无监督的view2view框架，通过联合优化图像去噪和3D重建，利用噪声独立性原理和波光学特征对齐技术，在光场显微镜重建中实现了高效、高质量的3D成像。
AI.motivation: 现有光场显微镜（LFM）重建算法对传感器噪声高度敏感，或者需要难以获取的真实标注数据用于训练，限制了其在实际中的应用。
AI.method: 提出V2V3D无监督框架：(1) 利用各视角噪声独立的假设，引入noise2noise原理进行有效去噪；(2) 提出基于波光学的特征对齐技术，将点扩散函数转化为卷积核用于特征对齐；(3) 统一架构联合优化图像去噪和3D重建。
AI.result: 在包含LF图像及其对应3D强度体积的数据集上进行实验，V2V3D实现了高计算效率，并在性能上超越了其他最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: V2V3D作为一种无监督的联合去噪与重建框架，为光场显微镜在挑战性条件下的3D成像提供了有前景的解决方案。

title: Datasets for Lane Detection in Autonomous Driving: A Comprehensive Review
summary: Accurate lane detection is essential for automated driving, enabling safe and reliable vehicle navigation across a variety of road scenarios. Numerous datasets have been introduced to support the development and evaluation of lane detection algorithms, each differing in terms of the amount of data, sensor types, annotation granularity, environmental conditions, and scenario diversity. This paper provides a comprehensive review of 20 publicly available lane detection datasets, systematically analyzing their characteristics, advantages, and limitations. We classify these datasets based on key performance indicators such as sensor resolution, annotation types and diversity of road and weather conditions using a novel multidimensional metric for dataset quality. By identifying existing challenges and research gaps, we highlight opportunities for future dataset improvements that can further drive innovation in robust lane detection. This review serves as a resource for researchers seeking appropriate datasets for robust lane detection and contributes to the broader goal of advancing autonomous driving.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了20个公开车道检测数据集，基于传感器分辨率、标注类型、道路和天气条件多样性等关键指标进行多维质量评估，识别了现有挑战和研究空白，为自动驾驶领域的车道检测研究提供了数据集选择参考和改进方向。
AI.motivation: 车道检测是自动驾驶的关键技术，但现有数据集在数据量、传感器类型、标注粒度、环境条件和场景多样性方面差异显著，缺乏系统的比较分析框架来指导研究人员选择合适的数据集，并推动未来数据集的改进。
AI.method: 对20个公开车道检测数据集进行综述，提出了一种新颖的多维数据集质量度量指标，从传感器分辨率、标注类型、道路和天气条件多样性等关键性能指标对数据集进行分类和系统分析。
AI.result: 系统性识别了各数据集的特征、优势与局限性，揭示了现有数据集存在的挑战和研究空白，为未来的数据集改进提供了方向。
AI.conclusion: 本综述为研究人员选择适合的车道检测数据集提供了参考资源，有助于推动鲁棒车道检测技术的创新和自动驾驶领域的整体进步。

title: Hands-On: Segmenting Individual Signs from Continuous Sequences
comment: Accepted in the 19th IEEE International Conference on Automatic Face and Gesture Recognition. Code Implementation Released
summary: This work tackles the challenge of continuous sign language segmentation, a key task with huge implications for sign language translation and data annotation. We propose a transformer-based architecture that models the temporal dynamics of signing and frames segmentation as a sequence labeling problem using the Begin-In-Out (BIO) tagging scheme. Our method leverages the HaMeR hand features, and is complemented with 3D Angles. Extensive experiments show that our model achieves state-of-the-art results on the DGS Corpus, while our features surpass prior benchmarks on BSLCorpus.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer的连续手语分割方法，将分割任务建模为序列标注问题（BIO标签方案），使用HaMeR手部特征和3D角度特征，在DGS语料库上取得了最优结果。
AI.motivation: 解决连续手语分割这一关键挑战，该任务对手语翻译和数据标注具有重要意义。
AI.method: 基于Transformer架构，采用BIO（Begin-In-Out）标签方案将手语分割建模为序列标注问题，利用HaMeR手部特征并辅以3D角度特征。
AI.result: 在DGS语料库上达到最优性能（state-of-the-art），所提特征在BSLCorpus上超越了先前基准。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的Transformer架构结合BIO标签方案和HaMeR+3D角度特征能够有效解决连续手语分割问题，在两个语料库上均表现优异。

title: Efficient All-Pairs Correlation Volume Sampling for Optical Flow Estimation
summary: Recent optical flow estimation methods often employ local cost sampling from a dense all-pairs correlation volume. This results in quadratic computational and memory complexity in the number of pixels. Although an alternative memory-efficient implementation with on-demand cost computation exists, this is significantly slower in practice and therefore many prior methods process images at downsampled resolutions, missing fine-grained details. To address this, we propose an algorithm for both memory and compute-efficient implementation of the all-pairs correlation volume sampling, still matching the exact mathematical operator as defined by RAFT. Our approach outperforms on-demand sampling by up to 92% while maintaining equally low memory usage, and performs at least on par with the default implementation with up to 99% lower memory usage. As cost sampling makes up a significant portion of the overall runtime, this can translate to up to 63% savings for the total end-to-end model inference on high-resolution inputs. Our evaluation of existing methods includes an 8K ultra-high-resolution dataset and an inference-time extension of the SEA-RAFT method. With this, we achieve state-of-the-art results at high resolutions both in accuracy and runtime.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种高效的全对偶相关体采样的算法，在保持与RAFT相同的精确数学运算的前提下，显著降低了内存和计算复杂度。相比于按需采样方法性能提升高达92%，相比于默认实现内存占用降低高达99%，端到端模型推理速度最高可提升63%，并在8K超高分辨率数据集上实现了SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有光流估计方法通常从密集的全对偶相关体中采样局部代价，导致像素数量的二次计算和内存复杂度。虽然存在按需计算的替代方案，但实际运行速度较慢，因此许多方法在降采样分辨率上处理图像，丢失了细粒度细节。本研究旨在解决这一矛盾。
