To validate and assess the generalisability of such a model, we also run simulations over synthetic classification data, varying distribution type and strength of the input measurement noise. We find for both real and synthetic data, the BQDA model presented is more trustworthy, in the sense that it is more interpretable, explicitly models the input measurement uncertainty, and maintains predictive performance of class probability outputs across datasets over different domains and sizes, whilst also being more computationally efficient.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个贝叶斯二次判别分析（BQDA）框架，将输入测量不确定性纳入生成式ML分类模型，并在遥感土地覆盖数据集上验证了其在可解释性、计算效率和预测性能方面的优势。
AI.motivation: 现有ML分类模型的不确定性量化主要关注认知不确定性，忽略了计量学中至关重要的输入测量不确定性，影响了可信AI的可追溯性。
AI.method: 基于贝叶斯框架构建生成式ML分类模型，以BQDA模型为具体实例，将其应用于Copernicus Sentinel-2遥感土地覆盖数据集，并通过合成数据（不同分布类型和噪声强度）验证泛化能力。
AI.result: 在真实和合成数据上，BQDA模型比随机森林、神经网络等模型更可信：可解释性更强、显式建模输入测量不确定性、跨域跨尺度保持预测性能且计算效率更高。
AI.conclusion: 将输入测量不确定性显式纳入贝叶斯生成式分类框架是提升模型可信度和计量可追溯性的有效路径。

title: Align & Invert: Solving Inverse Problems with Diffusion and Flow-based Models via Representation Alignment
summary: Enforcing alignment between the internal representations of diffusion or flow-based generative models and those of pretrained self-supervised encoders has recently been shown to provide a powerful inductive bias, improving both convergence and sample quality. In this work, we extend this idea to inverse problems, where pretrained generative models are employed as priors. We propose applying representation alignment (REPA) between diffusion or flow-based models and a DINOv2 visual encoder, to guide the reconstruction process at inference time. Although ground-truth signals are unavailable in inverse problems, we empirically show that aligning model representations of approximate target features can substantially enhance reconstruction quality and perceptual realism. We provide theoretical results showing (a) that REPA regularization can be viewed as a variational approach for minimizing a divergence measure in the DINOv2 embedding space, and (b) how under certain regularity assumptions REPA updates steer the latent diffusion states toward those of the clean image. These results offer insights into the role of REPA in improving perceptual fidelity. Finally, we demonstrate the generality of our approach by We integrate REPA into multiple state-of-the-art inverse problem solvers, and provide extensive experiments on super-resolution, box inpainting, Gaussian deblurring, and motion deblurring confirming that our method consistently improves reconstruction quality, while also providing efficiency gains reducing the number of required discretization steps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将表示对齐（REPA）技术应用于扩散/流模型与DINOv2视觉编码器之间，在逆问题求解的推理阶段引导重建过程。实验证明，该方法能显著提升超分辨率、图像修复、高斯去模糊和运动去模糊等任务的感知质量和重建精度，同时减少所需的离散化步数，提高计算效率。
AI.motivation: 先前研究表明，将生成模型内部表示与预训练自监督编码器对齐可提供强归纳偏置、加速收敛并提升样本质量。本文旨在将这一思想扩展到逆问题领域，在无真实信号的情况下，利用表示对齐引导推理过程，以改善重建质量。
AI.method: 在推理阶段，对扩散/流生成模型与DINOv2视觉编码器施加表示对齐（REPA）正则化，通过对齐模型对近似目标特征的表示来引导重建过程。理论上证明了REPA正则化等价于在DINOv2嵌入空间中最小化某种散度度量的变分方法，并在一定正则性假设下，REPA更新能将隐扩散状态引导至干净图像的状态。
AI.result: 在超分辨率、Box修复、高斯去模糊和运动去模糊四项逆问题上，集成REPA到多种先进解法器中均一致提升了重建质量，并且减少了所需的离散化步数，实现了效率提升。
AI.conclusion: REPA正则化提供了一种通用、有效的逆问题求解改进策略，通过表示对齐提升感知保真度，同时兼顾计算效率。理论分析为REPA如何改善感知质量提供了深刻见解。

title: Generating realistic global precipitation fields from modelled atmospheric circulation
comment: Accepted for publication at Climate Dynamics
summary: Improving the representation of precipitation in Earth system models (ESMs) is critical for assessing the impacts of climate change and especially of extreme events like floods and droughts. In existing ESMs, precipitation is not resolved explicitly, but represented by parameterizations. These typically rely on resolving approximated but computationally expensive column-based physics, not accounting for interactions between locations. They struggle to capture fine-scale precipitation processes and introduce significant biases. We present a novel approach, based on generative machine learning, which integrates a conditional diffusion model with a UNet architecture to generate accurate, high-resolution (0.25°) global daily precipitation fields from a small set of prognostic atmospheric variables. Unlike traditional parameterizations, our framework efficiently produces ensemble predictions, capturing uncertainties in precipitation, and does not require fine-tuning by hand. We train our model on the ERA5 reanalysis and present a method that allows us to apply it to unseen ESM data, enabling fast generation of probabilistic forecasts and climate scenarios. By leveraging interactions between global prognostic variables, our approach provides an alternative parameterization scheme that mitigates biases present in the ESM precipitation while maintaining consistency with its large-scale (annual) trends. This work demonstrates that complex precipitation patterns can be learned directly from large-scale atmospheric variables, offering a computationally efficient method to obtain high-resolution precipitation without the cost of running the dynamical model at such high resolution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于条件扩散模型与UNet架构的生成式机器学习方法，仅使用少量大气变量即可生成高分辨率（0.25°）全球日降水场，作为地球系统模型中传统参数化方案的替代，能有效减少降水偏差并生成集合预测。
AI.motivation: 现有地球系统模型（ESMs）中降水参数化方案计算昂贵、忽略空间相互作用、难以捕捉精细降水过程并引入显著偏差，亟需一种高效、准确的替代方案。
AI.method: 采用条件扩散模型结合UNet架构，以少量大气变量为条件，生成高分辨率（0.25°）全球日降水场；在ERA5再分析数据上训练，并提出方法使其可泛化到未见过的ESM数据，实现概率预测与气候情景生成。
AI.result: 模型能够高效生成集合预测并捕捉降水不确定性；在保持与ESM大尺度年际趋势一致性的同时，有效减轻了ESM降水中的偏差。
AI.conclusion: 复杂降水模式可以直接从大尺度大气变量中学习得到，该方法提供了一种计算高效的途径以获取高分辨率降水，无需运行高分辨率动力模型。

title: Efficient Transferable Optimal Transport via Min-Sliced Transport Plans
summary: Optimal Transport (OT) offers a powerful framework for finding correspondences between distributions and addressing matching and alignment problems in various areas of computer vision, including shape analysis, image generation, and multimodal tasks. The computation cost of OT, however, hinders its scalability. Slice-based transport plans have recently shown promise for reducing the computational cost by leveraging the closed-form solutions of 1D OT problems. These methods optimize a one-dimensional projection (slice) to obtain a conditional transport plan that minimizes the transport cost in the ambient space. While efficient, these methods leave open the question of whether learned optimal slicers can transfer to new distribution pairs under distributional shift. Understanding this transferability is crucial in settings with evolving data or repeated OT computations across closely related distributions. In this paper, we study the min-Sliced Transport Plan (min-STP) framework and investigate the transferability of optimized slicers: can a slicer trained on one distribution pair yield effective transport plans for new, unseen pairs? Theoretically, we show that optimized slicers remain close under slight perturbations of the data distributions, enabling efficient transfer across related tasks. To further improve scalability, we introduce a minibatch formulation of min-STP and provide statistical guarantees on its accuracy. Empirically, we demonstrate that the transferable min-STP achieves strong one-shot matching performance and facilitates amortized training for point cloud alignment and flow-based generative modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文研究最小切片传输计划（min-STP）框架中优化切片的可迁移性，证明在轻微数据扰动下优化切片保持稳定，并提出小批量版本以提升可扩展性，在点云对齐和流生成建模中实现高效迁移。
AI.motivation: 最优传输（OT）计算成本高，切片方法虽能降低复杂度，但优化后的切片能否在分布偏移下迁移到新的分布对尚不明确。理解迁移性对于数据动态变化或需要重复计算OT的场景至关重要。
AI.method: 理论分析了min-STP框架中优化切片的迁移性，证明其在数据分布轻微扰动下保持稳定；引入小批量min-STP公式并给出统计保证。
AI.result: 迁移性min-STP在一次性匹配任务中表现优异，并能在点云对齐和基于流的生成建模中实现摊销训练。
AI.conclusion: 优化的切片具有可迁移性，能够高效处理新分布对的传输计划计算，显著提升OT在相关任务间的可扩展性。

title: PLAID: A Unified Data Model for Machine Learning on Heterogeneous Physics Simulations
comment: Presented at EuRIPS 2025 and accepted at the AI4Physics Workshop @ ICML 2026
summary: Machine learning-based surrogate models have emerged as a powerful tool to accelerate simulation-driven scientific workflows, but their adoption is limited by the lack of large-scale, diverse, and standardized datasets for physics-based simulations. Existing benchmarks often focus on narrow domains or rely on simplified data models, and fail to capture the heterogeneity arising from variable geometries, meshes, and topologies, which is critical for assessing generalization in realistic settings. We introduce PLAID (Physics-Learning AI Data model), a unified and extensible data layer for heterogeneous physics simulations. It preserves the full complexity of simulation data while enabling efficient and scalable machine learning workflows, together with a library for dataset construction and manipulation~(\href{https://github.com/PLAID-lib/plaid}{github.com/PLAID-lib/plaid}). We release six datasets covering structural mechanics and computational fluid dynamics, designed to reflect realistic industrial scenarios and provide standardized benchmarks. The framework includes reproducible evaluation protocols and is integrated with Hugging Face to enable open, community-driven benchmarking with active user participation (\href{https://huggingface.co/PLAIDcompetitions}{huggingface.co/PLAIDcompetitions}).

AI.tldr: PLAID是一个统一可扩展的物理仿真数据层，提供了6个覆盖结构力学和计算流体力学的标准化数据集，并集成Hugging Face平台，旨在推动基于机器学习的代理模型在异构物理仿真中的基准测试和社区协作。
AI.motivation: 现有基于机器学习的物理仿真代理模型缺乏大规模、多样化、标准化的数据集；现有基准测试局限于窄领域或简化数据模型，未能捕捉真实场景中几何、网格和拓扑的异质性，难以评估模型的泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出PLAID数据模型，作为统一可扩展的数据层，保留仿真数据的完整复杂性；构建数据集构建与操作库；发布6个覆盖结构力学和计算流体力学的数据集；设计可复现的评估协议；集成Hugging Face平台支持社区驱动基准测试。
AI.result: 发布6个覆盖结构力学和计算流体力学的标准化数据集，提供可复现的评估协议，并在Hugging Face上开放社区基准测试平台。
AI.conclusion: PLAID通过统一数据模型和标准化基准，有望推动机器学习代理模型在异构物理仿真中的泛化评估和社区协作发展。

title: Unique Lives, Shared World: Learning from Single-Life Videos
summary: We introduce the "single-life" learning paradigm, where we train a distinct vision model exclusively on egocentric videos captured by one individual. We leverage the multiple viewpoints naturally captured within a single life to learn a visual encoder in a self-supervised manner. Our experiments demonstrate three key findings. First, models trained independently on different lives develop a highly aligned geometric understanding. We demonstrate this by training visual encoders on distinct datasets each capturing a different life, both indoors and outdoors, as well as introducing a novel cross-attention-based metric to quantify the functional alignment of the internal representations developed by different models. Second, we show that single-life models learn generalizable geometric representations that effectively transfer to downstream tasks, such as depth estimation, in unseen environments. Third, we demonstrate that training on up to 30 hours from one week of the same person's life leads to comparable performance to training on 30 hours of diverse web data, highlighting the strength of single-life representation learning. Overall, our results establish that the shared structure of the world, both leads to consistency in models trained on individual lives, and provides a powerful signal for visual representation learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"单生命周期"学习范式：仅用一个人的自我中心视频独立训练视觉模型，发现不同人训练出的模型具有高度对齐的几何理解，且能泛化到未见环境，在30小时数据量下性能与30小时多样化网络数据相当。
AI.motivation: 探索是否仅利用单一个人自我中心视频中的多视角信息，就能学出具有一致性和泛化能力的视觉表征，挑战当前依赖大规模多样化数据的主流范式。
AI.method: 在单一个人的自我中心视频上独立训练视觉编码器（自监督），提出基于交叉注意力的新指标量化不同模型内部表征的功能对齐程度；在室内外多个数据集上进行实验。
AI.result: (1) 不同人独立训练的模型几何理解高度对齐；(2) 模型学到的几何表征可泛化至未见环境下的深度估计等下游任务；(3) 30小时单个人视频与30小时多样化网络数据性能相当。
AI.conclusion: 世界的共享结构既使不同个体训练的模型趋于一致，也为视觉表征学习提供了强有力的信号。

title: Beyond Semantics: The Unreasonable Effectiveness of Reasonless Intermediate Tokens
comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
summary: Recent impressive results from large reasoning models have been interpreted as a triumph of Chain of Thought (CoT), and especially of the process of training on CoTs sampled from base LLMs in order to help find new reasoning patterns. While these traces certainly seem to help model performance, it is not clear how they influence it, with some works ascribing semantics to them and others cautioning against relying on them as transparent and faithful proxies of the model's internal computational process. To systematically investigate the role of end-user semantics of derivational traces, we set up a controlled study where we train transformer models from scratch on formally verifiable reasoning traces and the solutions they lead to. We notice that, despite gains over the solution-only baseline, models trained on entirely correct traces can still produce invalid reasoning traces even when arriving at correct solutions. More interestingly, our experiments also show that models trained on corrupted traces, whose intermediate reasoning steps bear no relation to the problem they accompany, perform similarly to those trained on correct ones, and even generalize better on out-of-distribution tasks. We also study the effect of GRPO-based RL post-training on trace validity, noting that while solution accuracy increases, this is not accompanied by improvements in trace validity. Finally, we examine whether reasoning-trace length reflects inference-time scaling and find that trace length is largely agnostic to the underlying computational complexity of the problem being solved. These results challenge the assumption that intermediate tokens or ``Chains of Thought'' reflect or induce predictable reasoning behaviors and caution against anthropomorphizing such outputs or over-interpreting them (despite their mostly seemingly forms) as evidence of human-like or algorithmic behaviors in language models.

AI.tldr: 本文通过可控实验发现，训练Transformer模型使用正确的思维链（CoT）推理轨迹并不能保证模型生成有效的推理过程，而使用与问题无关的 corrupted 轨迹训练反而能取得类似甚至更好的泛化性能。GRPO后训练虽提升答案准确率，但无助于推理轨迹的有效性。轨迹长度与问题计算复杂度无关。这些结果挑战了CoT反映或诱导可预测推理行为的假设。
AI.motivation: 探究思维链（CoT）推理轨迹的端用户语义对模型性能的实际影响，质疑CoT轨迹是否真的反映了模型内部的计算过程，还是仅仅提供了表面的语义形式。
AI.method: 从零开始训练Transformer模型，使用形式上可验证的推理轨迹及其对应解决方案，设置对照实验：正确轨迹 vs 损坏轨迹（中间步骤与问题无关），并进行GRPO-based RL后训练，分析轨迹有效性和长度与计算复杂度的关系。
AI.result: (1) 训练于正确轨迹的模型仍可产生无效推理轨迹；(2) 训练于损坏轨迹的模型性能与正确轨迹相当，在分布外任务上泛化更佳；(3) GRPO后训练提升答案准确率，但轨迹有效性无改善；(4) 轨迹长度与问题计算复杂度无关。
AI.conclusion: CoT轨迹并非可靠的推理行为指示器，其表面形式具有欺骗性，不应过度拟人化或过度解读为类人推理或算法行为的证据。

title: LiM-YOLO: Less is More with Pyramid Level Shift for Ship Detection in Optical Remote Sensing
summary: General-purpose object detectors face fundamental structural limitations when applied to ship detection in satellite imagery, where the ship scale distribution is concentrated at small sizes and high aspect ratios. In conventional You Only Look Once architectures, the deepest feature pyramid level (stride 32) compresses narrow vessels into sub-pixel representations, causing severe spatial feature dilution and compromising accurate ship boundary regression. We propose Less is More YOLO, a streamlined detector built upon the extra-large variant of YOLOv9, to address these domain-specific structural conflicts. From a statistical analysis of ship scale distributions across four major benchmarks (SODA-A, DOTA-v1.5, FAIR1M-v2.0, and ShipRSImageNet), we introduce a Pyramid Level Shift Strategy that shifts the detection head from strides 8, 16, and 32 to strides 4, 8, and 16. This shift satisfies a spatial representability condition derived from the Nyquist-Shannon principle for the narrowest targets, while eliminating the computational redundancy of the deepest pyramid level. To further stabilize training on high-resolution satellite inputs, we incorporate a group-normalized auxiliary projection module that introduces Group Normalization into the projection path, mitigating gradient instability in memory-constrained micro-batch regimes. Validated on these four datasets, our detector attains an mAP_{50-95} of 0.600 with only 21.16 million parameters, a 64.1% reduction from the extra-large YOLOv9 baseline (58.99 million). Despite this compact size, our model surpasses state-of-the-art detectors up to three times larger, validating that a well-targeted pyramid level shift achieves a "Less is More" balance between accuracy and efficiency. The code is available at https://github.com/egshkim/LiM-YOLO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Less is More YOLO (LiM-YOLO)，通过将YOLOv9的检测头从步长8/16/32下移至4/8/16（基于奈奎斯特-香农原理），解决了卫星图像中小尺度、高长宽比船只检测中深层特征图空间特征稀释的问题。模型参数量仅21.16M（较YOLOv9x减少64.1%），在四个基准数据集上达到0.600 mAP_{50-95}，超越三倍于其规模的SOTA检测器。
AI.motivation: 通用目标检测器在卫星图像船舶检测中存在根本性结构缺陷：YOLO架构中最深特征金字塔层（步长32）将狭窄船只压缩为亚像素表示，导致空间特征严重稀释，影响边界框回归精度。
AI.method: 1) 金字塔层级移位策略：基于对四个基准数据集船舶尺度分布的统计分析，将检测头从步长8/16/32移位至4/8/16，满足奈奎斯特-香农原理对最窄目标的空间可表示性条件，同时消除最深金字塔层的计算冗余。2) 分组归一化辅助投影模块：在投影路径引入Group Normalization，缓解高分辨率卫星输入下微批量训练中的梯度不稳定问题。
AI.result: 在SODA-A、DOTA-v1.5、FAIR1M-v2.0、ShipRSImageNet四个数据集上，LiM-YOLO以21.16M参数达到0.600 mAP_{50-95}，参数量较YOLOv9x（58.99M）减少64.1%，性能超越三倍于其规模的SOTA检测器。
AI.conclusion: 通过精心设计的金字塔层级移位，可以在精度与效率之间实现"少即是多"的平衡，验证了针对特定领域结构冲突的轻量化改进比盲目扩大模型规模更为有效。

title: OCR-Reasoning Benchmark: Unveiling the True Capabilities of MLLMs in Complex Text-Rich Image Reasoning
summary: Recent advancements in multimodal slow-thinking systems have demonstrated remarkable performance across various visual reasoning tasks. However, their capabilities in text-rich image reasoning tasks remain understudied due to the absence of a dedicated and systematic benchmark. To address this gap, we propose OCR-Reasoning, a novel benchmark designed to systematically assess Multimodal Large Language Models on text-rich image reasoning tasks. Specifically, OCR-Reasoning comprises 1,069 human-annotated examples spanning 6 core reasoning abilities and 18 practical reasoning tasks in text-rich visual scenarios. Unlike existing text-rich image understanding benchmarks that only provide a final answer, this benchmark additionally provides a detailed step-by-step reasoning process. This dual annotation enables the evaluation of both the models' final answers and their reasoning processes, thereby offering a holistic assessment of text-rich reasoning capabilities. By leveraging this benchmark, we conducted a comprehensive evaluation of the latest MLLMs. Our results demonstrate that even the most advanced MLLMs exhibit substantial difficulties in text-rich image reasoning tasks, with none achieving an accuracy above 50\% on our benchmark, indicating that the challenges of text-rich image reasoning are an urgent issue to be addressed. The benchmark and evaluation scripts are available at https://github.com/SCUT-DLVCLab/OCR-Reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出了OCR-Reasoning基准，包含1,069个手工标注的文本丰富图像推理样本，覆盖6种核心推理能力和18项推理任务，并附带详细推理过程。评估表明最先进的MLLMs准确率均低于50%，揭示了文本丰富图像推理任务的巨大挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态慢思考系统在视觉推理任务中表现出色，但文本丰富图像推理能力缺乏专门且系统的基准进行研究。
AI.method: 构建OCR-Reasoning基准，包含1,069个人工标注样本，覆盖6种核心推理能力和18项实际推理任务，提供最终答案和逐步推理过程的双重标注，用于系统评估MLLMs的文本丰富图像推理能力。
AI.result: 最先进的MLLMs在文本丰富图像推理任务中准确率均低于50%，表明现有模型在该任务上存在显著困难。
AI.conclusion: 文本丰富图像推理是亟待解决的重要挑战，OCR-Reasoning基准为这一方向提供了系统评估工具。

title: SketchAssist: A Practical Assistant for Semantic Edits and Precise Local Redrawing
summary: Sketch editing requires jointly handling high-level semantic changes and precise local redrawing, a combination that is particularly challenging for sparse, style-sensitive line art. Unlike natural images, sketches rely on minimal visual cues, making it difficult for existing methods to reconcile global semantic modifications with fine-grained structural control while preserving overall coherence. We present SketchAssist, an interactive sketch assistant that unifies instruction-guided editing with line-guided region redrawing, enabling efficient and controllable sketch manipulation while preserving overall composition. To support this task, we introduce a controllable data generation pipeline that constructs structured edit sequences with precise attribute variations and maintains structural alignment across multi-step modifications, while expanding stylistic diversity via style-preserving transformations. Building on this data, SketchAssist adopts a unified framework based on DiT, using a multi-channel input representation to encode sketches, masks, and guidance signals within a single interface. To further handle different editing modes, we integrate a Task-guided Mixture-of-Experts (T-MoE) into LoRA layers, enabling adaptive control over semantic and structural guidance. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on both tasks, achieving strong instruction adherence and improved structural and style consistency compared to recent methods. Together, our method provide a practical and controllable solution for sketch editing.

AI.tldr: SketchAssist是一个交互式草图编辑助手，通过统一指令引导编辑和线条引导区域重绘，结合可控数据生成管道和基于DiT的统一框架，以及任务引导的混合专家（T-MoE）机制，实现了对稀疏、风格敏感的线条艺术的高效可控编辑，在指令遵循、结构一致性和风格一致性方面达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 草图编辑面临高层次的语义变化和精确的局部重绘之间的双重挑战。与自然图像不同，草图依赖极少的视觉线索，现有方法难以在全局语义修改与细粒度结构控制之间取得平衡，同时保持整体一致性。
AI.method: 提出SketchAssist框架：(1) 可控数据生成管道，构建结构化编辑序列并扩展风格多样性；(2) 基于DiT的统一框架，采用多通道输入表示编码草图、掩码和引导信号；(3) 任务引导的混合专家（T-MoE）集成到LoRA层中，实现对语义和结构引导的自适应控制。
AI.result: 在两个任务上均达到SOTA性能，相比近期方法，在指令遵循、结构一致性和风格一致性方面有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: SketchAssist为草图编辑提供了一种实用且可控的解决方案，统一了指令引导编辑和线条引导区域重绘两种模式，实现了高效、可控的草图编辑。

title: Message-Passing State-Space Models: Improving Graph Learning with Modern Sequence Modeling
summary: The recent success of State-Space Models (SSMs) in sequence modeling has motivated their adaptation to graph learning, giving rise to Graph State-Space Models (GSSMs). However, existing GSSMs operate by applying SSM modules to sequences extracted from graphs, often compromising core properties such as permutation equivariance, message-passing compatibility, and computational efficiency. In this paper, we introduce a new perspective by embedding the key principles of modern SSM computation directly into the Message-Passing Neural Network framework, resulting in a unified methodology for both static and temporal graphs. Our approach, MP-SSM, enables efficient, permutation-equivariant, and long-range information propagation while preserving the architectural simplicity of message passing. Crucially, MP-SSM enables an exact sensitivity analysis, which we use to theoretically characterize information flow and evaluate issues like vanishing gradients and over-squashing in the deep regime. Furthermore, our design choices allow for a highly optimized parallel implementation akin to modern SSMs. We validate MP-SSM across a wide range of tasks, including node classification, graph property prediction, long-range benchmarks, and spatiotemporal forecasting, demonstrating both its versatility and strong empirical performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MP-SSM，将状态空间模型的核心计算原理嵌入消息传递神经网络框架中，统一处理静态和时序图，实现高效、置换等变的长程信息传播，并通过精确敏感性分析理论刻画信息流与梯度问题，在多种图任务上取得优异性能。
AI.motivation: 现有图状态空间模型（GSSMs）通过将SSM模块应用于从图中提取的序列，往往牺牲了置换等变性、消息传递兼容性和计算效率，亟需一种既能保持SSM优势又与图结构天然兼容的新方法。
AI.method: 将现代SSM计算的核心原理直接嵌入消息传递神经网络框架，提出MP-SSM，支持静态图和时序图的统一建模，并设计高效并行实现以类比现代SSM的优化方式。
AI.result: 在节点分类、图属性预测、长程基准测试和时空预测等多个任务上验证了MP-SSM的通用性和强实证性能。
AI.conclusion: MP-SSM通过将SSM原理融入消息传递范式，实现了置换等变、高效计算和长程信息传播的统一，并提供了精确的敏感性分析工具来理解深层模型中的梯度消失和过挤压问题。

title: No Data? No Problem: Robust Vision-Tabular Learning with Missing Values
summary: Large-scale medical biobanks provide imaging data complemented by extensive tabular information, such as clinical measurements or demographics. However, this abundance of tabular attributes does not reflect real-world datasets, where only a subset of attributes may be available. This discrepancy calls for methods that remain robust to missing values at inference. To address this challenge, we propose RoVTL (Robust Vision-Tabular Learning), a framework designed to handle any level of tabular data availability, from 0% to 100%. RoVTL comprises two key stages: contrastive pretraining, where we introduce tabular attribute missingness as data augmentation to promote robustness, and downstream task tuning, where tabular missingness is complemented by a novel Tabular More vs. Fewer loss that ranks performance based on the amount of available tabular data. Combined with gated-cross attention fusion module, our tuning approach enables consistent performance across all tabular data completeness scenarios. We evaluate RoVTL on cardiac MRI scans from the UK Biobank, demonstrating superior robustness to missing tabular data compared to prior methods. Furthermore, RoVTL successfully generalizes to an external cardiac MRI dataset for multimodal disease classification, and extends to the natural images domain, achieving robust performance on a car advertisements dataset. The model weights and code are available at https://github.com/marteczkah/RoVTL.

AI.tldr: 提出RoVTL框架，通过对比预训练（将表格属性缺失作为数据增强）和下游任务微调（新颖的Tabular More vs. Fewer损失函数结合门控交叉注意力融合模块），实现从0%到100%任意表格数据缺失率下鲁棒的多模态学习，在心脏MRI和自然图像数据集上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 大型医疗生物样本库提供丰富的影像和表格数据，但实际场景中表格属性往往只有子集可用，现有方法对推理时表格数据缺失的鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: RoVTL框架包括两个阶段：(1) 对比预训练，将表格属性缺失作为数据增强以提升鲁棒性；(2) 下游任务微调，采用Tabular More vs. Fewer损失函数根据可用表格数据量排序性能，并结合门控交叉注意力融合模块。
AI.result: 在UK Biobank心脏MRI数据上，RoVTL在表格数据缺失场景下优于现有方法；在外部心脏MRI数据集和自然图像（汽车广告数据集）上均展现出良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: RoVTL框架能有效处理任意比例的表格数据缺失问题，在医疗影像和自然图像多模态任务中均表现出鲁棒性，代码已开源。

title: Learnable Kernel Density Estimation for Graphs and Its Application to Graph-Level Anomaly Detection
comment: Accepted in the Forty-Third International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026), Main Track
summary: This work proposes a framework LGKDE that learns kernel density estimation for graphs. The key challenge in graph density estimation lies in effectively capturing both structural patterns and semantic variations while maintaining theoretical guarantees. Combining graph kernels and kernel density estimation (KDE) is a standard approach to graph density estimation, but has unsatisfactory performance due to the handcrafted and fixed features of kernels. Our method LGKDE leverages graph neural networks to represent each graph as a discrete distribution and utilizes maximum mean discrepancy to learn the graph metric for multi-scale KDE, where all parameters are learned by maximizing the density of graphs relative to the density of their well-designed perturbed counterparts. The perturbations are conducted on both node features and graph spectra, which helps better characterize the boundary of normal density regions. Theoretically, we establish consistency and convergence guarantees for LGKDE, including bounds on the mean integrated squared error, robustness, and generalization. We validate LGKDE by demonstrating its effectiveness in recovering the underlying density of synthetic graph distributions and applying it to graph anomaly detection across diverse benchmark datasets. Extensive empirical evaluation shows that LGKDE demonstrates superior performance compared to state-of-the-art baselines on most benchmark datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出LGKDE框架，利用图神经网络和最大均值差异学习图密度估计，通过对节点特征和图谱的扰动来优化参数，在理论上保证了一致性和收敛性，在图异常检测任务上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有图核+KDE方法因使用手工设计且固定的特征，在图密度估计中表现不佳，无法有效同时捕获结构模式和语义变化。
AI.method: 利用GNN将每个图表示为离散分布，采用最大均值差异学习多尺度KDE的图度量；通过对节点特征和图谱进行扰动来定义正常密度区域的边界，所有参数通过最大化图密度相对于扰动版本的密度来学习。
AI.result: 在合成图分布上能有效恢复真实密度，在图异常检测的多个基准数据集上优于最先进的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: LGKDE是一种兼具理论保证和实际性能的图密度估计方法，在手工艺品特征限制和图结构语义捕获方面取得了突破。

title: Guiding Token-Sparse Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models deliver high quality in image synthesis but remain expensive during training and inference. Recent works have leveraged the inherent redundancy in visual content to make training more affordable by training only on a subset of visual information. While these methods were successful in providing cheaper and more effective training, sparsely trained diffusion models struggle in inference. This is due to their lacking response to Classifier-free Guidance (CFG) leading to underwhelming performance during inference. To overcome this, we propose Sparse Guidance (SG). Instead of using conditional dropout as a signal to guide diffusion models, SG uses token-level sparsity. As a result, SG preserves the high-variance of the conditional prediction better, achieving good quality and high variance outputs. Leveraging token-level sparsity at inference, SG improves fidelity at lower compute, achieving 1.58 FID on the commonly used ImageNet-256 benchmark with 25% fewer FLOPs, and yields up to 58% FLOP savings at matched baseline quality. To demonstrate the effectiveness of Sparse Guidance, we train a 2.5B text-to-image diffusion model using training time sparsity and leverage SG during inference. SG achieves improvements in composition and human preference score while increasing throughput at the same time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出稀疏引导（SG）方法，通过在推理阶段利用令牌级稀疏性替代条件丢弃，解决了稀疏训练扩散模型在分类器自由引导（CFG）下表现不佳的问题，在ImageNet-256上以更少FLOPs取得更优FID，并在2.5B文生图模型中提升了组合质量与人类偏好分数。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型在训练和推理阶段计算成本高昂。近期工作利用视觉内容的冗余性通过仅训练部分视觉信息来降低训练成本，但这类稀疏训练的扩散模型在推理时因对CFG响应不足导致性能下降。
AI.method: 提出Sparse Guidance (SG)，用令牌级稀疏性代替条件丢弃作为引导信号，在推理时保留条件预测的高方差特性，从而在低计算量下提升生成保真度。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-256上FID达1.58，减少25% FLOPs；在匹配基线质量时可节省最高58% FLOPs。在2.5B文生图模型中，SG提升了组合质量与人类偏好分数，同时增加了吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: SG有效克服了稀疏训练扩散模型在推理时对CFG响应不足的问题，实现了质量与效率的双重提升，并证明了该方法在大规模文生图模型中的有效性。

title: Muddit: Liberating Generation Beyond Text-to-Image with a Unified Discrete Diffusion Model
comment: Accepted to ICLR 2026. Codes and Supplementary Material: https://github.com/M-E-AGI-Lab/Muddit
summary: Unified generation models aim to handle diverse tasks across modalities -- such as text generation, image generation, and vision-language reasoning -- within a single architecture and decoding paradigm. Autoregressive unified models suffer from slow inference due to sequential decoding, and non-autoregressive unified models suffer from weak generalization due to limited pretrained backbones. We introduce the second-generation Meissonic: Muddit, a unified discrete diffusion transformer that enables fast and parallel generation across both text and image modalities. Unlike prior unified diffusion models trained from scratch, Muddit integrates strong visual priors from a pretrained text-to-image backbone with a lightweight text decoder, enabling flexible and high-quality multimodal generation under a unified architecture. Empirical results show that Muddit achieves competitive or superior performance compared to significantly larger autoregressive models in both quality and efficiency. The work highlights the potential of purely discrete diffusion, when equipped with strong visual priors, as a scalable and effective backbone for unified generation.

AI.tldr: Muddit 是一个统一的离散扩散 Transformer，融合了预训练文本到图像骨干网络的视觉先验和轻量文本解码器，实现文本和图像模态的快速并行生成，在质量和效率上可与更大规模的自回归模型媲美。
AI.motivation: 统一生成模型面临两难：自回归模型推理慢，非自回归模型因缺乏预训练骨干而泛化弱。现有统一扩散模型通常从头训练，未能充分利用已有的强视觉先验。
AI.method: 提出 Muddit（第二代 Meissonic），一个统一离散扩散 Transformer，集成预训练文本到图像骨干的视觉先验，并搭配轻量文本解码器，支持文本和图像模态的统一架构下快速并行生成。
AI.result: Muddit 在质量和效率上均达到或超越规模显著更大的自回归模型，验证了离散扩散在统一生成中的竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 配备强视觉先验的纯离散扩散可作为一种可扩展且有效的统一生成骨干，为统一多模态生成提供了新方向。

title: TAGRPO: Boosting GRPO on Image-to-Video Generation with Direct Trajectory Alignment
summary: Recent studies have demonstrated the efficacy of integrating Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) into flow matching models, particularly for text-to-image and text-to-video generation. However, we find that directly applying these techniques to image-to-video (I2V) models often fails to yield consistent reward improvements. To address this limitation, we present TAGRPO, a robust post-training framework for I2V models inspired by contrastive learning. Our approach is grounded in the observation that rollout videos generated from identical initial noise provide superior guidance for optimization. Leveraging this insight, we propose a novel GRPO loss applied to intermediate latents, encouraging direct alignment with high-reward trajectories while maximizing distance from low-reward counterparts. Furthermore, we introduce a memory bank for rollout videos to enhance diversity and reduce computational overhead. Despite its simplicity, TAGRPO achieves significant improvements over DanceGRPO in I2V generation. The deliverables will be updated at https://tagrpo.github.io/ .

AI.tldr: 提出TAGRPO，一种基于对比学习的后训练框架，通过将GRPO应用于中间潜在表示并结合记忆库机制，有效提升了图像到视频生成模型的奖励一致性和生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有将GRPO直接应用于图像到视频(I2V)模型难以获得一致的奖励提升，需要一种专门针对I2V任务设计的后训练优化方法。
AI.method: 1) 利用相同初始噪声生成的rollout视频作为优化指导；2) 在中间潜在表示上应用GRPO损失，鼓励对齐高奖励轨迹并远离低奖励轨迹；3) 引入记忆库存储rollout视频以增强多样性并降低计算开销。
AI.result: 在I2V生成任务上，TAGRPO相比DanceGRPO取得了显著改进。
AI.conclusion: TAGRPO通过对比学习启发的GRPO损失和记忆库机制，为I2V模型提供了一种简单而有效的后训练框架，显著提升了生成性能。

title: Efficient Prediction of SO(3)-Equivariant Hamiltonian Matrices via SO(2) Local Frames
summary: We consider the task of predicting Hamiltonian matrices to accelerate electronic structure calculations, which plays an important role in physics, chemistry, and materials science. Motivated by the inherent relationship between the off-diagonal blocks of the Hamiltonian matrix and the SO(2) local frame, we propose a novel and efficient network, called QHNetV2, that achieves global SO(3) equivariance without the costly SO(3) Clebsch-Gordan tensor products. This is achieved by introducing a set of new efficient and powerful SO(2)-equivariant operations and performing all off-diagonal feature updates and message passing within SO(2) local frames, thereby eliminating the need of SO(3) tensor products. Moreover, a continuous SO(2) tensor product is performed within the SO(2) local frame at each node to fuse node features, mimicking the symmetric contraction operation. Extensive experiments on the large QH9 and MD17 datasets demonstrate that our model achieves superior performance across a wide range of molecular structures and trajectories, highlighting its strong generalization capability. The proposed SO(2) operations on SO(2) local frames offer a promising direction for scalable and symmetry-aware learning of electronic structures. Our code will be released as part of the AIRS library https://github.com/divelab/AIRS.

AI.tldr: 提出QHNetV2网络，通过SO(2)局部框架上的SO(2)等变操作替代昂贵的SO(3)张量积，实现全局SO(3)等变的哈密顿矩阵预测，在QH9和MD17数据集上取得优异性能。
AI.motivation: 传统的SO(3) Clebsch-Gordan张量积计算成本高昂，限制了神经网络在电子结构计算中的可扩展性。论文旨在设计一种高效且保持对称性的网络架构来预测哈密顿矩阵。
AI.method: 利用哈密顿矩阵非对角块与SO(2)局部框架的内在联系，在SO(2)局部框架内执行所有非对角特征更新和消息传递，引入高效的SO(2)等变操作和连续的SO(2)张量积来融合节点特征，从而避免SO(3)张量积。
AI.result: 在大型QH9和MD17数据集上的大量实验表明，QHNetV2在多种分子结构和轨迹上均实现了优越的性能，展现出强大的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 在SO(2)局部框架上提出的SO(2)操作为可扩展且对称性感知的电子结构学习提供了一个有前景的方向。

title: Seeing vs. Believing: Evaluating the Language Bias of Open-Source MLLMs in Counter-Intuitive Scenes
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance in mainstream visual understanding tasks, but their ability to process action scenes that contradict everyday common sense remains undertested. To address this gap, we introduce CAIT, a benchmark comprising 400 high-fidelity synthetic scenes focused on counter-intuitive visual actions, such as ``a rabbit is chasing a tiger'', where visual evidence explicitly contradicts common-sense expectations. We evaluate human, leading proprietary models (e.g., Claude and Gemini), and 14 representative open-source MLLMs. Humans achieve near-perfect performance (around 0.95 accuracy) and proprietary models demonstrate robust understanding (achieving up to 0.88 accuracy), standard open-source instruction-tuned models perform at the chance level. Further analysis demonstrates that this failure is driven by a strong language prior: rather than trusting the visual input, they automatically override the anomalous visual signals with statistically common text descriptions. Although introducing Chain-of-Thought reasoning mechanisms can improve accuracy, it significantly slows down the response and generates a new failure mode: models overthink the scenario and refuse to accept the actual visual content simply because it violates real-world physical laws. Finally, we demonstrate that targeted fine-tuning and structured prompting can effectively mitigate this reliance on language priors, enabling open-source models to accurately ground their reasoning in actual visual evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAIT基准（400个反常识视觉动作场景），评估MLLMs处理违反常识的视觉动作能力。人类准确率约0.95，闭源模型达0.88，开源指令微调模型仅达随机水平。失败根源在于强语言先验（用统计常见文本覆盖异常视觉信号）。CoT虽提升准确率但导致"过度思考"拒绝接受违反物理定律的视觉内容。针对性微调和结构化提示可有效缓解语言先验依赖。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLMs在主流视觉理解任务表现优异，但缺乏对违反日常常识的视觉动作场景（如"兔子追老虎"）的测试，这类场景能检验模型是否真正基于视觉证据推理而非依赖语言先验。
AI.method: 构建CAIT基准（400个高质量合成反常识视觉动作场景），评估人类、闭源模型（Claude/Gemini）及14个代表性开源MLLMs，通过对比分析揭示失败机制，并测试CoT、微调、结构化提示等缓解策略。
AI.result: 人类≈0.95准确率，闭源模型最高0.88，开源指令微调模型仅随机水平。失败由强语言先验导致（模型用统计常见文本覆盖异常视觉信号）。CoT提升准确率但引入"过度思考"新模式（因违反物理规律拒绝接受视觉内容）。微调和结构化提示有效缓解语言先验。
AI.conclusion: 当前开源MLLMs在处理反常识视觉动作时存在系统性缺陷，根源是语言先验主导而非视觉证据推理；CoT存在双刃剑效应；通过针对性微调和结构化提示可显著改善模型对视觉证据的忠实度。

title: Athena: Enhancing Multimodal Reasoning with Data-efficient Process Reward Models
summary: We present Athena-PRM, a multimodal process reward model (PRM) designed to evaluate the reward score for each step in solving complex reasoning problems. Developing high-performance PRMs typically demands significant time and financial investment, primarily due to the necessity for step-level annotations of reasoning steps. Conventional automated labeling methods, such as Monte Carlo estimation, often produce noisy labels and incur substantial computational costs. To efficiently generate high-quality process-labeled data, we propose leveraging prediction consistency between weak and strong completers as a criterion for identifying reliable process labels. Remarkably, Athena-PRM demonstrates outstanding effectiveness across various scenarios and benchmarks with just 5,000 samples. Furthermore, we also develop two effective strategies to improve the performance of PRMs: ORM initialization and up-sampling for negative data. We validate our approach in three specific scenarios: verification for test time scaling, direct evaluation of reasoning step correctness, and reward ranked fine-tuning. Our Athena-PRM consistently achieves superior performance across multiple benchmarks and scenarios. Notably, when using Qwen2.5-VL-7B as the policy model, Athena-PRM enhances performance by 10.2 points on WeMath and 7.1 points on MathVista for test time scaling. Furthermore, Athena-PRM sets the state-of-the-art (SoTA) results in VisualProcessBench and outperforms the previous SoTA by 3.9 F1-score, showcasing its robust capability to accurately assess the correctness of the reasoning step. Additionally, utilizing Athena-PRM as the reward model, we develop Athena-7B with reward ranked fine-tuning and outperforms baseline with a significant margin on five benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出雅典娜-PRM，一种多模态过程奖励模型，通过弱强完成者预测一致性高效生成高质量过程标注数据，仅需5000样本即在多个基准上取得卓越性能，并在测试时扩展、推理步骤评估和奖励排名微调三个场景中均达到领先结果。
AI.motivation: 传统过程奖励模型需要大量步骤级标注，人工成本高，而蒙特卡洛等自动标注方法会产生噪声标签且计算开销大。因此，需要一种高效、低成本且高质量的自动化过程标注方法。
AI.method: 1) 利用弱完成者和强完成者的预测一致性作为可信过程标签的筛选准则；2) ORM初始化策略；3) 负样本上采样策略。仅需5000样本进行训练。
AI.result: 以Qwen2.5-VL-7B为策略模型时，测试时扩展在WeMath上提升10.2分，MathVista提升7.1分；在VisualProcessBench上以3.9 F1分超越前代SOTA；作为奖励模型进行微调后，在五个基准上显著超越基线。
AI.conclusion: 雅典娜-PRM在验证测试时扩展、直接评估推理步骤正确性和奖励排名微调三个场景中均取得一致优越性能，证明了该方法的有效性和通用性。

title: Source-Free Domain Adaptation for Geospatial Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation
summary: Semantic segmentation of 3D geospatial point clouds is fundamental to remote sensing applications, yet domain shifts caused by regional and acquisition-related variations often degrade model performance. Although domain adaptation can mitigate such shifts, existing methods typically require access to source-domain data, which is often infeasible due to privacy concerns and regulatory policies. To address this, we propose LoGo (Local-Global Dual-Consensus), a novel source-free unsupervised domain adaptation (SFUDA) framework requiring only a pretrained model and unlabeled target data. At the local level, we introduce a class-balanced prototype estimation module that ensures that robust feature prototypes can be generated even for sample-scarce tail classes, effectively mitigating the feature collapse caused by long-tailed distributions. At the global level, we introduce an optimal transport-based global distribution alignment module that formulates pseudo-label assignment as a global optimization problem, effectively correcting the over-dominance of head classes inherent in local greedy assignments, and thereby preventing model predictions from being severely biased towards majority classes. Finally, we propose a dual-consistency pseudo-label filtering mechanism that retains only high-confidence pseudo-labels where local multi-augmented ensemble predictions align with global optimal transport assignments for self-training. Extensive experiments on two challenging benchmarks, encompassing cross-scene and cross-sensor settings, demonstrate that LoGo consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods. The source code is available at https://github.com/GYproject/LoGo-SFUDA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LoGo，一种用于3D地理空间点云语义分割的无源无监督域适应框架，通过局部类平衡原型估计和全局最优传输分布对齐，结合双一致性伪标签过滤机制，在跨场景和跨传感器设置下均达到最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有域适应方法通常需要访问源域数据，但由于隐私和监管政策限制，这在实际中往往不可行。因此，本文旨在仅利用预训练模型和无标签目标域数据，解决3D地理空间点云语义分割中的域偏移问题。
AI.method: LoGo框架包含三个核心模块：(1) 局部层面：类平衡原型估计模块，为样本稀缺的尾部类生成鲁棒特征原型，缓解长尾分布导致的特征坍缩；(2) 全局层面：基于最优传输的全局分布对齐模块，将伪标签分配建模为全局优化问题，纠正局部贪婪分配中头部类的主导偏差；(3) 双一致性伪标签过滤机制，保留局部多增强集成预测与全局最优传输分配一致的高置信度伪标签用于自训练。
AI.result: 在跨场景和跨传感器两个挑战性基准上的大量实验表明，LoGo consistently优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: LoGo作为首个针对3D地理空间点云语义分割的SFUDA框架，通过局部-全局双共识机制有效解决了长尾分布和类别偏差问题，在无需源域数据的情况下实现了优异的域适应性能。

title: Interpretability and Generalization Bounds for Learning Spatial Physics
comment: To appear in ICML 2026. 18 pages, 13 figures
summary: While there are many applications of ML to scientific problems that look promising, visuals can be deceiving. Using numerical analysis techniques, we rigorously quantify the accuracy, convergence rates, and generalization bounds of certain ML models applied to linear differential equations for parameter discovery or solution finding. Beyond the quantity and discretization of data, we identify that the function space of the data is critical to the generalization of the model. A similar lack of generalization is empirically demonstrated for commonly used models, including physics-specific techniques. Counterintuitively, we find that different classes of models can exhibit opposing generalization behaviors. Based on our theoretical analysis, we also introduce a new mechanistic interpretability lens on scientific models whereby Green's function representations can be extracted from the weights of black-box models. Our results inform a new cross-validation technique for measuring generalization in physical systems, which can serve as a benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文通过数值分析技术严格量化了机器学习模型在求解线性微分方程时的精度、收敛率和泛化界限，发现数据函数空间对模型泛化至关重要，不同模型可能表现出相反的泛化行为，并基于Green函数表示引入了一种新的机制可解释性视角和交叉验证技术。
AI.motivation: 尽管ML在科学问题中应用广泛，但可视化结果可能具有欺骗性，现有方法缺乏对ML模型在科学计算中准确性和泛化能力的严格量化分析。
AI.method: 采用数值分析技术严格量化ML模型在求解线性微分方程时的精度、收敛率和泛化界限；通过实证研究不同模型（包括物理特定技术）的泛化表现；基于理论分析提取黑箱模型权重中的Green函数表示。
AI.result: 数据函数空间对模型泛化具有关键作用；不同模型类别可能表现出相反的泛化行为；从黑箱模型权重中提取Green函数表示是可行的。
AI.conclusion: 基于理论分析提出了用于测量物理系统泛化能力的新型交叉验证技术，可作为基准；引入了基于Green函数的机制可解释性视角。

title: Left-Right Symmetry Breaking in CLIP-style Vision-Language Models Trained on Synthetic Spatial-Relation Data
summary: Spatial understanding remains a key challenge in vision-language models. Yet it is still unclear whether such understanding is truly acquired, and if so, through what mechanisms. We present a controllable 1D image-text testbed to probe how left-right relational understanding emerges in Transformer-based vision and text encoders trained with a CLIP-style contrastive objective. We train lightweight Transformer-based vision and text encoders end-to-end on paired descriptions of one- and two-object scenes and evaluate generalization to unseen object pairs while systematically varying label and layout diversity. We find that contrastive training learns left-right relations and that label diversity, more than layout diversity, is the primary driver of generalization in this setting. To gain the mechanistic understanding, we perform an attention decomposition and show that interactions between positional and token embeddings induce a horizontal attention gradient that breaks left-right symmetry in the encoders; ablating this contribution substantially reduces left-right discrimination. Our results provide a mechanistic insight of when and how CLIP-style models acquire relational competence.

AI.tldr: 本文通过可控的1D图像-文本测试平台，研究CLIP风格对比学习如何使Transformer编码器获得左右空间关系理解，发现标签多样性（而非布局多样性）是关键驱动因素，并通过注意力分解揭示位置编码与token嵌入的交互产生水平注意力梯度，打破左右对称性。
AI.motivation: 空间理解是视觉-语言模型的关键挑战，但这类关系理解是否真正被获取以及通过何种机制实现尚不明确。
AI.method: 构建可控1D图像-文本测试平台，使用CLIP风格对比目标训练轻量Transformer视觉和文本编码器，在单/双物体场景的配对描述上进行端到端训练，系统变化标签多样性和布局多样性评估泛化能力，并通过注意力分解进行机制分析。
AI.result: 对比训练能够学习左右关系；标签多样性相比布局多样性是泛化的主要驱动因素；位置编码与token嵌入的交互产生水平注意力梯度，该梯度打破左右对称性，消融该贡献会显著降低左右辨别能力。
AI.conclusion: 提供了CLIP风格模型何时以及如何获得关系能力的机制性见解。

title: Real-Time Progress Prediction in Reasoning Language Models
summary: Recent reasoning language models, particularly those that employ long latent chains of thought, achieve strong performance on complex agentic tasks. However, as these models operate over increasingly long time horizons, their internal progress becomes opaque to users, making expectation management and real-time oversight difficult. In this work, we investigate whether real-time progress prediction is feasible for such models. We first test whether hidden states encode progress information by discretizing reasoning trajectories and training a linear probe to classify reasoning states. We then fine-tune models to generate progress estimates from 0--100\% during chain-of-thought reasoning. Our strongest progress-reporting checkpoint reaches 0.161 MAE on mathematical reasoning traces and outperforms position baselines in this setting. Finally, we quantify the intrinsic ambiguity of progress labels by measuring how much the implied progress value varies from the same partial rollout. This ambiguity is lowest for Qwen3-4B, whose continuations produce the smallest rollout dispersion, suggesting that larger models can make progress labels more stable by reducing variation in remaining solution length.

AI.tldr: 本文研究推理语言模型在长链思维过程中的实时进度预测问题。通过离散化推理轨迹训练线性探针分类进度状态，并微调模型生成0-100%的进度估计，最佳模型在数学推理轨迹上达到0.161 MAE。同时量化了进度标签的内在模糊性，发现Qwen3-4B的延续性产生最小的展开离散度，表明更大的模型可以通过减少剩余解长度的变化来使进度标签更稳定。
AI.motivation: 推理语言模型在长链思维过程中内部进度对用户不透明，导致期望管理和实时监督困难，因此需要研究实时进度预测的可行性。
AI.method: 1) 离散化推理轨迹并训练线性探针对推理状态分类；2) 微调模型在思维链推理过程中生成0-100%的进度估计；3) 通过测量同一部分展开的进度值变化来量化进度标签的内在模糊性。
AI.result: 最佳进度报告检查点在数学推理轨迹上达到0.161 MAE，在该设置下优于位置基线。Qwen3-4B的延续性产生最小的展开离散度。
AI.conclusion: 实时进度预测对推理语言模型是可行的；更大的模型可以通过减少剩余解长度的变化来使进度标签更稳定。

title: LuxRemix: Lighting Decomposition and Remixing for Indoor Scenes
summary: We present a novel approach for interactive light editing in indoor scenes from a single multi-view scene capture. Our method leverages a generative image-based light decomposition model that factorizes complex indoor scene illumination into its constituent light sources. This factorization enables independent manipulation of individual light sources, specifically allowing control over their state (on/off), chromaticity, and intensity. We further introduce multi-view lighting harmonization to ensure consistent propagation of the lighting decomposition across all scene views. This is integrated into a relightable 3D Gaussian splatting representation, providing real-time interactive control over the individual light sources. Our results demonstrate highly photorealistic lighting decomposition and relighting outcomes across diverse indoor scenes. We evaluate our method on both synthetic and real-world datasets and provide a quantitative and qualitative comparison to state-of-the-art techniques. For video results and interactive demos, see https://luxremix.github.io.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于图像的光分解模型，用于从多视角场景捕获中实现室内场景的交互式光照编辑。该方法将复杂室内光照分解为独立光源，支持对每个光源的开关、色温和强度进行独立控制，并通过多视角光照协调确保分解结果在视图间一致。结合可重光照的3D高斯泼溅表示，实现了对独立光源的实时交互控制。实验证明该方法在多种室内场景中实现了高度逼真的光照分解和重光照效果。
AI.motivation: 室内场景的光照编辑是一项具有挑战性的任务，因为复杂的光照环境（如多光源、间接光照）使得精确分离和独立控制每个光源变得困难。现有方法在光照分解的准确性和交互实时性方面存在不足。
AI.method: 提出基于生成式图像的光分解模型，将复杂室内场景光照分解为独立光源；引入多视角光照协调机制确保分解在各视图间保持一致；将光照分解集成到可重光照的3D高斯泼溅表示中，支持实时交互控制。
AI.result: 在合成和真实数据集上均实现了高度逼真的光照分解和重光照效果，定量和定性比较均优于现有最先进技术。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效实现了室内场景中独立光源的实时交互编辑，为多视角场景捕获的光照分解和重光照提供了新的解决方案。

title: Exploring the robustness of TractOracle methods in RL-based tractography
comment: 38 pages, 8 figures. Submitted to Medical Image Analysis
summary: Tractography algorithms leverage diffusion MRI to reconstruct the fibrous architecture of the brain's white matter. Among machine learning approaches, reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a promising framework for tractography, outperforming traditional methods in several key aspects. TractOracle-RL, a recent RL-based approach, reduces false positives by incorporating anatomical priors into the training process via a reward-based mechanism. In this paper, we investigate four extensions of the original TractOracle-RL framework by integrating recent advances in RL, and we evaluate their performance across five diverse diffusion MRI datasets. Results demonstrate that combining an oracle with the RL framework consistently leads to robust and reliable tractography, regardless of the specific method or dataset used. We also introduce a novel RL training scheme called Iterative Reward Training (IRT), inspired by the Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) paradigm. Instead of relying on human input, IRT leverages bundle filtering methods to iteratively refine the oracle's guidance throughout training. Experimental results show that RL methods trained with oracle feedback significantly outperform widely used tractography techniques in terms of accuracy and anatomical validity.

AI.tldr: 本文在TractOracle-RL框架基础上整合了四项强化学习最新进展，并在五个扩散MRI数据集上评估性能。同时提出迭代奖励训练（IRT）方法，利用束滤波迭代优化Oracle引导。实验表明，带Oracle反馈的RL方法在准确性和解剖有效性上显著优于主流追踪技术。
AI.motivation: 传统的纤维追踪算法在脑白质纤维重建中存在假阳性问题，而TractOracle-RL通过解剖先验的奖励机制减少了假阳性。本文旨在进一步探索整合最新RL进展来提升追踪性能，并引入无需人工标注的迭代训练范式。
AI.method: 在TractOracle-RL框架上整合四项RL最新进展作为扩展；提出迭代奖励训练（IRT）方法，借鉴RLHF思想但用束滤波替代人类反馈，在训练过程中迭代优化Oracle奖励信号。
AI.result: 在五个不同扩散MRI数据集上，所有带Oracle反馈的RL方法均显著优于广泛使用的传统追踪技术；Oracle与RL框架的结合无论使用何种具体方法或数据集，均能稳定产生鲁棒可靠的追踪结果。
AI.conclusion: 将Oracle与RL框架结合是实现鲁棒可靠纤维追踪的有效策略；IRT方法提供了一种无需人工标注的迭代训练新范式，进一步提升了追踪的准确性和解剖有效性。

title: RadJEPA: Radiology Encoder for Chest X-Rays via Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture
summary: Vision-language pretraining has driven much of the recent progress in medical image representation learning, but this paradigm is constrained by the availability of paired image-text data and by the reporting bias of clinical narratives. We ask whether competitive radiology encoders can be learned without any language supervision. We introduce RadJEPA, a self-supervised framework built on a Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture and pretrained on approximately 840K unlabeled chest X-ray images. The model learns to predict latent representations of masked target regions from a visible context region, an objective that differs from both image-text contrastive pretraining and DINO-style self-distillation by explicitly modelling conditional structure in representation space. We evaluate RadJEPA primarily on radiology report generation with a frozen Vicuna-7B decoder, and additionally substitute its encoder into four widely used vision-language backbones (MedLLaVA, Qwen-2.5, BLIP-2, and Phi-4). For completeness we also report disease classification and semantic segmentation results. Across two datasets and four metrics, RadJEPA matches or exceeds the strongest image-only and vision-language baselines while using a ViT-B/14 backbone at 224 x 224 resolution.

AI.tldr: RadJEPA是一种基于联合嵌入预测架构的自监督框架，仅使用约84万张无标注胸部X光图像进行预训练，无需任何语言监督即可学习到具有竞争力的放射学表征。在放射学报告生成、疾病分类和语义分割任务上，RadJEPA使用ViT-B/14骨干网络在224×224分辨率下匹配或超越了最强的纯图像和视觉-语言基线模型。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言预训练范式受限于配对的图像-文本数据可用性以及临床叙述中的报告偏差，因此研究者希望探索是否可以在没有任何语言监督的情况下学习到具有竞争力的放射学编码器。
AI.method: 提出RadJEPA框架，基于联合嵌入预测架构(JEPA)，在约84万张无标注胸部X光图像上预训练。模型从可见上下文区域学习预测被掩蔽目标区域的潜在表示，该目标函数不同于图像-文本对比预训练和DINO风格自蒸馏，它显式建模表征空间中的条件结构。
AI.result: 在放射学报告生成任务中（使用冻结的Vicuna-7B解码器），以及在四个广泛使用的视觉-语言骨干网络（MedLLaVA、Qwen-2.5、BLIP-2和Phi-4）中替换编码器后，RadJEPA使用ViT-B/14骨干网络在224×224分辨率下，在两个数据集和四个指标上匹配或超越了最强的纯图像和视觉-语言基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 无需任何语言监督的自监督学习方法可以学习到与依赖配对图像-文本数据的视觉-语言预训练方法具有竞争甚至更优的放射学表征，挑战了当前医疗图像表征学习中对语言监督的依赖范式。

title: MolPIF: A Parameter Interpolation Flow Model for Molecule Generation
summary: Motivation: Structure-based drug design (SBDD) has advanced with deep generative models, but bridging the gap between continuous atomic coordinates and discrete atom types remains a challenge. Current approaches, such as diffusion and flow matching models, often fail to unify these heterogeneous modalities, relying on separate strategies or ill-fitting Euclidean metrics for discrete variables. This lack of a consistent framework limits generative models' ability to capture the geometric and chemical structure of protein-ligand complexes. Results: We present MolPIF, a parameter interpolation flow mechanism designed to unify the generation of continuous and discrete molecular variables. Unlike traditional flow models that operate in sample space, MolPIF interpolates between distributions in the parameter space, theoretically recovering Wasserstein-2 optimal transport for continuous coordinates and establishing Fisher-Rao geodesics for discrete atom types. We further incorporate a geometry-enhanced learning strategy to improve the capture of atomic contexts. Extensive evaluations on the CrossDocked2020 dataset demonstrate that MolPIF outperforms baselines in binding affinity, chemical validity, geometric fidelity and chemical space coverage. Additionally, MolPIF exhibits versatility in lead optimization and offers flexible prior distribution selection (such as Laplace), establishing a robust paradigm for SBDD. Availability: Source code is freely available at https://github.com/BLEACH366/MolPIF. Supplementary information: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics.

AI.tldr: MolPIF提出了一种参数插值流机制，通过在参数空间而非样本空间中插值分布，统一了连续原子坐标和离散原子类型的生成，在CrossDocked2020数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散模型或流匹配的SBDD方法未能统一连续原子坐标与离散原子类型这两种异质模态，缺乏一致的框架来捕捉蛋白质-配体复合物的几何与化学结构。
AI.method: 提出MolPIF，一种参数插值流（Parameter Interpolation Flow）机制，在参数空间中进行分布插值，理论上恢复连续坐标的Wasserstein-2最优传输和离散原子类型的Fisher-Rao测地线，并引入几何增强学习策略。
AI.result: 在CrossDocked2020数据集上，MolPIF在结合亲和力、化学有效性、几何保真度和化学空间覆盖度方面均优于基线方法，并展示了在先导优化中的灵活性和对Laplace等先验分布的支持。
AI.conclusion: MolPIF为SBDD提供了一种统一的、鲁棒的生成范式，有效弥合了连续与离散变量之间的鸿沟。

title: MVISTA-4D: View-Consistent 4D World Model with Test-Time Action Inference for Robotic Manipulation
summary: World-model-based imagine-then-act becomes a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation, yet existing approaches typically support either purely image-based forecasting or reasoning over partial 3D geometry, limiting their ability to predict complete 4D scene dynamics. This work proposes a novel embodied 4D world model that enables geometrically consistent, arbitrary-view RGBD generation: given only a single-view RGBD observation as input, the model imagines the remaining viewpoints, which can then be back-projected and fused to assemble a more complete 3D structure across time. To efficiently learn the multi-view, cross-modality generation, we explicitly design cross-view and cross-modality feature fusion that jointly encourage consistency between RGB and depth and enforce geometric alignment across views. Beyond prediction, converting generated futures into actions is often handled by inverse dynamics, which is ill-posed because multiple actions can explain the same transition. We address this with a test-time action optimization strategy that backpropagates through the generative model to infer a trajectory-level latent best matching the predicted future, and a residual inverse dynamics model that turns this trajectory prior into accurate executable actions. Experiments on three datasets demonstrate strong performance on both 4D scene generation and downstream manipulation, and ablations provide practical insights into the key design choices.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种具身4D世界模型，能从单视角RGBD观测生成多视角一致的四维场景动态，并通过测试时动作优化策略将预测的未来转换为可执行动作，在三维数据集上验证了场景生成和下游操作任务的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于世界模型的机器人操作方法要么仅支持纯图像预测，要么只能推理部分3D几何信息，缺乏预测完整4D场景动态的能力，限制了机器人在复杂环境中的操作性能。
AI.method: 1）设计交叉视角与交叉模态特征融合模块，同时保证RGB与深度的一致性以及多视角间的几何对齐；2）提出测试时动作优化策略，通过反向传播生成模型来推断轨迹级隐变量；3）残差逆动力学模型将轨迹先验转换为精确可执行动作。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上，4D场景生成和下游操作任务均表现优异，消融实验验证了关键设计选择的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过4D世界模型实现了从单视角到多视角一致的四维场景生成，并解决了逆动力学不适定问题，为机器人具身操作中的"先想象后行动"范式提供了新方案。

title: A Physics-Informed Hierarchical Neural Network for Microwave Scattering Analysis of 3D PEC Targets
summary: Accurate modeling of scattering from three-dimensional (3D) perfectly electrically conducting (PEC) targets at microwave frequencies constitutes a fundamental objective in computational electromagnetics, particularly for radar cross section (RCS) prediction and microwave scattering analysis. Classical solvers, such as the method of moments and the Multilevel Fast Multipole Algorithm (MLFMA), although provide high physical fidelity, they become costly under scenarios of repeated queries involving many incidence configurations or frequencies, whereas purely data-driven surrogates often lack accuracy on geometrically complex targets. This paper proposes a U-shaped physics-informed artificial neural network (U-PINet) for 3D microwave scattering analysis. Inspired by the near-far field decomposition of MLFMA, U-PINet combines a near-field graph encoder, parameterized by learnable univariate basis functions, with a hierarchical multi-scale fusion module organized on an octree partition. The proposed network is trained against a discretized residual of the electric-field integral equation at surface collocation points, without requiring reference current labels. Experiments on canonical and geometrically complex 3D PEC targets, conducted under multiple frequency and polarization configurations and assessed through bistatic RCS reconstruction, showcase that U-PINet outperforms representative physics-informed baselines, and yields substantial runtime savings over the classical MLFMA solver under repeated-query scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种U形物理信息人工神经网络（U-PINet），用于三维理想导体目标的微波散射分析。该网络受MLFMA近远场分解启发，结合近场图编码器和八叉树分层多尺度融合模块，通过电场积分方程的离散残差进行训练，无需参考电流标签。实验表明，U-PINet在双站RCS重建上优于现有物理信息基线，并在重复查询场景下相比经典MLFMA求解器大幅节省运行时间。
AI.motivation: 经典数值求解器（如矩量法、MLFMA）在重复查询（多入射角/多频率）场景下计算成本高昂，而纯数据驱动的代理模型在几何复杂目标上精度不足，亟需一种兼具物理保真度与计算效率的微波散射建模方法。
AI.method: 提出U-PINet架构：1）近场图编码器使用可学习单变量基函数参数化；2）基于八叉树组织的分层多尺度融合模块实现层次化特征聚合；3）训练时以电场积分方程在表面配置点上的离散残差为损失函数，无需参考电流标签。
AI.result: 在典型和几何复杂的三维PEC目标上，针对多种频率和极化配置进行双站RCS重建评估，U-PINet性能优于代表性物理信息基线方法，且在重复查询场景下相比经典MLFMA求解器实现显著运行时间节省。
AI.conclusion: U-PINet成功将物理知识（近远场分解、EFIE残差）嵌入神经网络设计，实现了高精度与高效率的平衡，为三维微波散射的快速重复分析提供了有效方案。

title: Olaf-World: Orienting Latent Actions for Video World Modeling
comment: ICML 2026. Project page: https://showlab.github.io/Olaf-World/ Code: https://github.com/showlab/Olaf-World
summary: Scaling action-controllable world models is limited by the scarcity of action labels. While latent action learning promises to extract control interfaces from unlabeled video, learned latents often fail to transfer across contexts: they entangle scene-specific cues and lack a shared coordinate system. This occurs because standard objectives operate only within each clip, providing no mechanism to align action semantics across contexts. Our key insight is that although actions are unobserved, their semantic effects are observable and can serve as a shared reference. We introduce Seq$Δ$-REPA, a sequence-level control-effect alignment objective that anchors integrated latent action to temporal feature differences from a frozen, self-supervised video encoder. Building on this, we present Olaf-World, a pipeline that pretrains action-conditioned video world models from large-scale passive video. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method learns a more structured latent action space, leading to stronger zero-shot action transfer and more data-efficient adaptation to new control interfaces than state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出SeqΔ-REPA对齐目标和Olaf-World流水线，通过将潜在动作与视频时序特征差异对齐，实现从无标签视频中学习可迁移的动作控制空间，支持零样本动作迁移和高效适应新控制接口。
AI.motivation: 可缩放的动作可控世界模型受限于动作标签稀缺；现有潜在动作学习方法学到的潜在变量在不同上下文间无法迁移，因为它们纠缠了场景特定线索且缺乏共享坐标系——原因是标准目标只在每个片段内操作，无法跨上下文对齐动作语义。
AI.method: 提出SeqΔ-REPA（序列级控制-效应对齐目标），将集成潜在动作与冻结的自监督视频编码器产生的时序特征差异对齐；基于此构建Olaf-World流水线，从大规模被动视频中预训练动作条件视频世界模型。
AI.result: 学到的潜在动作空间更结构化，相比SOTA基线在零样本动作迁移和适应新控制接口的数据效率上显著更强。
AI.conclusion: 动作虽未被观测，但其语义效应是可观测的，可以作为共享参考来实现跨上下文的潜在动作对齐。

title: A Unified Framework for Diffusion Model Unlearning with f-Divergence
summary: Most existing methods for concept unlearning in text-to-image diffusion models minimize a mean squared error (MSE) loss between the denoiser outputs conditioned on a target and an anchor concept, which is implicitly the KL divergence between two Gaussians. We generalize this objective to any $f$-divergence, recovering MSE as the KL instance, and identify a family of $α$-divergences whose Gaussian closed-form yields cheap, MSE-like training objectives. For the remaining $f$-divergences, we provide a min-max objective based on the variational formulation of the $f$-divergence. We theoretically analyze and numerically validate how different $f$-divergences impact the gradient magnitude and the convergence properties of the algorithm, affecting the quality of unlearning. For instance, we observe that the Hellinger closed-form instance consistently dominates MSE across multiple scenarios. More generally, the proposed unified framework offers a flexible paradigm for selecting the optimal divergence based on the application and user goal, allowing for finer control over the trade-off between unlearning efficacy and generative fidelity.

AI.tldr: 本文针对文本到图像扩散模型中的概念遗忘问题，将现有的基于MSE损失的KL散度目标推广到任意f-散度族，提出统一遗忘框架。通过α-散度的闭式解实现高效训练，对其他f-散度采用变分形式的min-max目标。理论分析和实验表明，不同散度影响梯度大小和收敛性质，其中Hellinger散度在多个场景中优于MSE，该框架允许根据应用需求灵活选择最优散度以平衡遗忘效果与生成保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有概念遗忘方法仅使用KL散度（即MSE损失），缺乏对不同散度选择如何影响遗忘性能的系统性理解。作者希望建立一个统一的理论框架，将遗忘目标推广到所有f-散度，从而允许根据具体应用需求灵活选择最优散度，实现遗忘效果与生成质量之间更精细的权衡控制。
AI.method: 1) 将现有MSE损失（等价于KL散度）推广到任意f-散度；2) 识别α-散度族，利用高斯闭式解得到与MSE类似的高效训练目标；3) 对剩余f-散度，基于f-散度的变分公式设计min-max目标；4) 理论分析不同散度的梯度幅度和收敛性质；5) 通过数值实验验证各散度的遗忘性能。
AI.result: 1) Hellinger散度的闭式解在多个场景中持续优于MSE（KL散度）的性能；2) 不同f-散度对梯度幅度和算法收敛性有显著不同的影响；3) 所提出的统一框架能够实现遗忘效果与生成保真度之间的灵活权衡控制。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为扩散模型概念遗忘提供了统一的f-散度框架，超越了传统仅使用KL散度的局限。通过理论分析和实验验证，证明了不同散度选择对遗忘性能的重要影响，特别是Hellinger散度展现出优越性。该框架为实际应用提供了根据具体需求选择最优散度的灵活范式。

title: Adapting Actively on the Fly: Relevance-Guided Online Meta-Learning with Latent Concepts for Geospatial Discovery
summary: In environmental monitoring, data collection is often costly, sparse, and shaped by urgent public-health needs. This is particularly true for cancer-causing PFAS (Per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances) contamination, where discussions with domain experts and environmental organizations highlight the need to strategically identify high-risk, under-observed regions under tight sampling budgets. More broadly, similar challenges arise in disaster response and public health settings, where dynamic environments make it essential to efficiently uncover hidden targets from limited ground truth. Yet sparse and biased geospatial labels limit the applicability of existing learning-based methods, such as reinforcement learning. To address this, we propose a unified geospatial discovery framework that integrates active learning, online meta-learning, and concept-guided reasoning. Our approach introduces two key innovations built on a shared notion of *concept relevance*, capturing how domain-specific factors influence target presence: a *concept-weighted uncertainty sampling strategy*, where uncertainty is modulated by learned relevance from readily available concepts such as land cover and source proximity; and a *relevance-aware meta-batch formation strategy* that promotes semantic diversity during online-meta updates, improving generalization in dynamic environments. We evaluate our framework on PFAS contamination discovery as a real-world inspired environmental monitoring task, demonstrating robust target discovery under limited data and changing conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的地理空间发现框架，集成了主动学习、在线元学习和概念引导推理，用于在有限采样预算下高效识别高风险但观察不足的区域（以PFAS污染发现为例）。核心创新包括概念加权不确定性采样策略和相关性感知的元批次形成策略。
AI.motivation: 环境监测中的数据收集成本高昂、稀疏且受公共卫生需求驱动，尤其针对PFAS这类致癌污染物，需要在高风险但观测不足的区域进行战略性采样，而现有的基于学习的方法（如强化学习）因标签稀疏和有偏而适用性有限。
AI.method: 提出统一的地理空间发现框架，包含三个核心组件：1) 主动学习，2) 在线元学习，3) 概念引导推理。两个关键创新：概念加权不确定性采样策略（利用土地覆盖、源距离等概念调节不确定性）和相关性感知元批次形成策略（在在线元更新中促进语义多样性）。
AI.result: 在PFAS污染发现任务上的实验表明，该框架能够在数据有限和环境动态变化的条件下实现稳健的目标发现。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效解决了稀疏地理空间标签下的目标发现难题，为环境监测、灾难响应和公共卫生等领域的动态环境下的有限预算采样提供了统一解决方案。

title: Position: The Hidden Costs and Measurement Gaps of Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is a practical, scalable way to improve large language models on math, code, and other structured tasks. However, we argue that many headline RLVR gains are not yet well validated because reports often conflate policy improvement with three confounds: (i) budget mismatch between RLVR and baseline evaluations, (ii) attempt inflation and calibration drift that convert abstentions into confident answers, and (iii) benchmark data contamination. Using budget-matched reproductions and partial-prompt contamination probes, we find that several widely cited gaps shrink substantially or disappear once budgets, prompts, and dataset versions are matched and contaminated sets are treated as memorization probes rather than evidence of reasoning. This does not mean that RLVR is ineffective, but it implies that current measurements often overstate capability gains and obscure reliability costs. We therefore propose a compact, tax-aware minimum standard for RLVR training and evaluation: budget-matched saturation curves with variance, calibration, and abstention tracking, a judge-robustness stress test when LLM judges are used, and an explicit contamination screen. With these controls, RLVR remains effective and deployable in verifiable domains, but reasoning gains should be treated as provisional without them.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在提升大语言模型数学、代码等结构化任务上的表现时，常因预算不匹配、尝试膨胀与校准漂移、基准数据污染三个混淆因素而被高估。在控制这些因素后，许多显著差距大幅缩小或消失。作者提出了一套包含预算匹配饱和曲线、校准/弃权追踪、评判鲁棒性测试和污染筛查的最低评估标准。
AI.motivation: 当前RLVR的许多报道将策略改进与三个混淆因素混为一谈，导致能力提升被夸大、可靠性成本被掩盖，因此需要系统性地识别并控制这些混淆因素，以更准确地评估RLVR的真实效果。
AI.method: 采用预算匹配的复现实验（使RLVR与基线评估的推理预算一致），以及部分提示污染探测（将受污染样本作为记忆探针而非推理证据），来隔离三个混淆因素的影响。
AI.result: 多个被广泛引用的RLVR性能差距在匹配预算、提示和数据集版本后大幅缩小或消失；受污染数据集会导致虚假的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: RLVR在可验证领域仍然有效且可部署，但当前的测量方法常高估能力提升、掩盖可靠性成本。建议采用包含预算匹配饱和曲线、校准/弃权追踪、评判鲁棒性测试和污染筛查的最低评估标准，在未满足这些控制条件时，推理能力提升应被视为暂定的。

title: GS-CLIP: Zero-shot 3D Anomaly Detection by Geometry-Aware Prompt and Synergistic View Representation Learning
summary: Zero-shot 3D Anomaly Detection is an emerging task that aims to detect anomalies in a target dataset without any target training data, which is particularly important in scenarios constrained by sample scarcity and data privacy concerns. While current methods adapt CLIP by projecting 3D point clouds into 2D representations, they face challenges. The projection inherently loses some geometric details, and the reliance on a single 2D modality provides an incomplete visual understanding, limiting their ability to detect diverse anomaly types. To address these limitations, we propose the Geometry-Aware Prompt and Synergistic View Representation Learning (GS-CLIP) framework, which enables the model to identify geometric anomalies through a two-stage learning process. In stage 1, we dynamically generate text prompts embedded with 3D geometric priors. These prompts contain global shape context and local defect information distilled by our Geometric Defect Distillation Module (GDDM). In stage 2, we introduce Synergistic View Representation Learning architecture that processes rendered and depth images in parallel. A Synergistic Refinement Module (SRM) subsequently fuses the features of both streams, capitalizing on their complementary strengths. Comprehensive experimental results on four large-scale public datasets show that GS-CLIP achieves superior performance in detection. Code can be available at https://github.com/zhushengxinyue/GS-CLIP.

AI.tldr: 提出GS-CLIP框架，通过几何感知提示和协同视图表示学习两阶段过程，解决零样本3D异常检测中投影导致几何细节丢失和单模态视觉理解受限的问题，在四个公开数据集上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本3D异常检测方法将3D点云投影为2D表示，但投影过程丢失几何细节，且依赖单一2D模态导致视觉理解不完整，限制了检测多种异常类型的能力。
AI.method: 两阶段学习框架：Stage 1通过几何缺陷蒸馏模块(GDDM)动态生成嵌入3D几何先验的文本提示，包含全局形状上下文和局部缺陷信息；Stage 2引入协同视图表示学习架构，并行处理渲染图和深度图，通过协同细化模块(SRM)融合双流特征。
AI.result: 在四个大规模公开数据集上的综合实验表明，GS-CLIP在零样本3D异常检测任务上取得了优越的检测性能。
AI.conclusion: GS-CLIP通过融合3D几何先验和双视角协同表示学习，有效解决了现有方法几何信息丢失和模态单一的问题，为样本稀缺和数据隐私场景下的3D异常检测提供了有效方案。

title: DiVeQ: Differentiable Vector Quantization Using the Reparameterization Trick
summary: Vector quantization is common in deep models, yet its hard assignments block gradients and hinder end-to-end training. We propose DiVeQ, which treats quantization as adding an error vector that mimics the quantization distortion, keeping the forward pass hard while letting gradients flow. We also present a space-filling variant (SF-DiVeQ) that assigns input to a curve constructed by the lines connecting codewords, resulting in less quantization error and full codebook usage. Both methods train end-to-end without requiring auxiliary losses or temperature schedules. In VQ-VAE image compression, VQGAN image generation, and DAC speech coding tasks across various data sets, our proposed methods improve reconstruction and sample quality over alternative quantization approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出DiVeQ和SF-DiVeQ两种可端到端训练（无辅助损失或温度调度）的向量量化方法，通过将量化视为添加模拟失真误差向量（保持前向硬量化但允许梯度流动）以及空间填充曲线分配，在VQ-VAE图像压缩、VQGAN图像生成和DAC语音编码任务中优于现有量化方法。
AI.motivation: 深度模型中常见的向量量化采用硬赋值，导致梯度阻断，阻碍端到端训练。
AI.method: DiVeQ将量化视为添加一个模拟量化失真的误差向量，保持前向硬量化的同时允许梯度流动；SF-DiVeQ将输入分配到由码字间连线构成的曲线上，减少量化误差并充分利用码本。
AI.result: 在VQ-VAE图像压缩、VQGAN图像生成和DAC语音编码任务中，所提方法在重建质量和样本质量上均优于替代量化方法。
AI.conclusion: DiVeQ及其空间填充变体可实现端到端训练，无需辅助损失或温度调度，并在多种任务上取得更优性能。

title: Axial-Centric Cross-Plane Attention for 3D Medical Image Classification
summary: Abridged: Clinicians commonly interpret 3D medical images by examining multiple anatomical planes rather than relying on volumetric views. In clinical CT workflows, the axial plane often serves as the primary diagnostic reference, while the auxiliary planes provide complementary spatial context. However, many existing 3D deep learning approaches either process volumetric data holistically or assign equal importance to all planes, failing to reflect this asymmetric, axial-centric interpretation strategy. To address this, we propose an axial-centric cross-plane attention architecture for 3D medical image classification that models asymmetric dependencies between anatomical planes. The architecture employs large-scale axial CT images pretrained MedDINOv3 as a frozen feature extractor for axial, coronal, and sagittal planes. RICA blocks and intra-plane transformer encoders capture plane-specific positional and contextual information, while axial-centric cross-plane transformer encoders selectively condition axial representations on complementary auxiliary representations. Experiments on six datasets from the MedMNIST3D benchmark show that the proposed method consistently outperforms existing 3D and multi-plane models in ACC and AUC. A lightweight variant, AC-Tiny, achieves competitive performance with substantially fewer trainable parameters, suggesting that architectural design contributes more to performance gains than increased model scale. Ablation studies further validate the importance of axial-centric querying, QKV allocation, directional cross-plane fusion, residual-free cross-attention, and classification head design. Slice-level Grad-CAM visualizations demonstrate that the model identifies diagnostically relevant regions across all planes. These findings highlight the value of aligning architectural design with clinical interpretation workflows for robust 3D medical image analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种以轴向为中心的跨平面注意力架构（AC-XNet），通过模拟临床医生轴向优先、辅面补充的读图策略，在MedMNIST3D六个数据集上显著优于现有3D和多平面模型，轻量版AC-Tiny以更少参数取得竞争性能。
AI.motivation: 现有3D深度学习方法要么整体处理体积数据，要么对所有平面赋予同等重要性，未能反映临床实践中轴向平面作为主要诊断参考、辅助平面提供补充空间信息的非对称解读策略。
AI.method: 使用大规模轴向CT图像预训练的MedDINOv3作为冻结特征提取器处理轴向、冠状、矢状三个平面；通过RICA块和平面内Transformer编码器捕获平面特定的位置与上下文信息；再通过以轴向为中心的跨平面Transformer编码器，选择性地以辅助表征条件化轴向表征，实现非对称的跨平面依赖建模。
AI.result: 在MedMNIST3D基准的六个数据集上，该方法在ACC和AUC指标上持续优于现有3D和多平面模型；轻量版AC-Tiny以显著更少的可训练参数达到竞争性能；消融实验验证了轴向中心查询、QKV分配、定向跨平面融合、无残差交叉注意力及分类头设计等各模块的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将架构设计与临床解读工作流对齐，对于稳健的3D医学图像分析具有重要价值，表明架构设计对性能提升的贡献大于单纯增加模型规模。

title: Monte Carlo Permutation Search
summary: We propose Monte Carlo Permutation Search (MCPS), a general-purpose Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) algorithm that improves upon the GRAVE algorithm. MCPS is relevant when deep reinforcement learning is not an option or when the computing power available before play is not substantial, such as in General Game Playing. The principle of MCPS is to include in the exploration term of a node the statistics on all the playouts that contain all the moves on the path from the root to the node. We test MCPS on a variety of games: Hex, Go, AtariGo, NoGo and a Wargame. MCPS almost always outperforms GRAVE. We also provide a mathematical derivation of the formulas used for weighting the three sources of statistics. These formulas are an improvement on the GRAVE formula since they no longer use the bias hyperparameter of GRAVE.

AI.tldr: 提出蒙特卡洛排列搜索(MCPS)算法，在GRAVE算法基础上改进，通过将路径上所有局面的统计信息纳入节点探索项，在多种游戏中优于GRAVE，并给出了无偏置超参数的数学公式推导。
AI.motivation: 现有MCTS算法（如GRAVE）在深度强化学习不可行或计算资源有限时（如通用游戏玩法）性能不足，需要更高效的搜索算法。
AI.method: 在节点的探索项中纳入从根节点到该节点路径上所有走法所包含的全部局面统计信息；推导了三种统计来源的加权公式，消除了GRAVE中的偏置超参数。
AI.result: 在Hex、Go、AtariGo、NoGo和Wargame等多类游戏中，MCPS几乎始终优于GRAVE算法。
AI.conclusion: MCPS是一种通用且高效的MCTS改进算法，适用于计算资源受限场景，其无偏置的统计加权公式提升了搜索性能。

title: LDP-Slicing: Local Differential Privacy for Images via Randomized Bit-Plane Slicing
summary: Local Differential Privacy (LDP) is the gold standard trust model for privacy-preserving machine learning by guaranteeing privacy at the data source. However, its application to image data has long been considered impractical due to the high dimensionality of pixel space. Canonical LDP mechanisms are designed for low-dimensional data, resulting in severe utility degradation when applied to high-dimensional pixel spaces. This paper demonstrates that this utility loss is not inherent to LDP, but from its application to an inappropriate data representation. We introduce LDP-Slicing, a lightweight, training-free framework that resolves this domain mismatch. Our key insight is to decompose pixel values into a sequence of binary bit-planes. This transformation allows us to apply the LDP mechanism directly to the bit-level representation. To further strengthen privacy and preserve utility, we integrate a perceptual obfuscation module that mitigates human-perceivable leakage and an optimization-based privacy budget allocation strategy. This pipeline satisfies rigorous pixel-level $\varepsilon$-LDP while producing images that retain high utility for downstream tasks. Extensive experiments on face recognition and image classification demonstrate that LDP-Slicing outperforms existing DP/LDP baselines under comparable privacy budgets, with negligible computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LDP-Slicing框架，通过将像素分解为二进制位平面，使本地差分隐私（LDP）能够高效应用于高维图像数据，解决了传统LDP在像素空间直接应用导致的效用严重下降问题，在满足ε-LDP的同时保持了图像在下游任务中的高可用性。
AI.motivation: 本地差分隐私（LDP）是隐私保护机器学习的黄金标准，但其在高维图像数据上的应用长期以来被认为不切实际，因为规范LDP机制设计用于低维数据，在像素空间直接应用会导致严重的效用退化。本文证明这种效用损失并非LDP所固有，而是源于将其应用于不恰当的数据表示。
AI.method: 提出LDP-Slicing框架，核心是将像素值分解为二进制位平面序列，从而将LDP机制直接应用于位级表示；集成感知混淆模块以减轻人类可感知的信息泄露；采用基于优化的隐私预算分配策略。
AI.result: 在面部识别和图像分类任务上的大量实验表明，LDP-Slicing在可比隐私预算下优于现有的DP/LDP基线方法，且计算开销可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: LDP-Slicing满足严格的像素级ε-LDP，同时产生的图像在下游任务中保持高可用性，证明了通过合适的数据表示变换可以解决LDP在高维图像数据上的效用瓶颈。

title: MATT-CTR: Unleashing a Model-Agnostic Test-Time Paradigm for CTR Prediction with Confidence-Guided Inference Paths
summary: Recently, a growing body of research has focused on either optimizing CTR model architectures to better model feature interactions or refining training objectives to aid parameter learning, thereby achieving better predictive performance. However, previous efforts have primarily focused on the training phase, largely neglecting opportunities for optimization during the inference phase. Infrequently occurring feature combinations, in particular, can degrade prediction performance, leading to unreliable or low-confidence outputs. To unlock the predictive potential of trained CTR models, we propose a Model-Agnostic Test-Time paradigm (MATT), which leverages the confidence scores of feature combinations to guide the generation of multiple inference paths, thereby mitigating the influence of low-confidence features on the final prediction. Specifically, to quantify the confidence of feature combinations, we introduce a hierarchical probabilistic hashing method to estimate the occurrence frequencies of feature combinations at various orders, which serve as their corresponding confidence scores. Then, using the confidence scores as sampling probabilities, we generate multiple instance-specific inference paths through iterative sampling and subsequently aggregate the prediction scores from multiple paths to conduct robust predictions. Finally, extensive offline experiments and online A/B tests strongly validate the compatibility and effectiveness of MATT across existing CTR models.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种模型无关的测试时范式(MATT)，通过特征组合置信度引导多推理路径生成，缓解低置信度特征影响，提升CTR模型预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有CTR模型优化主要聚焦训练阶段（模型架构或训练目标），忽略了推理阶段的优化机会；特别是低频特征组合会导致预测性能下降，产生不可靠或低置信度的输出。
AI.method: 1) 采用层次概率哈希估计各阶特征组合的出现频率作为置信度分数；2) 以置信度分数作为采样概率，通过迭代采样生成多条实例特定的推理路径；3) 聚合多条路径的预测分数进行鲁棒预测。
AI.result: 离线实验和在线A/B测试均验证了MATT在现有CTR模型上的兼容性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: MATT通过测试时范式创新地挖掘了已训练CTR模型在推理阶段的潜力，有效应对低频特征组合带来的预测不确定性。

title: GeoSolver: Scaling Test-Time Reasoning in Remote Sensing with Fine-Grained Process Supervision
summary: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have significantly advanced remote sensing interpretation, enabling them to perform complex, step-by-step reasoning remains highly challenging. Recent efforts to introduce Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning to this domain have shown promise, yet ensuring the visual faithfulness of these intermediate steps remains a critical bottleneck. To address this, we introduce GeoSolver, a novel framework that transitions remote sensing reasoning toward verifiable, process-supervised reinforcement learning. We first construct Geo-PRM-2M, a large-scale, token-level process supervision dataset synthesized via entropy-guided Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) and targeted visual hallucination injection. Building upon this dataset, we train GeoPRM, a token-level process reward model (PRM) that provides granular faithfulness feedback. To effectively leverage these verification signals, we propose Process-Aware Tree-GRPO, a reinforcement learning algorithm that integrates tree-structured exploration with a faithfulness-weighted reward mechanism to precisely assign credit to intermediate steps. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our resulting model, GeoSolver-9B, achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse remote sensing benchmarks. Crucially, GeoPRM unlocks robust Test-Time Scaling (TTS). Serving as a universal geospatial verifier, it seamlessly scales the performance of GeoSolver-9B and directly enhances general-purpose VLMs, highlighting its remarkable cross-model generalization.

AI.tldr: GeoSolver是一个面向遥感视觉推理的框架，通过构建大规模token级过程监督数据集Geo-PRM-2M（基于熵引导MCTS与视觉幻觉注入）、训练过程奖励模型GeoPRM，并结合Process-Aware Tree-GRPO强化学习算法，实现了可验证的、过程监督的链式推理。GeoSolver-9B在多个遥感基准上达到SOTA，且GeoPRM作为通用地理空间验证器，支持测试时缩放并增强通用VLM的跨模型泛化能力。
