To this end, we introduce a novel think-answer distillation framework that encourages the student to anchor its thinking on visual information by masking the student's salient reasoning prefixes. To compensate for such masked textual cues, the student is encouraged to rely more on visual evidence as an alternative source of information during distillation. Our masking strategies include: 1) token-wise salient reasoning-prefix masking, which masks high-influence reasoning prefixes selectively for each next-token prediction, and 2) self-paced masking budget scheduling, which gradually increases the masking scale according to distillation difficulty, measured by the discrepancy between teacher--student distributions. In the distillation phase, the student is guided by our salient reasoning-prefix mask, which blocks both future tokens and salient reasoning cues, in place of the standard causal mask used for auto-regressive language modeling. Experimental results show that our approach outperforms recent open-source VLMs, VLM distillation, and self-distillation methods on multimodal reasoning benchmarks, while further analyzes confirm enhanced visual utilization along the student thinking process.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的思考-答案蒸馏框架，通过在推理过程中掩盖学生模型的显著推理前缀，迫使其更依赖视觉证据，从而将大型VLM的思考能力蒸馏到紧凑模型中，解决长推理轨迹中的视觉遗忘问题。
AI.motivation: VLM中的思考-答案方法（如Qwen3-VL-Thinking）虽能提升推理性能，但计算成本高昂。将其蒸馏到紧凑模型时，学生模型在长推理轨迹中容易遗忘视觉信息，因此需要提升学生对视觉证据的利用能力。
AI.method: 1) Token级别的显著推理前缀掩码：针对每个next-token预测，选择性地掩盖高影响力的推理前缀token；2) 自步调掩码预算调度：根据师生分布差异（蒸馏难度）逐步增加掩码比例；3) 在蒸馏阶段用显著推理前缀掩码替代标准因果掩码，同时遮挡未来token和显著推理线索。
AI.result: 在多模态推理基准上，该方法优于最新的开源VLM、VLM蒸馏方法和自蒸馏方法；进一步分析表明学生模型的思考过程中视觉利用能力得到增强。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的蒸馏框架有效提升了紧凑VLM的视觉推理能力，验证了通过掩码策略促使模型依赖视觉证据来补偿缺失的文本推理线索的可行性。

title: Constrained Meta Reinforcement Learning with Provable Test-Time Safety
summary: Meta reinforcement learning (RL) allows agents to leverage experience across a distribution of tasks on which the agent can train at will, enabling faster learning of optimal policies on new test tasks. Despite its success in improving sample complexity on test tasks, many real-world applications, such as robotics and healthcare, impose safety constraints during testing. Constrained meta RL provides a promising framework for integrating safety into meta RL. An open question in constrained meta RL is how to ensure safety of the policy on the real-world test task, while reducing the sample complexity and thus, enabling faster learning of optimal policies. To address this gap, we propose an algorithm that refines policies learned during training, with provable safety and sample complexity guarantees for learning a near optimal policy on the test tasks. We further derive a matching lower bound, showing that this sample complexity is tight.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在元强化学习框架下确保测试任务安全性的算法，该算法通过微调训练阶段学到的策略，在理论上证明了安全性和样本复杂度的保证，并推导了匹配的下界，证明其样本复杂度是紧的。
AI.motivation: 现有元强化学习方法虽然能提高测试任务的样本效率，但未能保障安全性。许多实际应用（如机器人、医疗）在测试阶段有严格的安全约束，需要一种既能保证安全性又能降低样本复杂度的元RL算法。
AI.method: 提出一种算法，在训练阶段学得的策略基础上进行微调（refinement），以在测试任务上同时实现安全性和近最优策略学习的样本复杂度保证，并推导了匹配的下界以证明样本复杂度的最优性。
AI.result: 算法提供了可证明的安全性和样本复杂度保证，并推导了匹配的下界，表明该样本复杂度是紧的（即最优的）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了约束元强化学习中安全性保障的理论空白，为在实际安全关键场景下部署元RL提供了理论基础和算法方案。

title: When Brains Disagree: Biological Ambiguity Underlies the Challenge of Amyloid PET Synthesis from Structural MRI
summary: Structural MRI-to-amyloid PET synthesis has been proposed as a non-invasive alternative for amyloid assessment in Alzheimer's disease (AD). However, reported performance of identical models varies widely across studies, and increasingly complex architectures have not led to consistent gains. This inconsistency is thought to be caused by a fundamental biological ambiguity: MRI captures neurodegeneration, while PET measures amyloid pathology - two processes that are often temporally decoupled in AD. As a result, similar MRI patterns may correspond to different amyloid states, creating ambiguous one-to-many mappings. MRI-to-amyloid PET synthesis may therefore be intrinsically ill-posed; however, this idea has yet to be tested scientifically. The aim of this work is to test this hypothesis through two controlled experiments. We first control the training distribution by stratifying paired MRI-PET data by amyloid and neurodegeneration status. Using two standard synthesis models under a controlled design, we show that biologically unambiguous mappings are learnable in isolation, but performance collapses when data ambiguity is introduced. This demonstrates that ambiguity in the data distribution, rather than architectural capacity, constrains performance. Second, we show that introducing orthogonal biological information in the form of plasma biomarkers resolves this ambiguity. When multimodal inputs are incorporated, performance improves and stability is restored. Together, these findings suggest that limited and inconsistent performance in MRI-to-amyloid PET synthesis is explained by intrinsic biological ambiguity, and that stable, meaningful progress requires multimodal integration rather than architectural complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对照实验证明，MRI到淀粉样PET合成性能受限的根本原因是生物学歧义性（神经退行性与淀粉样病理的时间解耦），而非模型架构复杂度不足；引入血浆生物标志物等多模态信息可解决该歧义，提升合成性能。
AI.motivation: 现有MRI-to-amyloid PET合成方法性能在不同研究间差异大且不稳定，增加模型复杂度未带来一致提升，作者怀疑根本原因在于MRI（测量神经退行性）与PET（测量淀粉样病理）之间存在生物学歧义——两者在AD病程中常时间解耦，导致相似的MRI模式可能对应不同的淀粉样状态，形成一对多映射，使得该任务本质上是病态的，但这一假设尚未被科学验证。
AI.method: 通过两项对照实验：（1）控制训练数据分布，按淀粉样状态和神经退行状态对配对MRI-PET数据进行分层，在受控设计下使用两种标准合成模型，验证生物学无歧义映射可单独学习，而引入数据歧义后性能崩溃；（2）引入正交生物学信息（血浆生物标志物）作为多模态输入，观察性能改善与稳定性恢复情况。
AI.result: 无歧义的生物学映射在隔离条件下可学习，但数据歧义引入后性能崩溃，证明性能受限源于数据分布歧义而非模型容量；引入血浆生物标志物等多模态输入后，性能提升且稳定性恢复。
AI.conclusion: MRI-to-amyloid PET合成性能有限且不一致的根本原因是内在生物学歧义性，而非模型复杂度不足；实现稳定且有意义的进展需要多模态信息融合，而非增加架构复杂性。

title: Graph is a Substrate Across Data Modalities
comment: Graph structure across data modalities, accepted by ICML26
summary: Graphs provide a natural representation of relational structure that arises across diverse domains. Despite this ubiquity, graph structure is typically learned in a modality- and task-isolated manner, where graph representations are constructed within individual task contexts and discarded thereafter. As a result, structural regularities across modalities and tasks are repeatedly reconstructed rather than accumulated at the level of intermediate graph representations. This motivates a representation-learning question: how should graph structure be organized so that it can persist and accumulate across heterogeneous modalities and tasks? We adopt a representation-centric perspective in which graph structure is treated as a structural substrate that persists across learning contexts. To instantiate this perspective, we propose G-Substrate, a graph substrate framework that organizes learning around shared graph structures. G-Substrate comprises two complementary mechanisms: a unified structural schema that ensures compatibility among graph representations across heterogeneous modalities and tasks, and an interleaved role-based training strategy that exposes the same graph structure to multiple functional roles during learning. Experiments across multiple domains, modalities, and tasks show that G-Substrate outperforms task-isolated and naive multi-task learning methods. The codebase, model, and datasets are available at https://github.com/zmli6/G-Substrate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出G-Substrate框架，将图结构作为跨模态、跨任务的共享结构基板进行学习，通过统一结构模式与交叠角色训练策略，实现结构知识的持续积累与复用，在多项任务中表现优于任务隔离和朴素多任务学习方法。
AI.motivation: 现有图结构学习通常是模态和任务隔离的，导致跨模态、跨任务的结构性规律被反复重建而非积累于中间图表示层面，缺乏能够持久化并积累图结构的表示学习机制。
AI.method: 提出G-Substrate图基板框架，包含两个互补机制：(1) 统一结构模式——确保异构模态和任务间的图表示兼容；(2) 交叠角色训练策略——使同一图结构在学习过程中暴露于多种功能角色。
AI.result: 在多个领域、模态和任务上的实验表明，G-Substrate优于任务隔离方法和朴素多任务学习方法。
AI.conclusion: 图结构应作为跨学习上下文的共享结构基板进行组织，以支持结构知识的持久化与积累，G-Substrate为此提供了有效的实例化方案。

title: Beyond Text Prompts: Visual-to-Visual Generation as A Unified Paradigm
summary:
Humans often specify and create through visual artifacts: typography sheets, sketches, reference images, and annotated scenes. Yet modern visual generators still ask users to serialize this intent into text, a bottleneck that compresses signals like spatial structure, exact appearance, and glyph shape. We propose \textbf{\emph{visual-to-visual} (V2V)} generation, in which the user conditions a generative model with a visual specification page rather than a text prompt. The page is not an edit target, but a visual document that specifies the desired output. We introduce \textbf{V2V-Zero}, a training-free framework that exposes this interface in existing vision-language model (VLM) conditioned generators by replacing text-only conditioning with final-layer hidden states extracted from visual pages, exploiting the fact that the frozen VLM already maps both text and images into the generator's conditioning space.
  On GenEval, V2V-Zero reaches 0.85 with a frozen Qwen-Image backbone, closely matching its optimized text-to-image performance without fine-tuning. To evaluate the broader V2V space, we introduce \textbf{Simple-V2V Bench}, spanning seven visual-conditioning tasks and seven models, including GPT Image 2, Nano Banana 2, Seedream 5.0 Lite, open-weight baselines, and a video extension. V2V-Zero scores 32.7/100, outperforming evaluated open-weight image baselines and revealing a clear capability hierarchy: attribute binding is strong, content generation is unreliable, and structural control remains hard even for commercial systems. A HunyuanVideo-1.5 extension scores 20.2/100, showing the interface transfers beyond images. Mechanistic analysis shows the default reasoning path is primarily visually routed, with 95.0\% of conditioning-token attention mass on visual-page hidden states.

AI.tldr: 提出视觉到视觉(V2V)生成范式及训练无关框架V2V-Zero，利用冻结VLM的隐藏状态替代文本条件，实现基于视觉规格页面的图像生成，在GenEval上达到0.85，并引入Simple-V2V Bench进行多任务评估。
AI.motivation: 现代视觉生成器要求用户将视觉意图序列化为文本提示，这一过程压缩了空间结构、精确外观和字形等关键视觉信号，成为生成瓶颈。
AI.method: V2V-Zero通过提取冻结VLM对视觉规格页面的最终层隐藏状态，替换原有文本条件输入到生成器中，实现训练无关的视觉到视觉生成。
AI.result: GenEval上达到0.85，匹配优化后文生图性能；Simple-V2V Bench上32.7/100，优于开放权重基线；注意力机制分析显示95.0%的条件词元注意力集中在视觉页面隐藏状态上。
AI.conclusion: V2V范式有效突破文本序列化瓶颈，属性绑定能力强，但内容生成和结构控制仍存在挑战，该接口可迁移至视频生成。

title: Over-Alignment vs Over-Fitting: The Role of Feature Learning Strength in Generalization
summary: Feature learning strength (FLS), i.e., the inverse of the effective output scaling of a model, plays a critical role in shaping the optimization dynamics of neural nets. While its impact has been extensively studied under the asymptotic regimes -- both in training time and FLS -- existing theory offers limited insight into how FLS affects generalization in practical settings, such as when training is stopped upon reaching a target training risk. In this work, we investigate the impact of FLS on generalization in deep networks under such practical conditions. Through empirical studies, we first uncover the emergence of an $\textit{optimal FLS}$ -- neither too small nor too large -- that yields substantial generalization gains. This finding runs counter to the prevailing intuition that stronger feature learning universally improves generalization. To explain this phenomenon, we develop a theoretical analysis of gradient flow dynamics in two-layer ReLU nets trained with logistic loss, where FLS is controlled via initialization scale. Our main theoretical result establishes the existence of an optimal FLS arising from a trade-off between two competing effects: An excessively large FLS induces an $\textit{over-alignment}$ phenomenon that degrades generalization, while an overly small FLS leads to $\textit{over-fitting}$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究特征学习强度（FLS）对深度网络泛化性能的影响，发现存在一个最优FLS值（既不过大也不过小），并通过理论分析揭示其源于过对齐与过拟合之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有理论主要在渐近框架下研究FLS对优化动态的影响，但缺乏对实际训练场景（如达到目标训练风险后停止）中FLS如何影响泛化性能的理解。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 通过实证研究发现最优FLS的存在，进而对使用逻辑损失训练的两层ReLU网络进行梯度流动力学的理论分析，其中FLS由初始化尺度控制。
AI.result: 存在一个最优FLS，过大FLS导致"过对齐"现象降低泛化，过小FLS导致过拟合。
AI.conclusion: FLS对泛化的影响并非单调：更强特征学习并不普遍提升泛化，而存在一个最优强度，该最优性源于过对齐与过拟合之间的竞争性权衡。

title: Bayesian In Vivo Tracking of Synapses using Joint Poisson Deconvolution and Diffeomorphic Registration
summary: Synapses are densely packed submicron structures that dynamically reorganize during learning and memory formation. Longitudinal \textit{in vivo} imaging of fluorescently tagged synaptic receptors offers a promising opportunity to study large-scale synaptic dynamics and how these processes are disrupted in neurological disease. However, in vivo imaging with 2-photon microscopy uses low laser power and therefore suffers from low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and high shot noise, nonlinear tissue motion between days, nonstationary fluctuations in synaptic fluorescence, and significant blur induced by the microscope point spread function (PSF). Together, these factors make it challenging to detect and track synapses, especially in regions with high synaptic density. This paper presents a novel template-based framework for modeling synapses as varying luminance point sources that move under a nonlinear tissue deformation. Taking a unified Bayesian approach, we apply this model to microscopy data by deriving a posterior that incorporates a diffeomorphic mapping for domain warping, a Gaussian point spread function for the imaging process, and a Poisson observation model for raw photon counts. The Bayesian solution simultaneously: (1) Constructs a probabilistic template of synapse locations, (2) denoises and deconvolves the image data, (3) infers fluorescence intensities, (4) performs diffeomorphic image registration to correct for tissue motion, and (5) provides confidence regions for these parameter estimates. We demonstrate the framework on both a 2D+t simulated dataset and a 3D+t longitudinal \textit{in vivo} microscopy dataset of fluorescent synapses imaged in a mouse over two weeks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于模板的贝叶斯框架，用于对活体显微成像中的突触进行建模，同时实现去噪、去卷积、配准和不确定性量化，并在模拟和两周小鼠活体数据上验证了效果。
AI.motivation: 活体双光子显微成像因低激光功率导致低信噪比、高散粒噪声、非线性组织运动、荧光非平稳波动及点扩散函数引起的模糊，使得在突触密集区域检测和追踪突触极具挑战。
AI.method: 提出统一贝叶斯方法，将突触建模为可变亮度点光源在非线性组织变形下运动；后验概率整合了微分同胚映射（域扭曲）、高斯点扩散函数（成像过程）和泊松观测模型（原始光子计数），同时完成模板构建、去噪去卷积、荧光强度推断、微分同胚配准和置信区间估计。
AI.result: 在2D+t模拟数据集和3D+t两周小鼠活体荧光突触显微数据集上进行了验证。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够同时处理成像中的多种退化因素，为大规模突触动态研究提供了有效工具。

title: Probing the Knowledge Boundary: An Interactive Agentic Framework for Deep Knowledge Extraction
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) can be seen as compressed knowledge bases, but it remains unclear what knowledge they truly contain and how far their knowledge boundary extends. Existing benchmarks are mostly static and provide limited support for systematic knowledge probing. In this paper, we propose an interactive agentic framework to systematically extract and quantify the knowledge of LLMs. Our method includes four adaptive exploration policies to probe knowledge at different granularity. To ensure the quality of extracted knowledge, we introduce a three-stage knowledge processing pipeline that combines vector-based filtering to remove strict duplicates, LLM-based adjudication to resolve ambiguous semantic overlap, and domain relevance auditing to retain valid knowledge units. Through extensive experiments, we find that Recursive Taxonomy is the most effective exploration strategy. We also observe a clear knowledge scaling law, where larger models consistently recover more knowledge. In addition, we identify a Pass@1 versus Pass@k trade-off: domain-specialized models achieve higher initial accuracy but experience rapid degradation, while general-purpose models maintain stable performance over extended extraction. Finally, our results show that differences in training data composition lead to distinct and measurable knowledge profiles across model families, reflecting how pretraining shapes each model's parametric knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个交互式智能体框架，通过四种自适应探索策略和三级知识处理流水线，系统性地提取和量化LLM中的参数化知识，发现递归分类法是最有效的探索策略，且存在知识缩放定律和Pass@1与Pass@k之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有基准大多为静态的，对系统性知识探测的支持有限，而LLM作为压缩知识库，其实际包含的知识内容及知识边界尚不明确，因此需要一种能够系统提取和量化LLM知识的方法。
AI.method: 提出交互式智能体框架，包含四种自适应探索策略（递归分类法为最佳），以及三级知识处理流水线：基于向量的去重过滤、LLM裁决解决语义重叠、领域相关性审计保留有效知识单元。
AI.result: 递归分类法是最有效的探索策略；存在知识缩放定律（更大模型恢复更多知识）；发现Pass@1与Pass@k的权衡（领域专用模型初始准确率高但退化快，通用模型稳定性更好）；不同训练数据导致模型家族间存在可测量的知识轮廓差异。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能有效揭示LLM的知识边界和知识组织规律，验证了模型大小与知识量的缩放关系，并表明预训练数据组成塑造了模型的参数化知识轮廓。

title: MiVE: Multiscale Vision-language features for reference-guided video Editing
summary: Reference-guided video editing takes a source video, a text instruction, and a reference image as inputs, requiring the model to faithfully apply the instructed edits while preserving original motion and unedited content. Existing methods fall into two paradigms, each with inherent limitations: decoupled encoders suffer from modality gaps when processing instructions and visual content independently, while unified vision-language encoders lose fine-grained spatial details by relying solely on final-layer representations. We observe that VLM layers encode complementary information hierarchically -- early layers capture localized spatial details essential for precise editing, while deeper layers encode global semantics for instruction comprehension. Building on this insight, we present MiVE (Multiscale Vision-language features for reference-guided video Editing), a framework that repurposes VLMs as multiscale feature extractors. MiVE extracts hierarchical features from Qwen3-VL and integrates them into a unified self-attention Diffusion Transformer, eliminating the modality mismatch inherent in cross-attention designs. Experiments demonstrate that MiVE achieves state-of-the-art performance by ranking highest in human preference, outperforming both academic methods and commercial systems.

AI.tldr: MiVE 是一种利用 VLM 多尺度层次特征（早期层保留空间细节，深层保留全局语义）进行参考引导视频编辑的框架，通过统一自注意力扩散 Transformer 取代跨注意力设计，消除模态差异，在人类偏好评估中达到 SOTA 性能。
AI.motivation: 现有参考引导视频编辑方法存在两类固有局限：解耦编码器在独立处理指令和视觉内容时存在模态差距；统一视觉语言编码器仅依赖最终层表示，丢失了细粒度空间细节。
AI.method: MiVE 将 VLM（Qwen3-VL）重新用作多尺度特征提取器，提取层次化特征（早期层空间细节 + 深层全局语义），并将其整合到统一的**自注意力 Diffusion Transformer** 中，替代传统的跨注意力设计以消除模态不匹配。
AI.result: 在人类偏好评估中排名最高，性能优于学术方法和商业系统，达到 SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 利用 VLM 层次化多尺度特征能有效解决模态差距与空间细节丢失问题，自注意力融合策略优于跨注意力方案。

title: ECHO-2: A Large-Scale Distributed Rollout Framework for Cost-Efficient Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is a critical stage in post-training large language models (LLMs), involving repeated interaction between rollout generation, reward evaluation, and centralized learning. Distributing rollout execution offers opportunities to leverage more cost-efficient inference resources, but introduces challenges in wide-area coordination and policy dissemination. We present ECHO-2, a distributed RL framework for post-training with remote inference workers and non-negligible dissemination latency. ECHO-2 combines centralized learning with distributed rollouts and treats bounded policy staleness as a user-controlled parameter, enabling rollout generation, dissemination, and training to overlap. We introduce an overlap-based capacity model that relates training time, dissemination latency, and rollout throughput, yielding a practical provisioning rule for sustaining learner utilization. To mitigate dissemination bottlenecks and lower cost, ECHO-2 employs peer-assisted pipelined broadcast and cost-aware activation of heterogeneous workers. Experiments on GRPO post-training of LLMs ranging from 4B to 32B parameters under real wide-area bandwidth regimes show that ECHO-2 significantly improves cost efficiency while preserving RL reward comparable to strong baselines.

AI.tldr: ECHO-2是一个分布式强化学习框架，通过结合集中式学习与分布式rollout生成、容忍策略过时性、重叠执行rollout生成/传播/训练、引入基于重叠的容量模型以及采用对等辅助流水线广播和成本感知激活机制，在后训练大语言模型时显著提升成本效率并保持RL奖励。
AI.motivation: 在LLM后训练中，RL的rollout执行可以分布到更经济的推理资源上，但广域协调和策略传播存在挑战，现有方法未能有效处理传播延迟带来的瓶颈。
AI.method: 1) 集中式学习与分布式rollout相结合，将策略过时性作为可控参数；2) 引入基于重叠的容量模型，关联训练时间、传播延迟和rollout吞吐量；3) 采用对等辅助流水线广播降低传播瓶颈；4) 成本感知的异构worker激活策略。
AI.result: 在4B到32B参数的GRPO后训练实验中，在真实广域网带宽条件下，ECHO-2显著提升了成本效率，同时保持了与强基线相当的RL奖励。
AI.conclusion: ECHO-2有效解决了分布式RL后训练中的传播延迟挑战，为大规模LLM后训练提供了实用的成本效益框架。

title: Can Visual Mamba Improve AI-Generated Image Detection? An In-Depth Investigation
summary: In recent years, computer vision has witnessed remarkable progress, fueled by the development of innovative architectures such as Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), diffusion-based architectures, Vision Transformers (ViTs), and, more recently, Vision-Language Models (VLMs). This progress has undeniably contributed to creating increasingly realistic and diverse visual content. However, such advancements in image generation also raise concerns about potential misuse in areas such as misinformation, identity theft, and threats to privacy and security. In parallel, Mamba-based architectures have emerged as versatile tools for a range of image analysis tasks, including classification, segmentation, medical imaging, object detection, and image restoration, in this rapidly evolving field. However, their potential for identifying AI-generated images remains relatively unexplored compared to established techniques. This study provides a systematic evaluation and comparative analysis of Vision Mamba models for AI-generated image detection. We benchmark multiple Vision Mamba variants against representative CNNs, ViTs, and VLM-based detectors across diverse datasets and synthetic image sources, focusing on key metrics such as accuracy, efficiency, and generalizability across diverse image types and generative models. Through this comprehensive analysis, we aim to elucidate Vision Mamba's strengths and limitations relative to established methodologies in terms of applicability, accuracy, and efficiency in detecting AI-generated images. Overall, our findings highlight both the promise and current limitations of Vision Mamba as a component in systems designed to distinguish authentic from AI-generated visual content. This research is crucial for enhancing detection in an age where distinguishing between real and AI-generated content is a major challenge.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了Vision Mamba模型在检测AI生成图像方面的表现，将其与CNN、ViT和VLM-based检测器在多个数据集上进行基准对比，分析了准确性、效率和泛化能力，揭示了Vision Mamba在该任务中的优势与局限性。
AI.motivation: 随着图像生成技术的飞速发展（CNN、GAN、扩散模型、ViT、VLM等），AI生成图像被滥用于 misinformation、身份盗窃等领域的风险日益增加。虽然Mamba架构已在多项图像分析任务中展现潜力，但其在检测AI生成图像方面的能力尚未被充分探索，因此需要系统性评估。
AI.method: 对多种Vision Mamba变体进行系统性基准测试，与代表性的CNN、ViT和VLM-based检测器在多样化的数据集和合成图像来源上进行对比分析，重点评估准确性、效率和跨图像类型及生成模型的泛化能力。
AI.result: Vision Mamba在检测AI生成图像方面展现出了一定的潜力，但同时也存在当前局限性。研究揭示了其相对于已有方法的优势与不足，但文中未给出具体数值结果。
AI.conclusion: Vision Mamba有望成为区分真实与AI生成视觉内容系统中的一个组件，但仍需进一步改进。该研究对于应对区分真实与AI生成内容这一重大挑战具有重要意义。

title: GraphDancer: Training LLMs to Explore and Reason over Graphs via Two-Stage Curriculum Post-Training
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly rely on external knowledge to improve factuality, yet many real-world knowledge sources are organized as heterogeneous graphs rather than plain text. Reasoning over such graphs requires models to follow schema-defined relations through precise function calls and to aggregate evidence across multiple rounds of interaction. We propose GraphDancer, a two-stage post-training framework that teaches LLMs to reason over graphs by interleaving natural-language reasoning with graph function execution. The first stage teaches the model how to interact with the graph under rule-based rewards, while the second stage further teaches it to prefer more grounded and efficient interaction trajectories. The key novelty of GraphDancer is a graph-aware curriculum that organizes both stages by the structural complexity of information-seeking trajectories, progressively increasing task difficulty during training. We evaluate GraphDancer on a multi-domain benchmark by training on one domain only and testing on unseen domains and out-of-distribution question types. Despite using only a 3B backbone, GraphDancer outperforms baselines equipped with larger/stronger backbones, demonstrating robust cross-domain generalization of graph exploration and reasoning skills. Our code can be found at https://github.com/leopoldwhite/GraphDancer.

AI.tldr: GraphDancer是一个两阶段后训练框架，通过将自然语言推理与图函数执行交错结合，教会LLMs在异构图上进行推理。仅用3B骨干模型，在跨域泛化上超越了使用更大/更强骨干的基线方法。
AI.motivation: LLMs越来越多地依赖外部知识来提高事实性，但许多真实世界的知识源是以异构图而非纯文本形式组织的。在这些图上推理需要模型通过精确的函数调用遵循模式定义的关系，并在多轮交互中聚合证据，现有模型缺乏这种能力。
AI.method: 提出GraphDancer两阶段后训练框架：第一阶段在基于规则的奖励下教模型如何与图交互；第二阶段进一步教模型偏好更可靠高效的交互轨迹。核心创新是图感知课程学习，按信息寻迹轨迹的结构复杂性组织两个阶段，逐步增加训练难度。
AI.result: 在仅训练一个域并测试未见域和分布外问题类型的多域基准上，使用3B骨干的GraphDancer超越了配备更大/更强骨干的基线方法，展现出鲁棒的跨域图探索和推理能力泛化。
AI.conclusion: GraphDancer通过图感知课程学习的两阶段后训练，有效教会LLMs在异构图上进行结构化推理，且具有良好的跨域泛化能力，验证了在小规模模型上学习图推理技能的有效性。

title: EgoExo-WM: Unlocking Exo Video for Ego World Models
summary: Egocentric world models present a promising direction for enabling agents to predict and plan, but their performance is constrained by the limited availability of egocentric training data and its inherent partial observability of humans' physical actions. In contrast, exocentric video is abundant and reveals body poses well, but lacks direct alignment with an agent's action space -- and is not egocentric. We propose a method to bridge this gap by extracting structured body pose from exocentric video as a representation of action and transforming the exocentric video to egocentric video, informed by a human kinematics prior. This process unlocks the integration of in-the-wild exocentric data for egocentric world model training. We show that training whole-body action-conditioned egocentric world models with our converted data significantly improves both prediction quality and downstream planning performance, where we infer the sequence of body poses needed to achieve a visual goal state. Our approach paves the way to enlist arbitrary in-the-wild videos for building powerful egocentric world models, furthering applications in robot planning and augmented-reality guidance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过从外中心视频中提取结构化人体姿态并利用运动学先验将其转换为自我中心视频，从而利用大量外中心视频数据训练自我中心世界模型，显著提升了视频预测质量和下游规划性能。
AI.motivation: 自我中心世界模型受限于自我中心训练数据的稀缺性以及其固有的对人类物理动作的部分可观测性，而外中心视频虽然丰富且能很好地展现身体姿态，但缺乏与智能体动作空间的直接对齐且并非自我中心视角，因此需要弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 从外中心视频中提取结构化人体姿态作为动作表示，结合人体运动学先验，将外中心视频转换为自我中心视频，从而将野外外中心数据整合到自我中心世界模型的训练中。
AI.result: 使用转换后的数据训练全身动作条件化的自我中心世界模型，显著提升了预测质量和下游规划性能，能够推断出实现视觉目标状态所需的身体姿态序列。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为利用任意野外视频构建强大的自我中心世界模型铺平了道路，可进一步应用于机器人规划和增强现实引导等领域。

title: Rank-Learner: Orthogonal Ranking of Treatment Effects
comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary: Many decision-making problems require ranking individuals by their treatment effects rather than estimating the exact effect magnitudes. Examples include prioritizing patients for preventive care interventions, or ranking customers by the expected incremental impact of an advertisement. Surprisingly, while causal effect estimation has received substantial attention in the literature, the problem of directly learning rankings of treatment effects has largely remained unexplored. In this paper, we introduce Rank-Learner, a novel two-stage learner that directly learns the ranking of treatment effects from observational data. We first show that naive approaches based on precise treatment effect estimation solve a harder problem than necessary for ranking, while our Rank-Learner optimizes a pairwise learning objective that recovers the true treatment effect ordering, without explicit CATE estimation. We further show that our Rank-Learner is Neyman-orthogonal and thus comes with strong theoretical guarantees, including robustness to estimation errors in the nuisance functions. In addition, our Rank-Learner is model-agnostic, and can be instantiated with arbitrary machine learning models (e.g., neural networks). We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method through extensive experiments where Rank-Learner consistently outperforms standard CATE estimators and non-orthogonal ranking methods. Overall, we provide practitioners with a new, orthogonal two-stage learner for ranking individuals by their treatment effects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Rank-Learner，一种直接学习治疗效应排序的两阶段学习器，无需精确估计CATE，具有Neyman正交性、模型无关性等优势，实验效果优于传统CATE估计方法。
AI.motivation: 许多决策问题（如患者优先级排序、广告效果排名）需要的是个体治疗效应的排序而非精确效应大小，但现有文献主要关注因果效应估计，直接学习治疗效应排序的问题尚未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 提出Rank-Learner两阶段学习器：第一阶段估计 nuisance functions；第二阶段基于成对学习目标直接优化治疗效应排序，无需显式CATE估计。该方法具有Neyman正交性（对nuisance函数估计误差鲁棒）且模型无关（可集成任意ML模型如神经网络）。
AI.result: 实验表明Rank-Learner在排序任务上始终优于标准CATE估计方法及非正交排序方法。
AI.conclusion: 为实践者提供了一种新的、正交的两阶段学习器，可直接对个体按治疗效应进行排序，具有强理论保证和广泛适用性。

title: Xiaomi Auto World Model: A Joint World Model Integrating Reconstruction and Generation for Autonomous Driving
summary: This report presents a unified technical system addressing the two core capabilities of world models for autonomous driving: world representation and world generation. For world representation, we propose WorldRec, a feed-forward reconstruction architecture driven by sparse scene queries. WorldRec initializes structured queries in 3D space, leveraging them to aggregate cross-view, cross-temporal features, thereby naturally enforcing spatial consistency across frames and yielding compact yet high-fidelity 3D Gaussian scene representations. For world generation, we propose WorldGen, a two-stage training framework of bidirectional pretraining followed by causal fine-tuning through three progressive stages (Teacher Forcing, ODE distillation, and DMD), enabling high-quality online causal video generation in as few as 4 denoising steps. Building on both modules, we further introduce the JWM, which deeply integrates WorldRec and WorldGen to achieve synergistic gains in generation stability, cross-frame consistency, and visual fidelity, providing a solid foundation for closed-loop simulation, data synthesis, and end-to-end training in autonomous driving.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套统一技术系统，包含WorldRec（基于稀疏场景查询的前馈重建架构，用于世界表示）和WorldGen（两阶段训练框架，用于高质量在线因果视频生成），并将两者深度融合为JWM，为自动驾驶的闭环仿真、数据合成和端到端训练提供了坚实基础。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶需要同时具备世界表示和世界生成两个核心能力，但目前缺乏统一的技术系统来同时处理这两个任务。
AI.method: WorldRec采用前馈重建架构，在3D空间初始化结构化查询，聚合跨视角、跨时间特征，生成紧凑高保真的3D高斯场景表示。WorldGen采用双向预训练+因果微调两阶段框架，通过Teacher Forcing、ODE蒸馏和DMD三个渐进阶段，仅需4步去噪即可实现高质量在线因果视频生成。JWM深度融合两者以协同提升生成稳定性、跨帧一致性和视觉保真度。
AI.result: WorldRec和WorldGen分别实现了高效的世界表示和世界生成，JWM深度融合后显著提升了生成稳定性、跨帧一致性和视觉保真度，支持仅4步去噪的高质量因果视频生成。
AI.conclusion: 该统一系统为自动驾驶的闭环仿真、数据合成和端到端训练提供了坚实的技术基础，实现了世界表示与生成两大能力的协同增强。

title: Stochastic Decision Horizons for Constrained Reinforcement Learning
summary: We propose stochastic decision horizons (SDH), a theoretically grounded framework for solving constrained RL problems with every-step constraint satisfaction, a desirable property in many real-world applications. In SDH, a constraint violation yields an effective shortening of horizon via a state-action continuation probability. Using Control as Inference, we develop the first off-policy and regularized algorithms for RL with instantaneous constraints. We identify two principled semantics for what counts as a decision after a violation. Absorbing-state semantics end the decision process, so only surviving decisions pay entropy cost, yielding max-entropy AS-SAC. Virtual-termination keeps the decision process alive while stopping reward credit, yielding KL-regularized VT-MPO. To connect SDH with CMDPs, we track how violations accumulate along trajectories (their violation-depth profile). SDH effectively weights each trajectory by the exponential of its total violation; this matches an additive CMDP budget exactly when violations occur at a single characteristic scale, and we pinpoint where it cannot: when rare, deep violations mix with frequent, shallow ones. Experiments validate the theory. On the 90-muscle H2190 humanoid (Hyfydy), VT-MPO matches state-of-the-art gait realism with $4\times$ fewer environment steps and substantially more stable training. On Safety Gymnasium, violation-depth profiles correctly identify the regimes in which SDH delivers strong reward-violation trade-offs. Experiments validate the theory. On the 90-muscle H2190 humanoid (Hyfydy), VT-MPO matches state-of-the-art gait realism with 4x fewer environment steps and substantially more stable training. On Safety Gymnasium, violation-depth profiles correctly identify the regimes in which SDH delivers strong reward-violation trade-offs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出随机决策视界（SDH）框架，用于解决每步约束均需满足的约束强化学习问题。SDH通过状态-动作持续概率在违反约束时有效缩短视界，并基于Control as Inference推导出两种原理性算法：AS-SAC（吸收态语义，最大熵）和VT-MPO（虚拟终止语义，KL正则化）。实验在90肌肉人形机器人上实现4倍样本效率提升，并在Safety Gymnasium上验证了SDH的奖励-违反权衡性能。
AI.motivation: 现有约束强化学习方法通常处理累积成本约束（CMDP），但许多实际应用（如机器人控制）要求每个时间步都满足约束（即时约束满足）。需要一种理论完备的框架来同时保证每步约束满足和高效学习。
AI.method: 1) 提出SDH框架：违反约束时通过状态-动作持续概率缩短视界；2) 基于Control as Inference推导两种语义——吸收态语义（终止决策过程，仅存活决策付熵代价，得AS-SAC）和虚拟终止语义（保持决策过程但停止奖励累积，得VT-MPO）；3) 引入违反深度剖面（violation-depth profile）连接SDH与CMDP，揭示SDH等价于按违反指数加权轨迹，且仅在违反发生在单一特征尺度时匹配CMDP累计预算。
AI.result: 1) 在90肌肉H2190人形机器人（Hyfydy）上，VT-MPO以4倍更少的环境交互步数匹配最先进步态真实度，训练稳定性显著提升；2) 在Safety Gymnasium上，违反深度剖面正确识别了SDH能实现强奖励-违反权衡的区域；3) 理论揭示了SDH与CMDP的精确等价条件及其局限性。
AI.conclusion: SDH提供了一个理论扎实的即时约束强化学习框架，两种语义对应不同设计选择，违反深度剖面为理解SDH与CMDP的关系提供了新视角。实验证明了SDH在样本效率和训练稳定性上的优势。

title: RAVE: Re-Allocating Visual Attention in Large Multimodal Models
summary: Large multimodal models (LMMs) inherit the self-attention mechanism of pretrained language backbones, yet standard attention can exhibit suboptimal allocation, including cross-modal misallocation between textual and visual evidence and intra-visual imbalance among visual tokens. We propose RAVE (Re-Allocating Visual Attention), a lightweight pair-gating mechanism that adds a learned query-key bias to pre-softmax attention scores over visual keys, derived from pre-RoPE query and key features. RAVE requires no architectural modification to the backbone and can be trained end-to-end with the rest of the model. Across a suite of multimodal benchmarks, RAVE improves over standard attention by an average of 3 points, with the largest gains on perception-intensive tasks -- including multilingual OCR, chart understanding, document VQA, and scene text VQA -- where accurate visual grounding is critical.

AI.tldr: RAVE是一种轻量级成对门控机制，通过为视觉键添加可学习的查询-键偏置来重新分配视觉注意力，无需修改骨干架构，在多模态基准测试中平均提升3个点，尤其在感知密集型任务（多语言OCR、图表理解、文档VQA、场景文本VQA）上效果显著。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型的自注意力机制存在次优分配问题，包括文本与视觉证据之间的跨模态错误分配以及视觉token内部的视觉内不平衡。
AI.method: RAVE（Re-Allocating Visual Attention）是一种轻量级成对门控机制，它利用预RoPE的查询和键特征，在softmax之前的注意力分数上为视觉键添加一个可学习的查询-键偏置，从而重新分配视觉注意力。无需对骨干架构进行修改，可与模型其余部分端到端训练。
AI.result: 在多模态基准测试中，RAVE相比标准注意力平均提升3个点，在感知密集型任务（多语言OCR、图表理解、文档VQA、场景文本VQA）上增益最大。
AI.conclusion: RAVE通过简单的成对门控机制有效改善了多模态模型中的视觉注意力分配问题，尤其在需要精确视觉定位的感知密集型任务上表现突出。

title: Rethinking the Trust Region in LLM Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a cornerstone for fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs), with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) serving as the de facto standard algorithm. Despite its ubiquity, we argue that the core ratio clipping mechanism in PPO is structurally ill-suited for the large vocabularies inherent to LLMs. PPO constrains policy updates based on the probability ratio of sampled tokens, which serves as a noisy single-sample Monte Carlo estimate of the true policy divergence. This creates a sub-optimal learning dynamic: updates to low-probability tokens are aggressively over-penalized, while potentially catastrophic shifts in high-probability tokens are under-constrained, leading to training inefficiency and instability. To address this, we propose Divergence Proximal Policy Optimization (DPPO), which substitutes heuristic clipping with a more principled constraint based on a direct estimate of policy divergence (e.g., Total Variation or KL). To avoid huge memory footprint, we introduce the efficient Binary and Top-K approximations to capture the essential divergence with negligible overhead. Extensive empirical evaluations demonstrate that DPPO achieves superior training stability and efficiency compared to existing methods, offering a more robust foundation for RL-based LLM fine-tuning. Our code is available at https://github.com/sail-sg/Stable-RL.

AI.tldr: 论文指出PPO的比率裁剪机制因基于单样本蒙特卡洛估计，对大词汇量LLM存在对低概率 token 过度惩罚、对高概率 token 约束不足的问题，提出DPPO方法，用直接估计的策略散度（TV或KL）替代启发式裁剪，并引入Binary和Top-K高效近似，实验证明DPPO在训练稳定性和效率上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: PPO中的比率裁剪机制在大词汇量LLM场景下存在结构性缺陷：基于采样token概率比的裁剪是噪声较大的单样本蒙特卡洛估计，导致对低概率token过度惩罚（抑制探索）、对高概率token约束不足（可能引发灾难性偏移），造成训练不稳定和低效。
AI.method: 提出DPPO（Divergence Proximal Policy Optimization），用直接估计的策略散度（如Total Variation或KL散度）作为约束替代PPO的启发式比率裁剪；为避免额外内存开销，设计了Binary近似和Top-K近似两种高效方法来捕获核心散度信息。
AI.result: 大量实验表明DPPO在训练稳定性和效率方面优于现有方法（包括PPO），为基于RL的LLM微调提供了更鲁棒的基础。
AI.conclusion: DPPO通过更 principled 的散度约束替代PPO的启发式裁剪，有效解决了LLM场景下策略更新的不稳定性问题，是RLHF领域一个有前景的改进方向。

title: Mind Your Margin and Boundary: Are Your Distilled Datasets Truly Robust?
summary: Dataset distillation (DD) compresses a large training set into a small synthetic set for efficient training, but most DD methods optimize only clean accuracy and leave robustness uncontrolled. Recent robust DD methods improve robustness, yet they often suffer from a poor accuracy-robustness trade-off because they (i) treat all adversarially perturbed examples uniformly, despite robust risk being dominated by near-zero robust margins, and (ii) do not explicitly increase inter-class separation in the decision boundary where attacks concentrate. We present Contrastive Curriculum for Robust Dataset Distillation (C$^2$R), a framework that couples an attack-aware curriculum with a contrastive robustness objective. From a robust-margin perspective, we derive a perturbation score that approximates each sample's robust hinge, enabling a curriculum that prioritizes the smallest-margin adversaries that most directly drive robust error. In parallel, a class-balanced contrastive robustness loss enforces adversarial invariance while explicitly widening boundary separation across classes. Experiments on CIFAR-10/100, Tiny-ImageNet, and multiple ImageNet-1K subsets under six attacks show that C$^2$R achieves the best robust accuracy, outperforming prior robust DD by $2.8$% on average.

AI.tldr: C²R框架通过攻击感知课程学习与对比鲁棒性目标，在数据集蒸馏中实现了更优的精度-鲁棒性权衡，在多个数据集和攻击下平均鲁棒准确率提升2.8%。
AI.motivation: 现有鲁棒数据集蒸馏方法存在两个问题：(1) 对所有对抗扰动样本一视同仁，忽略了鲁棒风险主要由近零鲁棒边界的样本主导；(2) 未在攻击集中的决策边界处显式增加类间分离，导致精度-鲁棒性权衡不佳。
AI.method: 提出C²R框架：(1) 从鲁棒边界角度推导扰动分数来近似样本的鲁棒铰链损失，构建攻击感知课程，优先处理最小边界对抗样本；(2) 引入类别平衡的对比鲁棒性损失，强制对抗不变性同时显式加宽类间决策边界。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10/100、Tiny-ImageNet及多个ImageNet-1K子集上，针对六种攻击进行实验，C²R取得了最佳鲁棒准确率，平均超过先前鲁棒DD方法2.8%。
AI.conclusion: 通过攻击感知课程与对比鲁棒性目标的协同设计，有效改善了蒸馏数据集的精度-鲁棒性权衡，显著提升了鲁棒数据集蒸馏的性能。

title: Emergent Causal-Geometric Dynamics Across Depth in Large Language Models
summary: Geometric analyses of large language model (LLM) representations reveal structured variation across depth but remain fundamentally correlational with respect to token prediction formation. Meanwhile, causal interventions expose depth-dependent efficacy profiles without a unifying account of their representational dynamics. A complete account of LLM function requires explaining how representational structure evolves across depth to causally produce predictions. We synthesize these perspectives by combining geometric analysis with mechanistic interventions, explicitly centralizing depth-wise dynamics as the organizing axis for interpreting LLM function. In decoder-only LLMs, we identify a sharp transition from context-processing to prediction-forming computation, accompanied by a more gradual reorganization of representational geometry across layers. This synthesis reveals a late-layer geometric code in which angular structure parameterizes next-token distributional similarity and enables selective causal control over predictions, while representation norms encode information largely decoupled from prediction. Together, our results provide a synthesis of causal and geometric perspectives, yielding a mechanistic account of how control-relevant geometric dynamics across depth transform context into prediction in language models. This perspective reconciles previously puzzling findings and implies that layer-wise function cannot be understood or effectively intervened upon in isolation, but only within the emergent global dynamical structure of the network.

AI.tldr: 本文通过结合几何分析与因果干预，揭示了仅解码器LLM中从上下文处理到预测形成的深度转变，发现晚期层中角度结构参数化下一词分布相似性并实现选择性因果控制，而表示范数则与预测解耦。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM几何分析和因果干预研究相互独立：几何分析发现表示随深度呈结构化变化，但仅具相关性；因果干预揭示不同深度的效能轮廓，但缺乏统一解释。需要一个统一的框架来解释表示结构如何随深度演化以因果性地产生预测。
AI.method: 将几何分析与机制干预相结合，以深度方向动力学为核心组织轴，对仅解码器LLM中表示几何随层深的变化进行结构化分析，并识别从上下文处理到预测形成的计算转变。
AI.result: 1) 识别出从上下文处理到预测形成的急剧转变，伴随表示几何的逐步重组；2) 晚期层中角度结构参数化下一词分布相似性，并实现选择性因果控制；3) 表示范数编码的信息与预测基本解耦。
AI.conclusion: 因果与几何视角的统一为语言模型如何跨深度将上下文转化为预测提供了机制性解释，并指出层功能不能孤立理解，必须在涌现的全局网络动力学框架中看待。

title: RISE: Reliable Improvement in Self-Evolving Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved strong multimodal reasoning capabilities, but further improving them still relies heavily on large-scale human-constructed supervision for post-training. Such supervision is costly to obtain, especially for reasoning-intensive multimodal tasks where questions, answers, and feedback signals must be carefully designed. This motivates self-evolving learning, where a model improves itself through a dual-role closed loop: a questioner autonomously poses questions and a solver learns to solve them. However, we observe that current VLM self-evolving methods still face three major challenges: coarse-grained role alternation delays the interaction between question generation and solver adaptation; generated questions can progressively degrade in quality; and question types may collapse toward a narrow distribution. These issues limit the efficiency and reliability of self-evolution. Thus, we propose \textbf{RISE}, a reliable self-evolving framework for vision-language models. RISE is built on three complementary designs: fine-grained role alternation, which shortens the feedback loop between the questioner and the solver to improve efficiency; a quality supervisor, which improves question validity and pseudo-label reliability; and skill-aware dynamic balancing, which mitigates mode collapse and maintains broad skill coverage during evolution. Together, these components enable more reliable and effective self-evolution from unlabeled images. Experiments on two VLM backbones across seven benchmarks show that RISE consistently improves the base models, yielding broad and sustained gains. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/AMAP-ML/RISE.

AI.tldr: RISE是一个面向视觉-语言模型的可靠自进化框架，通过细粒度角色交替、质量监督器和技能感知动态平衡三大设计，解决了现有自进化方法中交互延迟、问题质量下降和模式坍塌的问题，在七个基准上实现持续性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM自进化方法面临三大挑战：粗粒度角色交替导致问题生成与求解器适应之间的交互延迟；生成的问题质量逐渐退化；问题类型趋于狭窄分布，限制了自进化的效率和可靠性。因此需要更可靠的自我进化框架。
AI.method: RISE包含三个互补设计：1) 细粒度角色交替——缩短提问者与求解器之间的反馈循环以提高效率；2) 质量监督器——提升问题有效性和伪标签可靠性；3) 技能感知动态平衡——缓解模式坍塌，在进化过程中保持广泛的技能覆盖。
AI.result: 在两个VLM骨干网络和七个基准上的实验表明，RISE能够持续提升基础模型性能，带来广泛且持久的收益。
AI.conclusion: RISE通过三个互补设计实现了更可靠、更有效的自进化，能够从无标注图像中持续提升VLM的多模态推理能力，解决了现有方法的关键瓶颈。

title: Position: Machine Learning for Heart Transplant Allocation Policy Optimization Should Account for Incentives
comment: To appear at ICML 2026 (position paper track). V3 incorporates reviewers' feedback
summary: The allocation of scarce donor organs constitutes one of the most consequential algorithmic challenges in healthcare. While the field is rapidly transitioning from rigid, rule-based systems to machine learning and data-driven optimization, we argue that current approaches often overlook a fundamental barrier: incentives. In this position paper, we highlight that organ allocation is not merely an optimization problem, but rather a complex game involving organ procurement organizations, transplant centers, clinicians, patients, and regulators. Focusing on US adult heart transplant allocation, we identify critical incentive misalignments across the decision-making pipeline, and present data showing that they are having adverse consequences today. Our main position is that the next generation of allocation policies should be incentive aware. We outline a research agenda for the machine learning community, calling for the integration of mechanism design, strategic classification, causal inference, and social choice to ensure robustness, efficiency, fairness, and trust in the face of strategic behavior from the various constituent groups.

AI.tldr: 本文指出器官分配不仅是优化问题，更是涉及多参与方的博弈问题，以美国成人心脏移植为例揭示了激励错配带来的负面后果，呼吁下一代分配政策应是激励感知的，并提出了融合机制设计、策略分类、因果推断和社会选择的机器学习研究议程。
AI.motivation: 当前器官分配系统从规则型向机器学习驱动优化转型，但忽视了激励这一根本性障碍，导致实际运行中出现不良后果。
AI.method: 以美国成人心脏移植分配为案例，识别决策流程中关键激励错配，展示相关数据证据，并提出激励感知的研究议程。
AI.result: 揭示了激励错配在当前分配系统中已造成负面后果，明确了现有方法的局限性。
AI.conclusion: 下一代分配政策应纳入机制设计、策略分类、因果推断和社会选择等方法，确保面对各参与方策略行为时的鲁棒性、效率、公平性和信任度。

title: Broken Memories: Detecting and Mitigating Memorization in Diffusion Models with Degraded Generations
summary: While diffusion models excel at generating high-quality images, their tendency to memorize training data poses significant privacy and copyright risks. In this work, we for the first time identify that memorization induces internal numerical instability, often manifesting as visually ``broken'' artifacts. Inspired by stability analysis in numerical methods, we introduce empirical stability regions based on latent update norms to quantitatively characterize stable behavior during generation. Leveraging this, we propose a principled, on-the-fly framework for step-wise detection and adaptive mitigation. Our approach suppresses memorization without altering prompts or guidance, thereby preserving semantic fidelity and image quality. Extensive experiments on Stable Diffusion 1.4 demonstrate that our method achieves an AUC $>0.999$ detection performance and a $0.0\%$ memorization rate after mitigation with negligible overhead ($\approx0.01$s per image).

AI.tldr: 本文首次发现扩散模型中的记忆化会导致内部数值不稳定，表现为视觉"破碎"伪影。借鉴数值方法中的稳定性分析，引入基于潜在更新范数的经验稳定区域来量化生成过程中的稳定行为，并提出一个即时的逐步检测与自适应缓解框架，在不改变提示或引导的情况下抑制记忆化，保持语义保真度和图像质量。在Stable Diffusion 1.4上达到AUC>0.999的检测性能和0.0%的记忆率，额外开销可忽略不计（每张图约0.01秒）。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型虽能生成高质量图像，但其记忆训练数据的倾向带来了严重的隐私与版权风险，现有方法缺乏有效的检测与缓解手段。
AI.method: 1) 发现记忆化与内部数值不稳定性的关联；2) 借鉴数值方法稳定性分析，引入基于潜在更新范数的经验稳定区域；3) 提出逐步检测与自适应缓解的即时框架，不改变提示或引导。
AI.result: 在Stable Diffusion 1.4上，检测AUC>0.999，缓解后记忆率降至0.0%，每张图额外开销约0.01秒。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法能有效检测并抑制扩散模型中的记忆化现象，同时保持语义保真度和图像质量，计算开销极低。

title: Constructing Industrial-Scale Optimization Modeling Benchmark
comment: This paper was accepted by ICML'26 for publication
summary: Optimization modeling underpins decision-making in logistics, manufacturing, energy, and finance, yet translating natural-language requirements into correct optimization formulations and solver-executable code remains labor-intensive. Although large language models (LLMs) have been explored for this task, evaluation is still dominated by toy-sized or synthetic benchmarks, masking the difficulty of industrial problems with $10^{3}$--$10^{6}$ (or more) variables and constraints. A key bottleneck is the lack of benchmarks that align natural-language specifications with reference formulations/solver code grounded in real optimization models. To fill in this gap, we introduce MIPLIB-NL, built via a structure-aware reverse construction methodology from real mixed-integer linear programs in MIPLIB~2017. Our pipeline (i) recovers compact, reusable model structure from flat solver formulations, (ii) reverse-generates natural-language specifications explicitly tied to this recovered structure under a unified model--data separation format, and (iii) performs iterative semantic validation through expert review and human--LLM interaction with independent reconstruction checks. This yields 223 one-to-one reconstructions that preserve the mathematical content of the original instances while enabling realistic natural-language-to-optimization evaluation. Experiments show substantial performance degradation on MIPLIB-NL for systems that perform strongly on existing benchmarks, exposing failure modes invisible at toy scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MIPLIB-NL基准，通过结构感知的反向构建方法，从真实混合整数线性规划问题（MIPLIB 2017）中生成自然语言描述与求解器代码对齐的评估数据集，揭示现有LLM系统在工业规模优化任务上的性能退化。
AI.motivation: 现有评估基准多基于玩具级或合成问题，无法反映工业规模（10³–10⁶变量/约束）优化建模的真实难度，缺乏将自然语言规范与真实优化模型参考公式/求解器代码对齐的基准。
AI.method: 采用结构感知的反向构建方法：从MIPLIB 2017的扁平求解器公式中恢复紧凑可复用的模型结构；反向生成与恢复结构显式关联的自然语言规范（统一模型-数据分离格式）；通过专家评审、人-LLM交互及独立重建检查进行迭代语义验证。
AI.result: 构建了223个一对一重建实例，保留原始实例的数学内容；实验表明在现有基准上表现良好的LLM系统在MIPLIB-NL上性能显著下降，暴露了玩具规模下不可见的失败模式。
AI.conclusion: MIPLIB-NL填补了自然语言到优化建模评估的空白，揭示了现有方法在工业级问题中的局限性，为未来研究提供更具挑战性的基准。

title: The Neglected Baseline in Model Interpretation
summary: We observe that existing model interpretation methods generally ignore the baseline, and such neglect often results in imprecise or even incorrect interpretation. In this paper, we reformulate the task of model interpretation and the interpretation principles for model interpretation results to demonstrate the importance of the baseline. We further unify gradient-based methods, Integrated Gradients (IG) methods, and Taylor expansion, clarifying the connections among them and explicitly identifying the baseline for each method. On this basis, we analyze the flaws and errors in related model interpretation methods (IG, LayerCAM, ODAM, Difference Map). We advocate evaluating the quality of model interpretation results precisely through the attribution error between the attribution result and the attribution target, rather than adopting flawed evaluation methods, such as those based on marginal-effect or the assumption of perfect model performance. We revise IG and develope a model interpretation method with a clear and reasonable baseline, achieving better results. Our method supports model interpretation based on features from any layer. Interpretation based on features from different layers are all reasonable, and the differences among these results reflect varying degrees of feature extraction at different feature extraction stages.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现有模型解释方法普遍忽略基线（baseline），导致解释不精确甚至错误。通过重新定义模型解释任务和原则，统一了梯度法、积分梯度法和泰勒展开，揭示了各方法的基线。分析了IG、LayerCAM、ODAM、Difference Map等方法的缺陷，提出用归因误差评估解释质量，并开发了具有明确合理基线的新解释方法，支持任意层的特征解释。
AI.motivation: 现有模型解释方法普遍忽略基线（baseline）的重要性，导致解释结果不精确或错误。作者旨在通过重新审视基线在模型解释中的核心作用，统一不同方法并揭示其缺陷，进而开发更合理的解释方法。
AI.method: 重新定义模型解释任务和原则以强调基线的重要性；统一梯度法、积分梯度（IG）和泰勒展开，明确各方法的基线；基于此分析IG、LayerCAM、ODAM、Difference Map等方法的缺陷；提出用归因误差（attribution error）替代基于边际效应或完美模型假设的评估方法；在IG基础上改进，开发具有明确合理基线的新方法，支持任意层的特征解释。
AI.result: 新方法在归因质量上优于现有方法；不同层的解释结果均合理，且差异反映了不同特征提取阶段提取特征的粒度差异。
AI.conclusion: 基线是模型解释的关键因素，忽略基线的现有方法存在系统性缺陷；归因误差是更可靠的评估指标；改进后的方法提供了更精确、合理的模型解释，且能灵活应用于不同网络层的特征分析。

title: Vital Trace: Protocol-Constrained Patient-State Reasoning for Longitudinal Clinical Trajectories
summary: Longitudinal clinical reasoning over electronic health records requires tracking evolving physiological measurements, laboratory results, and interventions across extended patient trajectories. Existing LLM-based clinical reasoning systems often rely on repeatedly serializing patient histories or exchanging unconstrained textual agent messages, leading to context drift, unstable reasoning, and growing inference cost over long horizons. We present Vital Trace, a protocol-constrained multi-agent framework for future clinical risk prediction over evolving ICU trajectories. Instead of maintaining unbounded textual histories, Vital Trace uses a compact persistent patient-state memory together with staged reasoning performed by four coordinated agents: a Router, Reasoner, Auditor, and Steward. To support temporally coherent reasoning, we introduce a manually curated Global Protocol containing physiological state-transition rules and a dynamic patient-state representation that tracks hemodynamic, respiratory, renal, metabolic, and inflammatory instability over time. We evaluate Vital Trace on MIMIC-IV and eICU using future vasopressor-support, respiratory-support, renal-support, and deterioration prediction tasks. Results show that structured protocol-constrained reasoning improves temporal consistency, communication stability, calibration, and interpretability compared with free-form multi-agent baselines while achieving strong predictive performance across long ICU trajectories.

AI.tldr: Vital Trace提出了一种协议约束的多智能体框架，通过紧凑的患者状态记忆和四个协调智能体（Router、Reasoner、Auditor、Steward）结合全局生理协议，在ICU长轨迹临床风险预测中实现了比自由形式多智能体基线更好的时间一致性、通信稳定性、校准性和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的临床推理系统在处理长时间跨度的电子健康记录时，反复序列化患者历史或交换无约束文本消息，导致上下文漂移、推理不稳定以及推理成本不断增加。
AI.method: 提出Vital Trace协议约束多智能体框架，包含紧凑的持久患者状态记忆和四个协调智能体（Router、Reasoner、Auditor、Steward），并引入人工整理的全局协议（包含生理状态转换规则）和动态患者状态表示（追踪血流动力学、呼吸、肾脏、代谢和炎症不稳定性）。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-IV和eICU数据集上的未来血管加压药支持、呼吸支持、肾脏支持和病情恶化预测任务中，协议约束的结构化推理在时间一致性、通信稳定性、校准性和可解释性方面优于自由形式多智能体基线，且在长ICU轨迹上保持强预测性能。
AI.conclusion: 结构化协议约束推理能够有效提升长时序临床推理的稳定性和可解释性，为ICU临床风险预测提供了更可靠的智能体协作范式。

title: Suicide Risk Assessment from AI-powered Video Surveillance: An Interpretable Framework for Prevention in Metro Stations
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures, 1 table. Accepted for Publication in the International Joint Conference of Artificial Intelligence (IJCAI)
summary: Understanding and monitoring human behavior in metro stations play an important role in supporting suicide prevention efforts, where early identification of high-risk situations can enable timely intervention. This requires assessing suicide risk from a surveillance video by jointly reasoning about the behavior of each passenger, his/her spatial context, and temporal dynamics. However, this assessment using videos captured by surveillance cameras is challenging, as it demands accurate perception of human motion, understanding of platform geometry, and aggregation of heterogeneous behavioral cues over time. In this work, we formalize the task of Suicide Risk Assessment (SRA) in metro stations and introduce the first interpretable framework that addresses this challenge. Unlike approaches that focus on isolated subtasks or attempt to infer intent directly, our formulation assesses suicide risk from accumulated evidence by incorporating person tracking, activity recognition, semantic segmentation of the platform, and trajectory-driven risk heatmap modeling. By formalizing SRA as a distinct task and benchmarking a complete operational pipeline achieving 83.2% ROC-AUC on real surveillance data, this work highlights the complexity of suicide risk assessment and opens new directions for research on interpretable AI systems for social good.

AI.tldr: 本文首次形式化定义了地铁站自杀风险评估（SRA）任务，并提出一个可解释的计算框架，通过整合行人跟踪、活动识别、站台语义分割和轨迹驱动的风险热图建模，在真实监控视频上实现了83.2%的ROC-AUC性能。
AI.motivation: 地铁站中监控人类行为对预防自杀至关重要，早期识别高风险情景可实现及时干预。现有方法要么聚焦于孤立子任务，要么试图直接推断意图，缺乏从累积证据中评估自杀风险的可解释框架。
AI.method: 提出可解释的SRA框架，集成四个模块：行人跟踪、活动识别、站台语义分割、轨迹驱动的风险热图建模。通过联合推理每个乘客的行为、空间上下文和时间动态，从累积证据中评估自杀风险。
AI.result: 在真实监控数据上，该操作管道实现了83.2%的ROC-AUC。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过形式化SRA为独立任务并建立完整基准，揭示了自杀风险评估的复杂性，为面向社会公益的可解释AI系统开辟了新研究方向。

title: Benchmark Leakage Trap: Can We Trust LLM-based Recommendation?
summary: The expanding integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into recommender systems poses critical challenges to evaluation reliability. This paper identifies and investigates a previously overlooked issue: benchmark data leakage in LLM-based recommendation. This phenomenon occurs when LLMs are exposed to and potentially memorize benchmark datasets during pre-training or fine-tuning, leading to artificially inflated performance metrics that fail to reflect true model performance. To validate this phenomenon, we simulate diverse data leakage scenarios by conducting continued pre-training of foundation models on strategically blended corpora, which include user-item interactions from both in-domain and out-of-domain sources. Our experiments reveal a dual-effect of data leakage: when the leaked data is domain-relevant, it induces substantial but spurious performance gains, misleadingly exaggerating the model's capability. In contrast, domain-irrelevant leakage typically degrades recommendation accuracy, highlighting the complex and contingent nature of this contamination. Our findings reveal that data leakage acts as a critical, previously unaccounted-for factor in LLM-based recommendation, which could impact the true model performance. We release our code at https://github.com/yusba1/LLMRec-Data-Leakage.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示并系统研究了LLM推荐系统中的基准数据泄露问题，发现当大模型在预训练或微调阶段接触并记忆评测基准数据时，会产生虚高的性能指标。实验表明，领域相关的数据泄露会导致虚假的性能提升，而领域无关的泄露则会降低推荐准确率，凸显了数据污染的复杂性和危害性。
AI.motivation: LLM在推荐系统中的广泛应用带来了评估可靠性挑战，而现有研究忽视了基准数据泄露这一关键问题。该问题会导致评测指标虚高，无法反映模型真实性能，因此有必要系统研究这一现象及其影响。
AI.method: 通过模拟多种数据泄露场景，在策略性混合的语料库上对基础模型进行持续预训练，语料包含域内和域外的用户-物品交互数据，进而观察不同泄露情况下的性能变化。
AI.result: 发现了数据泄露的双重效应：领域相关的泄露会导致显著的但虚假的性能提升；而领域无关的泄露则会降低推荐准确率。这表明数据泄露的影响具有复杂的条件依赖性。
AI.conclusion: 数据泄露是LLM推荐中一个关键的、此前未被充分考虑的混淆因素，严重影响模型真实性能的评估。研究呼吁学界关注并解决该问题。

title: GFSR: Geometric Fidelity and Spatial Refinement for Reliable Lane Detection
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems. 12 pages, 6 figures
summary: Lane detection stands as a crucial perception task in autonomous driving and advanced driver assistance systems. However, existing methods still degrade in complex real scenarios due to two major limitations. First, classification confidence only characterizes the categorical existence of lane priors and has no strong correlation with geometric quality. If threshold filtering and NMS are conducted merely based on this confidence, the model tends to retain lane priors with high confidence while eliminating those with lower confidence but superior geometric representation. Secondly, the regression modules in existing methods weaken correlations among sampling points, hindering fine-grained optimization of distant, high-curvature and complex-topology lanes and causing underfitting. To address these issues, we propose Geometric Fidelity and Spatial Refinement (GFSR), a framework consisting of LaneIoU-guided Confidence Calibration (LCC) and Adaptive Gated Location Refinement (AGLR). Specifically, LCC adopts LaneIoU as soft supervision to explicitly estimate the geometric fidelity of lane priors, which is further fused with classification confidence to construct the Collaborative Reliability Index (CRI). This index guides lane prior filtering, effectively retaining those with high classification confidence and favorable geometric quality. Meanwhile, cooperating with regression heads in each refinement stage, AGLR predicts sampling point lateral offsets and adopts a gating mechanism to adaptively regulate correction magnitude, strengthen inter-point correlations and boost model adaptability as well as robustness toward complex lane scenarios. Extensive experiments on CULane and CurveLanes demonstrate that our GFSR achieves state-of-the-art performance on CULane, with F1_50 and F1_75 scores of 81.46% and 65.01%, and reaches 87.35% F1_50 on CurveLanes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GFSR框架，包含LaneIoU引导的置信度校准（LCC）和自适应门控位置精炼（AGLR），通过几何保真度评估和空间细化解决车道检测中置信度与几何质量脱节及采样点关联弱的问题，在CULane和CurveLanes上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有车道检测方法存在两大局限：1) 分类置信度仅表征车道先验的类别存在性，与几何质量缺乏强相关性，导致基于置信度的阈值过滤和NMS会剔除几何质量好但置信度低的预测；2) 回归模块弱化了采样点间的关联，阻碍了对远距离、高曲率和复杂拓扑车道的细粒度优化，导致欠拟合。
AI.method: 提出GFSR框架，包含两个核心模块：1) LaneIoU引导的置信度校准（LCC）：以LaneIoU作为软监督显式估计车道先验的几何保真度，并与分类置信度融合构建协作可靠性指标（CRI），用于引导先验过滤，保留高分类置信度且几何质量好的预测；2) 自适应门控位置精炼（AGLR）：在每个精炼阶段与回归头协作，预测采样点横向偏移，并采用门控机制自适应调节校正幅度，增强点间相关性，提升模型对复杂车道场景的适应性和鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在CULane上F1_50和F1_75分别达到81.46%和65.01%，在CurveLanes上F1_50达到87.35%，均达到SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过几何保真度引导的置信度校准和自适应门控位置精炼，有效解决了置信度-几何质量脱节和采样点关联弱的问题，提升了复杂场景下的车道检测性能。

title: GICDM: Mitigating Hubness for Reliable Distance-Based Generative Model Evaluation
comment: Forty-third International Conference on Machine Learning, 2026
summary: Generative model evaluation commonly relies on high-dimensional embedding spaces to compute distances between samples. We show that dataset representations in these spaces are affected by the hubness phenomenon, which distorts nearest-neighbor relationships and biases distance-based metrics. Building on the classical Iterative Contextual Dissimilarity Measure (ICDM), we introduce Generative ICDM (GICDM), a method to correct neighborhood estimation for both real and generated data. We introduce a multi-scale extension to improve empirical behavior. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real benchmarks demonstrate that GICDM resolves hubness-induced failures, restores reliable metric behavior, and improves alignment with human assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出生成式迭代上下文差异度量（GICDM），用于纠正生成模型评估中因高维嵌入空间的枢纽效应导致的最近邻关系失真和度量偏差问题。
AI.motivation: 生成模型评估依赖高维嵌入空间的距离度量，但这些空间存在枢纽效应（hubness phenomenon），扭曲了最近邻关系，导致基于距离的评估指标产生偏差，影响评估可靠性。
AI.method: 基于经典迭代上下文差异度量（ICDM），提出生成式ICDM（GICDM），通过校正真实数据和生成数据的邻域估计来缓解枢纽效应，并引入多尺度扩展以改善实证表现。
AI.result: 在合成和真实基准上的大量实验表明，GICDM解决了枢纽效应引发的评估失败，恢复了可靠的度量行为，并提升了与人类评估的一致性。
AI.conclusion: GICDM有效消除了高维嵌入空间中枢纽效应对生成模型评估的负面影响，是一种更可靠的评估方法。

title: Diff-Instruct with Diffused Reward: Towards Principled One-step Generator RL
summary: Recent advances in one-step text-to-image generation have enabled real-time synthesis with remarkable efficiency and quality. Previous reinforcement learning methods for one-step generators combine image-space reward optimization with diffusion noisy-space distribution matching. This paradigm brings challenges due to a mismatch between terminal reward optimization and the underlying generative dynamics. As a result, optimization tends to exploit stochastic degrees of freedom, often improving reward at the expense of image fidelity. To address this issue, we propose Diff-Instruct with Diffused Reward (DIDR), a data-free trajectory-level alignment framework derived from Integral KL minimization. DIDR propagates the RLHF-optimal reward-tilted clean-image distribution across all noise levels along the diffusion trajectory. We show that this objective admits the same minimizer as clean-image RLHF, while naturally inducing the Diffused Reward Score (DRS), which acts as a reward-driven correction to the reference score function. To make this practical, we further introduce the Diffused Reward Proxy (DRP), an efficient estimator of DRS based on differentiable short-step denoising. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DIDR consistently Pareto-dominates existing one-step SDXL baselines. Moreover, when transferred to a 6B DiT backbone (Z-Image), DIDR surpasses its 50-step teacher in preference alignment while requiring only a single generation step.

AI.tldr: 提出DIDR框架，通过积分KL最小化在扩散轨迹所有噪声水平上传播RLHF最优奖励倾斜分布，解决一步文本到图像生成中终端奖励优化与生成动力学不匹配的问题，实现单步生成超越多步教师模型的对齐效果。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习方法将图像空间奖励优化与扩散噪声空间分布匹配结合，导致终端奖励优化与生成动力学不匹配，优化易利用随机自由度提升奖励但损害图像保真度。
AI.method: 基于积分KL最小化提出无数据的轨迹级对齐框架DIDR，将RLHF最优奖励倾斜干净图像分布沿扩散轨迹传播至所有噪声水平，推导出扩散奖励分数(DRS)作为参考分数函数的奖励驱动校正，并引入可微短步去噪的扩散奖励代理(DRP)进行高效估计。
AI.result: 在SDXL基线上DIDR一致帕累托优于现有方法；迁移至6B DiT骨干(Z-Image)时，单步生成超越其50步教师模型的偏好对齐效果。
AI.conclusion: DIDR通过轨迹级对齐有效解决一步生成器奖励优化与保真度之间的权衡问题，在多种骨干网络上展现出显著优势。

title: DeepInterestGR: Mining Deep Multi-Interest Using Multi-Modal LLMs for Generative Recommendation
summary: We introduce DeepInterestGR, a novel framework that integrates deep interest mining into the generative recommendation pipeline. This addresses the "Shallow Interest" problem - existing generative methods rely on surface-level textual features and fail to capture latent user motivations, limiting personalization depth and recommendation interpretability. Our approach leverages Multi-LLM Interest Mining (MLIM) via structured reasoning prompting, Reward-Labeled Deep Interest (RLDI) for quality control, and Interest-Enhanced Item Discretization (IEID) via RQ-VAE, combined with a two-stage SFT-GRPO training pipeline guided by an Interest-Aware Reward. We validate DeepInterestGR on three Amazon Review benchmarks (Beauty, Sports, Instruments), comparing against 14 state-of-the-art baselines including SASRec, BERT4Rec, TIGER, LC-Rec, and S-DPO. Our method achieves 5.8%-8.3% relative improvements on HR@10 and 7.7%-9.9% on NDCG@10 over the strongest baseline, with cross-domain generalization gains of +24.8%. These results provide evidence that incorporating deep semantic interests can effectively improve SID-based generative recommendation.

AI.tldr: 提出DeepInterestGR框架，通过多LLM兴趣挖掘、奖励标签深度兴趣控制、兴趣增强物品离散化等模块，将深层兴趣挖掘融入生成式推荐系统，在三个Amazon数据集上相比14个基线方法取得5.8%-8.3%的HR@10和7.7%-9.9%的NDCG@10提升，跨域泛化提升达24.8%。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式推荐方法仅依赖表面文本特征，无法捕捉用户潜在动机，导致个性化深度不足、推荐可解释性差，即"浅层兴趣"问题。
AI.method: 提出DeepInterestGR框架，包含三大核心模块：(1) Multi-LLM Interest Mining (MLIM) - 通过结构化推理提示进行多LLM兴趣挖掘；(2) Reward-Labeled Deep Interest (RLDI) - 奖励标注的深度兴趣质量控制；(3) Interest-Enhanced Item Discretization (IEID) - 基于RQ-VAE的兴趣增强物品离散化。采用两阶段SFT-GRPO训练流程，由兴趣感知奖励引导。
AI.result: 在Beauty、Sports、Instruments三个Amazon数据集上，相比SASRec、BERT4Rec、TIGER、LC-Rec、S-DPO等14个基线，HR@10相对提升5.8%-8.3%，NDCG@10相对提升7.7%-9.9%，跨域泛化增益达+24.8%。
AI.conclusion: 融入深层语义兴趣能有效提升基于SID的生成式推荐性能，验证了深度兴趣挖掘在生成式推荐中的价值。

title: EgoProx: Evaluating MLLMs on Egocentric 3D Proximity Reasoning Across a Cognitive Hierarchy
summary: Humans constantly reason about 3D proximity, the relations between their body and surrounding objects, to guide perception and action in daily life. Whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can perform such embodied 3D reasoning remains unclear. To this end, we introduce EgoProx, a benchmark for egocentric 3D proximity reasoning. We organize our tasks along a cognitive chain, covering intention, exploration, exploitation, and chain-of-actions reasoning. We also design an agent based data engine that produces diverse and consistent QA pairs at scale. We benchmark prevailing MLLMs on EgoProx and conduct additional analyses with dataset specific and task specific instruction tuning. We observe large cross-domain gains, indicating that current MLLMs contain some spatial knowledge; however, they still struggle to effectively leverage it for spatial reasoning VQA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EgoProx基准，用于评估多模态大模型在自我中心3D近距离推理能力，涵盖从意图到行动链的认知任务。通过数据引擎生成多样化QA对，实验表明现有MLLMs虽具备一定空间知识，但在空间推理VQA上仍存在困难。
AI.motivation: 人类在日常生活中持续推理自身与周围物体的3D近距离关系以指导感知和行动，但目前尚不清楚多模态大语言模型是否具备这种具身3D推理能力，因此需要建立相应的评估基准。
AI.method: 构建EgoProx基准，沿认知链组织任务（意图、探索、利用、行动链推理）；设计基于智能体的数据引擎以大规模生成多样化且一致的问答对；在EgoProx上评测主流MLLMs，并进行数据集特定和任务特定的指令微调分析。
AI.result: 观察到较大的跨域增益，表明当前MLLMs包含一定的空间知识；然而，模型在有效利用这些知识进行空间推理VQA方面仍存在困难。
AI.conclusion: 现有MLLMs具备部分空间知识但难以有效运用于空间推理，EgoProx基准揭示了这一能力差距，为未来提升模型的具身3D推理能力提供了方向。

title: GUI-Libra: Training Native GUI Agents to Reason and Act with Action-aware Supervision and Partially Verifiable RL
summary: Open-source native GUI agents still lag behind closed-source systems on long-horizon navigation tasks. This gap stems from two limitations: a shortage of high-quality, action-aligned reasoning data, and the direct adoption of generic post-training pipelines that overlook the unique challenges of GUI agents. We identify two fundamental issues in these pipelines: (i) standard SFT with CoT reasoning often hurts grounding, and (ii) step-wise RLVR-tyle training faces partial verifiability, where multiple actions can be correct but only a single demonstrated action is used for verification. This makes offline step-wise metrics weak predictors of online task success. In this work, we present GUI-Libra, a tailored training recipe that addresses these challenges. First, to mitigate the scarcity of action-aligned reasoning data, we introduce a data construction and filtering pipeline and release a curated 81K GUI reasoning dataset. Second, to reconcile reasoning with grounding, we propose action-aware SFT that mixes reasoning-then-action and direct-action data and reweights tokens to emphasize action and grounding. Third, to stabilize RL under partial verifiability, we identify the overlooked importance of KL regularization in RLVR and show that a KL trust region is critical for improving offline-to-online predictability; we further introduce success-adaptive scaling to downweight unreliable negative gradients. Across diverse web and mobile benchmarks, GUI-Libra consistently improves both step-wise accuracy and end-to-end task completion. Our results suggest that carefully designed post-training and data curation can unlock significantly stronger task-solving capabilities without costly online data collection. We release our dataset, code, and models to facilitate further research on data-efficient post-training for reasoning-capable GUI agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GUI-Libra，一种针对开源GUI智能体的定制化后训练方案，通过动作感知的SFT、基于KL正则化的RLVR训练以及高质量推理数据集构建，弥合了开源与闭源系统在长周期导航任务上的差距。
AI.motivation: 开源原生GUI智能体在长周期导航任务上落后于闭源系统，主要源于两个问题：缺乏高质量、与动作对齐的推理数据，以及直接套用通用后训练流程而忽视了GUI智能体的独特挑战（标准SFT+CoT会损害grounding能力，step-wise RLVR面临部分可验证性问题）。
AI.method: (1) 构建并发布81K GUI推理数据集，通过数据构造与过滤流程解决动作对齐推理数据稀缺问题；(2) 提出动作感知SFT（Action-aware SFT），混合推理-动作数据与直接动作数据，并通过token重加权强调动作和grounding；(3) 引入KL正则化作为RLVR中的信任区域，稳定部分可验证性下的离线-在线预测能力；提出成功自适应缩放（success-adaptive scaling）降低不可靠负梯度的权重。
AI.result: 在多种Web和移动端基准测试上，GUI-Libra在逐步准确率和端到端任务完成率上均有持续改进，证明精心设计的后训练和数据筛选无需昂贵的在线数据收集即可显著提升任务求解能力。
AI.conclusion: 针对GUI智能体专门设计的后训练流程（动作感知SFT + KL正则化RLVR + 高质量推理数据）能够有效缩小开源与闭源系统的差距，为数据高效的后训练提供了可行路径。

title: Resolving Ambiguity in Composed Image Retrieval via Calibrated Interaction
summary: Composed image retrieval (CIR) searches a corpus with a reference image and a text describing how to modify it. Despite rapid progress from triplet-trained compositors to zero-shot and generative methods, essentially all systems share one assumption: that a query maps to a single target, scored by Recall@K against one annotation. We argue this is fundamentally at odds with the task. A query such as make it more formal does not name an image but a region of the corpus, and which member the user intends is genuinely underdetermined. This underspecification is the root of the well-known false-negative problem and leaves current models unable to tell a precise query from an ambiguous one. We reframe CIR as calibrated intent resolution under uncertainty: a retriever is wrapped in a conformal prediction layer that returns a candidate set with a coverage guarantee and whose size is a principled measure of ambiguity; when the set is large, an expected-information-gain policy asks the single most useful clarifying question, drawn from interpretable ambiguity axes, and the set contracts. We introduce AmbiCIR, a benchmark and human-validated user simulator that revive the dormant auxiliary and dialogue annotations of CIRR and extend the multiple-positive setting of CIRCO. Across open-domain and fashion benchmarks our method matches single-turn state of the art, confirming calibrated resolution is cost-free on precise queries, while reaching the intended target in a fraction of the interaction budget required by naive conversational baselines, and it is the first to report valid coverage and calibration for the task.

AI.tldr: 本文指出组合图像检索（CIR）中查询存在内在歧义性（如"make it more formal"对应多个候选），将任务重新定义为不确定性下的校准意图解析，提出基于共形预测的检索框架，自动返回具有覆盖保证的候选集，并通过信息增益策略主动提问来缩小集合。引入AmbiCIR基准和人工验证的用户模拟器，实验表明该方法在精确查询上达到SOTA，在模糊查询上大幅优于对话基线，且首次报告了有效的覆盖率和校准性能。
AI.motivation: 现有CIR方法普遍假设一个查询映射到单一目标，并用Recall@K评估，但这忽略了查询的固有模糊性（如"make it more formal"可对应多个图像），导致假阴性问题，且模型无法区分精确查询与模糊查询。
AI.method: 将CIR重新定义为不确定性下的校准意图解析：在检索器外层包裹共形预测层，输出具有覆盖保证的候选集，候选集大小作为歧义度的原则性度量；当候选集过大时，基于期望信息增益策略从可解释的歧义轴中选择最有效的澄清问题，通过多轮交互缩小候选集。
AI.result: 在开放域和时尚基准上，该方法在单轮场景下匹配SOTA性能（证实精确查询上零成本校准），在模糊查询上以远少于朴素对话基线的交互轮次达到目标，且首次报告了任务上有效的覆盖率和校准指标。
AI.conclusion: CIR的模糊性是内在的而非异常，将任务重新定义为不确定性下的校准解析是更合理的框架；共形预测+主动澄清策略在保持精确查询性能的同时，高效处理了模糊查询，为实际部署提供了可靠的不确定性量化。

title: Phase-Type Variational Autoencoders for Heavy-Tailed Data
summary:
Heavy-tailed distributions are ubiquitous in real-world data, where rare but extreme events dominate risk and variability. However, standard Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) employ simple decoder distributions, such as Gaussian distributions, that fail to capture heavy-tailed behavior, while existing heavy-tail-aware extensions remain restricted to predefined parametric families whose tail behavior is fixed a priori. We propose the Phase-Type Variational Autoencoder (PH-VAE), whose decoder distribution is a latent-conditioned Phase-Type (PH) distribution, defined as the absorption time of a continuous-time Markov chain (CTMC). This formulation composes multiple exponential time scales, yielding a flexible and analytically tractable decoder that adapts its finite-range tail behavior directly from the observed data. Experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that PH-VAE accurately approximates diverse heavy-tailed distributions, significantly outperforming Gaussian, Student-t, and extreme-value-based VAE decoders in modeling observed tail behavior and extreme quantiles. In multivariate settings, PH-VAE captures realistic cross-dimensional tail dependence through its shared latent representation.
  To our knowledge, this is the first work to integrate Phase-Type distributions into deep generative modeling, bridging applied probability and representation learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Phase-Type变分自编码器（PH-VAE），其解码器采用基于连续时间马尔可夫链吸收时间的Phase-Type分布，通过组合多个指数时间尺度灵活建模数据中的重尾行为，在合成和真实基准上显著优于高斯、Student-t和极值分布解码器。
AI.motivation: 标准VAE使用高斯等简单解码器分布，无法捕捉真实数据中普遍存在的重尾行为；现有重尾感知扩展局限于预定义的参数化分布族，其尾部行为固定不变。
AI.method: 提出PH-VAE，其解码器分布为潜变量条件化的Phase-Type分布，定义为连续时间马尔可夫链的吸收时间；通过组合多个指数时间尺度，得到一个灵活且解析可解的解码器，能从观测数据中自适应学习有限范围内的尾部行为。
AI.result: 在合成和真实基准上，PH-VAE能精确近似多种重尾分布，在建模观测尾部行为和极端分位数方面显著优于高斯、Student-t和极值分布VAE解码器；在多变量场景中，通过共享潜表示捕获跨维度的真实尾部依赖。
AI.conclusion: 这是首次将Phase-Type分布集成到深度生成模型中，桥接了应用概率论与表示学习两个领域。

title: Where Detectors Fail: Probing Generative Space for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: Detecting AI-generated images (AIGI) remains challenging because detectors often fail to generalize to unseen generators. Although existing methods are trained on large datasets, their performance still degrades when generation settings change, indicating that data scale alone is insufficient and that limited coverage of generative variations during training is a key factor. Studies on generative model editing show that small changes in internal representations can produce diverse and meaningful image variations, many of which are not explored under standard sampling. Leveraging this insight, we propose PROBE (Probing Robustness via Boundary Exploration), a framework that improves detector generalization by actively exploring challenging regions of the generative process. Instead of treating the generator as a fixed data source, PROBE uses the detector as a critic to steer the generator through manifold-level modifications, producing realistic samples that are difficult to classify. These samples expose failure cases that are uncommon under standard data sampling strategies and are used to refine the detector. Experimental results across multiple benchmarks indicate that PROBE enhances generalization to unseen generators, resulting in more generalizable AIGI detection performance. Code and models are available at https://github.com/Amamiya-C/PROBE-AIGI-Detection

AI.tldr: 提出PROBE框架，通过主动探索生成过程中的困难区域来提升AI生成图像检测器的泛化能力，实验证明该方法能有效泛化到未见过的生成器。
AI.motivation: 现有AI生成图像检测器尽管使用大规模数据训练，但在生成设置改变时性能下降，说明数据规模本身不足以解决泛化问题，训练过程中生成变化的覆盖范围有限才是关键因素。
AI.method: PROBE框架利用检测器作为评判器，通过流形级别的修改引导生成器生成难以分类的真实样本，主动探索生成过程中的困难区域（即决策边界附近），暴露标准采样策略下不常见的失败案例，并用这些样本来优化检测器。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上，PROBE增强了对未见过的生成器的泛化能力，取得了更优的AI生成图像检测性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过主动探索生成过程的困难区域而非被动依赖固定数据源，可以有效提升检测器的泛化性能，为AIGI检测提供了新的研究思路。

title: CompassDPO: Dynamics-Controlled Direct Preference Optimization for Robust Safety Alignment
summary: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has become a standard framework for safety alignment, but its reliance on pairwise preference updates makes training sensitive to imperfect supervision. Existing robust DPO methods often address this sensitivity through global loss corrections or external data-level interventions, while largely overlooking how unreliable comparisons distort batch-level optimization dynamics. We propose CompassDPO, a reward-free DPO framework that stabilizes preference optimization through dynamics control. Using the implicit DPO reward margin as a training-time compass, CompassDPO regulates sample influence along two complementary axes: update direction and update magnitude. For directional control, it applies sparse, budgeted, and warm-up delayed loss mixing to attenuate update components that conflict with the emerging preference direction. For magnitude control, it adaptively soft-winsorizes high-loss tail contributions, reducing tail dominance while preserving useful gradients from hard examples. Both mechanisms use only signals available during standard DPO training and require no external reward model or additional supervision. Experiments on PKU-SafeRLHF across four backbones and multiple out-of-distribution safety benchmarks show that CompassDPO consistently improves robustness over vanilla DPO and strong DPO-family baselines, especially under controlled label-flip noise. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CompassDPO-4D00

AI.tldr: CompassDPO通过动态控制DPO训练中的更新方向和幅度（稀疏预算延迟损失混合+自适应软截断），在不依赖外部奖励模型的情况下提升偏好优化的鲁棒性，在PKU-SafeRLHF等基准上表现优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有鲁棒DPO方法主要依赖全局损失修正或外部数据干预，忽略了不可靠比较在批次级优化动态中造成的扭曲。作者希望提出一种无需奖励模型、仅利用DPO训练过程中已有信号的框架，从更新方向和幅度两个维度控制样本影响，从而稳定偏好优化。
AI.method: CompassDPO包含两个互补机制：(1) 方向控制——利用隐式DPO奖励边距作为"指南针"，采用稀疏、有预算且带热身延迟的损失混合，衰减与主导偏好方向冲突的更新分量；(2) 幅度控制——自适应软截断高损失尾部，减少尾部主导的同时保留难例的有用梯度。两者均仅使用标准DPO训练中的可用信号，无需外部奖励模型或额外监督。
AI.result: 在PKU-SafeRLHF数据集上，跨4种骨干网络和多个分布外安全基准测试，CompassDPO在鲁棒性上一致优于标准DPO及强DPO系列基线，尤其在受控标签翻转噪声场景下表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 通过动态控制偏好优化中样本的更新方向和幅度，可以有效缓解不可靠比较带来的训练不稳定性，且该方法不依赖外部模型，具有较好的实用性和泛化能力。

title: Tetris: Tile-level Sampling for Efficient and High-Fidelity Video Object Tracking
summary: Track materialization converts raw video into reusable object tracks that downstream queries can run against without rerunning tracking, but extracting those tracks efficiently and with high fidelity remains expensive. Prior systems reduce cost through temporal frame sampling, erasing the inter-frame motion that fine-grained tracking requires. In stationary video, however, large portions of each frame contain no objects of interest, and the remaining regions tolerate different sampling rates. We present Tetris, a track-extraction system that decomposes videos into a tile-based polyomino data model, enabling fine-grained spatiotemporal pruning that reduces detector calls with minimal fidelity loss. Tetris runs three operators upstream of the user-provided detector: a classifier identifies relevant tiles and groups them into polyominoes, an integer linear program (ILP) prunes redundant polyominoes under a user-specified accuracy constraint, and a packer assembles the survivors into canvases that minimize detector calls. Across 7 stationary-video datasets, Tetris stays within a 5% tracking accuracy loss of a full-frame, every-frame reference pipeline, whereas prior systems exceed this bound on 3 of the 7 datasets. At this 5% bound, Tetris achieves up to 17.4x higher throughput than prior systems and up to 68.8x higher than the reference pipeline. The project page is at https://tetris-db.github.io .

AI.tldr: Tetris是一种面向静态视频的磁贴式多格骨牌数据模型，通过细粒度时空剪枝在保持5%精度损失的前提下，实现最高68.8倍的吞吐量提升。
AI.motivation: 现有轨道物化系统通过时间帧采样降低成本，但会丢失帧间运动信息，难以支持细粒度跟踪；而全帧全时处理又过于昂贵。
AI.method: 将视频分解为基于磁贴的多格骨牌数据模型；由分类器识别相关磁贴并分组为多格骨牌；整数线性规划在用户指定精度约束下剪枝冗余多格骨牌；打包器将剩余磁贴组装为画布以最小化检测器调用。
AI.result: 在7个静态视频数据集上，Tetris保持在5%跟踪精度损失以内；在该边界下，吞吐量比现有系统高17.4倍，比全帧参考管线高68.8倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过细粒度时空剪枝策略，Tetris在显著降低计算成本的同时保持了跟踪高保真度，为静态视频场景下的轨道提取提供了高效解决方案。

title: Geometrically Constrained Outlier Synthesis
summary: Deep neural networks for image classification often exhibit overconfidence on out-of-distribution (OOD) samples. To address this, we introduce Geometrically Constrained Outlier Synthesis (GCOS), a training-time regularization framework aimed at improving OOD robustness during inference. GCOS addresses a limitation of prior synthesis methods by generating virtual outliers in the hidden feature space that respect the learned manifold structure of in-distribution (ID) data.
