The synthesis proceeds in two stages: (i) a dominant-variance subspace extracted from the training features identifies geometrically informed, off-manifold directions; (ii) a conformally-inspired shell, defined by the empirical quantiles of a nonconformity score from a calibration set, adaptively controls the synthesis magnitude to produce boundary samples. The shell ensures that generated outliers are neither trivially detectable nor indistinguishable from in-distribution data, facilitating smoother learning of robust features. This is combined with a contrastive regularization objective that promotes separability of ID and OOD samples in a chosen score space, such as Mahalanobis or energy-based. Experiments demonstrate that GCOS outperforms state-of-the-art methods using standard energy-based inference on near-OOD benchmarks, defined as tasks where outliers share the same semantic domain as in-distribution data. As an exploratory extension, the framework naturally transitions to conformal OOD inference, which translates uncertainty scores into statistically valid p-values and enables thresholds with formal error guarantees, providing a pathway toward more predictable and reliable OOD detection.

AI.tldr: GCOS是一种训练时正则化框架，通过在隐藏特征空间中生成几何约束的虚拟异常样本，提升图像分类模型对分布外样本的鲁棒性，并在近OOD基准上超越现有方法，同时可扩展至保形OOD推理以提供统计保证。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络在图像分类中常对分布外样本表现出过度自信，现有合成方法生成的虚拟异常样本未能尊重内在数据流形结构，导致生成的异常样本要么过于容易被检测，要么与分布内数据难以区分。
AI.method: 两阶段合成策略：(i) 从训练特征中提取主方差子空间，识别几何上合理的离流形方向；(ii) 基于校准集非一致性得分的经验分位数构建共形外壳，自适应控制合成幅度以生成边界样本。结合对比正则化目标在评分空间（如马氏距离或能量得分）中促进ID/OOD分离。
AI.result: 在近OOD基准（异常样本与分布内数据共享相同语义域的任务）上，GCOS结合标准能量推理显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: GCOS框架可自然过渡至保形OOD推理，将不确定性得分转化为具有统计有效性的p值，支持具有正式误差保证的阈值设定，为实现更可预测、更可靠的OOD检测提供了途径。

title: ControlLight: Towards Controllable, Consistent, and Generalizable Low-Light Enhancement
summary: Existing deep learning-based low-light enhancement methods are typically trained on limited datasets with single enhancement targets, which restricts their generalization ability and controllability in real-world applications. To overcome these limitations, we propose ControlLight, a controllable, consistent, and generalizable framework for low-light enhancement. We first construct a large-scale dataset of real-world degraded images with continuous illumination-strength supervision. To further ensure consistent outputs under different control strengths, we introduce a misalignment-aware weighted flow matching loss that preserves image structure across continuous enhancement strengths. ControlLight allows users to edit real-world degraded low-light images toward satisfactory enhancement results by flexibly controlling the strength while preserving visual consistency and realism. Extensive experiments show that ControlLight achieves state-of-the-art performance against existing low-light enhancement approaches while demonstrating strong continuous controllability and generalization to real-world scenarios.

AI.tldr: ControlLight 提出了一个可控、一致且泛化能力强的低光照增强框架，通过构建大规模连续光照监督数据集和引入错位感知加权流匹配损失，实现了用户可灵活控制增强强度并保持视觉一致性的新方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于深度学习的低光照增强方法在有限数据集上训练且只有单一增强目标，限制了其在真实场景中的泛化能力和可控性。
AI.method: 1) 构建了一个具有连续光照强度监督的大规模真实退化图像数据集；2) 引入错位感知加权流匹配损失，确保在不同控制强度下输出结果的一致性并保持图像结构。
AI.result: ControlLight 在低光照增强任务上达到了最先进的性能，同时展现出强大的连续可控性和对真实场景的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: ControlLight 通过灵活的强度控制和视觉一致性保持，允许用户将真实退化的低光照图像编辑到满意的增强效果，为低光照增强提供了可控、一致且泛化的解决方案。

title: Grammar of the Wave: Towards Explainable Multivariate Time Series Event Detection via Neuro-Symbolic VLM Agents
summary: Time Series Event Detection (TSED) aims to localize semantically meaningful events in time series data, with critical applications in high-stakes domains. Unlike statistical anomalies, events are often defined by natural-language descriptions with internal temporal-logic structures across multiple physical channels. However, in real-world settings, dense event annotations are expensive to obtain, making purely supervised learning difficult. We introduce Language-guided TSED, a setting where a model is given textual event descriptions and must ground them to intervals in multivariate signals with little or no labeled data. To address this problem, we propose Event Logic Tree (ELT), a knowledge representation framework that converts linguistic descriptions into structured temporal logic over signal primitives. Building on ELT, we present SELA, a neuro-symbolic VLM agent framework that iteratively grounds primitives from signal visualizations and composes them under ELT constraints, producing both event intervals and faithful tree-structured explanations. We further release a real-world benchmark across energy and climate domains with expert knowledge and annotations. Experiments show that SELA improves over supervised fine-tuning and existing zero/few-shot time series reasoning baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出语言引导的时间序列事件检测新范式，设计了ELT知识表示框架将文本描述转化为时序逻辑，并构建SELA神经符号VLM代理系统，在无/少标注条件下实现了优于监督微调和现有零样本方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 时间序列事件检测在关键领域有重要应用，但事件由自然语言定义且具有内部时序逻辑结构，而密集的事件标注成本高昂，使得纯监督学习难以落地。
AI.method: 提出Event Logic Tree (ELT)将语言描述转化为结构化时序逻辑；构建SELA神经符号VLM代理框架，迭代地从未知信号可视化中定位基元，并在ELT约束下组合，同时输出事件区间和解释树。
AI.result: 在能源和气候领域的真实基准上，SELA在零/少样本设置下优于监督微调和现有时间序列推理基线。
AI.conclusion: 语言引导的TSED范式结合ELT与SELA，有效降低了事件检测对密集标注的依赖，并在多通道信号中实现了可解释的事件定位。

title: From Contrast to Consistency: Rethinking Event-based Continuous-Time Optical Flow Estimation
summary: Estimating continuous optical flow is a fundamental yet challenging problem in dynamic visual perception. Event-based cameras, with microsecond latency and high dynamic range, capture brightness changes asynchronously, offering a unique opportunity to model motion with fine temporal precision. However, the scarcity of temporally dense ground-truth annotations limits the effectiveness of supervised learning, while contrast maximization (CM) frameworks, focused on sharpening the Image of Warped Events (IWE), often neglect temporal continuity and structural coherence, leading to distorted trajectories under complex motion. To overcome these challenges, we propose a hybrid-supervised framework for continuous-time optical flow estimation, grounded in the principle of Spatio-temporal Structural Consistency (STSC). This paradigm jointly enforces local structural stability and trajectory continuity, ensuring physically coherent motion across time. To further enhance representation and robustness, we design a bidirectionally complementary multi-scale architecture and employ a curriculum-guided hybrid training strategy, enabling a smooth transition from supervised point constraints to self-supervised manifold regularization. Comprehensive experiments across multiple benchmarks show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in both continuous-time and standard optical flow estimation, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed learning paradigm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于时空结构一致性（STSC）的混合监督框架，用于事件相机的连续时光流估计，通过局部结构稳定性和轨迹连续性约束，结合双向互补多尺度架构和课程引导训练策略，在多个基准上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 事件相机虽具有微秒级延迟和高动态范围的优势，但（1）时间密集的真值标注稀缺，限制了监督学习的有效性；（2）现有的对比度最大化（CM）方法聚焦于锐化事件折合图像（IWE），忽视了时间连续性和结构一致性，在复杂运动下会产生扭曲轨迹。
AI.method: （1）提出混合监督框架，基于时空结构一致性（STSC）原则，联合约束局部结构稳定性和轨迹连续性；（2）设计双向互补多尺度架构；（3）采用课程引导的混合训练策略，实现从监督点约束到自监督流形正则化的平滑过渡。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上，该方法在连续时光流估计和标准光流估计任务中均取得了当前最优（SOTA）性能。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的时空结构一致性学习范式有效解决了事件相机光流估计中的标注稀缺和时间连续性缺失问题，验证了混合监督框架在动态视觉感知中的优越性。

title: Disentangled Representation Learning through Unsupervised Symmetry Group Discovery
summary: Symmetry-based disentangled representation learning leverages the group structure of environment transformations to uncover the latent factors of variation. Prior approaches to symmetry-based disentanglement have required strong prior knowledge of the symmetry group's structure, or restrictive assumptions about the subgroup properties. In this work, we remove these constraints by proposing a method whereby an embodied agent autonomously discovers the group structure of its action space through unsupervised interaction with the environment. We prove the identifiability of the true symmetry group decomposition under minimal assumptions, and derive two algorithms: one for discovering the group decomposition from interaction data, and another for learning Linear Symmetry-Based Disentangled (LSBD) representations without assuming specific subgroup properties. Our method is validated on three environments exhibiting different group decompositions, where it outperforms existing LSBD approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种方法，让具身智能体通过与环境的无监督交互自主发现其动作空间的群结构，从而学习基于对称性的解缠表示，无需先验的对称群结构知识或对子群性质的限制性假设，并在三个环境上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于对称性的解缠表示学习方法要求对对称群结构有较强的先验知识，或对子群性质做出限制性假设，这限制了方法的通用性和实用性。本文旨在去除这些约束，提出一种更自主的解缠学习方法。
AI.method: 1) 证明在最小假设下真实对称群分解的可识别性；2) 提出一种从交互数据中发现群分解的算法；3) 提出一种无需特定子群性质假设即可学习线性对称解缠（LSBD）表示的算法。
AI.result: 在三种具有不同群分解的环境上进行验证，该方法在性能上优于现有的LSBD方法。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功去除了对称性解缠学习中对群结构先验知识和子群性质假设的限制，通过智能体的自主探索实现了群分解的发现与解缠表示的学习，为更通用的解缠表示学习提供了新思路。

title: AI-T2I: Aggregating-and-Isolating Cross-Attention to Diffusion Models for Text-to-Image Synthesis
comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Multimedia (2026). 13 pages, 15 figures
summary: Text-to-image synthesis has made significant progress, benefiting from the strong generative capabilities of diffusion models. However, these models struggle to achieve precise text-to-image alignment within cross-attention maps during the denoising process. Existing works primarily focus on inter-subject-token activations (i.e., cross-attention scores) overlap for different subjects, overlooking the intra-subject-token activations scattering issue for identical subjects. In this paper, we propose an Aggregating-and-Isolating cross-attention approach to diffusion models for Text-to-Image synthesis, dubbed AI-T2I. Technically, to address the scattering issue, we devise an aggregation loss to identify and consolidate the scattered intra-token activations, which implicitly helps mitigate the potential overlap issue. Upon that, an isolation loss is further introduced to push the inter-token activations apart, thus fulfilling precise text-to-image alignment. Extensive experiments on various benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of AI-T2I over the state-of-the-art works for text-to-image synthesis. Furthermore, our AI-T2I exhibits excellent generalization across other tasks, e.g., controllable layout generation and personalized generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AI-T2I方法，通过聚合损失解决扩散模型中同一主体token激活分散问题，并结合隔离损失分离不同主体token激活，从而提升文生图任务中文本-图像对齐精度。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型在文生图中存在交叉注意力对齐不精确问题，已有工作主要关注不同主体token间的激活重叠（inter-subject-token），忽略了同一主体内部token激活分散（intra-subject-token scattering）的问题。
AI.method: 提出聚合-隔离交叉注意力方法（AI-T2I）：1) 聚合损失（Aggregation Loss）用于识别并合并分散的同一主体内部token激活，同时隐式缓解潜在的重叠问题；2) 隔离损失（Isolation Loss）进一步将不同主体token的激活区域推离，实现精确的文本-图像对齐。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上，AI-T2I显著优于现有最先进方法，并在可控布局生成和个性化生成等下游任务中展现出良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过同时解决intra-token散射和inter-token重叠两个对齐问题，AI-T2I有效提升了扩散模型在文生图及扩展任务中的跨注意力对齐精度。

title: FedTreeLoRA: Reconciling Statistical and Functional Heterogeneity in Federated LoRA Fine-Tuning
summary: Federated Learning (FL) with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has become a standard for privacy-preserving LLM fine-tuning. However, existing personalized methods predominantly operated under a restrictive Flat-Model Assumption: they addressed client-side \textit{statistical heterogeneity} but treated the model as a monolithic block, ignoring the \textit{functional heterogeneity} across LLM layers. We argue that these two statistical (horizontal) and functional (vertical) dimensions, are \textit{orthogonal in source yet coupled in interaction}, implying that the optimal depth of parameter sharing is functionally dependent on client similarity. To address this, we propose \textbf{FedTreeLoRA}, a framework employing tree-structured aggregation for fine-grained, layer-wise alignment. By dynamically constructing an aggregation hierarchy, FedTreeLoRA allows clients to share broad consensus on shallow `trunks' while progressively specializing on deep `branches'. Experiments on NLU and NLG benchmarks demonstrate that FedTreeLoRA significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods by effectively reconciling generalization and personalization.

AI.tldr: FedTreeLoRA提出树形聚合框架，通过分层对齐解决联邦学习中统计异质性与功能异质性的耦合问题，在NLU/NLG基准上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有个性化联邦学习方法仅关注客户端间的统计异质性（水平维度），忽略了LLM各层间的功能异质性（垂直维度），而这两个维度正交但耦合，最优参数共享深度依赖于客户端相似度，现有方法无法有效处理这一双重异质性。
AI.method: 提出FedTreeLoRA框架，采用树形聚合结构实现细粒度、逐层对齐：动态构建聚合层次，客户端在浅层"树干"共享广泛共识，在深层"树枝"逐步专业化。
AI.result: 在NLU和NLG基准上，FedTreeLoRA显著优于现有最先进方法，有效平衡了泛化与个性化。
AI.conclusion: 联邦学习中的统计异质性与功能异质性需要协同处理，树形分层聚合是解决这一双重异质性的有效范式。

title: MuNet: A Mutualistic Network for Joint 3D Human Mesh Recovery and 3D Clothed Human Reconstruction from Single Images
summary: 3D human mesh recovery and 3D clothed human reconstruction are inherently related, yet they have long been studied in isolation, thereby overlooking the potential gains of joint optimization. To overcome this limitation, we propose to address these two tasks within a unified framework, which allows their mutual dependencies to be effectively exploited. Building on this idea, we propose MuNet, a mutualistic network for joint 3D human mesh recovery and 3D clothed human reconstruction from single images. First, we adopt 2-manifold graphs as a unified representation for all 3D models, enabling consistent modeling across 3D human mesh recovery and clothed human reconstruction. Second, we design an end-to-end graph convolutional network that progressively deforms an initial graph into a 3D human mesh and refines it into a detailed 3D clothed human model. Third, we introduce a mutualistic mechanism that allows reciprocal interaction between the two tasks {during training}, where 3D human mesh recovery provides guidance for 3D clothed human reconstruction, and reconstruction feedback refines the 3D human mesh recovery. We extensively evaluate MuNet on six benchmark datasets for 3D human mesh recovery and 3D clothed human reconstruction, including Human3.6M, 3DPW, MPI-INF-3DHP, THuman2.0, CAPE, and RenderPeople. Experimental results demonstrate that MuNet achieves state-of-the-art performance on both tasks across all datasets. The code of MuNet is released for research purposes at https://github.com/starVisionTeam/MuNet.

AI.tldr: MuNet是一个统一框架，通过互惠机制联合优化3D人体网格恢复和3D穿着衣物人体重建，在六个基准数据集上均达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 3D人体网格恢复和3D穿着衣物人体重建本质相关，但长期被孤立研究，忽视了联合优化的潜在收益。
AI.method: 1) 采用2-流形图作为统一表示；2) 设计端到端图卷积网络，逐步变形初始图为3D人体网格并细化至穿着衣物人体模型；3) 引入互惠机制，使两个任务在训练中相互交互：网格恢复指导重建，重建反馈优化网格恢复。
AI.result: 在Human3.6M、3DPW、MPI-INF-3DHP、THuman2.0、CAPE、RenderPeople六个基准数据集上，两个任务均达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: 联合优化3D人体网格恢复和穿着衣物人体重建是有效的，互惠机制能充分利用两个任务之间的相互依赖关系。

title: Beyond Linearity in Attention Projections: The Case for Nonlinear Queries
comment: Accepted at the ICLR 2026 GRaM workshop: https://openreview.net/forum?id=pwdnneFiNZ#discussion
summary: Recent algebraic analysis shows that in decoder-only and encoder-only transformers, the Query projection $W_Q$ may be set to identity without noticeable performance deterioration. This is possible because attention depends on $X$ only through the products $XW_Q, XW_K, XW_V$, allowing basis transformations to be absorbed by adjacent layers and propagated through the network. We replace $W_Q \in \R^{d \times d}$ with a nonlinear residual of the form $Q(X) = X + f_θ(X)$, where $f_θ$ is a bottleneck MLP with $d^2 + O(d)$ parameters. The identity term anchors the nonlinearity to a known-good prior. Experiments on GPT-3 small style models show consistent improvement over the baseline ($2.40\%$ lower validation log-loss, $6.81\%$ lower perplexity), comfortably outperforming a model with 12.5\% more non-embedding parameters. These results motivate investigation at larger scales and across modalities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用非线性残差 $Q(X)=X+f_\theta(X)$ 替代标准 Transformer 中的 Query 投影 $W_Q$，其中 $f_\theta$ 为瓶颈 MLP。实验表明该方法在 GPT-3 small 风格模型上持续优于基线（验证 log-loss 降低 2.40%，困惑度降低 6.81%），甚至超过多 12.5% 非嵌入参数的大模型。
AI.motivation: 代数分析表明 decoder-only 和 encoder-only transformer 中 Query 投影 $W_Q$ 可设为恒等映射而不显著影响性能，这启发作者利用该空间探索更高效的 Query 投影设计。
AI.method: 将 $W_Q \in \R^{d \times d}$ 替换为非线性残差 $Q(X) = X + f_\theta(X)$，其中 $f_\theta$ 是参数量为 $d^2+O(d)$ 的瓶颈 MLP。恒等项 $X$ 将非线性锚定在已知的优良先验上。
AI.result: 在 GPT-3 small 风格模型上，验证 log-loss 降低 2.40%，困惑度降低 6.81%，且性能优于参数量多 12.5% 的基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在较小规模上有效，值得在大规模模型及其他模态上进一步探索。

title: Global Structure-from-Motion Meets Feedforward Reconstruction
summary: Structure-from-Motion -- the process of simultaneously estimating camera poses and 3D scene structure from a collection of images -- remains a central challenge in computer vision, with many open problems yet to be solved. Recent advances in feedforward 3D reconstruction have made significant strides in overcoming persistent failure cases of classical SfM methods, particularly in scenarios characterized by low texture, limited overlap, and symmetries. However, while feedforward approaches excel in these challenging conditions, they often face limitations regarding scalability, accuracy, or robustness, and typically fall short of classical methods in standard reconstruction settings. In this work, we systematically analyze these limitations and propose a new Structure-from-Motion pipeline by combining the respective strengths of classical and feedforward methods. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets show the benefits of our approach, achieving state-of-the-art results across a wide range of scenarios. We share our system as an open-source implementation at https://github.com/colmap/gluemap.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合经典SfM方法与前馈式3D重建方法优势的新型SfM流水线，在多种场景下达到了最先进水平，并开源了实现代码。
AI.motivation: 经典SfM方法在低纹理、弱重叠和对称场景中容易失败，而前馈式方法虽在这些困难场景中表现出色，但在标准重建场景中在可扩展性、精度或鲁棒性方面存在局限。本文旨在系统分析这些局限，并取长补短，构建一个能广泛适用且性能优越的SfM系统。
AI.method: 提出一种新的SfM流水线，系统性地融合经典SfM方法与前馈式3D重建方法的各自优势，在困难的低纹理/弱重叠/对称场景中利用前馈方法的强项，在标准场景中保留经典方法的高精度和可扩展性。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上进行大量实验，表明该方法在广泛的重建场景中达到了最先进的结果。
AI.conclusion: 经典方法与前馈方法的有效结合能够克服各自固有局限，实现跨场景的鲁棒、精确且可扩展的SfM重建，开源实现有助于推动该领域的发展。

title: Flow Matching Policy Optimization with Mirror Descent and Entropy Constraints
summary: Balancing policy expressiveness with the exploration-exploitation trade-off is a core challenge in online Reinforcement Learning (RL). While Stochastic Differential Equation (SDE)-based diffusion policies can represent complex, multimodal action distributions, they suffer from two critical limitations: their stochastic reverse processes render entropy intractable (necessitating heuristic exploration), and computing policy gradients through long denoising chains is expensive and unstable. In this work, we show that ODE-based flow matching inherently resolves these issues by enabling both simulation-free policy optimization and tractable entropy computation. Building on this, we introduce Flow Matching Policy Optimization with Mirror Descent and Entropy Constraints (FMER). Our framework exploits this insight in three ways. First, we theoretically establish that minimizing an advantage-weighted conditional flow matching loss acts as a simulation-free surrogate for policy mirror descent. This steers the velocity field toward high-value regions while entirely avoiding backpropagation through the ODE solver. Second, we derive an analytic entropy objective that corrects for the density distortion caused by the $\tanh$ transformation (mapping an unbounded latent space to bounded actions), thereby facilitating principled maximum-entropy optimization. Finally, we dynamically tune the mirror descent temperature based on the effective sample size to enforce a robust trust region during training. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that FMER achieves superior performance on the challenging sparse-reward FrankaKitchen environment, while maintaining competitive results across standard dense-reward MuJoCo benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于流匹配的策略优化框架FMER，通过ODE流匹配替代SDE扩散策略，解决了熵不可计算和反向传播昂贵的问题，在稀疏奖励任务中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有基于SDE的扩散策略存在两个关键缺陷：随机逆过程导致熵不可计算（需启发式探索），且通过长去噪链计算策略梯度昂贵且不稳定。本文旨在利用ODE流匹配从根本上解决这些问题。
AI.method: 1) 理论证明优势加权条件流匹配损失可作为策略镜像下降的无模拟替代，避免通过ODE求解器反向传播；2) 推导解析熵目标，修正tanh变换导致的密度扭曲，实现有原则的最大熵优化；3) 基于有效样本量动态调节镜像下降温度以强制执行鲁棒的信任区域。
AI.result: 在稀疏奖励的FrankaKitchen环境中取得优异性能，在标准密集回报的MuJoCo基准上保持竞争性结果。
AI.conclusion: 基于ODE的流匹配策略能够同时实现无模拟策略优化和可计算的熵，FMER框架通过三项技术贡献有效提升了在线强化学习中策略表达性与探索-利用权衡的表现。

title: Diet Your LLM: Dimension-wise Global Pruning of LLMs via Merging Task-specific Importance Score
comment: 14 pages, 10 figures. Code available at https://github.com/Jimmy145123/DIET
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities, but their massive scale poses significant challenges for practical deployment. Structured pruning offers a promising solution by removing entire dimensions or layers, yet existing methods face critical trade-offs: task-agnostic approaches cannot adapt to task-specific requirements, while task-aware methods require costly training to learn task adaptability. We propose DIET (Dimension-wise global pruning of LLMs via merging Task-wise importance scores), a training-free structured pruning method that combines dimension-level granularity with task-aware selection. DIET profiles activation magnitudes across tasks using only 100 samples per task, then applies majority voting to construct a single global mask. DIET does not require large costs from pre-computation or training. Experiments on seven zero-shot benchmarks using Gemma-2 2B and 9B models demonstrate the effectiveness of DIET; for example, at 20% sparsity on Gemma-2 2B, DIET achieves near 10% average accuracy improvement, compared to previous state-of-the-art structured pruning methods. This advantage persists across various sparsity levels and model scales, positioning DIET as a practical and robust choice for structured LLM pruning.

AI.tldr: 提出DIET方法，一种无需训练的结构化剪枝方法，通过跨任务维度重要性评分融合与多数投票生成全局掩码，在Gemma-2模型上以20%稀疏度实现近10%的平均准确率提升。
AI.motivation: 现有结构化剪枝方法存在关键权衡：任务无关方法无法适应特定任务需求，而任务感知方法需要昂贵的训练来学习任务适应性。需要一种兼顾维度级细粒度与任务感知性且无需训练的方法。
AI.method: DIET (Dimension-wise global pruning of LLMs via merging Task-wise importance scores)：使用每任务仅100个样本分析激活幅度，通过多数投票构建单一全局掩码，无需预计算或训练。
AI.result: 在Gemma-2 2B和9B模型的七个零样本基准上，20%稀疏度下DIET相比此前最优结构化剪枝方法实现近10%平均准确率提升，且优势在不同稀疏度和模型规模下保持一致。
AI.conclusion: DIET作为一种无需训练的结构化LLM剪枝方法，兼具维度级细粒度和任务感知性，实用且鲁棒，为结构化剪枝提供了有效的新方案。

title: Understanding the Challenges in Iterative Generative Optimization with LLMs
summary: Generative optimization uses large language models (LLMs) to iteratively improve artifacts (such as code, workflows or prompts) using execution feedback. It is a promising approach to building self-improving agents, yet in practice remains brittle: despite active research, only 9% of surveyed agents used any automated optimization. We argue that this brittleness arises because, to set up a learning loop, an engineer must make ``hidden'' design choices: What can the optimizer edit and what is the "right" learning evidence to provide at each update? We investigate three factors that affect most applications: the starting artifact, the credit horizon for execution traces, and batching trials and errors into learning evidence. Through case studies in MLAgentBench, Atari, and BigBench Extra Hard, we find that these design decisions can determine whether generative optimization succeeds, yet they are rarely made explicit in prior work. Different starting artifacts determine which solutions are reachable in MLAgentBench, truncated traces can still improve Atari agents, and larger minibatches do not monotonically improve generalization on BBEH. We conclude that the lack of a simple, universal way to set up learning loops across domains is a major hurdle for productionization and adoption. We provide practical guidance for making these choices.

AI.tldr: 本文研究生成式优化（Generative Optimization）中工程师必须做出的隐性设计选择（起始工件、信用跨度、批处理策略）对优化成功与否的决定性影响，并通过三个案例验证这些因素的重要性，指出缺乏统一的跨领域学习循环设置方式是生产化推广的主要障碍。
AI.motivation: 尽管生成式优化是构建自我改进智能体的有前景方法，但在实践中仍然脆弱（仅9%的智能体使用了自动优化），原因是工程师在设置学习循环时必须做出未被充分研究的隐性设计选择。
AI.method: 系统研究了三个关键因素：起始工件、执行轨迹的信用跨度、以及将试验和错误批处理为学习证据的方式；通过在MLAgentBench、Atari和BigBench Extra Hard三个案例中进行实验验证。
AI.result: 不同起始工件决定了MLAgentBench中可达的解空间；截断的执行轨迹仍可改进Atari智能体；更大尺寸的minibatch并不会单调提升BBEH上的泛化性能。
AI.conclusion: 缺乏简单、通用的跨领域学习循环设置方式是生成式优化生产化和推广的主要障碍，并提供了应对这些设计选择的实践指导。

title: Grokking or Glitching? How Low-Precision Drives Slingshot Loss Spikes
comment: 28 pages, 13 figures; ICML 2026 Workshop on High-dimensional Learning Dynamics (Spotlight)
summary: Deep neural networks exhibit periodic loss spikes during unregularized long-term training, a phenomenon known as the "Slingshot Mechanism." Existing work usually attributes this to intrinsic optimization dynamics, but its triggering mechanism remains unclear. This paper proves that this phenomenon is a result of floating-point arithmetic precision limits. As training enters a high-confidence stage, the difference between the correct-class logit and the other logits may exceed the absorption-error threshold. Then during backpropagation, the gradient of the correct class is rounded exactly to zero, while the gradients of the incorrect classes remain nonzero. This breaks the zero-sum constraint of gradients across classes and introduces a systematic drift in the parameter update of the classifier layer. We prove that this drift forms a positive feedback loop with the feature, causing the global classifier mean and the global feature mean to grow exponentially. We call this mechanism Numerical Feature Inflation (NFI). This mechanism explains the rapid norm growth before a Slingshot spike, the subsequent reappearance of gradients, and the resulting loss spike. We further show that NFI is not equivalent to an observed loss spike: in more practical tasks, partial absorption may not produce visible spikes, but it can still break the zero-sum constraint and drive rapid growth of parameter norms. Our results reinterpret Slingshot as a numerical dynamic of finite-precision training, and provide a testable explanation for abnormal parameter growth and logit divergence in late-stage training.

AI.tldr: 本文证明深度神经网络训练中的"弹弓机制"（周期性损失尖峰）是由浮点数精度限制导致的数值现象。当模型进入高置信度阶段，正确类别的logit与其他logits的差值超过吸收误差阈值时，正确类别的梯度在反向传播中被精确舍入为零，而错误类别的梯度保持非零，破坏了梯度零和约束，引发分类器参数更新的系统漂移。这种漂移与特征形成正反馈，导致全局分类器均值和特征均值指数增长，最终引发损失尖峰。部分吸收情况下虽不产生可见尖峰，但仍会破坏零和约束并导致参数范数快速增长。
AI.motivation: 已有研究将弹弓机制归因于优化动力学本身，但其触发机制尚不明确。本文旨在揭示这一现象的真正成因。
AI.method: 理论证明与数值分析：从浮点数精度限制出发，分析梯度吸收误差对反向传播的影响，建立正反馈模型解释参数与特征的指数增长。
AI.result: 证明弹弓机制是有限精度训练的数值动力学现象；提出数值特征膨胀（NFI）机制；阐明完全吸收与部分吸收的不同影响。
AI.conclusion: 重新解释了弹弓机制的本质，为训练后期异常参数增长和logit发散提供了可检验的解释。

title: CUDABeaver: Benchmarking LLM-Based Automated CUDA Debugging
summary: Debugging CUDA programs has long been challenging because failures often arise from subtle interactions among hardware behavior, compiler decisions, memory hierarchy, and asynchronous execution. More importantly, with the rapid expansion of GPU usage across scientific computing, machine learning, graphics, and systems workloads, CUDA debugging has become more challenging than ever. Current evaluations of LLM-based CUDA programming largely miss this setting: a model can pass correctness tests with repair by degeneration, simplifying the CUDA code into a safer but slower program that abandons the original optimization structure. We introduce CUDABEAVER, a benchmark for CUDA debugging from real failing workspaces produced during LLM-based CUDA generation. Each task provides the broken candidate, native build/test commands, raw error evidence, and a single editable file. CUDABEAVER evaluates whether a fixer truly repairs the failing CUDA code or merely finds a slower test-passing replacement, reporting results by failure category, debugging trajectory, stagnation mode, and performance preservation. We further propose pass@k(M,C,A), a protocol-conditional CUDA debugging metric by making the fixer M, corpus C, and protocol axes Aexplicit. Using this metric across 213 tasks and seven frontier LLMs, we show that protocol-aware evaluation gives a more faithful view of CUDA debugging ability: when performance-loss tolerance is high, fixers appear much stronger, but even a minor stricter performance requirement can sharply reduce measured success, shifting scores by up to 40 percentage points.

AI.tldr: CUDABEAVER是一个针对CUDA调试的基准测试，包含213个真实的失败工作区任务。它提出了协议条件式的CUDA调试指标pass@k(M,C,A)，揭示了在性能损失容忍度变化时，LLM修复器的成功得分可波动高达40个百分点。
AI.motivation: CUDA程序调试因硬件、编译器、内存层次和异步执行的复杂交互而极具挑战性。现有的LLM代码生成评估忽略了一个关键问题：模型可能通过"退化性修复"（简化代码、放弃优化结构）来通过正确性测试，导致性能下降。
AI.method: 构建包含真实失败工作区的CUDABEAVER基准（213个任务），每个任务提供破损代码、构建/测试命令、错误证据和可编辑文件。提出pass@k(M,C,A)协议条件式指标，明确区分修复器M、语料库C和协议轴A（性能损失容忍度）。
AI.result: 对7个前沿LLM的评估显示：协议感知的评估更真实反映CUDA调试能力；高性能损失容忍度下修复器表现较强，但即使轻微收紧性能要求也会显著降低成功率，得分波动幅度可达40个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 现有评估方法高估了LLM在CUDA调试中的实际能力，引入性能约束指标至关重要，CUDABEAVER和pass@k(M,C,A)为更真实的CUDA调试能力评估提供了框架。

title: BrainDINO: A Brain MRI Foundation Model for Generalizable Clinical Representation Learning
summary: Brain MRI underpins a wide range of neuroscientific and clinical applications, yet most learning-based methods remain task-specific and require substantial labeled data. Here we show that a single self-supervised representation can generalize across heterogeneous brain MRI endpoints. We trained BrainDINO, a self-distilled foundation model, on approximately 6.6 million unlabeled axial slices from 20 datasets encompassing broad variation in population, disease, and acquisition setting. Using a frozen encoder with lightweight task heads, BrainDINO supported transfer across tumor segmentation, neurodegenerative and neurodevelopmental conditions classification, brain age estimation, post-stroke temporal prediction, molecular status prediction, MRI sequence classification, and survival modeling. Across tasks and supervision regimes, BrainDINO consistently equaled or exceeded natural-image and MRI-specific self-supervised baselines, with particularly strong advantages under label scarcity. Representation analyses further showed anatomically organized and pathology-sensitive feature structure in the absence of task-specific supervision. Our findings indicate that large-scale slice-wise self-supervised learning can yield a unified brain MRI representation that supports diverse neuroimaging tasks without volumetric pretraining or full-network fine-tuning, establishing a scalable foundation for robust and data-efficient brain imaging analysis. Code is available at https://github.com/mclwu22/BrainDINO

AI.tldr: BrainDINO是一个自蒸馏基础模型，在约660万张未标记脑部轴向切片上训练，通过冻结编码器配合轻量任务头，在多种脑MRI任务（肿瘤分割、神经退行性疾病分类、脑龄估计等）中达到或超越现有基线，尤其在标签稀缺场景下表现优异，无需体素级预训练或全网络微调即可实现统一的脑MRI表征。
AI.motivation: 现有基于学习的脑MRI分析方法多为任务特定且依赖大量标注数据，缺乏能跨多种脑MRI任务泛化的统一表征模型，作者旨在探索大规模自监督学习能否产生通用的脑MRI基础表征。
AI.method: 采用自蒸馏（self-distillation）框架，在20个数据集约660万张未标记轴向切片上进行预训练；下游任务使用冻结编码器配合轻量任务头（linear probing或轻量微调），无需体素级预训练或全网络微调。
AI.result: BrainDINO在肿瘤分割、神经退行性与神经发育分类、脑龄估计、脑卒中后时间预测、分子状态预测、MRI序列分类及生存建模等多项任务中，一致达到或超越自然图像与MRI特定自监督基线，在标签稀缺条件下优势尤为显著；表征分析显示其特征结构具有解剖组织性和病理敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 大规模切片级自监督学习能够产生统一的脑MRI表征，支持多样化神经影像学任务，为鲁棒且数据高效的脑影像分析提供了可扩展的基础方案。

title: Identifiable Token Correspondence for World Models
summary: Token-based transformer world models have shown strong performance in visual reinforcement learning, but often suffer from temporal inconsistency in long-horizon rollouts, including object duplication, disappearance, and transmutation. A key reason is that most existing approaches treat next-frame prediction purely as a token generation problem, without considering the persistence of tokens across time. We introduce Identifiable Token Correspondence (ITC), a decoding step for token-based transformer world models that formulates next-frame prediction as a structured assignment problem with latent token correspondence variables: each next-frame token is explained either by copying a token from the previous frame or by generating a new one. ITC leaves the transformer architecture and training procedure unchanged and can be added on top of existing backbones. Our experiments show state-of-the-art performance on 4 challenging benchmarks. The proposed method achieves a return of 72.5% and a score of 35.6% on the Craftax-classic benchmark, significantly surpassing the previous best of 67.4% and 27.9%. We release our source code on https://github.com/snu-mllab/Identifiable-Token-Correspondence.

AI.tldr: 提出可识别Token对应关系(ITC)，通过将下一帧预测建模为结构化分配问题（含潜在token对应变量），解决基于token的transformer世界模型在长程 rollout 中的时间不一致性问题，在4个基准上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有基于token的transformer世界模型在长程 rollout 中存在严重的时间不一致性（物体重复、消失、变形），根本原因是当前方法将下一帧预测纯粹视为token生成问题，忽略了token在时间维度上的持久性。
AI.method: 提出Identifiable Token Correspondence (ITC)，将下一帧预测形式化为一个结构化分配问题，引入潜在token对应变量：每个下一帧token要么从上一帧复制，要么生成新token。ITC不改变transformer架构和训练流程，可作为即插即用模块添加到现有骨干网络上。
AI.result: 在4个挑战性基准上达到SOTA。在Craftax-classic基准上，回报率达72.5%，得分35.6%，显著超越此前最佳（67.4%和27.9%）。
AI.conclusion: ITC通过引入token时间对应机制，在不改动现有模型架构的前提下有效解决了世界模型的时间不一致性问题，显著提升了长程视觉强化学习任务的表现。

title: AMARIS: A Memory-Augmented Rubric Improvement System for Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning
summary: Rubric-based reward shaping provides interpretable and editable reward signals for fine-tuning LLMs via reinforcement learning (RL), but existing adaptive rubric methods typically update criteria from local evidence such as the current batch or instance-level comparisons. This local view discards diagnostic information produced during training, making it difficult to track recurring failures, evaluate previous rubric edits, or raise standards once earlier criteria become saturated. We introduce AMARIS, A Memory-Augmented Rubric Improvement System that grounds rubric updates in longitudinal training evidence. AMARIS stores rollout analyses, step-level summaries, and rubric update records in a persistent evaluation memory, then retrieves recent and semantically relevant history to revise rubrics. We evaluate AMARIS across science, medicine, instruction following, and creative writing under both global and instance-specific rubric settings. AMARIS improves over static, local-adaptive, and memory-ablated baselines, such as +2.8 points on GPQA-Diamond and +2.2 points on IFBench over the strongest baselines, while analysis shows that memory reduces oscillatory rubric edits and supports a progression from early failure correction to later curriculum advancement. AMARIS runs asynchronously alongside the normal RL loop, reducing blocking latency relative to synchronous rubric updates.

AI.tldr: AMARIS是一个基于记忆增强的评分标准改进系统，通过存储和分析训练过程中的纵向证据（包括轨迹分析、步骤级摘要和更新记录），动态优化用于强化学习微调LLM的评分标准，在多个任务上显著优于静态和局部自适应基线。
AI.motivation: 现有自适应评分标准方法仅基于当前批次或实例级比较等局部证据更新准则，丢弃了训练过程中产生的诊断信息，导致难以追踪重复失败、评估历史编辑效果以及在早期标准饱和后提升要求。
AI.method: AMARIS将轨迹分析、步骤级摘要和评分标准更新记录存入持久化评估记忆，检索近期和语义相关的历史信息来修订评分标准，并作为异步模块与正常RL循环并行运行。
AI.result: 在科学、医学、指令遵循和创意写作任务中，AMARIS在全局和实例级评分标准设置下均优于静态、局部自适应和消融记忆的基线，如GPQA-Diamond提升2.8分、IFBench提升2.2分。记忆机制减少了振荡性编辑，支持从早期失败修正到后期课程进阶的演进。
AI.conclusion: 基于记忆增强的纵向证据整合是提升评分标准自适应性的有效范式，且异步设计减少了同步更新带来的阻塞延迟。

title: FLUIDSPLAT: Reconstructing Physical Fields from Sparse Sensors via Gaussian Primitives
summary: Reconstructing continuous flow fields from sparse surface-mounted sensors is central to aerodynamic design, flow control, and digital-twin instrumentation. Existing neural methods for this task typically encode sensor readings into implicit latent codes with little spatial interpretability and limited formal guidance on how representational capacity should scale with observation count. Inspired by 3D Gaussian Splatting, we introduce FLUIDSPLAT, a sensor-conditioned model that predicts K anisotropic Gaussian primitives forming a partition-of-unity scaffold, a spatially explicit and interpretable intermediate representation of the flow. For an idealized Gaussian primitive estimator, we prove an $O(K^{-s/d})$ approximation rate for fields with Sobolev smoothness $s$; incorporating $N$ noisy observations yields a squared-risk decomposition with bias $O(K^{-2s/d})$ and variance $O(σ^{2}K/N)$.Balancing the two yields $K^{*}\!\sim\!(N/σ^{2})^{d/(2s+d)}$: primitive count cannot grow freely under sparse sensing, revealing a variance bottleneck that motivates complementing the scaffold with a state-conditioned residual decoder. Across four benchmarks spanning 2D and 3D, FLUIDSPLAT achieves 11-28% error reduction over several strong baselines on cylinder flow, AirfRANS, FlowBench LDC-3D, and PhySense-Car 3D benchmarks.

AI.tldr: FLUIDSPLAT是一种受3D高斯泼溅启发的传感器条件流场重建模型，通过预测K个各向异性高斯基元形成空间可解释的中间表示，并证明了其逼近率与感知误差的理论界，在四个基准上实现11-28%的误差降低。
AI.motivation: 现有基于神经网络的流场重建方法将传感器读数编码为隐式潜码，缺乏空间可解释性，且关于表示能力应如何随观测数量扩展缺乏理论指导。
AI.method: 受3D高斯泼溅启发，FLUIDSPLAT预测K个各向异性高斯基元形成单位分解（partition-of-unity）支架作为空间显式且可解释的中间表示；理论分析给出了Sobolev光滑度s下的逼近率O(K^{-s/d})及含噪声观测下的偏差-方差权衡；引入状态条件残差解码器以缓解稀疏感知下的方差瓶颈。
AI.result: 在圆柱绕流、AirfRANS、FlowBench LDC-3D和PhySense-Car 3D四个基准上，相比多个强基线方法实现11-28%的误差降低。
AI.conclusion: FLUIDSPLAT通过空间显式的高斯基元表示和理论引导的残差解码器设计，在稀疏传感器条件下实现了更优的流场重建性能，揭示了基元数量在稀疏感知下的方差瓶颈并提供了有效的缓解策略。

title: A Sharper Picture of Generalization in Transformers
comment: 10 pages, 9 figures, 41 pages of supplementary material
summary: We study transformers' generalization behavior on boolean domains from the perspective of the Fourier spectra of their target functions. In contrast to prior work (Edelman et al., 2022; Trauger & Tosh, 2024), which derived generalization bounds from Rademacher complexity, we investigate the feasibility of obtaining generalization bounds via PAC-Bayes theory. We show that sparse spectra concentrated on low-degree components enable low-sharpness constructions with good generalization properties. Our idea is to show the existence of flat minima implementing any boolean function of sparsity no greater than the context length, and then apply a PAC-Bayes bound to an idealized low-sharpness learner, resulting in a non-vacuous generalization bound. We use this to give a formal account of why chain-of-thought improves generalization for high-degree target functions, and show that the complexity parameters in our bound can be efficiently estimated via property testing. We evaluate predictions empirically and conduct a mechanistic interpretability study to support the realism of our theoretical construction in real transformers.

AI.tldr: 本文通过PAC-Bayes理论研究了Transformer在布尔域上的泛化行为，证明了稀疏低阶傅里叶谱可实现平坦极小值并得到非空泛化界，解释了链式思维如何改善高阶目标函数的泛化，并通过实验和机械可解释性研究验证了理论。
AI.motivation: 现有工作（Edelman等，2022；Trauger & Tosh，2024）基于Rademacher复杂度给出了Transformer的泛化界，但该方法忽略了优化过程的影响。作者希望从PAC-Bayes视角出发，利用平坦极小值的性质，探索能否得到更紧、非空的泛化上界。
AI.method: 1) 证明对于任意稀疏度不超过上下文长度的布尔函数，存在平坦极小值（flat minima）可实现该函数；2) 对理想化的低锐度（low-sharpness）学习器应用PAC-Bayes界，得到非空泛化保证；3) 通过性质测试（property testing）高效估计复杂度参数；4) 进行实验和机械可解释性分析验证理论构造的现实性。
AI.result: 获得了非空的PAC-Bayes泛化界；形式上解释了链式思维（chain-of-thought）为何能改善高阶目标函数的泛化；证明了复杂度参数可通过性质测试高效估计；实验支持了理论构造在真实Transformer中的合理性。
AI.conclusion: Transformer的泛化能力可从傅里叶谱的稀疏性和低阶性角度理解，PAC-Bayes框架为此提供了有力工具，链式思维的有效性可归因于其对目标函数阶数的约简。
